bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbya ra'i sgra dbyangs/shar yulaphunatshogasatshe ring gisabartsams/mirigasadaposkrun khang/

dpe skrun gsal bshad/〈bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbya ra'i sgra dbyangs 〉zhes bya ba 'di nyid ni mkhas dbang shar yul phun tshogs tshe ring mchog nas rtsom bris gnang ba'i bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus khungs btsan kha gsal zhig red 'dug pa 'dis bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus la zhib 'jug dang / rgyus lon/ de bzhin slob sbyong bcas gnang mkhan tshor bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kha tshang lta bde zhig mkho 'don gnang 'dugagazhan yang deb ther 'di'i nang lo rgyus deb ther khag las lung drangs pa'i ma yig mang tsam yod pa de dag khrod dag 'bri'i thad deng sang gi 'bri stangasadang mi mthun pa dper na/ u ru su la ngo rgol dang / ngo gol/ ngo go'i/ ngo rgo'i/ ngo go/ ngo gos sogs bris 'dug pa de dag dang / da dung cung mi 'dra ba'i nang don dum bu 'ga' re yod pa de dag kyang lo rgyus ngo ma mtshon ched ma bcos par rang sor bzhag yod pa phud/ gzhan dpe deb nang e she ya dang / bsko bzhag khag cig nyin du lta bu'i dag 'bri khag gcig e sha ya dang / bsko gzhag khag gcig nyin rdu sogs su gcig gyur gyis dag bcos zhu khul byas yod pas de thad rgya che'i mkhas dbang rnam pa dang /klog pa po lhan rgyas nas dbye zhib kyis nor 'dzol song rigs yod tshe kun slong dge ba'i nor bcos bka' slob lhug rtsol yong ba'i re ba dang bcas/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pas/2༷༷/lo'i zla 11par/

sngon 'gro'i gtam/〈bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbru ra'i sgra dbyangs 〉zhes bya ba ni rang nyid kyis bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus zhib 'jug byed pa'i don gnad dang gal che khag dang / 〈tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i rnam thar rin phreng 〉dang /〈bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/〉 〈deb ther kunagasal me long 〉sogs dpyad gzhi'i lo rgyus yig tshags khag la gzhigs te tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang / rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes/ stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab sogs kyi dus skabs su byung ba'i bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus te dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs par ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug thengs khag gnyis dang / rdo rje g.yib sogs u ru su'i gsang myul bod du 'ongs pa/ krang dbyin thang gis bod don dag ther byas pa'i skor/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho rgya gar sogs la bros byol phebs pa/sim la'i gros tshogs zer ba'i skor/ bod sa gnas srid 'dzin byed thabs gsar pa 'ga' zhig sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags sogs kyi gnas babs skor/ lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal sogs la nyes chad phog pa/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis hong rma'o sung dmigs bsal bod du mngags pa'i skor/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang se ra dgon gyi dmag 'khrug skor/ rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkrongs pa'i skor/ rgya che'i e sha ya'i tshogs 'du zer ba/ bod kyi tshong don tshogs pa sogs gong gsal lo rgyus don gnad 'di dag gi thog nas bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ni nang bkra ma shes na/ phyi spyan

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/mi 'grub zer ba'i gna' dpe ltar/ bgegs rkyen bar chad mang bas bod kyi dbang bsgyur pa'i dbar srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod mngon gsal dod pa dang / g.yo thabs che ba/ rno ngar che ba bcas su gyur/ de bzhin phyi'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul sogs gal 'gangs ha cang che ba'i lo rgyus kyi don chen zhig yin pa gsal por rtogs thub/ lhag par du skabs de'i don rkyen khag tu dngos su zhugs myong ba'i ser skya dpon rigs mang po dang yun ring mnyam las byed pa'i ring khong rnam pas lo rgyus don dngos kyi zhib gsal gnas tshul mang po zhig sba gsang med par mtshams sbyor gnang ba dang / de mtshungs don rkyen de dag skor 'khod pa'i rgya bod dpyad gzhi'i yig tshags mang por lo mang ring zhib 'jug gzab nan zhus te rgya che'i klog pa po dang / khyad par du blo ldan gzhon nu rnams la bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus dngos tshul gsal zhing rtogs par phan pa cung zad yong ched deb chung 'di rtsom sgrig zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang rang nyid kyi chab srid dang /lo rgyus shes bya sogs dman pas nor 'khrul yong nges la mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du rgya che'i klog pa pos skyon brjod dang bka' slob 'dzems med yod par 'tshal/rtsom pa pos/2

dkar chagale'u dang po/ ta la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan mcho'i dus skabs/ (1)dang po/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sku 'khrungs pa dang yang srid ngos 'dzin khri 'don zhus pa'i skor/ (2)gnyis pa/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po byung ba/ (14)gsum pa/ tā la'i bla mas srid 'gan dngos su bzhes pa dang / bod kyi dbang bsgyur ba nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod skor/ (29)bzhi pa/ rdo rje g.yib sogs u ru su'i gsang myul bod du 'ongs pa/(38)lnga pa/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal par ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa/ (47)drug pa/ krang dbyin thang gis bod don dag ther byas pa'i skor/ (67)bdun pa/ tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog phyi sog tu nyen g.yol du phebs pa dang / de rjes pe cing du phebs te 7gong ma yum sras dang mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i skor/(76)1

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbu ra'i sgradabyangs/brgyad pa/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho rgya gar du bros byol phebs pa'i skor/ (91)dgu pa/ dbyin ji'i dbyen sbyor bas sim la'i gros tshogs zer ba 'tshogs pa'i skor/ (100)bcu pa/ bod sa gnas su srid 'dzin gyi byed thabs gsar pa 'ga' zhig byung ba'i skor/ (112)bcu gcig pa/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang bod kyi dbang 'dzin pa nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res byas pa'i skor/ (125)bcu gnyis pa/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin dang gser khrir mnga' gsol ba'i skor/(133)le'u gnyis pa/ rgyal tshabar sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpalas shes dang stag brag ngag dbang gsung rabarkya dusaskabs/(141)dang po/ tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs pa rdzogs rjes sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi gnas babs skor/(142)gnyis pa/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rgyal tshab kyi srid khrir 'khod pa/ (150)gsum pa/ lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal sogs la nyes chad phog pa/ (152)bzhi pa/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis hong rma'o sung 2 dmigs bsal bod du gtong gnang mdzad pa/ (159)

dkar chagalnga pa/ stag brag shog khas g.yo thabs la brten nas srid dbang blangs pa/ (162)drug pa/ rwa sgreng shog kha'i stong bsam dang stag brag shog kha'i bsam don/ (174)bdun pa/ rwa sgreng shog khar pham nyes tshabs chen byung ba'i skor/ (186)brgyad pa/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang se ra dgon pa'i dmag 'khrug skor/ (197)dgu pa/ go min tang krung dbyang gis rgyal zur rwa sgreng skyob thabs byas pa/ (213)bcu pa/ rwa sgreng bkrongs rjes stag brag shog khas bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur pa/ (224)1 e sha ya'i tshogs 'du zer ba'i skor/ (225)2 bod kyi tshong don tshogs pa sogs kyi skor/ (231)bcu gcig pa/ srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab srid khri nas phab pa'i skor/ (239)bcu gnyis pa/ bod kyi lo rgyus kyi bde skyid nyi ma shar ba/ (244)bod0 nye rabs lozug② lo chigs gal chen/ (255)3
sdu

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbu ra'i sgradabyangs/dang po/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sku 'khrangs pa dang yang srid ngos 'dzin khri 'don gyuzhus pa'i skor/〈tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rin po che'i phreng ba 〉ru 'khod par gzhigs na/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho ni ri bo shan ta'i nye 'dabs shar phyogs dwags smad khul gyi glang gling lha pa zhes ri bo glang chen 'gyings pa lta bu'i mdun na glang mdun zhes grags pa'i zhing pa spyir btang pa zhig gi khyim du yab kun dga' rin chen dang / yum blo bzang sgrol ma zhes pa'i sras su ngo mtshar gyi ltas sna tshogs dang bcas rab byung bco lnga pa'i me byi (spyi lo 1876)lo'i zla lnga pa'i tshes lnga nyin gyi zhogs pa'i nyi 'od ri rtser 'phro ba dang dus mtshungs lhums kyi rgya las grol te sku bltams/ thog ma'i mtshan du blo bzang thabs mkhas rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ 'khrungs yul glang gling lha pa zhes grags pa gnam gshes dro grang snyom pa mtha' bzhi kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i me tog dang sngo ljang ri bos bskor ba'i lta na sdug pa'i zhing khams lta bu zhig yod cing / khye'u gang de dpral ba'i dbyes che zhing bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor legs pa mtshan bzang gi ngo mtshar du ma dang ldan pa zhig yod/skabs der tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho gzim khri mtha' can du gyur te lo gcig lhag tsam song stabs yang srid rin po che brtsad 'tshol ngos 'dzin zhu phyogs thad sngar srol du lha bla ma'i lung brtag ltar 'ardol dgos pas/ thog mar kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku

le'udang po/ tā la'i blam skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/phreng brgyad pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug la thugs dam zhus par yang srid rin po che sku bltams zin pa ma zad/ de lha sa'i shar lho'i mtshams su yod ces gsungs/ de nas gnas chung rdo rje grags ldan sogs chos skyong khag spyan 'dren lung zhus skabs kyang yang srid rin po che shar lho'i mtshams su sku bltams zin pa'i bka' lung gsal por gnang bar brten rgyal tshab rta tshag dngabaka' shag gi bka' bzhin dpon rigs dang bla ma las sne mang po khag bgos te yang srid 'tshol bar 'gro skabs chos 'khor rgyal gnyer sdod kyis dwags po glang mdun du khye'u ngo mtshar can zhig sku bltams tshul skor snyan sgron zhus pas/ rgyud stod mkhan zur blo bzang dar rgyas chog grwa dang bcas pa sa gnas thog tu rtog zhib gnang bar phebs skabs mtsho mjal dang rmi ltas byung rigs gcig mthun byung lugs dang mthong thos dogs gsum lha bag til 'bru tsam yang med par srid gzhung la snyan zhu phul 'byor byung 'phral sku bcar mkhan chen byang chub rnam grol dang bka' drung lha dbang nor bu sku 'khor dang bcas gtong gnang mdzad/ khong rnam gnyis kyis slar yang rtog zhib gzab nan mdzad thog yab yum gnyis la snga phyir snga ltas bzang po gang dang gang byung rigs la snon 'phri he bag spu tsam yang med par yig thog tu bkod de snyan zhu 'phral du 'bul dgos pa'i bka' phab/ sku bcar mkhan chen byang chub rnam grol dang bka' drung lha dbang nor bu gnyis kyis yab yum zung la mjal dar a she sgrus legs re dang / gser zangs kyi sku brnyan sogs phul te khye'u 'di nyid gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'dugapas rgyun du gtsang spra gang legs dang phyi mi gzhan dang gang byung gis mjal 'phrad gnang na 'grig min gyi bka' brda bslab bya gang zab mdzad/de nas sku bcar mkhan chen byang chub rnam grol dang bka' drung lha dbang nor bu lha sar phyir log phebs rjes gong gsal gnas tshul rnams /ba

— bodakyinyerabs lo sa ta ra'i sgradabyangs/gsal rim bzhin snyan seng sgron pas glang mdun du bltams pa'i chung srid 'di ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa'i yang srid 'khrul bral yin pa tha gru kun tu grags che bas 'gal rkyen mi yong ba'i slad du thog ma'i ngos 'dzin gyi go bsgrig mdzad ched gzhung gnas nas rgyud stod mkhan zur blo bzang dar rgyas rgyus mnga'i babs kyis 'khrungs yul du mngags rdzongs gnang mdun yang srid mchog sprul la mjal dar dang / gser zangs las grub pa'i sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku brnyan sogs 'bul gnang mdzad/de 'phral paṇa chen sku phreng brgyad pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug dang / rgyal tshab kun gling rta tshag thung zhan hu thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan/ gdan sa chen po ser 'bras dga' gsum/ bkra shes lhun po/ gzhung zhabs ser skya dpon rigs yongs bcas blo rtse gcig mthun gyis chung srid 'di nyid bsregs bcad brdar gsum byas te 'khrul pa'i dri ma dang bral ba yin pas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis bod bzhugs am ban sung ku'e brgyud gnam bskosagong ma kong zhu'i la gser snyan sgron pas gong ma mchog gi bka' phyir phebs su 6 kun dga' rin chen gyi khye'u blo bzang thabs mkhas rgya mtsho de bzhin gser bum brtag dpyad zhu ma dgos par 'phral 'phral tā la'i bla ma rin po che'i mchog sprul du ngos 'dzin byas 'thus yong 'gro ’ ①zhes bka' bzhes bzang po thob pas gzhung gnas nas chung srid mchog sprul rin po che'i 'khrungs gzhis su gong ma mchog gi bka' lan snyan sgron zhu bar bka' blon mdo mkhar ba tshe dbang nor bu dang / sku bcar zhabs zhur rtse gzim dpon mkhan po rje drung ngag dbang dngos grub kyis gtsos gsol thab zhabs 'bring mi grangs bdun sogs ched du mngags rdzongs gnang ba hor zla dgu pa'i tshes sa rnamathar tsomatshar rigazeng 〉shingapar stod cha shog grangs42

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/bco lnga gza' skar 'byung 'phrod mchog tu dge ba'i nyin gyi snga dro glang mdun du nges 'byor thub pa bskyod cing de 'phral gsol gro dang / gsol ja/ dkar spro/ bzhes 'bras sogs legs par bsgrigs pa'i dbus na yang srid rin po che bzhugs thog legs 'bul mjal dar dang / maṇ+ḍal rten gsum bstar ba sogs rten 'brel mdzad sgo gnang /me glang (1877)lo'i zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu nyin gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang bas rtse nas gsol gzim mchod gsum dang / bka' blon g.yu thog pa lha dbang rdo rje/ tha'i ji mda' dpon sogs ser skya dpon rigs lnga bcu tsam gdan zhur bskyod de 'khrungs gzhis dwags po glang mdun du 'byor 'phral bka' blon g.yu thog pas gtsos phebs bsu ba yongs kyis gus phyag phul ba dang 'brel srid gzhung sogs gzhung sger nas phul ba'i legs 'bul mjal dar dang / maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' yo chas/ gser dngul/ gos dar sogs btegs shing / rang rang go bab kyi mjal dar phul te phyag dbang zhus/ yab yum sku 'khor yongs la gser dngul gos dar sogs legs skyes gang gzab phul/ 'khrungs gzhis nas kyang phebs bsu ba 〉pon rigs zhabs 'bring yongs la yul lugs ltar bsu ba zhabs tog gang gas py-i kā/cu gcig pa'i tshes gcig gza' skar mthun sbyor mchog tu dge ba'i nyin yang srid mchog sprul yab yum sku 'khor dang bcas phebs thon gnang / phebs bsu bka' blon g.yu thog pa sogs chibs zhabs rnams kyi dbus su yang srid rin po che phebs byams la bzhugs thog gar rol pa dang /rta dar ba/ srid pa ho'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas lam sne drangs te 'khrungs gzhis nas dngos su chibs kha bsgyur/ lam 'khel yul gru kun gyi lha sde mi sde yongs nas phebs bsangs dang / ser sbrengs rnga brdung dar 'phyar sogasdu sri

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/zhu bkur sti zhabs tog gang legs zhus te rim bzhin chibs bsgyur mdzad/de lo'i zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nyin lha sa'i shar ngos tshal gung thang du phebs/ sngar srol bzhin bod bzhugs am ban sung ku'e dang las rogs sa'i ling ang rnam gnyis kyang tshal gung thang du ngo bcar mdzad/ yang srid rin po che gzim chung nyi 'od du gdan drangs thog phyag stan steng zhal shar gzigs su bzhugs/ de'i sku rgyab tu rgyal tshab rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan dang / yongs 'dzin sku gzhon pa phur lcog rin po che/ ser skya dpon rigs bcas pus mo sa la btsugs te bzhugs/ de nas am ban sung ku'e nas 667gong ma bdag po chen pos/ tā la'i bla mar ngos 'dzin byas pa yin ’ zhes 667gong ma'i bka' sgrog sbyang zhus 'phral tā la'i bla ma mchog gis zhal shar du gzigs te phyag dgu phrugs phul rjes bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod mi ཿam ban sung ku'e dang las rogs sa'i ling ang rnam gnyis kyis tā la'i bla ma mchog la gus pas mjal dar phul/ am ban dang las rogs la tshur mjal dar a she re dang / gsol ras gser zangs las grub pa'i sku brnyan/ snam spus legs spos sogs gnang skyes gya nom pa gnang /de nas rten 'brel mdzad sgo tshugs te thog mar rgyal tshab rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan ye shes mchog gis srid gzhung gi sku tshab mdzad de mjal dar dang / maṇ+ḍal/ rin chen sna lnga/ dar gos chen sogs 'bul ba ji snyed pa phul/ de rjes gdan sa chen po bkra shes lhun po'i sku tshab mgron gnyer dang / de bzhin hu thog thu khag dang / bka' blon/ gung dza sag tha'i ji/ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi sogs nas mjal dar phul/ sa stag (1878)lo'i zla dang po'i tshes bzhi nyin gzhung nas gdan zhus ltar/ kun /ta (rnamathar rin zeng 〉stod cha shog grangs47

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng brgyad pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug lha sar phebs/ zla dang po'i tshes bcu gcig nyin kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang /rgyal tshab rta tshag thung zhan hu thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan/ yongs 'dzin phur lcog blo bzang tshul khrims byams pa rgya mtsho sogs gung thang du chibs bskyod gnang ste 7rgyal ba'i yang srid dang zhal 'dzoms gnang thog phan tshun mjal dar 'bul res mdzad/ de rjes tā la'i bla ma mchog gi dbu sku'i gtsug phud ma gtogs dbu skyes dang / dar gos kyi na bza' rnams dor te rab byung gi cha lugs mnabs shing / gzims chung nyi 'od kyi rten gtso byin can gyikhyan sngar paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis chung srid rin po che'i dbu sku'i gtsug phud bzhes te tsa rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde dpal bzang po mi zhes mtshan gsol ba dang chabs cig bzhugs khri las bzhengs te mjal dar dang gser zangs las grub pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sku rnying ma byon legs pa na bza' dang ldan pa zhig 'bul gnang mdzad/ de 'phral tā la'i bla ma mchog gis mjal dar nang mdzod spus legs gcig gser zangs kyi sku brnyan spus legs nam ldan zhig 'bul gnang mdzad/ de nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang bkra shes lhun pos snga rting du yang srid rin po che dbu skra gtsug phud 'bul bzhes dang mtshan gsol ba'i mdzad sgo'i rten 'brel zhu ched 'du khang chen mor dkar spro'i dgyes ston gzab rgyas bshams/ skye bo ser skya mtha' dag dga' spro'i dpal la ci dgar rol/zade'i tshes bco brgyad nyin tā la'i bla ma mchog rgyal tshab rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan dang / bla sprul khag drung rigs ser skya sogs chibs zhabs du ma'i dbus su gung thang gtsug lag khang nas chibs kha bsgyur te lha sa'iskyid chu'i byang ngos dben gnas ri rgya bsam gtan gling du phebs k+to lo

bod kyi nye rabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/'khor gcig tsam der bzhugs/ skabs der kun gzigs paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug gzhis rtser phyir log mdzad/ de nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bod bzhugs am ban sung ku'e birgyud tsa tā la'i bla ma rin po che phyi lo gser khrir mnga' gsol zhu 'thus dang / sngar lam nor bu'i 'ja' sa dang gser gyi 'ja' sa bcas 'jags gnas/ gser tham yang sngar rgyun bed spyod zhus 'thus/ phyogs mtshungs phebs byams ser po sogs sngar srol bzhin bstsal 'thus pa mizhes gong ma chen por dral tse'i thog gser snyan sgron 'bul zhus pas sa yos (1879)lo'i spyi zla lnga pa'i nang gong ma'i bka' mchan phyir phebs su lha tā la'i bla ma'i skye sprul rin po che ngos 'dzin gtan 'khel zin te 'di lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin mnga' gsol bya rgyu sogs shin tu nas bkra shes pa'i don gnad bzang por song gshes/ ngos kyang dga' spro lhag par thob cing / tā la'i bla ma'i mchog sprul la gnang skyes su kha btags ser po gcig sku brnyan gcig bzlas phreng gcig rdor dril cha tshang gcig bcas bstsal yod/ phyogs mtshungs tā la'i bla ma sku gong mar bstsal thob byung ba'i gser gyi tham ga de bzhin tā la'i bla ma gser khrir 'khod skabs thugs rje che zhu'i zhu yig thog phab 'thus dang / 'gyogs byams/shing rta/ sga 'bol srab mda'/ khu ral sogs kha dog ser po yang sngar lam bed spyod bgyis 'thus/ yab kun dga' rin chen la gung gi cho lo dang /nor bu'i tog rma bya'i sgro mdongs bcas gsol ras yod pas dga' bar gyis ① zhes 'khod yod/yab kun dga' rin chen la gung gi cho lo bstsal rjes sngar lam ltar gzhung gis sgos gzhis rgya che dang zhing bran mang po gnang bas mnga' bdag che sa rnamathar rigazeng 〉ston cha/ shogagrangs52 52

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphrengabacu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/gras su gyur pa ltar yab gzhis glang mdun zhes grags/de nas zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu nyin rgyal tshab rta tshag thung zhan hu thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan dang / bka' blon/ gung dza sag tha'i ji sogs bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs che gras khag ri rgya bsam gtan gling du tā la'i bla ma gdan 'dren par phebs/ tshes bcu gnyis nyin tā la'i bla ma mchog dang /7rgyal tshab rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan ye shes sogs sgang stod 'dod rgu thang du bzhugs sgar bkra shes mngon par nyams dga'i gnas der chibs bsgyur gnang rgyu yin pas bzhugs sgar du bod bzhugs sung ku'e am ban dang / phebs bsu ba ser skya dpon rigs yongs rdzogs 'byor zhing / tā la'i bla ma mchog phebs byams la bzhugs thog 7rgyal tshab rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan/ yongs 'dzin phur lcog blo bzang tshul khrims sogs chibs zhabs dang bcas sgang stod 'dod rgu thang gi bzhugs sgar du phebs/ am ban dang mjal dar sne sprod mdzad de mjal gur chen mo'i nang bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod rjes rgyal tshab rta tshag thung zhan hu thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan dang kun gzigs paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi sku tshab/ yongs 'dzin phur lcog blo bzang tshul khrims/ de mo hu thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas sogs sprul sku che khag gung dang zhabs pad/ phogs mda' rtsis sras shar byang chos rje rnam gnyis/ ser 'bras dga' gsum/rgyud grwa stod smad kyi slob dpon/ drung rigs ser skya byings/ gling khag ru/ bzhi sde/ khang yod khang chung / kha che/ bal po/ skya dar ba sogs nas zing rang gi go bab ltar rim bzhin mjal dar phul rjes rten 'brel mdzad sgo dugs/tshes bcu gsum nyin tā la'i bla ma gser khrir 'khod pa'i mdzad sgo dngos su tshugs rgyu yin stabs gna' bo'i yul mchog lha sa dang nye 'dabasdu kyi

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/grong sde gang sar bsangs dang gdug spos kyi dri zhim kun tu khyab/ phebs lam g.yas g.yon du rdo star dang dkar thig 'then/ pho brang chen po po ta la dang /ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang sogs kyi yang steng du gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ bkra shes khra ring sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan pas lha sa 'di yang mtho ris lha yi zhing khams mi yul du 'phos pa lta bur gyur/ rnga dang /sil snyan/ dung la sogs pa'i rol mo'i rnam grangs kyi sgra dbyangs snyan par sgrog pa'i khrod du tā la'i bla ma mchog phebs byams ser po byams 'degs pa brgyad kyis btegs pa'i nang bzhugs/ rgyal tshab rta tshag thung zhan hu thog thu dang / yongs 'dzin phur lcog blo bzang tshul khrims/ dga' ldan khri gnan zur/ hu thog thu khag skye sprul che khag gung / zhabs pad/ dza sag nang ma mkhan sde/ drung skya ser/ chin khral dpon rigs khag de bzhin la dwags kha che/ bal po a tsār+ya sogs chibs zhabs dang bcas phebs/ smon grong zam pabargyud shar skya rengs nas rgya bod dmag dpung ru bsgrigs te spos sne spos 'dzugs zhus/ lha ldan gsung chos ra bar phebs skabs gzhung bsten gnas chung 'od ldan dkar po'ang bsu bar bcar/ de nas sngar srol ltar gtsug lag khang du jo bo shākya mu ne dang / 'phags pa rang byung lnga ldan/ srong btsan sgam po/ rgya bza'/ bal bza'/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs rten gsum khag la snyan shal sgron 'bul sogs gnas gzigs kyi mdzad sgo rgya che gnang / de nas rtse pho brang du phebs nas gzims chung nyi 'od 'gag brgyud phebs te gong ma'i 'dra thang dang 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra'i snang brnyan sogs la sku phyag dang snyan shal 'bul gnang mdzad/ de nas tshes bcu bzhi nyin gza' skar mthunasbyor phun sum tshogs pas rtse pho brang chen po'i tshoms chen srid zhi phun tshogs su bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod pa'i che 'don mnga' gsol zhu skadisdu 7gong ma chen po'i sku tshab am ban mchog nas 7gong ma'i gnang skyes

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/rnams stegs kyi khar bshams thog 7gong ma chen pos tā la'i bla ma nyid gser khrir mnga' gsol la mchog tu dgyes pa'i gzengs bstod kyi bka' yig bstsal ba de mkhan drung bgres pas skad gsang mthon pos snyan sgron zhus ma thag tu am ban sung ku'e mchog nas legs 'bul mjal dar spus legs gcig dang / g.yang ṭi sngon po'i ru yi gcig sogs phul zhing / gong ma chen pos bstsal ba'i legs skyes gos krung ton las grub pa'i zhal thang che ba gcigakha btags gcig g.yang ṭi'i zhal dkar yu ring gcig dngul la tsha gser btang ba'i 'khor lo gcig dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che ba gcig rgya dngul srang chig khri tham pa sogs rin thang bral ba'i dngos po ji snyed pa bstar/dus der rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol ba'i dga' ston rten 'brel zhu ched rtse zhol rdo ring sgang du bod kyi sa gnas khag nas 'ongs pa'i bro pa gzhas ma dang / lha mo bas glu gar gyi 'khrab ston sna tshogs byas/ na gzhon pho mo grangs las 'das pas gzab mchor sna tshogs spras te bkra shes glu dbyangs blangs/ mdor na stod mnga' ris bskor gsum dang /bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug gi lha sde mi sde yongs kyi skye bo mtha' dag dga' spro'i dpal la ci dgar rol/de nas sngar lam ltar sba yer mkhan po gtong gnang mdzad de 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen por bsngags brjod kyi yi ge'i nang / 6 sngon chad bdag cag mtha' 'khob skye bo yi/ bde skyid ma lus khyod kyi bka' drin te/ da dung khyod min skyabs gnas su la re 7zhes 'khod/chu rta(1〈〈2)lor/ tā la'i bla ma mchog dgung grangs bdun la phebs pa'i skabs der kun gzigs paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug snyung gzhi bzhes stabs rgyal tshab rta tshag thung zhan hu thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan gyi drung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ 11

bod kyi nye rabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/chu rta (1882)lor/ kun gzigs paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ me khyi (1886)lo'i zla bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad nyin gyi nyi nub dus der rgyal tshab rta tshag thung zhan hu thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan mchog rtse shar brgyud shod gzim chung du sku gshegs/ 6 tshes dgu nyin bod bzhugs am ban nas yongs 'dzin srid skyong chen po'i sku gdung la zhib 'jug dang / tham gar do dam byas zu tshes bcu gsum nyin bka'i mdun na 'don rnam bzhi dang / spyi khyab mkhan po bcas nas mjal dar maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul gyi sgo nas gong sa chen po sku na ma son cing /thugs gnyer gsan bsam mdzad dgos dang bcas re zhig 'phrin las kyi mdzad po srid skyong khur 'dzin de mo ho thog thu rang 'os tshul go bsdur snyan sgron zhu bar mdzad ’ ①ces gsal zhing / de nas tā la'i bla ma'i dgongs mthun byung 'phral bod bzhugs am ban gnyis la bka' shag nas go bsdur zhus pa la'ang mos mthun byung 'dug pa ni rnam thar nang 6 srid skyong las tshab gsar bsko'i skor bod bzhugs am ban gnyis la'ang bka' bsdur mdzad pa bzhin de mo ho thog thu rang la thugs gtan 'khel don/ am ban bka' 'brelabaka'i phying sang rta mdo g.yu gsum gong sa mchog la snyan sgron zhu bar phebs ②zhes 'khod pa bzhin am ban gnyis nas de mor srid skyong bsko gzhag yong ba'i gong ma chen por gser snyan sgron pa dang / bod kyi srid 'gan rgyun mthud skyong dgos stabs lo de'i hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin de mo ho thog thu srid skyong las tshab kyi che 'don bskyangs 'dugade nas gong ma chen po'i bka' lan 'khor rjes srid skyong gi khri 'don ༵ /shāḥ/ sdi/ ཿtā rti// ཿ// /lhaḥtāḥdzā/shā

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/dngosagazhi gnang ba'i skor rnam thar nang / lo de ga'i zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin 6 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po nas gser gyi bka' shog rin po che bstsal phebs dgongs don bzhin/ de mo ho thog thu mchog nas gangs ljongs chab srid 'phrin las kyi 'tsho 'dzin thugs 'gan gtsang bzhes kyi khri phebs dang / las tham rtsis bzhes kyi mdzad sgo chabs cig bskyang rgyu'i slad du ’ rtse pho brang du phebs te thog mar shar rgyud shod gzim chung rig gnas kun gsal du sngar srol rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo rnams gnang / ra de nas nyi 'od du mchod yon thabs gcig tu gser zhal lhan 'dzoms pa'i sar bod bzhugs am ban nas dngul tham chen mo za ma tog nas phyung ste srid skyong chen po'i phyag tu phul mi ①zhes gsal ba ltar de nasaklobazung chab srid kyi gnang sgo rnams dngos su phyag bstar mdzad/sa byi lo'i (spyi lo 1888)zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi nyin paṇa chen sku phreng brgyad pa'i yang srid 'os sprul dwags po :ma pa khul dang / la mo/thob rgyal bcas su khye'u gsum thon pa sngar lam rtse gzim chung sa gsum rnam rgyal du bum sgrub dang 'brel mtshan byang gser bum dkrug 'don bskyangs don/ dga' :ma gyi khye'u'i mtshan byang 'phar te thon pas paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma mchog yang srid 'khrul bral du nges pa rnyed thub pa byung / dus der bod kyi gnas tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas su gyur pa ste/ chin rgyal rabs kyi dbang bsgyur snam zad sgron me dang mtshungs pas/dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa sogs kyis bod la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i ham sems nyin bzhin je cher phyin/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sku na phra bas bod kyi dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i ① rnamathar rin ṣ+ṭha 〉stod cha/ shog grangs148 13

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/'gal ba'ang rnyog 'dzing can du 'gyur ba dang bcas so//gnyis pa/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug thengs dang po byung ba/dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i skabs su 'dzam gling ma rtsa'i ring lugs de sger sdem ma rtsa'i ring lugs dang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dus skabs su slebs shing / btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal khab khag dbar tshong ra dang /thon skyed rgyu chas 'phrog res byed pa'i dmag 'thab yang yang langs shing /dus der chin krung dbyang srid gzhung ha cang nyams zhan gyi gnas su lhungs te rang rgyal lho nub sa khul sogs sa gnas mang por dbang bsgyur byed pa'i nus pa dang bral bagla dbyin ji dang u ru sus zi khron bod rigs sa khul khag la rtse rgyal gyi chos khang btsugs/ dbyin ji dang u ru su'i dbar sa gnas de dag phan tshun 'gran rtsod byed pa'i rtsod gleng yang yang langs/ dus der dbyin jis btsan bzung gi sa cha rgya skyed gtong ba dang bod hril po btsan bzung byed pa'i dmigs yul bsgrub ched chos spel ba dang / yul bskor/ gter rigs brtag zhib byed pa sogs la kha g.yar nas snga rjes su gsang nyul mang po bod du btang / bod kyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis kho pa tsho'i g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba gsal por rtogs te ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs dbyin jis btsan 'dzul gyi dmigs yul de bsgrub ched thabs lam gzhan zhig btsal ba ste thog mar bod kyi sa 'brel rgyal khab chung ngu khag gcig btsan bzung byas pa/dper na/ shing khyi (1814)lor/ dbyin jis g.yo sgyu'i sbyor bas 'bras ljordoswā par dpung rogs byas te bal po'i lag nas sa cha khag gnyis btsan

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/'phrog byas/ dus der bal pos phyogs gcig nas dbyin ji btsan rgyal dmag la ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bod bzhugs am ban zhi ming mchog la dpung rogs gtong rgyu'i re ba ji ltar zhus kyang des dpung rogs gtong rgyu lta zhog 6 don med rnyog dra bzos na mi 'grig ’ ces kha rdung btang / der brten bal po bye'u phrug thang la lus pa lta bur gyur nas dbyin ji btsan 'dzul par 'gog rgol byed thabs dben pa'i gnas su lhungs nas mthar mgo btags zhus te 'dra mnyam min khro'i sa ka li'i chings yig ma bzhag thabs med du gyur cing / dbyin jis bal po rgyal khab chung ngu der gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis btsan 'dzul byed pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni bal yul dang sa 'brel yin pa'i sa rgya che la dmag shugs zhan pa dang / chos dad che la dogs zon chung ba/ mi 'bor nyung la thonakhungs mang ba'i bod 'di za sems bcangs pa de yin/ de nas dbyin jis 'brug pa'i mi khag gcig dang ngan 'brel byas te bod kyi sa khongs mon dang / mtsho sna sogs btsan bzung byed pa'i grabs gshom byas pa ma zad/'brug yul dang 'bras ljongs su btsan 'dzul byed 'go btsugs/ skabs der 'bras ljongs sa spyod pa mthu stobs rnam rgyal gro mo chu 'bi pho brang du tsha g.yol du bzhugs stabs dbyin jis 'jigs skul dang bsru srid thengs mang byas te khong rgya gar rdo rje gling du phebs dgos zhes zhus/ 'on kyang khong gis khasalen rtsa ba nas ma gnang bar me byi (1876)lor 'brug pa sa spyod pa dang / khong rang nyid nas gong ma chen po'i sku tshab bod bzhugs sung ku'e am ban dang / rgyal tshab rta tshag thung zhan hu thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan/bka' blon gung lha klu ye shes nor bu dang / bka' blon bla ma yon tan/ mdo mkhar ba tshe ring nor bu/ g.yu thog lha dbang rdo rje/ ram pa bkra shes dar rgyas bcas bod kyi dpon rigs gtso bo rnams la 66deng sang dbyin ji/ /ga

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/g.yo'i byed bab gang dang gang la bltas kyang ring por mi thogs par bod ljongs chos ldan gyi zhing sar btsan 'dzul gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher rma 'byin gyi bya ngan spel rgyu gdon mi za ba'i snang tshul gsal por mthong 'dug pas des na bod gzhung mchog nas khul 'di'i sa mtshams 'phrang khag sogs sgo gang sar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi myang zhib so 'on byed mi do chod gtong gnang dang 'brel sngon tshud nas zhi drag thabs sgo gang dge'i mdzad phyogs lagayen bstar 'os gang bsam zol med gsal 'debs zhu rgyu ’ zhes 'khod pa'i snyan zhu snga rjes su 'byor/ dus mtshungs mtha' mtshams sa gnas rdzong gzhis khag nas kyang khul de'i gnas tshul mthong thos dogs gsum skor snyan zhu snga rjes su phul 'byor byung ba dang / lhag par du phag ri dang gam pa rdzong khag gnyis nas snyan zhu rim phul nang gsal 6 gus tshos rgyal mtshams sa 'dres gnad che khag tu gsang stabs kyis myang zhib so 'on byed mi snga rjes su btang ba dang / gzhan yang sa 'dres phyi rgyal mi ser la 'brel ba byas te gnas tshul brtsad gcod byas pa rtse mthun byung bar bstan dgra phyi gling pas rang phyogs su btsan 'dzul bya rgyu'i bsam ngan khog bcang gis khong tsho'i gnadayod mi sna rang re'i sa mtshams yas mas gang sar mngon chung gi thog nas nyul zhib tu yong ste la 'phrang dog sar lam bzo'i sa bkra zhib 'god byas pas ma tshad rang phyogs su dmigs nas dmag mi bsdu gsog dang / dmag rgyags grabs gshom byed gtan yin 'dug par rgyal mtshams shin tu rtsa 'gangs che gshes gus 'bangs sa mtha'i rdzong sdod 'go pa rnams rang bzhin a tshod 'di myur sdod blos bzod bral lags na bla dpon chen pos 'phral mur sku tshab do chod gtong gnang mdzad 'os sogs gang dga' ci legs thugs g.yengs su ma 'gyur ba mkhyen/ mkhyen zhes pa 'byor 'phral bod bzhugs sur+sha /'e am ban mchog dang / srid skyong rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan/

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/bka' shag sogs bka' bsdur gzab nan mdzad pa'i snying por/ sa mtshams kyi don gnad 'di ni rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang dang bod mi rigs khag gi mi mang gi dngos srog la thug pa'i rtsa che'i bya ba zhig yin pas 'phral du sa mtshams gnad don rtogs zhib byed por am ban sku tshab phogs dpon krang ching thung dang / bod dmag mda' dpon bkra shes dar rgyas gnyis ched du bsko gzhag thog mngags gtong mdzad kyang / kho pa gnyis nas sa mtshams rdzongagazhis khag la ngo bskyod thog rtog zhib dang bkod sgrig gang yang ma byas par bshar rgyag 'bras ljongs su bskyod de 'bras ljongs rgyal po mthu stobs rnam rgyal sogs dpon rigs yongs la khyed tshos bod phyogs su dbyin dmag btang shor byung na mi 'grig ces blang dor gan rgya zhig blangs gdes sa mtshams gnad don gal che rnams thag gcod thub par rloms te snang chung du song ba'i ngan 'bras su dbyin jis btsan 'dzul grabs gshom mang tsam spel rung mgo rul sna yis mi tshor ba'i dpe ltar gyur/ de nas dbyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag gi 'go pa ho'e hre zer bas 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i nye 'brel rdo khra bkras gling gi pha rnam rgyal dang / bo gdong bla ma zer ba gnyis dang ngan pa lag 'brel gyis 'bras ljongs yongs su btsan bzung byas thog 'bras ljongs de nyid bod phyogs su btsan 'dzul byed sa'i dmag lam bzo ba dang / dmag mkho'i zam pa rgyag pa/ dmag mi bsdu rub/ dmag phogs gra sgrig byed pa'i lte gnas sheg tu gyur/ 'bras ljongs dang 'brug yul dbyin ji'i lag 'og tu shor rjes rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang / lhag par du bod mi mngagis dogs zon cher skyed kyis rang srung rgol lan slog pa'i gra sgrig gang legasakhyas pa dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kyang sa mtshams sra brtan yong ched dang / 'bras ljongs pa dang bod rigs sha rus kyi 'brel ba zab pa dang / skad yig 'dra ba/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad gdi spyad

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/mkhan gcig pa yin stabs 'bras ljongs rgyal po sku 'khor rnams bod kyi mnga' khongs sa gnas su gnas spo gnang dgos pa'i bslab bya yang yang mdzad/ 'bras ljongs rgyal po mthu stobs rnam rgyal sku 'khor gyis kyang bslab bya dang len mdzad de bod du gnas spos kyis lo gnyis lhag tsam bzhugs/dus der dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas 'bras ljongs rgyal po mthu stobs rnam rgyal mchog 'phral du phyir log dgos zhes 'jigs skul thengs mang byas kyang khong gis dpa' ngar zhum pa med par dbyin ji btsan 'dzul par yig thog nas kha rdung drag po gtong gnang mdzad/ dus mtshungs 'bras ljongs rgyal po mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang lha lcam ye shes sgrol ma rnam gnyis lha sar ngo phebs thog bka' shag tu 6 dbyin ji'i bya spyod gang la gzhigs kyang 'bras ljongs 'bangs rnams da mus o tshod du sdod blos bzod min la brten bod 'bras bstan pa gcig gyur la dgongs bod gzhung gis nga tshor rgyab skyor dang 'go 'dren sngar bzhin yong ba'i zhal bzhes yong ba zhes zhus shing / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu gnang rgyu zhal bzhes bzang po gnang ba ma zad/ 'bras ljongs rgyal sras ngo 'khor gyi khri phebs legs 'bul dang / maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'bul bzhes thog 'bras ljongs rgyal po dang /lha lcam/ sras sogs phyir phebs skabs na bza' dang / dngul ṭam rdo sum cu so drug ja 'khor drug bdun cu tham pa gzhis rtse bkar khang nas 'bru khal chig stong tham pa 'don sprod chog pa'i bka' yig bcas bstsal/dbyin jis 'brug yul dang 'bras ljongs bzung rjes sa mtshams rdzong gzhis khag la phyi rgyal mi rigs bod sar nang 'dzul mi chog pa'i bka' yig tsha nanaganang yang dbyin ji'i gsang nyul rgya gar ba sa ra can rda zer ba des chos byed skyes bu dam par brdzus te thog ma rgyal rtser 'byor/ de nas rim bsdihā 'brong rtser 'ongs te 'brong rtse'i gzhis bdag pha lha lcam gyis snang med

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/dang snying rje'i bsam pa bcangs te kho par sne len rogs ram gang mang gnang ba ma zad/ bkras lhun gyi sprul sku seng chen sku phreng na rim dang pha lha dbar mchod yon gyi 'brel ba dam zab che bas bkras lhun dgon gyi seng chen sprul sku blo bzang dpal ldan chos 'phel la ngo sbyor gnang stabs des dbyin ji'i so pa sa ra can rda chos byed dge 'dun tshul ldan la mngon te phyag dpe dang dngos po mang po gnang / bla slob kyi la rgya bzung ste bzhugs pa'i gnas tshul sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rtogs rjes seng chen sprul sku blo bzang dpal ldan lha sar bka' 'gug gnang ste phyi rgyal gyi mi rgyal mtshams brgal te nang sar yong mi chog pa'i bka' rgya rab dang rim pa yod pa shes bzhin du phyi mi bdag sprod kyis gsang ba phyi gyar byed pa'i nor 'khrul che yang nyes chad yang bzos gyis mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes dang grwa sa'i las gnas dbyung ste kong po rgya mda' rdzong du rgyang 'bud btang / mthar rgya mda' rdzong du bkrongs/phyogs mtshungs dbyin ji'i gsang nyul de dang pha lha'i lcam mnyam du rgyal rtse brgyud mar lam yar 'brog bsam sding sogs la gnas mjal ba'i tshul byed bzhin lha sar 'byor/ gnas tshul de bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rtogs rjes sger pha lha ba'i 'dzin khongs 'brong rtse gzhis le lag nas lo re sa gnas srid gzhung la bkar 'jug 'bru gtsang ru'i khal dgu stong dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu dang bre bcu dgu dang phul lnga re lo ltar gtsang 'bul zhu dgos pa'i nyes chad gnang / der brten sger pha lha ba'i sras chung ba sras smyon zer ba des bod mi rigs la rgyab gtod kyis dbyin ji'i rjes 'brangs pa byas/skabs der dbyin jis bod kyi sa 'brel rgyal khab chung ngu khag yongs su btsan bzung byas te bod la sgo kun nas btsan 'dzul byed pa'i nyen kha'i gnas su lhungs/ dus mtshungs dbyin ji dang h+pha ran si'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung pe cing du 'byor bzhin yod pas chin krung dbyang srid sdusang

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/yang rlung gi dbus na gnas pa'i sgron me lta bur gyur/ bod kyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang / rgyal gces dpon rigs ser skya khag gis mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams brtan srung dang rang nyid kyi mdzes sdug ldan pa'i pha yul 'di 'dre lag tu mi shor ba'i ched du me stag (1866)lor/ rang rgyal gyi sa cha bston med lung thur lar so lta khang btsugs pa dang srung dmag bskos te sa mtshams su gang byung gis tshong 'grul byed pa dang / dbyin ji'i mi rang mtshamasakyis bod kyi sa khongs su yong bar bkag 'gog byas/ da dung lung thur lar gnas chung 'od ldan dkar po'i rten khang yang bzhengs/ dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas lung thur lar so lta khang btsugs pa mthong 'phral me stag (1866)lo'i spyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin krung gor bca' sdod dbyin ji'i gzhung tshab che mo ba hwar sin gyis chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gi phyi don spyi khyab ya mon la ru da lta bod pas dbyin ji'i mi bod du yong mtshams bzhag pa shes rjes sa mtshams phyi rol du rdo rje gling dang rgyang thag le dbar brgya tsam gyi sar skyogs rdzong brgyab pa de'i dmigs yul ni tshong 'grul bkag sdom byed ched red/ dbyin jir cha mtshon na phyogs rdzong de gtor las sla po yod rung / nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyis rnyog gra bzo 'dod med pas de ga nas bod bzhugs am ban la brda gnang nas bod pas rang snang gang shar gyis ham pa tsha po byed mi rung ba brgyud bsgrags byed du 'jug rogs gnang mizhes yi ge btang 'byor byung 'phral chin krung dbyang srid gzhung dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te dkar nag dbye ba tsam yang mi 'byed par bod bzhugs am ban 'un hra'o brgyud bod sa gnas srid gzhung la lung thur la'i so lta khang gtor dgos pa'i bka' phab kyang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang ser skya mi mang yongs kyis chin krung dbyang gi nor 'khrul gyi bka' der ma brtsis par me phag (110ra7)lo'i zla gnyis par gdan sa chen po ser 'bras dga' gsum dang

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/bkra shes lhun po/ bod kyi ser skya yongs nas am ban 'un hra'o brgyud chin srid gzhung la 6 lung thur la ni bod kyi mnga' khongs bston med yin pas so lta khang nam yang phyir 'then byed kyi min zhes gser snyan sgron/ da dung dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa 'bras ljongs sa khongs nas phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i re ba bton cing / chin dus rabs su dbyin jis bod la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i lo rgyus zhes pa'i deb ther nang tsa dus der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas phyogs gcig nas sa mtshams su rtsod gleng rab dang rim pa bzo ba dang /phyogs gzhan zhig nas bod la dngos su btsan 'dzul byed ched/ spyi lo 1887lor sa mtshams su dmag mi nyis stong lhag tsam bskongs pa dang me skyogs bzhi dbor ba ma zad/ pad sdong mdun zhes pa'i sa gnas der dmag mkho'i yo chas 'bor chen dbor nas bod du btsan 'dzul byed pa'i rten gzhi dngos su btsugs zhes 'khod/ skabs der sa gnas de gar dngos po dbor 'dren byed mkhan mang po bod rigs yin stabs dbyin jis bod la btsan 'dzul byed rtsis yod pa kho tshos shes rtogs byung 'phral dbor 'dren las mi 'go pa sa thar dar rgyas zhes pa bod mi lus stobs bzang la/ spyang grung 'dzoms pa zhig yod pa des bod mi rnams sgrig 'dzugs byas te thel tse lag bskor gyis dbyin ji btsan 'dzul par ngo rgol byed pa'i grabs byas kyang nang rul zhig gis gsang kha brdol nas dbyin dmag gis sa thar dar rgyas bzung ste sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang mi ji 'dra yod min gyi ming tho kha gsal zhig dgos lugs brjod kyang / sa thar dar rgyas kyis lkog tu ming tho 'khod pa'i mna' gan bzas/ khong khro'i me lce 'bar bzhin mig rtsa dmar por gyur pa'i ngang btsan 'dzul pa khyod tshor ming tho dgos na skyag gcin nang du 'tshol zhig brjod pas/ dbyin dmag ci bya gtol med du gyur te sa thar dar rgyas bsdams bkyig byas thog bod phyogs su btang / rjes su sa thar dar ཿsdu kyi

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/rgyal gces kyi bya spyod der gzengs bstod mdzad ched gro mo spyi khyab bsko gzhag bstsal bar grags/dus der bod kyi mi rigs khag gi mi mang dang dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa ltaspyod gang sar me chu lta bu nam yang mthun thabs med pa zhig yin stabs srid skyong dang / bka' shag bka' bsdur thog bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms bskongs 'tshogs dang 'brel ser skya mi mang tshang ma'i bsam gros zhib bsdur ma byas thabs med yin pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang ste tshogs 'du thengs mang bskongs 'tshogs kyis 6 spyi sgrig mna' nan mthu mo che mibazhag ste ji sridabar bod ser skya mi mang yongs nas spyi sgrig gan don sems thag gtsang bcad gyis lag bstar bya rgyu khas len byas te tshogs 'dur zhugs pa'i 'thus mi yongs nas blos blangs chings rtags bkod de bod bzhugs am ban 'un hra'o dang / rgyal tshab rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan/ bka' shag bcas la dbyin dmag 'gog thabs byed pa'i bsam gros bton don yodabyin ji btsan 'dzul pa bkag 'gog nan tan mtha' 'khyongs byed ched mtha' mtshams su zhi ba dang drag po'i las don gyi bkod 'doms nus ldan gdeng thub khag gcig bsko gzhag gnang dgos khar dbus gtsang dang / lho kha/ dwags kong /spo bo/ khams khul/ byang 'brog bcas nas 'don dmag dang yul dmag skul 'gug dang / da dung dgos pa byung tshe dgon sde che 'bring khag nas ser dmag dang / tha na skyes pa bco brgyad drug cu'ang dmag skul rgyag dgos rgyur dmag mi bsdu bskong byed mkhan dpon rigs ser skya'i khongs nas 'gan 'khur mi sna bsko gzhag gnang dgos pa dang / go lag thad bod bzos me phyogs dang / bod mda' me rdzas/ zha mdel/ spud ti/ gri mdung tha na 'ur rdo yan chad go sgrig dang / phyogs mtshungs dmag rgyags 'bru rigs kyis ga~X bza' chas gang ci 'du 'god gsog 'jog dang dbor 'dren dos

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/khal sogs phyogs gang sa nas dmag grabs 'thus tshang bya rgyu nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud du ma song ba las 'go 'dzugs rgyu dang / de bzhin dgra 'gog dmag bzlog zhabs rim bsgrub rgyu'i thad dga' ldan khri gdan zur gyis gtsosabla sprul khag la thugs dam gsung zhu'i dgongs don gdan sa chen po rnam bzhi dang dpal ldan gsang chen rgyud grwa stod smad sogs ris med dgon sde khag la mang 'gyed bsnyen bkur dang sbrags dgra 'gog dmag 'thab la rgyal kha thob pa'i mchog gsum gsol 'debs rgyab skyor rim gro bsgrub rgyu dang /de 'brel gzhung bsten dgra lha'i gtso bo gnas chung chos rgyal chen po dang /la mo tshangs pa/ dga' gdong chos skyong sogs lha bla khag la dbyin jir zhi ba dang drag po'i 'gog thabs ji ltar byas pa bzang skor lung brtag phul te bka' lung dgongs don lag bstar byed 'os kyis mtshon thabs sgo gang gzab ma tshang ba med pa dam 'dzin lhod med dgos rgyu mi sogs kyi skor bsam 'char gros gzhi tshig tho spyi dam bzhi sbyar phul/ de'i skor bod bzhugs am ban 'un hra'o brgyud gong ma kwang zhud la snga phyi'i yong rkyen zhib gsal snyan sgron snga phyi zhus kyang phan pa gang yang ma byung /dus der bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang ser skya mi mang yongs nas dbyin ji btsan 'dzul par 'gog rgol byed pa'i dmag grabs byed sgo de dag la bod bzhugs am ban 'un hra'o mchog gis rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu gnang / me phag (1887)lo'i zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhi nyin phas rgol ma rungs pa de dag brlag ched 'bras ljongs sa mtshams su mda' dpon lha sding sras dang / rtse mgron bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kong dmag bcas gtong gnang mdzad/ de bzhin khams phyogs kyi dpung dmag ser skya lnga brgya nyi shu tsam bod 'bras sa mtshams su bskyod/ sa mtshams kyi gnas tshul nyin bzhin dza drag che ba'i gnas su gyar ba'i skabs der 'bras ljongs rgyal po mthu /sdus

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbu ra'i sgradabyangs/rnam rgyal gyis pho nya mngags te dbyin ji dang bod gzhung phyogs gnyis kur zhi ba'i gros sol yong ba'i re ba bton yang dbyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag gis nyan 'jog spu tsam yang ma byas khar/ sa byi (1888)lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes bdun nyin/ dbyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag mi grangs bzhi brgya lnga bcu tsam gyis glo bur du lung thur la gsham nas bod dmag la tshur rgol byas/dus der bod dmag rnams so lta khang gi nye 'gram du gnas chung 'od ldan dkar po'i sku gsob bzos nas ru bsgrigs/ lag tu bod mda' dang /mda' gri mdung gsum sogs gna' rabs kyi mtshon cha mang po 'khyer te dbyinaji'i dmag mir phar rgol drag po byas/ chin rgyal rabs kyi skabs su dbyin jis bod la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i lo rgyus zhes pa'i nang 6 dus der dmag chas ser po gyon pa'i dbyin ji'i dmag dpon bsad/ de byings dmag mi rnams dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te phyir bros/ bod dmag yongs la skyon cha gang yang ma byung zhing zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad nyin gyi zhogs pa dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas sngar lam brgyud slar yong bod dmag la tshur rgol byas/bod dmag yongs kyis gra sgrig ang gsar thog dpa' ngar zhum pa med par btsan 'dzul dmag dang dmag 'thab thengs mang byas te dbyin ji'i dmag mi brgya lhag tsam bsad rmas btang / bod dmag gi brgya dpon gcig dang /yul dmag nyi shu lhag tsam dmag thog tu shor zhes 'khod/ dus der 'bras ljongs mi mang gis kyang g.yas gzhogs g.yon 'degs thog dbyin ji btsan 'dzul par dmag 'thab yang yang byas/ btsan 'dzul pas rang nyid pham par sdug nad rtsa ba nas mi thegs/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin dbyin ji'i dmag dpon chen po kā lud rmos dbyin dmag 'bor chen zhig sne 'khrid de bod dmag la slar yang tshur rgol byas/ me phyogs 'phangs pa mde'u bod dpa/ bsdu rub byas pa'i dkyil du lhungs stabs gna' bo'i go mtshon lag tu

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/thogs pa'i bod dmag rnams ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su rgyar te nag thang gi phyogs su bros/ dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas lung thur la yongs su btsan bzung thog rim bzhin sa mtshams brgal te mdun bskyod byas/ chin rgyal rabs kyi skabs su dbyin jis bod la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i lo rgyus zhes pa'i nang 6 bod dmag rnams nag thang du 'byor rjes nag thang byang ngos ri bo thi o kha na zhes pa mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las dbyin khre chig khri sum stong lnga bcu yod pa de bzung thog 'thab ra bzos te yib bsdad/ nyin zhig dgong mo dbyin ji'i 'go dmag rnams nag thang du 'byor te phyogs bzhir nyul zhib yang yang byas rung bod dmag gcig kyang ma mthong stabs der mtshan mo sgar brgyab nas bsdad ces 'khod/ dus der spyang grung 'dzoms shing dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i kong dmag gis mtshan mo gsang stabs kyis dbyin ji'i dmag sgar gyi mtha' bzhi yongs su bskor te kong dmag rnams kyis lag tu gri dpa' dam re 'khyer/ dus gcig tu phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas ki nyi hi zhes ngar skad 'brug sgra ldir ba ltar sgrog bzhin dbyin dmag la phar rgol byas/dbyin ji'i 'go dmag mang po tshar bcad/ de nas dbyin ji 'go dmag gis nag thang byang ngos su bod dmag mang po yod pa shes 'phral me sgrogs yang yang 'phangs par brten bod kyi 'go dmag rnams chu srid pho brang ngos su phyir 'then mi byed thabs med kyi gnas su gyur/ mtha' mtshams kyi gnas tshul nyin bzhin dza drag che bar brten zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin bod dmag dmag sgar spyi khyab tu bka' blon lha klu ba ye shes nor bu bsko gzhag bstsal ba ma zad/ las bya ser skya dang / bod dmag yul dmag sogs mi grangs chig khri tsam sa mtshams su bskyod/de rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang ser skya mi mang yongs kyis mu mthud dbyin ji btsan 'dzul par phar gol byed pa'i grabs gshom2 ཿsa/

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/bka' blon thun mong gis gnas chung 'od ldan dkar por lung zhu phul ba'i bka' lan du ra dang po btsams par mi bya ste/ brtsams nas ldog par ga la rigs mi zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ mu mthud dbyin 'gog rang srung dmag 'thabaco rgyu gtan 'khel gyis mda' dpon phun rab pa dbang 'dus rdo rje dang / mgron byams pa bstan 'dzin gnyis kyi thog las bya drung rigs ser skya bzhi dang / kong po rgya mda' dang / jo mo/ rtse sgang / zho kha bcas rdzong khag bzhi'i 'don dmag chig stong nyis brgya dang / lho kha sne gdong dang /'phyongs rgyas/ 'on/ 'ol kha/ lho brag sogs gyi yul dmag chig stong drug brgya yul dmag so so'i 'go 'doms ru dpon dang / brgya dpon/ lding dpon bcas khyon bsdoms 'go dmag grangs nyis stong brgyad brgya ser dmag kyang kha snon du gtong gnang mdzad/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos gong gsal dpon dmag rnams la mjal 'phrad dang / srung ba/ phyag tsha/ na bza' sogs yid tshim pa gnang ste phas rgol gdug pa can rnams mthar skyod dgos pa'i bslab bya yang yang gnang / bod bzhugs am ban 'un hra'o yis bod kyi ser skya mi mang gis rgyal gces mtha' srung gi bya spyod la rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu gnang ba ma zad/ dmag 'thab kyi zhib gsal thabs byus rab dang rim pa 'don gnang mdzad/ dus mtshungs chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gi phyi rgyal la mgo sgur ba'i nor 'khrul gyi byed thabs der mos mthun ma byas par 6 dbyin ji dang u ru sus bod la 'di lta bu'i do snang byed pa de tshong las tsam ma yin par yun ring gi dmigs yul ngan pa bcangs yod pas bod mi yongs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang rang yul srubaskyob byed pa'i bya spyod niyongs su yang dag pa zhig yin pas chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis der rgyab skyor gnang dgos zhes gnas lugs rab dang rim pa zhus kyang nyan 'ardokā spu tsam ma byas khar khong gnas dbyungs btang ste las tshab tu am ban

le'u dang po/ tā pa'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/hreng thas bod du mngags pas des chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gi mgo 'dogs ring lugs pa'i lam phyogs yongs su lag len bstar te bod dmag rnams phag rir bka' sgug ste sdod dgos pa las/ dbyin jir 'gog rgol byed mi chog pa'i bka' phab/ kho pa tsho'i mgo 'dogs ring lugs kyi byed thabs de yang dag pa yin pa mtshon ched lung thur lar so lta khang btsugs pa de bod phyogs nas nor ba red zer ba dang de rjes kho pa dngos su g.yul sa'i mdun phyogs su bskyod/ tsa gro mo rin chen sgang khul du yod pa'i bod dmag chig khri lhag tsam de dag phyir 'then dgos mi zhes bod sa gnas srid gzhung la brda lan yang yang btang / skabs der dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas phyir 'thenabyed rgyu lta zhog mgo thar dpung 'dzul gyis sa cha mang po btsan bzung thog bod dmag la me stogs yang yang brgyab/ g.yo can dbyin jis glo bur tshur rgol byed nyen shin tu che bas bod dmag rnams slong ma thang zhes pa'i sa khul yan du le dbar bcu phrag kha shas yod pa'i nags gseb tu yib ste 'thab ra bzos thog brtan srung bya dgos zhes bka' shag gis bka' phab/ de rjes am ban hreng thas kyis bod dmag nags gseb tu bsdad yod pa shes 'phral dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te 6 bod dmag 'phral du phyir 'then dgos/dbyin dmag bskyar du yong na bod sdod am ban nga la skad cha dris chog ces gtam 'chal mang tsam bshad/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis am ban gyi bka' brtsi bkur zhu khul tsam las don du bod dmag kha bkram ste khul de gar bzhag 'dug de rjes am ban hreng thas kyis bod dbyin tshong don skor gro moradabyin ji dang gros mol byed rgyu yin lugs brjod skabs srid skyong de mo ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas mchog dang / bka' shag gdan sa gsum/ gzhung zhabs yongs bcas bka' gros mdzad de am ban hreng thasa'i wang zhu zhig phul ba'i don du 6 kwang zhud khri lo gnyis pa/ rakā snang

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i smra dbyangs/bco lnga pa'i me byi lo nas dbyin jis snga phyi bar gsum du bod sar tshong 'grul gsar gtod sogs kha g.yar sa sna tshogs btsal te btsan 'dzul byed rgyu'i lkog g.yo'i 'char gzhi yod pa 'di'i thad bod ljongs ser skya mi dmangs tshang mas bzod sgom bya thabs bral gshes rang nus gang yod kyis 'gog srung bya rgyu nyag gcig ma gtogs da phan pham nyes phran bu byung yang sems thag sngon bcad la nam yang 'gyur ba med pas la mtshams su 'go dmag rim btang gis 'gog srung byas dang byed bzhin yin kyang / da cha am ban hreng thas nyid kyi dgongs 'char de gnam bskos gong ma bdag po chen po'i bka' yin zhes yang yang nan bshad gnang ba ltar dmag mtshams 'jog dgos na snga 'phros gro mor yod pa'i dbyin 'gog byed mkhan bod dmag rnams sa gnas gcig tu rub sdod ma dgos par kha bkram nas bzhag chog pa las/ phyir 'then rtsa ba nas zhu ma dgos pa dang / gal srid phyir 'then byas na dgra bor stabs bde'i go skabs sprad pa zhig rang yin pas nges par du gnas skabs ring de don lag len bstar chog pa zhes zhus/ chabs cig srid skyong de mo mchog dang / bka' shag gis tshogs 'du'i bsam gros gzhir bzung am ban hreng bas la nang sol ji ltar zhus kyang kho pas 6 de yang 'grig gi ma red/cibod dmag khag gcig phag rir 'jog pa phud/ de byings phyir 'then byed dgos zhes mtha' gcig tu bshad/ phyogs mtshungs mi rigs kyi rkang 'dren pa am ban hreng bas zer ba des gro mo shar sing mar dbyin ji'i dmag sgar du bskyod de dbyin gzhung sku tshab sber dang mnyam du 'bras ljongs dang tshong 'grul sa mtshams dbye phyogs skor gros mol byas/ sa glang (1〈〈9)lor/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab bka' blon ram pa bkra shes dar rgyas sogs lha sa nas gro mor phyir log skabs su am ban hreng thas la srid skyong de mo gā zlog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas mchog dang / gdan

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/sa chen po gsum/ ser skya dpon rigs thun mong gi zhu yig gcig phul te dmag mi phyir 'then byed phyogs skor gong gi bka' bzhin zhus chog pa dang /sa mtshams dbye phyogs dang tshong 'grul skor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mos mthun med pa'i bsam gros mang po bshad kyang nyan 'jog rtsa ba nas ma byas par/ sa glang (1889)lo'i zla gnyis pa'i zla stod du chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bsko gzhag byas pa ltar hreng bas kho pas dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i blon chen gyi ming 'khyer te ka li ka tar bskyod/ dbyin ji'i sku tshab hin rdu khag lnga'i spyi khyab las don blon chen ang dang po dang mnyam du rgyal btsong chings yig don tshan brgyad bzhag de rjes sne gdong 'gag sgo'i skor chings yig don tshan dgu bzhag pa bcas la bod kyi ser skya mi mang yongs nas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/gsum pa/ tā la'i bla mas srid 'gan dngos su bzhes pa dang / bod kyi dbang bsgyur ba nang khul srid dbang 'phrog des byed pa'i 'thab rtsod skor/rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sku na chung ba'i skabs der bod kyi gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing che ba'i dus la babs kyang srid phyogs kyi bya ba mtha' dag srid skyong dang bka' shag sogs kyis byas te/ rgyal dbang nyid yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis sogs mkhas dbang mang po bston te nang rig pa dang tshad ma rig pa sogs rig gnas che chung khag la gsan sbyong mthar phyin mdzad thog rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing lug (1895)lor rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo nyi shur phebs skabs sngar lam ltar na/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin sdi shā'i

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes dgos kyang / dus der paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma sku na phra bas lo 'di'i zla dang po'i tshes lnga nyin drung rigs ser skya yongs kyis mgrin dbyangs gcig grags thog gsol ba btab pa bzhinajo bo shākya mu de'i spyan sngar bslab gzhi yongs rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes skadadang lha ldan cho 'phrul smom lam chen mo'i tshogs mgon du lha ldan gtsug lagatang du zhabs sor 'khod de tshes bcu gcig nyin jo bo shākya mu ne dang /ched du gdan drangs pa'i thub dbang sta zur ma sogs rten gtso khag gi spyan sngar rnam lnga'i mchod sprin gzab rgyas bshams pa'i mdun du bzhugs khrir zhabs sor bkod de/ yongs 'dzin phur lcog byams pa rgya mtshos mkhan slob sbrags ma dang / yongs 'dzin chung ba gling sprul blo bzang lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyis gsang ste ston pa/ sgrub khang sprul sku blo bzang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho nas dus go ba/ las kyi kha skong khri chen blo bzang tshul khrims dang shar byang chos rje rnam gnyis sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes shing /de nas khyams ra chen mor srid skyong de mo hu thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas mchog dang / gung / bka' blon/ dza sag tha'i ji/gdan sa gsum kyi 'thus mi/ ser skya dpon rigs yongs bcas nas mjal dar dang / maṇ+ḍal rten gsum sogs dgyes ston mdzad sgo gzab rgyas bskyangs rjes mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas bsnyen rdzogs 'bul ba po rnams la gser dngul dar gos sogs yon 'bul dang jo bo shākya mu ne sogs rten gtso khag la rin po che'i rgyan dang / gos dar gyi na bza'/ mchod sprin rgya cher 'bul gnang mdzad/ smon lam grol rjes skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma mchog rtse pho brang chen po po ta lar phyir phebs/ de nas sngar lam ltar sba yer maX/ po mngags te 'jam dbyangs gong ma kong zhu'i mchog la gser snyan

le'u dang po/ tā pa'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/sgron/ zla drug pa'i tshes gnyis nyin gong ma mchog gis dral tse'i thog bka' yig phebs par 6 tā la'i bla ma nas zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gcig nyin thugs rdzogs zin pa 'di dag bkra shis dge mtshan lhag par che bas ngos kyang yid spro dpag med bskyed cing da nas bzung tā la'i bla mas chos spyod slob gnyer 'khur brtson gang ches zhwa ser gyi bstan pa rgya khyab 'phel rgyas dgos nges la/da lam tā la'i bla ma la bka' drin 'phar ma'i gsol ras su byu ru'i bzlas phreng gcig dang / gser skud las grub pa'i shubs bcas yol go gcigagayang ṭi dkar po'i yol go gcig rgya khug che ba gcig rgya khug chung ba gnyis/ phyogs mtshungs yongs 'dzin che ba phur lcog zhabs drung blo bzang tshul khrims byams pa rgya mtshor kha btags che ba gcig bcas stsal yod 7ces phebs pa bod sdod am ban brgyud sngar srol rten 'brel legs tshogs kyi sgo 'phar phye ba'i lam nas tā la'i bla ma mchog gi phyag tu bzhes te dgyes pa'i ngang sku phyag dgu phrugs bskyangs ①dus der bod kyi gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog dang rnyog 'dzing ha cang chen po byung ba ste/ lung thur la'i dmag 'thab pham rjes bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ dmag don sogs gang ci'i thad sngar byung ma myong ba'i gyong gun chen po phog ste spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba shugs cher phyin pa dang gcig dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas bod yongs rdzogs kha lo bsgyur ba'i ched du btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa slong ba'i grwa sgrig byed pa dang gnyis/ chin gong ma'i krung dbyang srid gzhung ni rlung gi dbus na gnas pa'i sgron me lta bur gyar bas phyi nang gi las don mtha' dag labakod byus gtong ba'i nus pa bral ba dang gsum/ bod kyi dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de rno ngar dang ① rnamathar rin zeng 〉stod cha/ shogagrangs252 31

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/mngonagasal dod por gyur pa dang bzhi/ u ru sus go skabs de dang bstun te 'dre lag bod du brkyangs pa dang lnga bcas so/ / gong gsal gnas tshul de dag la brten srid skyong de mo mchog gis dgongs zhu rim pa mdzad de tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtshos srid 'gan dngos su bzhes dgos pa'i gser snyan sgron zhing / bka' shag dang / gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum/ drung rigs ser skya mang che ba bcas kyis kyang tā la'i bla ma mchog gis srid 'gan dngos su bzhes dgos pa'i re 'dun yang yang bton pa ltar/ shing lug (1894)lor srid skyong de mo hu thog bu'i dgongs zhu'i zhu yig de bka' shag dang / gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum/ ser skya dpon rigs yongs bcas kyi tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms thog gros mol byed dgos pa'i bka' ji phebs bzhin/ tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms thog gros mol gzab nan zhus te gong sa mchog la phul ba'i snyan zhu 'di ltar te/ 6 gong sa chen pos chab srid kyi bgyi ba'i sne mo las 'dzin pa drung rigs ser skya spyi tshogs la ji 'gab go bsdur dgos rgyu bka' phebs ltar tshang 'dzoms zhib sol zhus mthar chu 'brug dang / shing rta lo gnyis su ji ltar gsol ba bzhin rje bla ma srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan phyag na pad+ma gang nyid bdag cag kha ba ri pa'i mgon skyabs dam par rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bsngags pa'i me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal don gyi bdag po yin par ma zad/ mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtshor gsan bsam dang / bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa lhur bzhes legs par grub cing /sngar gyi bzhed srol dgung grangs bco brgyad thog lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'ganabazhes dus las kyang lhag pa'i sku'i na tshod bcu phrag zung du phebs pa dang / srid dang zhi ba'i chos tshul mtha' dag la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen rlabs rnam dpyod zab dgyel 'gran zla dang bral ba sogs gang ci'i sgo nadī byedag cag bka' 'bangs lha mi ser skya ris su ma chad pa thams cad blo

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphrengabacu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/mos re sems rtse gcig lags na/ da cha bod ljongs chos srid thugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mchog nyid nas gtsang bzhes bka' drin che thub pa zhes mgrin gcig gis gsol ba 'debs lags mi ①zhes re ba zhus pa ltar dang / de bzhin gong ma chen por sngon du gser snyan bsgron pa'i bka' phyir phebs su'ang 6 rdo rje 'chang tā la'i za ma khyed/ da cha sku na yar son/ mdo sngags kyi chos thams cad thugs kyi rgya mtshor chub pa ni phan bde'i rtsa ba chen po yin/ khyad par shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'i snying po zhwa ser gyi ring lugs la mkhas shing don rnams kyang legs par rtogs par gyur/sems can thams cad la blo nye ring med pa bu lta bur bskyangs/ mi ngan pa rnams la nyes pa phab pa yang spyi'i bde skyid khrims kyi lugs srol yin pa mkhyen/ rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma gong ma rnams dang khyad med pa/ nged gnam 'og sa steng gi rgyal po sems can thams cad kyi pha ma'i dgongs pa dang mthun par gyur/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi sems can thams cad phan bde la bkod/ chos srid gnyis kyi bdag por rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma khyed dbang bskur gzengs bstod par mi sna ched du mngags pa'i gdong gsol ras gnang sbyin rgya chen po bstsal ba gus pas dang du longs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can rnams bde skyid la bkod par brtson pa mi lhod pa gyis/nan tan gyis ②zhes phebs pa bcas la brten/ shing lug (1895)lo'i zla /tshes /nyin pho brang chen po po ta la'i tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs su rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan yongs su tshi /shāḥthe /sna ཿtā rti/sdo ཿ// /lhaḥsgo/// 256 93

bod kyi nye rabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/bzhes pa'i mdzad sgo tshugs/ nyin der pho brang chen po po ta la'i yang steng dang / lha sa'i grwa tshang dang grong mi'i khang pa'i yang steng du dar lcog btsugs shing / dung rgya gling gtong ba/ bsang gtong lha gsol byed pa/ mchod sprin gzab rgyas spro ba dang / bod yongs kyi skye rgu mtha' dag gzab mchor gyis brgyan te rnga rdung bro 'khrab pa sogs dga' spro'i dpal la ci dgar rol/sngar lam ltar thog mar bka' shag dang / de nas rim bzhin bkra shis lhun po dang / gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum/ bod sa gnas khag gi ser skya yongs kyi 'thus mis 'bul tshan phul te rten 'brel zhus pa ma zad/'brug pa rgyal po dang / 'bras ljongs sa spyod pa/ gor ṣa rgyal po/ phyi sog gi chos rgyal rje btsun dam pa sogs mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khag gis pho nya mngags te legs 'bul bteg pa dgyes bzhes bskyangs/me sprel (1896)lor/ dgung gsar gyi sngar srol mdzad sgo grub rjes zla dang po'i tshes dgu nyin lha ldan cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i skabs su rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho tshogs mgon du chibs bsgyur bskyangs thog gdan sa gsum gyi dge 'dun khri phrag gnyis lhag tsam la gsung chos gnang / tshes bco lnga mtshan mo bco lnga mchod pa'i mchod gzigs la chibs bsgyur mdzad skabs sku bcar mkhan po dang / dpon rigs che gras khag ma gtogs mi ser dkyus ma rnams bar bskor du skyod mi chog la/ khang pa'i yang steng nas kyang blta mi chog de nas smon lam tshogs dbus kyi mdzad pa legs grub zin te tshes nyer lnga nyin rgya btab ra mo cher gnas gzigs grub rjes pho brang po ta lar phyir phebs mdzad/rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan yongs su bzhes rjes bod kyi gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog mngon gsal dod po khag gnyis byurdo ༵ 'di ltar/ dang po bod bzhugs am ban gyi go gnas sngar bzhin

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/gnas kyang / chin gong mas mgo 'dogs kyi lam phyogs lag len bstar te dbyin rgol dmag 'khrug la rgyab skyor ma byas pa dang / nyag rong dus zing langs pa sogs la brten bod bzhugs am ban dang tā la'i bla ma mchog dbar gyi 'brel ba nyin bzhin je sdug tu song ba/ gnyis pa/ chin gong mas bod mi mang gi rgyal gces mtha' srung gi dmag 'thab la rgyab skyor byed rgyu lta zhog dbyin ji btsan 'dzul par ngo dga' gdong gsol byed ched lung thur la nas bzung gam pa rdzong gi lho ngos 'brog ra dang sa cha mi nyung ba zhig sprad pa sogs la brten tā la'i bla mas u ru sur dpung rogs bcol te dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa mthar skyod pa'i thabs byus gsar pa zhig mi bzung thabs med du gyur/ 'on kyang mu ru sus go skabs de dang bstun nas bod 'di kho pa tshos kha lo bsgyur ba'i re ngan bcangs te 'dre lag bod du brkyangs/phyogs mtshungs bod kyi dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul du srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod rno ngar can du gyur pa ste/ sa phag (1899)lor/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po bkrongs rtsis byed pa'i don gnad cig byung ba'i byed gte gtso bo de mo hu thog thu ngag dbangablo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas skor la bshad srol mi 'dra ba mang tsam byung ba dper na/ la las de mo srid zur 'dzin bzung byas rjes btson khang du sku gshegs zer ba dang / la las btson khang du bcug rjes bkrongs zer ba/ yang la las ngan gtad bcug ste srid dbang 'phrog rtsis byed pa zer ba'i gnas tshul de rigs rtsa ba nas med par ma nyes kha g.yogs byung zer ba sogs bshad tshul mang tsam yod/ 'on kyang don gnad 'di'i thad tā la'i bla ma sku phrengabacu gsum pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rin po che'i phreng bar 'khod pa 'di ltar/ 4srid zur de mo ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas de nyid ni gong ma mchod yon gyis gzigs mthong che zhing / gzhung bstan la phyag /sna mi

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/dman pa zhig yin par grags kyang / bar lam bstan rgyas gling bla brang gi las khur 'dzin pa rgan gras blo gzu bor gnas pa dag 'das shing / sku'i tsha bor gyur pa nor bu tshe ring dang don ldan zhes pa sogs 'ga' zhig gi thog tu babs pa na rang nyid nyes 'dod kyi snga ltas lta bur tā la'i bla ma mchog gi mnga' thang mdzad pa phun sum tshogs pa la yong ye mi bzod cing / bod ljongs chab srid mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa rang nyid kyi dbang du bsdu bar 'dod pa'i kun slong ngan pa'i gdon gyis rgyud bsgyur te thog mar gong sa chen po bkrong rgyu'i rtsis kyis dgung snying mtshan gsal gyi bla tshe srog gsum liṅgā'i dmigs yul du bkod pa dang / bod kyi skye 'gro rnams rgyal dbang nyid la blo log skur 'debs yong res gangs ljongs su char med nad mug sogs bkra mi shis pa gtong rgyu bcas kyi ngan gtad rdzas sbyor sngags 'khor khag mang dpal ri sprul sku dang / nyag sprul zer bar rgyu rngan sprod dan byas nas bzo bsgrubs kyis po ta la'i phyogs bzhi dang bsam yas has po ri/ gzhan yang lha mthu chen gnas sa/ rgyal dbang mchog la 'bul rgyu'i zhabs phyags gsar bskrun gyi mthil lto sbyar nang bcas su sba 'jug bgyis shing / re zhig bar skyabs mgon chen po'i sku khams nyog pa dang / thugs rig bying ba/ gsol zas kyi dang ga 'gag pa/ 'gyur dug gi reg pas gang gsol ba thams cad gnod pa can du gyur nas ltem tshul cher bzhes pa na/ dmar zlum ye shes kyi spyan ldan dag gis shig thog sor mo 'dzugs pa ltar ngan spyod kyi mtshang brtol bas brtsad chod de gzhung nas khrims lugs ltar rtsa zhib rim bzhin mdzad par/'di skor gyi byed gte mthong thos le 'khri rnams nas ngos len mtha' gsal zhus pa'i lag bris kyi zhu tho nang gsal ltar sngar ma grags pa'i byas nyes tshabs po che thon zhes/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du blo gros gcig tu mthun te nyes can khaX sdu khrims gcod dang bstan gling snod bcud gang ci rtsa med gzhung bzhes

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan spatsho'idusaskabs/ zhu rgyu'i 'char gzhi phul srid zur nyid kyang bstan gling chos rar mtshams bcad bzhugs su bcug thog sku srog la chad las kyi rgol ba'i rkyen gangayang med par dgung grangs zhe lnga'i thog tu sku tshe'i 'du byed 'dor ba'i tshul bstan/’ 4'di skor skabs der gong mar snyan sgron dang 'brel bka' dpyad ji ltar gnang ba sogs bla sprul rgya deb dang / wang shu'i deb gzhung sogs la 'khod kyatshul gsal/gongagasal 'di dag gi thog nas srid skyong de mo hu thog thu las gnas dgongs zhu gnang rjes de mo'i sku tsha nor bu tshe ring dang don ldan sogs dang kho pa tsho'i phyogs gtogs dpon rigs tam sems can 'ga' zhig gis rang nyid kyi dbang shor bas tā la'i bla ma mchog la yi ma rangs par bkrong thabs byas te kho pa tshos slar yang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang 'dzin rgyu'i re ngan bcangs rung / lkog g.yo de dag mthil brtol rjes byed gte gtso bo nor bu tshe ring dang don ldan sogs de'i rjes 'brangs pa gtso bo rnams 'dzin bzung thog zhu ba blangs pas so so'i sdig nyes rnams ngos len zhus shing / de mo srid zur ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas nas gong gsal gnas tshul rnams thos 'phral nyin de'i mtshan mo glo bur dgongs pa rdzogs/ skabs der dgung lo zhe bcu zhe lngar phebs/ de nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis byed gte rnams rim bzhin tshar bcad/ bstan gling grwa tshang gi rgyu dngos rang 'jags thog bla brang gi rgyu dngos dang / sne gdong ngam ring / mal gro gung dkar sogs gzhis khag gzhung bzhes thog de mo hu thog thu'i mtshan gnas med pa bzos te slad phyin yang srid kyang ngos 'dzin zhu mi chog ces bka' phab/gong du smos pa ltar de mo srid zur gyi don gnad skor bshad tshul mi 'dra ① rnamathar rigazeng 〉stod cha/ 37

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/ba ji ltar yod rung / don du 'di'i thog nas skabs der bod kyi dbang bsgyur pa nang khul srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de rno ngar dang /dza drag rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas su gyur ba gsal po mthong thub/dus der bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bkras lhun bla brang gnyis dbar gyi 'gal ba'ang cher 'gyur ba'i 'go tshugs/ mdor na/ bod kyi dbang bsgyur pa nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod yang yang langs stabs dbyin ji dang / u ru su sogs phas rgol ma rungs pa tshor bod kyi nang srid la the byus dang dkrug shing / btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug slong ba bcas kyi go skabs rnyed de kho pa tsho'i 'dre lag bod du brkyangs/bzhi pa/ rdo rje g.yib sogs u ru su'i gsang myul bod du 'ongs pa/rgya yig gi deb ther tā la'i bla ma'i rnam thar zhes pa'i nang 6 tā la'i bla ma mchog gis u ru sur 'brel ba gnang ba de ni gsham gsal gyi gnas tshul la brten nas byung ba ste/ phyogs gcig nas dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag dpung bod kyi mtha' mtshams su slobs te bod 'di nyen kha'i gnas su lhungs pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas chin rgyal rabs srid gzhung dbyin jir zhed snang skyes te bod mi mang gis phar rgol byas pa der rgyab skyor shugs chen byed mi nus stabs tā la'i bla ma phyi phyogs kyi rgyab skyor gzhan zhig btsal te dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul la 'gog rgol byed dgos snyam/ der brten u ru su btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i mgo bskor du tshud de nor 'khrul gyi sgo nas u ru su btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod la rogs ram byas te dbyin jir 'gog 38

le'u dang po/ tā la'i bras skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/rgol byed pa'i ngos 'dzin byas ①zhes bkod yod/ gong gsal gyi dbye zhib de dag skabs de'i gnas tshul dang yongs su mthun zhing / tā la'i bla ma mchog gis thog mar u ru sur 'brel ba 'dzugs pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni dbyin rgol rgyal srung gi ched du yin/ de rjes u ru su'i lkog g.yo'i ngan byus la dbu 'khor nas nor 'khrul gyi lam du lhungs te mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la mi phan pa'i bya ba 'ga' zhig mdzad yod/u ru su'i ngos nas bshad na/ bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral btang ste kho pa tsho'i mi ser spel yul du bsgyur ba'i lkog g.yo de snga sa nas yod pa zhig yin/ dper na rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu sprel (1872)lor u ru su'i hrang zha'o dmag dpon phu rje wa'ar si yi dang / lo'o phu blo si ci sogs shin cang byang ngos brgyud nag chu bar slebs/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang ser skya mi mang yongs kyis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs mi de dag nag chu nas mtsho sngon du phyir log mi byed thabs med byung / skabs der u ru su'i nyul ma dang sa gnas de ga'i bod rigs mi mang dbar gdong gtug 'thab rtsod thengs gsum tsam byung ste kho pa tshos gdug rtsub chen pos bod rigs mi mang sum cu lhag tsam bsad/ de rjes me byi (1876)lor u ru su'i ngo dpon nyi'i zer ba bod du myul zhib tu yong bar bod kyi ser skya mi mang yongs nas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas yod/ btsan rgyal u ru su'i nyul ma bkag 'gog byed pa'i skor la/ rta tshag rje drung hu thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan ye shes kyis bod bzhugs am ban sung ku'e brgyud gong ma chen por snyan zhu phul ba 'di ltar/ che gzhung gi las don zhor skyong byed po rje drung hu thog thu nas yi ge phul don/ nye char am ban mchog nas 'di gar wang shu gnang ① tā la'i ma'i rnamathar 〉bod yigadeb ngos29944༷༷ 39

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/'byor zhib cha deb gsal bskyar zlos zhu ma dgos pa phud/ 'gag don du rgyal khab phan tshun tshong 'grul skor spyi khyab las don byed po'i ya mon nas gnas tshul phebs gsal kong zhu'i khri bzhugs gnyis pa'i zla lnga pa'i tshes bdun nyin ngo rgol rgyal khab kyi las don byed po nas mi sna chen mngags kyis gnas tshul 'byoragasal du ngo dpon nyi'i zer ba pha mi brgyud bod ljongs bcas pa'i sa gnas su bskor nyul du thon tshe gang cir mthong thos rgya che yong gnas la lag 'khyer gsol ras gnang lugs nan gyis zhu bar brten/ pe cing zhun than phu'i ya mon nas tham ga phab ste ngo rgol rgyal khab kyi mi snar rtsis sprod song ba/slar ngo dpon nyi'i bcas 'byon skabs lag 'khyer la gzhigs pas gtong dgos las zings shig don phud rigs mi 'byung ba dgos rgyu phebs pa ltar brtsi 'jog byed dgos zhes gsal ba 'di skor bka' blon rnam pa dang / spyi khyab mkhan po brgyud bod 'bangs ser skya mi dmangs la wang shu sgrog sbyangs thog bkod khyab zhus par ser skya spyi mthun gyis zhu rigs su/ de snga zhan hong khri bzhugs bcu gcig pa'i lo than kru'i mi rigs sogs gsar spros kyi btang tshe nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bod khams spyi'i bde skyid la gnod tshabs yong gnas la 'di rigs ji ltar byas kyang gtong thabs med lugs mna' gan spyi sgrig rtags sbyar bzhag thog bod bzhugs blon chen brgyud gong ma chen por gser snyan sgron pa sogs rgya bod deb gsal ma zad/ rang khongs sa gnas khag nas 'di gras 'gro 'dug btang shor lta bzhag yig 'grul tsam yang gtong len mi chog pa'i dam drag zhu mus de ltar yin na/ da lam ngo rgol mi rigs bod phyogs su gsar spros kyes gtong rgyu sngar bzhag gan don la mi gnas pa'i khar/ sa gnas 'dab 'brel khag mang nas 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'i 'grul lam 'go tshugs sogs lab rtsod kyes sa mtshams zhon mi 'jags pas zlongs shig dang / der brten bstan mar 'phral phugs gnod 'gal ji

le'udang po/ tā la'i bla'i skuphrengabacugasum pa thubabastanargyas༄ dusaskabs/'gyur 'gan blos bzod min la ngo gol mi rigs sa gnas ji 'drar 'byor rung / bkag 'gegs phyir slog mi zhu mthu med la de don rgya bod bka' sol 'phral du yod pa zhes zhu nan ci che dang 'brel bas ser skya mi dmangs nas ngos hu thog thu dang / bka' blon thun mong bcas la zhu tho dang / am ban chen por 'bul rgyu'i snyan zhu rtags 'byar bcas phul 'byor byung ba am ban mchog dgongs dngas ched ser skya spyi'i snyan zhu rtags 'byar zur 'bul zhus par thugs zhib kyis rgyal khab phan tshun tshong 'grul spyi khyab mdzad po'i ya mon la gnas tshul gnang 'os sogs bod khams bstan srid spyi don gal cher dgongs bzhes kyis ngo rgol mi rigs gsar spros yong thal mi 'byung ba zhig dgongs 'jags yod pa zhu/ de'i ched du/ me byi zla brgyad tshes bcu la phul zhes 'khod yod/ gong gsal gyi zhu yig 'di'i thog nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang ser skya mi mang yongs nas ngo gol mi rigs te u ru su nyul zhib pa bod du yong rgyu lta zhog tha na tshong 'grul dang yig 'grul tsam yang gtong len byed par ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas pa gsal po mthong thub/ de rjes u ru su'i nyul ma dang dmag don mi sna chab mdo sogs brgyud bod kyi sa khongs su yong thabs ji ltar byas rung / bod kyi sa gnas so so'i 'go dmangs yongs nas sems thag gtsang bcad kyis bkag 'gog mtha' gcig tu byas stabs kho pa tsho byed thabs dben pa'i gnas su gyar/phyi rol pa ni g.yo thabs ngan sbyor la shin tu mkhas pas u ru su'i mi ngo ma bod la thar thabs rtsa ba nas med stabs thabs lam gzhan zhig gi sgo nas bod kyi nang srid la the byus byed pa'i lkog g.yo'i ngan byus bshams pa ste/ mu ru su btsan rgyal ring lugs pas phyi sog btsan bzung byas rjes thog mar rje btsun dam pa brgyud tā la'i bla ma mchog 'gug thabs byas pa ma zad/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad gus tshad med byed khul gyis nang pa'i /spyan

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/par nyams gso dang / chos byed skyes bu dam pa rnams la rgyab skyor dang dngos po'i rogs ram shugs chen byed pa'i g.yo thabs la brten nas phyi sog yongs su kha lo bsgyur rjes nang sog dang bod rim bzhin za rtsis byas/ skabs derasbyi sog nas gzhin nu nyis brgya lhag tsam bod du 'ongs thog ser 'bras dga' gsum dang / gdan sa bkra shis lhun po bcas la rab tu byung / rdo rje g.yib zer ba yang skabs der lha sar 'byor te dpal ldan 'bras spungs dgon du grwa pa byas/ kho pa ni me rta (1846)lor phyi sog gi sa khongs li g.ya' thar skyes/ sog po'i ming du rdo rje g.yib dang / ming gzhan du ga'o mung lo sin o min g.ya' kun dbang rdo rje zer/ bod du 'byor rjes chos mingablo bzang ngag dbang zhes 'bod/ mi de'i ming sgra bsgyur byed stangs mi 'dra ba mang ba ste mu ru su'i yig thog tu rdo rje g.yud bu dang / dbyin yig tu rdo'o tri bu/ rgya yig tu nā gar kre zhes 'khod/ dbyin yig gi rdo rje g.yib kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus zhes pa'i nang 'khod don/ slospyi lo 1871lor/ rdo rje g.yib rang lo nyer lngar son skabs bod du 'ongs nas 'bras spungs dgon par rab tu byung / lo sum cu so lngar slebs skabs dgon pa de'i slob dpon byas/ rig gnas spyi dang lhag par du mtshan nyid la sbyang pa mthar phyin byas te mkhas par gyur/ skabs der rgyal khab phyi nang gi chab srid dang dmag las sogs 'jig rten khyim pa'i las la the byus rtsa ba nas mi byed par rab byung pa tshul ldan gyi ngang tshul bstan/ spyi lo 1898lor kho pa rang lo lnga bcu nga gnyis la slebs pa nas bzung kho pa'i gdong ris ngo ma de phyir bton te phyi don gal che khag la the gtogs dang nyes skyon 'dzems med kyis 'thab las g.yo 'khrul gyi bya ba mang tsam brtsams pas rdo rje g.yib zer ba'i ming de ka li ka tā dang / sbi mā sogs 'dzam gling sa cha mang por khyab/ spyi lo 1898lor/a/ sgri'u dang / u ru su'i shar lho zhing chen khag la bsod snyom gyi ming 'khyer
