le'udang po/ tā la'i blas phreng bcugasum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskab /nas bskyod skabs u ru su'i 'brel yod kyi blon chen tshos shes 'phral kho pa dang thug 'phrad thog nang sol zhib phra byas pa brgyud rdo rje g.yib lha sar bca' sdod u ru su'i sku tshab tu bsko gzhag byas zer/ de rjes rdo rje g.yib rim bzhin bod du phyir log ste rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshor 'bul ba 'bor chen bul/de bzhin bka' blon bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che gras khag la'ang dngos po mang tsam phul/ u ru su'i gsang nyul las khungs kyis bkod mngags byas pa ltar/ rdo rje g.yib kyis tā la'i bla ma sogs la zhu gsal/ tsa krung go'i rgyal khab ces pa khyed rang gi bdag po'i rgyal khab yin zhing / da lta sog ma chag dum lta bur gyur pas der bsnyes na mi 'grig krung go'i rgyal khab dbyin ji'i dbang shugs 'og tshud zin cing /dbyin ji de bzhin 'dod gnag rdzogs med dang / ye shu'i chos lugs la gus sems che bas khyed rang gi chos la dad gus mi byed pa ma zad/ bod kyi bla ma'i sku dbang srol rnying rtsa med du gtong nges yin/ ngo gol 'di bzhin gnam 'og gi stobs shugs can yin na dpung rogs byung tshe dbyin ji 'dul thub pas ma tshad/ ngo go'i gong ma'ang khyed rang gi chos la 'jug thub pa dang / ngo gol mi rigs yongs rdzogs spyan ras gzigs kyi mnga' 'bangs zhus te btsun pa slob ma yong nges red 7zer ba sogs g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba mang tsam spel/ skabs der tā la'i bla ma mchog nas chin krung dbyang srid gzhung la nor srid dang /mtshon cha'i thad rgyab skyor yong ba'i re ba ji ltar gsol yang chin gong mas mgo 'dogs kyi lam phyogs lag len bstar te bod mi mang gi dbyin 'gog mtha' srung gi rgyal gces kyi bya spyod la thog mtha' bar gsum du rgyab skyor mi byed pa dang / phyogs mtshungs chin rgyal rabs rang nyid kyang rim bzhin snum zad sgron me lta bur gyur pa sogs phyi nang gi gnas tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas su gyar bar brten rdo rje g.yib kyi g.yo gtam de dag don dngodi spyang

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/mtshungs pa'i bden gtam zhig tu gzigs te bka' shag sogs dpon rigs ser skya yongs dang / gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mir bka' bsdur tsam yang ma gnang bar gsang ba'i thog nas u ru sur phebs rtsis gnang / bka' shag gis gnas tshul de shes 'phral rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshor snyan zhu phul ba'i nang smyo u ru sus bod la rgyab skyor byed pa'i bsam pa yod na'ang gzhungadon gal che 'di lta bu rdo rje g.yib gcig pur bka' bsdur mdzad de thag gcod gnang ba ni dbang cha las brgal bas ga la srid mices gsol/ de nas bka' shag dang ser skya dpon rigs/ gdan sa gsum sogs kyis bya thabs rnam pa sna tshogs la brten nas bkag 'gog byas stabs sku ngo phebs gnang thabs bral bas sa phag (1899)lor/ rdo rje g.yib slar yang u ru sur bskyod de u ru su'i gong mas mjal 'phrad gnang / kho pa u ru sur bskyod pa'i skor la dbyin ji sogs rgyal khab mang pos do snang chen po byas shing / skabs de'i phyi rgyal tshags par thog bkod don/ 5tā la'i bla mas btang ba'i pho nya der u ru sus dga' bsu chen po zhus pa red/ pho nya'i ming la rdo rje zer/ kho'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni u ru su dang mdza' mthun gyi 'brel ba dam du gtong ched dang / tā la'i bla ma'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma dang yul zog sna tshogs gong mar phul zhing / de min u ru su'i rgyal sa hreng pa'o ru bod kyi gzhung tshab bca' sdod 'dzugs phyogs skor la gros mol byed par 'ong ba red mi zer/ yang tshags par 'ga' zhig thog bkod par lha tā la'i bla mas bltas na u ru su dang mdza' mthun yong ba byas na go rim bab dang mthun shos sheg yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan u ru su ni dbyin ji'i lkog gshom rtsa gtor gtong thub mkhan gyi rgyal khab stobs ldan nyag cig yin pa'i rkyen gyis red mi ces zer/ tā la'i bla ma mchog gis pho nya mngags te u ru su dang 'bristu ba dam zab tu gtong ba'i gnas tshul dus der dbyin ji btsan rgyal

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphrengabacu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/ring lugs pas shes 'phral khong khro chen po langs te 5tā la'i bla mas nga tsho'i tsung tu'u yis bsam pa'i brtse dung bstan pa de dang du mi len par nga tsho rtsis med btang ba ma zad/ mngon sum 'dzems med kyis u ru sur pho nya btang ba sogs byas stabs nga tshos de'i thad mjug 'bras ga 'dra zhig yong min da dung gsal po mi shes/ bod kyi da yod gnas tshul la bsgyur bcos sam dkrug thabs byed pa'i phyogs lhung gang zhig la'ang kha rog sdod thabs med mi zer/de nas rdo rje g.yib bod du phyir log byed skabs u ru su'i gong mas tā la'i bla mar 'bul byed yi ge gcig khyer yong nas brjod gsal/ ngo gol mi sna ched mngags gtong rgyu'i skor gros sol zhib gsal dgos rgyu zer ba dang /gong mas bkur ba'i ngo go'i shi lā chos lugs khang gi chos kyi bdag po'i chos srol gyon pa zhig tā la'i bla ma mchog la phul/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam song rjesardo rje g.yib slar yang a'o kra'u ru skyod skabs bka' shag sogs ser skya dpon rigs mang pos gser snyan sgron par tā la'i bla mas gsan 'jog rtsa ba nas ma gnang bar lkog tu sgo mang mtshan zhabs dar han mkhan po blo bzang ngag dbang dang sku tshab don gcod du rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs bal yul brgyud dang rtse drung gtam snyan ngag dbang chos 'dzin ngo mas dang gser dngul zangs lcags kyi bzo rigs kha shas sog yul brgyud u ru su la kho pa dang mnyam du gtong gnang mdzad/ kho pa tsho u ru sur 'byor rjes gong mas mjal 'phrad thog gros mol mang tsam byas/ lcags glang (1901)lor/ lha sar phyir log rjes tā la'i bla ma mjal skabs phan tshun gros mol zhus pa'i don tshan nang du chen wang lha sar mngags sdod kyis phan tshun dbar gyi mdza' grogs spel rgyu dang / bod kyi 'thus mi tshos phul ba'i u ru su dang bod dbar gyi chings zin nang 6 ngo gos bod la bzo sgo phye ('byed )dang / lho phyogs nye 'breladang byed dka' ba'i don rtsa byung tshe ngo gos nas khas len rogadi /ma

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/byed rgyu/ ngo go nas g.ya' shi g.ya' sa dkyil rgyal khab khongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu ’ zhes 'khod pa de skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma mchog la phul thog rtags 'dzugs gtan 'khel mdzad kyang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis khas ma blangs shing / yang tā la'i bla ma mchog dgongs 'gal yong dogs kyis bab sel mang tsam zhus pa ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma'i dgongs don 'ba' zhig mi sgrub thabs med du gyur te mtshon cha grabs gshom byed chen rdo rje g.yib slar yang u ru sur btang ste rim bzhin mtshon cha 'bor chen bod du dbor nas nor bu gling khar nyar tshags gnang / dus der rdo rje g.yib dang bka' blon bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje'i bar la'ang 'brel ba dam zab tu song ba dang / bka' blon bshad sgra'i lta ba la'ang 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste u ru sur dpung rogs bcol nas dbyin 'gog rang srung gi dmag 'thab byed pa'i thabs byus la yongs su mos mthun byas/skabs der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas sa mtshams su zhib bsher byed par kha g.yar te dmag mi btang thog gam pa rdzong btsan bzung byas/ da dung bod la drag po'i btsan 'dzul rgya che byed pa'i gra sgrig byas pa ma zad/ dbyin ji dang bod dbar gyi 'brel ba de u ru su dang bod dbar gyi 'brel ba las ha cang dam zab che ba yod/ gal srid u ru sus bod du bya spyod spel tsam byas na dbyin jis zur bshol rtsa ba nas mi byed thag chod yin zer/u ru sus bod du gsang nyul thengs mang btang ste bod kyi chab srid dang /dmag don/ dpal 'byor sogs phyogs gang thad nas yongs su kha lo bsgyur dgos bsams na'ang skabs der ri pin dang u ru su'i dbar gyi 'brel ba nyin bzhin je sdug tu song stabs dbyin jir kha gtad gcog pa'i nus pa dang bral te phyir bshol mi byed thabs med kyi gnas su gyur/46

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphrengabacu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/lnga pa/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal par ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa/7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan yongs su bzhes rjes sngar bzhin dbyin 'gog mtha' srung gi mdzad phyogs phyag bstar mdzad stabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang am ban dbar gyi 'gal ba shugs je cher phyin zhing der brten dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs par bod btsan bzung byed pa'i go skabs gsar pa zhig rnyed de dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa'i dmag dpon ho'i thes dbyin dmag nyis brgya tsam 'khrid de gam pa rdzong khongs rgya khang zhes pa'i sa cha de btsan bzung gis 'brog pa'i ra lug lnga stong tsam dang 'bri g.yag drug brgya tsam 'phrog bcom byas/ skabs der bod mi mang gis 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byas pa dang / u ru sus kyang bod kyi rgyab langs byas te dbyin jir mtha' tshig nan po bsgrags stabs dbyin ji'i 'go dmag rnams phyir 'then mi byed thabs med kyi gnas su byar/denas dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas zhi ba'i g.yo thabs la brten nas sa phag (1899)lor ka shi rmir bca' sdod dbyin ji'i ngo tshab dang rdo rje gling du bca' sdod 'brug rgyal po'i sku tshab o rgyan brgyud 7gong sa mchog la yi ge snga rjes khag gnyis phul te tā la'i bla ma sku ngo ma dang mjal 'phrad zhus nas bod kyi sa mtshams dang / dbyin bod tshong 'grul skor sogs gros mol zhu rgyu'i re ba bton yang / chin krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sdod am ban brgyud de mgatogs phyi rgyal ba dang yig 'grul byas mi chog zer ba'i yi ge de gnyis phyir slog mdzad/ 'on kyang chin krung dbyang srid gzhung la bod sa ga/lha kyi

bod kyi nye rabs lorgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/ don gnad skor 'dra mnyam drang bden gyi skad cha shod pa'i nus pa bral stabs dbyin gzhung dang zhi 'jam mthun thabs kyi bsam pa bcangs te 'bras spyi blon chen zer ba'i dbyin ji'i mi sbel brgyud dbyin gzhung la 'brel gtugs byas shing / spel gyis chu stag (1902)lo'i zla 5tshes 26nyin bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad la dbyin jis bod kyi gnad don skor gyi bsam 'char zer ba'i yi ge zhig sprad pa'i nang 'khod pa 'di ltar/6 dang po/ rgya gar srid gzhung gis krung go'i dpon rigs la dbang cha med pas bod gcun mi thub pa mthong rjes dbang cha yod pa'i bod dpon dang chings yig bskyar du 'jog rgyu las da phyin krung go'i dpon rigs la bod bdag skyong byed pa'i dbang cha med pa bzo rtsis 'dugaganyis pa/ bod srid gzhung gis gal te mi sna btang nas kho tsho dang gros mol ma byas na kho tshos go skabs dang bstun te bod du yong nas bod kyi srid dbang gi tshab byas te bdag skyong byed rgyu red/gsum pa/ u ru sus kyang byang phyogs nas dpung 'jug byed srid cing /de ltar byung na lho phyogs nas rgya gar dang byang phyogs nas u ru sus btsir rgol gyis /da la btsan shed kyis na'o li ltar rang dbang rang bdag byed 'jug / zhi bye/ blon chen gang nyid kyis nges par du 'phral du tā la'i bla ma dang gros mol gnang nas mi sna 'jon thang che ba zhig bdams thog dbang cha tshang ma gnang ste krung go'i dpon rigs dang mnyam du las don sgrub tu 'jug dgos pa las bod dpon gyis phyi gling pa dang 'brel gtug byas nas rang mtshams kyis chings yig 'jog tu 'jug mi rung zhes zer/gong gsal don tshan de dag gi thog nas dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lu/sdu pas bod btsan bzung byed rgyu'i lkog gshom de dmar rjen du thon pa

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dus bas/dang / /na thokrung dbyang srid gzhung de'ang nus med nyams zhan du gyur pa gsal de /sa r+sha// /ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas sa mtshams su rang snang gang shar gyis rdo rtags gsar pa btsugs te sa cha mang po btsan bzung byas stabs bod mi mang khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar nas rdo rtags gsar pa de rnams gtor bar brten dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas bod dmag gis sa mtshams las brgal ba dang / chings thag dang rgyab 'gal byas pa red zer ba sogs dkar nag gab phyi slog pa'i gleng phyogs mang tsam bzos/ don dngos thog bod phyogs nas thog mtha' bar gsum du chin 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen po chan lung khri bzhugs lo nga dgu (1794)lor gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i sa mtshams tho po las nam yang mi brgal bar rang mtshams brtan por bzung yod/ 'on kyang chu yos (1902)lor dbyin ji'i gzhung phyogs nas bod 'bras sa mtshams su zhi ba'i gros sol byas te sa mtshams gnad don thag gcod byed dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ltar/ lo de'i zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin/ 7gong ma chen po'i bkas mngags bod bzhugs sku tshab gnas gsum pa'i kre rmu hwa 'un shin dang / gro mo'i dpya khral si sba 'ar/ bka' shag gi ngo tshab drung yig che mo ba blo bzang 'phrin las/ dbus mda' tsha rong dbangaphyug rgyal po bcas 'thus mi bzhi dang las bya rtse drung dge 'dun chos dar dang / brgya dpon 'gyur med tshe brtan/ lding dpon mi lnga/ rgya sbyong dmag mi bcu gnyis bcas gtong gnang mdzad kyang / dus der dbyin dmag gi dmag dpon rung ha'o h+phang dang / 'bras ljongs su bca' sdod dbyin ji'i kron yon hos thā gnyis kyis dbyin ji'i 'thus mi'i ming khyer nas dmag mi nyis brgya tsam sne 'khrid de bod la 'brel ba tsam yang ma byas par sa mtshams las brgal te gam pa rdzong phyogs su 'ongs/ sa gnas rdzong sdokā /sa

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/bkag 'gog ji ltar byas kyang nyan 'jog byed rgyu lta zhog rdzong dpon la'ang nyes rdung btang zhing / de 'phral gam pa rdzong sdod btsag ser khang bas bkras lhunabla brang brgyud bka' shag la snyan zhu phul ba'i phyir lan phebs gsal du tsa nye sngon bod zla gsum pa'i nang dbyin gzhung nas yi ge 'byor gsal dbyin bod sa mtshams dang / tshong 'grul skor gros sol thag gcod byed par gam 'bras sa mtshams su mi sna do chod 'phral gtong dgos rgyu gsal ba bzhin 'di nas zhi gros mdzad po bod bzhugs am ban sku tshab hwa 'un shin dang /mkhan drung blo bzang 'phrin las/ dbus mda' tsha rong dbang phyug rgyal po/las bya ser skya/ sku srung dmag mi dang bcas ched rdzong song ba bzhin gzhi rkang da lam gam 'bras sa mtshams su bod dbyin lhan 'dzoms gnang rgyu 'di bzhin zhi ba'i 'phros sne mthun thabs shig yin rung / pha rol po chab srid kyi g.yo thabs che bas da dung bsam sbyor ngan gshom ji yod ma nges stabs gam pa de bzhin de ga bla brang gi 'dzin khongs yin gshes rdzong sdod mi sna do chod yod shag la 'di ga'i zhi gros mi snar go sdur dang 'brel gzhis byes phyar ba gru 'degs kyis don du btsan 'dzul mi yong ba'i zhi drag thabs sgo gang mkhas kyi mdzad phyogs 'thus zab yod pa zhes 'khod pa ltar bkras lhun bla brang gis de 'phral ser skya dpon rigs yongs kyi tshogs 'du bskongs 'tshogs thog gam pa rdzong nas dbyin ji phyir slog byed pa'i gros mol byed par kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i sku tshab sngags chen mkhan po grub dbang sprul sku dang /rtse phyag las 'phar rim bzhi nor sgang bsod nams dbang 'dus/ las bya lde 'chang mdangs chen srid dar dang / las tshan ldan lhun/ las tshan don khang / yul dmag 'go 'doms shod drung steng pa sogs lag rtags yul zog 'bor chen 'khyer nas gtong gnang ltar khong tshos 'jam bshad ji ltar byas kyadwa sdun 'bras gang yang ma byung zhing / de nas chin krung dbyang srid gzhung

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab rnams gam pa rdzong du 'byor 'phral dbyin phyogs dang 'brel gtugs byas thog sngon tshud nas brjod gsal ltar zhi ba'i gros mol byed yul gro mo kho nar ma gtogs gam pa rdzong du byas na mi 'grigs zhes bshad/ 'on kyang dbyin phyogs kyis nyan 'jog rtsa ba nas ma byas par/ da dung pe cing du bca' sdod dbyin ji'i dpon rigs sā ta g.yis chin krung dbyang srid gzhung la gros sol 'thus mir bod sdod am ban dang bka' blon zhig gtong dgos brjod pa ltar/ nus med gnyod chung du gyur pa'i chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod bzhugs am ban g.yus gang 'phral du gam pa rdzong du bskyod de zhi ba'i gros mol thog phan tshun dmag 'thab mi yong ba byed dgos pa'i bka' phab kyang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mis bod bzhugs am ban gam brdzong du 'gro rgyur ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas te brjod don/ 5sngon chad lung thur lar pham nyes byung yang da lta bskyar gso byed thub/ bod bzhugs am ban hreng tha'i yis dmag rgyag par bkag 'gog mang po byas stabs sa cha shor ba red/ da res gal te slar yang bkag 'gog byas tshe bod bzhugs am ban gyis slar yang las gar 'thus shor bzos pa rang red ces bshad/skabs der bod bzhugs am ban g.yus gang dang las rogs gnyis ka bya thabs dben pa'i gnas su gyur nas gong mar bod kyi gnas tshul skor zhib gsal snyan zhu phul thog lasu gnas dgongs pa zhus shing / de'i las tshab tu g.yu'u thad bod sdod am ban dang rna chen las rogs su bsko gzhag stsal/skabs der bka' blon bshad sgras gtsos pa'i bka' shag gis dbyin zhi ba'i gros mol las drag shugs kyi 'gog rgol byed par mos mthun ma byas stabs 7gong sa mchog dgongs tshoms kyis bka' blon bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje dang / bka' blon zhol khang tshe brtan dbang phyug bka' blon 54 ma

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/chang khyim ngag dbang dpal bzang / dza sag hor khang pa bsod nams stobs rgyal bcas las zhabs gnas dbyungs kyis nor gling las shag tu do dam thogatshogs 'thus zur btsugs kyi zhib gcod gnang rgyu gtan 'bebs mdzad cing / hor khang dza sag 'jigs skrag gis ma bzod par bros te lha sa'i skyid chur mchongs nas rang srog rang gis lcebs pa red/de nas chu yos (1902)zla 10par dbyin dmag rnams rang 'gul gyis phyir 'then byas shing / dbyin gzhung nas zhi ba'i gros mol gyis sa mtshams gnad don thag gcod byed dgos brjod pa de g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba tsam yin zhing / don du skabs der bod la drag po'i btsan 'dzul byed pa'i gra sgrig mu mthun byas nas gzhis rtse sa khul du so pa 'bras ljongs pa mi gnyis btang ste nyul zhib byed pa sogs khrims 'gal gyi bya ba mang tsam spel bas sa gnas de ga'i rdzong sdod nas 'dzin bzung byas/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpon rung ha'o glang gis gnas tshul de shes 'phral gong gsal gsang nyul de gnyis nyin bcu'i nang glod dgos pa dang / gun gsab dbyin ji'i sgor mo nyis stong sprod dgos zer ba sogs tshul min gyi re 'dun mang tsam bton kyang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum gyis re 'dun de dag la mos mthun rtsa ba nas ma byas stabs gam pa rdzong khul nas 'bri g.yag nyis brgya tsam dang / dngos po 'bor chen 'phrogs pa ma zad/ dkar nag gab phyi slog ste sa mtshams skor zhi ba'i gros sol legs sgrub ma byung ba'i 'gan gtso bo bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis 'khur dgos pa dang / dbyin ji dang bod kyi gnad don de drag shugs la brten nas thag gcod dgos zer/dus mtshungs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis ser skya mi mang yongs nas mdung shugs gcig sgril gyis bstan dgra phyi gling par 'gog rgol mtha' gzi/ tu byed ched dmag skul rtsa tshig spel ba'i nang don 'di ltar/ 6 bod

le'udang po/ tā pa'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/ljongasakyi sa mtshams kyi gnad don skor da lta sa mtshams de gar krung dbyin gros tshogs 'tshog thog gros mol byed bzhin yod mod/ 'on kyang phyogs gnyis 'cham mthun ngang nas nyan 'jog byed thub pa zhig yong ha cang khag po red/ gal srid da dung khungs lung med pa'i re 'dun bton byung na rang res nges par du mi yul bde skyid kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched du rang lus 'bul dgos pa las lag pa bskums nas bsdad na gtan nas 'grig gi ma red/ bod ljongs kyi spyi sgrigs mna' gan mthu bo che'i nang du gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar yar langs nas kho tsho'i khungs lung med pa'i byed stangs la rgol lan sprod dgos/ de'i don du sa byi lor khyab bsgrags byas pa'i rtsa tshig nang du chag yang btang ba'i sger pa'i khral dang / dmag khral/ dbul po'i khral bcas dang / lcags yos lor rtog zhib byas rjes khyab bsgrags byas pa'i khral chag gtong srol yig gsal rnams phun/ de byings gzhung sger chos gsum khongs kyi 'brog pa yin phyin khral rkang drug re la dmag mi re 'khri sgrub byed dgos/ gzhan yang sa khul khag gi mi mang dang lo na sogs ming tho gsar du bkod de sngar lam dmag khral rgyugs stangs sam lugasasrol ltar ming tho gsar pa'i nang du bkod pa'i mi rnams nges par du dud tshang so so'i mir brtsis nas 'di gar skyel dgos/ 'on kyang dud tshang de'i khongs mi gal srid dngos gnas gas pa'am lo na phra ba zhig yin pas mi gzhan zhig tshab byed du 'jug dgos byung tshe skye stobs 'bar zhing las nagan 'pher ba zhig 'dems dgos pa las khral sel sla bcos rigs byas mi chogamatshon cha dang / rdzas mdel/ sbi sdi/ zla ba gcig gi dmag rgyags sogs dmag mkho'i dngos mas skor rgyal rtse zhol pas sa byi lor khyab bsgrags byas pa'i lugs srol ltar byed dgos mi zhes zer/skabs der dbyin jis bod la btsan 'dzul thengs gnyis pa bye༄ /go

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbu ra'i sgradabyangs/tshugs shing / chin dus rabs su dbyin jis bod la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i lo rgyus zhes pa'i nang 4spyi lo 1902lo'i zla 11par/ dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas sing pa'i rkang dmag chig stong bzhi brgya tsam dang / gor ṣa'i dmag mi mi grangs bdun brgya/ rta dmag mi grangs brgya/ me phyogs dang me mda' sbag sbag gi dmag sde khag gcig g.yul 'gyed dmag mi'i sman khang / rgyab phyogs mkho sprod dpung sde sogs mi grangs tshig khri lhag tsam sgrig 'dzugs byas shing / de'i nang dbyin ji'i mi brgya lhag tsam las med/ dbyin dmag gi dmag dpon chen po r+sā khā thang rna'i bkod 'doms 'og hrang zha'o dmag dponadung ha'o h+phang gis dmag sne 'khrid de lo de'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu nyin/ gong gsal dbyin dmag rnams nag thang du 'dzoms/ de nas rim bzhin rdza leb la brgal te gro mo rin chen sgang dang / phag ri stod la/ gu ru phyogs su 'ongs zhes 'khod/ skabs der khams khul sho star lho gsum dang / rmar mdzo gsang gsum/ ri chab dpa' gsum/ dwags kong rdzong gzhis khag brgyad/ dbus gtsang rdzong gzhis bdun/ lho kha rdzong gzhis khag bco brgyad/ nag tshang tsho drug byang rigs sde bzhi sogs kyi yul dmag dang /'don dmag rnams rim bzhin g.yul sa'i mdun phyogs su bskyod de bod dmag sum stong lhag tsam phag rir 'byor nas 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byas kyang / chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi mngags te dbyin phyogs dang gros mol byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ 'on kyang bod mi mang gis mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams dang rang gi pha yul srung skyob byed ched mu mthud 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad kyang gro mor 'gro mi nus par de mur sdod dgos byung zhing / dus der dbyin dmag giX sdug ri btsan bzung byas rjes rim bzhin rgyal rtse phyogs su dmag bskyod

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/byed pa'i grabs byas kyang / bod dmag gi rgyab phyogs dpung rogs ji yod ma shes stabs dbyin jis do po dbor 'dren byed mkhan bod mi gnyis la rngan pa 'bor chen sprad de phyugs rdzi bar brdzus nas ka la bar bod dmag gi rgyab phyogs su dpung rogs gang dang gang yod nyul zhib byed par btang / kho pa gnyis phyir log skabs cha lu dmag sgar gyis mi gcig 'dzin bzung byas pa dang / gcig shos lho phyogs jo mo ri gsham brgyud bros phyin te dbyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag gi 'go dpon la chu mig gshongs ko dang / rdo chen/ cha lu/ ka la sogs la dmag sgar rim bzhin yod pa dang / rgyab phyogs dpung dmag kyang 'bor chen yod pa'i gsang ba'i gnas tshul rnams dbyin dmag gi 'go dpon la bshad stabs dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te byed thabs bsgyur nas g.yo can drang brdzus kyis shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga zhogs pa dud sne nas bod kyi dmag sgar la yi ge zhig btang don/yod bar bod dbyin dbar zhi gros rim par byas rung bod phyogs nas zhi drag spyi 'doms dbang cha che ba'i mi sna med stabs thag gcod ma thub pas da cha dbang cha yod pa'i mi sna dang nga tsho ngo 'phrad byas thog da phan 'khrun chod ma thub pa rnams da lam sa gnas 'di rang du 'khrun chod bya rgyur nga tshor mos mthun yod cing / dbyin bod zhi gros mi sna gang mgyogs lhan 'dzoms bya rgyu yin ’ zhes zer/ bod kyi dpon dmag rnams dmag don dang chab srid kyi bya bar myong byang dman pa dang / bya ba che rigs mtha' dag lha dang bla ma'i bka' lung la gzhigs te bsgrub dgos pas dbyin dmag gi g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba'i mgo bskor du tshud de gros mol byed rgyu khas blangs shing / de nasadabyin ji'i dpon dmag sngon la rta dmag dang / de rjes rkang dmag dos khal/khur pa gla mi sogs rim bzhin chu mig gshongs ko phyogs su 'ongs/ sa gnas de ga'i sa srung bod dmag dang zhi ba'i gros sol la gzhug mkhan 'gāswā mi

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/rnams bzhugs mus thog dbyin dmag gi cho bab yong rkyen rnams so lta rim pa btsugs yod pas gsang gnas gang yod skabs 'phral snyan seng zhus 'phral mda' dpon lha sding sras dang / rnam gling pa/ rgyal rtse ru dpon skyid sbug pa/ khang shar/ paṇa chen rin po che'i sku tshab rtse gsol dpon mkhan po zur khang nub/ se 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi bcas nang gros zhib gsal mdzad don/ sngon la dbyin jir gros mol byed mkhan gdong len du thon te zhi ba'i thabs lam la brten nas dbyin bod dbar gyi gnad don rnams thag gcod yong ba byed rgyu dang / gal srid zhi ba'i gros mol byas te phan tshun mthun thabs ma byung tshe rang cag rnams nas bstan srid kyi la rgya mi 'dor bar dpa' ngar zhum med kyis 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byed dgos stabs 'go dmag rnams 'dzing rags khag la bgos te me mda' yi sbud ti spar nas sdod dgos pa dang / gri/ mdung / 'ur rdo sogs gra sgrig ang gsar dgos pa las/ 'tshab 'tshub kyis me mda' kha shor te dkrog rkyen bzo ba sogs dgos med kyi bya ba'i rigs mi yong ba byed dgos zer brda khyab btang zhing / de nas dbyin bod phyogs gnyis phan tshun 'brel mthun byas thog mda' dpon lha sding sras dang rnam sras gling / rgyal rtse ru dpon skyid sbugapaṇa chen rin po che'i sku tshab gsol dpon mkhan po zur khang nub sogs bod phyogs kyi 'thus mi dang / rung ha'o glang sogs dbyin ji'i 'go dmag gi 'thus mi rnams chu mig gshongs ko'i dkyil du rdo'i rags skyor zhig yod sar tshang ma 'dzoms thog phan tshun go ming gnas bab ngo sprod gnang res mdzad 'phraladabyin ji'i dmag dpon rung ha'o h+phang gis smyo gros sol byed par thog maraphyogs gnyis gas sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen du zhi ba'i 'go nas gros sol byed dgos stabs drag chas 'jog dgos pas phan tshun dmag mi tsho'i me mda'i nadī spya mde'u 'don dgos shing / bod dmag tshos spud ti'i me gsod dgos

le'udang po/ tā la'i bras skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/pa dang / dbyin dmag tshang mas me mda'i khog nang gi mde'u tshang ma 'don rgyu yin zhes brjod/ skabs der bod dmag gi lding dpon yan la 'phrul mda' re ma gtogs dmag dkyus rnams la bod mda' re dang / gri dpa' dam re las med/ bod phyogs kyi 'go dmag dpon rigs tshos dgra phyogs kyi kha mkhas tshig 'jam la yid ches kyis mda' dpon lha sding pa sogs 'thus mi rnams nas de ltar dang len gyis bod dmag rnams la bka' brda btang bas bod dmag yongs nas me mda'i sbud ti bsad de zhi ba'i thabs lam brgyud dbyin bod gnad don thag gcod yong ba'i re stong bsgug ste blo lhod po'i ngang bsdad cing / dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa ni g.yo 'phrul gdug rtsub kyi las la byang chub pa zhig yin stabs lkog tu dbyin dmag mang po bod dmag gi mtha' skor du yib ste bsdad cing / me mda'i khog nang gi mde'u bton yang me mda'i mthil gyi snum blugs sa'i nang mde'u sbas te nyar/ de nas phan tshun zhi ba'i gros sol byed 'go tshugs te chu tshod skar ma bco lnga tsam song skabs dbyin dmag gi dmag dpon zhig gis glo bur du me mda' chung chung zhig bton nas lha sding sras dang / rnam sras gling sogs bod phyogs kyi 'thus mi rnams la me mda' 'phangs pa'i sgra de nye 'gram du sgug bsdad pa'i rang phyogs 'thus mi'i gamagayog tshos thos 'phral lha sding sras kyi a phrug dgra 'dul gyis nga tsho'i mi bsad song zhes mda' dpon lha sding gi chibs pa'i thog gi dpa' dam de shubs las phyungs te ki sgra sgrog bzhin der yod g.yog 'ga' zhig gi sne 'khrid de the tshom spu tsam yang med par mchongs te dbyin dmag ru dpon gcig dang /brgya dpon gcig lding dpon gcig sogs 'go dmag bcu grangs zhig la gri bsnun te bsad rmas btang / mtha' bzhir yod pa'i bod dmag rnams kyis kyang dpa' ngar zhum pa med par ral gri 'phyar bzhin mchong yong yang dbyin dmag gis mtha' bzhi bskor te me mda' sbag sbag sogs deng rabs dīnā gyi

bod kyi nye rabs lo sa ta ra'i sgradabyangs/mtshon cha bed spyad stabs bod dmag rnams dpa' rtsal can gyi dpa' bo lag thum dang 'dra bar bya thabs dben pa'i gnas su lhungs shing / mthar bod phyogs kyi 'thus mi rnam sras gling pa dang paṇa chen rin po che'i sku tshab gsol dpon mkhan po zur khang nub dang / ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi gcig ru dpon khang gsar ba bcas sa gnas de ga rang du bkrongs/ de min bod dmag lnga brgya tsam srog shor ba dang / bod dmag nyis brgya tsam rmas pa'i go lag yongs rdzogs phrogs shing / mda' dpon lha sding sras kyang rmas nas ro yi dkyil du shi brdzu btab ste bzhugs pa'i skabs su sa rub mtshams su dbyin dmag gi rdog khres dbor mi 'ga' zhig ro yi dkyil du rna long dang / tshigs khebs sogs dngos po 'tshol bar 'ongs shing / 'bras ljongs pa'i bud med gcig gis mda' dpon lha sding sras kyi phyag mdzub tu gser gyi tshigs khebs cig yod pa mthong 'phral gri chung zhig bton te mdzub mo gcod par 'ongs pas lha sding sras na re/ gser gyi tshigs khebs 'di khyod la sprad chog nga tsho chos lugs gcig pa red/ dbyin dmag la gsang brda ma skyel rogs zhes yang yang gsungs/ 'on kyang mos gser gyi tshigs khebs de tshur blangs te dbyin ji'i dmag sgar du 'byor rjes dgra dmag la bod dmag gi dmag dpon zhig ro'i dkyil du shi rdzu btab ste bsdad 'dug ces smras pas dbyin dmag gis mda' dpon lha sding bzung bar 'ong ba gzigs ma thag tu nye 'gram du yod pa'i rta dkar po zhig chibs te chu mig gshongs ko'i shar ngos kyi ri'i steng du bros phebs skabs dbyin dmag gis me phyogs 'phangs pas lha sdingasras dpa' ngar ldan pa'i ngang sku gshegs so/ de nas sa rub mtshams ro'i dkyil du shi rdzu btab ste bsdad pa'i bod dmag gzhan rnams bros phyin pa dang / ru dpon skyid sbug pa zhabs la me mda' phog ste rmas nas lus pa zhaswāswā phyis mthong 'phral sgal par 'khur ba dang / ru dpon steng pa yang rmas

le'u dang po/ tā pa'i bla'i skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/stabs dmag dkyus shig gis sgal par 'khur te 'gro ba dmag mi gzhan gyis mthong 'phral res mos kyis 'khur nas rim bzhin skyid spug gi 'dzin khongs cha lu gzhis su 'byor ba dang ru dpon skyid sbrug pas bka' shag tu rta shad btang ste snga phyi'i yong rkyen rnams zhib gsal snyan zhu phul ba dang 'brel de khul dmag sgar khag la 'gog srung byed thabs skor la gsang 'phrin skyel bar btang zhing / bod dmag rnams phyir 'then byed pa'i lam bar dbyin dmag dang dmag 'thab yang yang byas te slar yang bod dmag bdun brgya tsam shi rmas byung / mdor na/ thengs 'di'i dbyin rgol dmag 'thab nang bod dmag gi mda' dpon lha sding sras dang / rnam sras gling / ru dpon khang gsar byang ma sogs mi grangs tshig stong bzhi brgya lhag tsam shi rmas byung ba dang / go lag phal che ba dgra lag tu shor zhing / dbyin dmag gi hrang sha'o dmag dpon pu lan rda'i lag pa ya gcig shor ba dang / hrang sha'o dmag dpon tun la'o dang gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan la rmas skyon chen po phoga'ago dmag bcu gsum tsam shi rmas byung ba las/ de min mi srog dang rgyu dngos gang la'ang gnod pa che ba gang yang byung med/chu mig gshongs ko'i dmag 'thab la pham nyes 'di lta bu byung ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dbyin dmag gi g.yo thabs la brten nas glo bur du tshur rgol byas pa dang gcig chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis mgo 'dogs ring lugs kyi lam phyogs lag len bstar te dbyin 'gog dmag 'khrug la mi shugs dang dngos shugs gang gi thad nas kyang rogs skyor gang yang ma byas pa dang gnyis/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa nang khul du'ang 'gal ba che bas mdung shugs gcig sgril gyi dmag 'thab byed ma thub pa dang gsum/ lha bla ma'i lung bstan kho nar brten nas dmag 'thab byed pa las bod dmag gi 'go dmag rnams dmag don gyi shes bya dang sbyong brdar hā/na

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/pa/ myong byang go mtshon zhan pa dang bcas bzhi'o/ 'on kyang thengs 'di'i dmag 'thab la pham nyes chen po byung ba des bod kyi 'go dmangs yongs la khrag gi bslab bya gting zab cig thob ste khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar bzhin dbyin ji btsan 'dzul par 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byed pa'i sems thag bcad cing / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kyang bod kyi ser skya mi mang yongs la skul slong shugs chen byas te slar yang dmag skul brgyab nas 'don dmag dang / yul dmag ser dmag bsdoms chig khri drug stong lhag tsam rgyab dpung du btang ste rgyal rtse dang / gzhis rtse/ sna dkar rtse sogs dmag 'thab kyi 'gag rtsa sa gnas khag la sa srung du bzhag dus der chu mig gshongs ko nas phyir 'then byas pa'i dmag mi lhag 'phros sum brgya bcu tsam las med kyang rgyab phyogs kyi dpung rogs khag gcig rim bzhin 'byor te dmag grangs nyis stong sum brgya skor yod pa zhib bsher dang 'brel rdzas mdel dmag rgyags sogs la legs sgrig 'os 'tshams byas thog gtsang mda' bkras gling pa dang / rgyal rtse mda' dpon ram pa bcas 'go dmag yongs kyis sems thag gtsang bcad kyis dmag 'thab byed rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag dbyin dmag gis mu mthun rgyal rtse phyogs su yong ba'i lam bar byang gling dgon pa dang / sku 'bum dgon pa sogs dgon sde mang po mer bsregs pa dang sku gsung thugs rten dang mang tshogs kyi dngos po mang po 'phrog bcom byas shing / de rjes dbyin dmag rnams khang dmar gyi lho nub ri rgyab tu gnas pa'i sho lam dgon du 'byor ba'i nam smad du mda' dpon bkras gling pa dang ram pa gnyis kyis dmag dpung 'khrid de mtshan 'gebs drag 'thab byas mthar dbyin dmag 60lhag tsam bsad rmas btang ba dang / dbyin dmag gi me mda' chung chung 'ga' zhig thob/ de nas dbyin dmag rgyal rtser 'gyu sdu'i lam bur bod dmag gis 'gog rgol dmag 'thab thengs mang byas

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/shing / lhag par du dbyin dmag rnams rdza 'phrang brgyud yong skabs lho kha dang dwags kong khul gyi 'don dmag dang / yul dmag ser dmag sogs mi grangs 2000tsam bsdu nub kyis mda' dpon bkras gling pa dang / ram pa/smon skyid gling pa/ ser dmag gi 'go 'doms 'bras srungs bsam lho bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/ ser byes har gdong blo bzang / dga' ldan byang rtse blo dga'/ ra stod byams pa phun tshogs/ se ra'i rdob rdob a dga'/ rdob rdob kun rdur can sogs kyis dmag grabs gang legs byas te dbyin dmag tshar gcod gtong rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag rdza 'phrang zer ba'i sa cha de ni g.yasagayon gnyis kur brag ri mtho ba dang / lam thag ring la gu dog pa/dgra bor dmag 'thab byed sa'i sa cha btsan po zhig yin zhing / de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ri steng du 'dzing rags bzos te bod dmag rnams kyi 'phrul mda' dang / bod mda'/ mda' gri mdung gsum gra sgrig legs par byas nas sgug bsdad de dgra bo tshar gcod gtong rtsis byas kyang rang dmag gcig gis me mda' kha shor stabs dbyin dmag gis ri'i g.yas g.yon du bod dmag yod pa shes te me phyogs dang 'phrul mda' mang po 'phen zhing / ri klung gi khyad par shor stabs bod dmag gis me mda' dang / rbab rdo mang po bsgril te dbyin dmag la mas skyon gang 'tshams phog pa las tshar gcod gtong ba'i dmigs yul sgrub ma thub/ de nas dbyin dmag gis mu mthud mdun bskyod thog rim bzhin rgyal rtse'i nye 'gram gnas rnying dgon par 'byor te chos byed skyes bu rnams la mnar gcod tshad med btang / dgon pa de btsan bzung gis rdo gcal gyi dkyil du sgar brgyab ste bsdad cing / bod dmag gis gnas tshul de shes 'phral thabs gros gzab nan byas te nyin zhig mtshan mo kong dmag gis gnas rnying dgon pa'i mtha' bskor te glo bur 'jab rgol byas stabs dbyin dmag gis bod dmag rnams mthong ma thag tu dngangasdu /ga

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/rab tu skyes te bros thabs byas kyang ma thar bar dbyin dmag du ma tshar bcad cing / gnas rnying dgon pa'i sgo ra de yang khrag gi mtshe'u lta bur gyur pas da lta'ang phas rgol ma rungs pa'i khrag rjes dngos su mthong rgyu yod/ yul de khul gyi dmangs gzhas su lha a dar kong po'i dmag gis/ dbyin mgo sa la g.yugs song / gnas rnying rdo gcal che mo/ dmar po'i khrag gis brgyangs song ’ zhes pa de ni skabs de'i dmag 'thab kyi gnas tshul dngos su mtshon pa zhig red/ de rjes dbyin dmag la dpung rogs rim bzhin 'byor te rgyal rtse btsan bzung thog 'bru rigs khal stong phrag kha shas dang / 'bar rdzas kron kha shas phrogs pa ma zad/ rgyal rtse rdzong gi khang pa mang che ba bshig dbyin dmag gi dmag dpon rung ha'o h+phang gis sne 'khrid byas pa'i dbyin dmag rnams myang chu'i 'gram gyi lcang lo gling khar sgar brgyab ste bsdad pa'i skabs su mtshan mo zhig la bod dmag chig stong lhag tsam gyis lag tu gri ring thogs te mkha' lding sbrul la brngams pa ltar dbyin dmag gi dmag sgar du phar rgol byas stabs btsan 'dzul pa la la dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te chu la mchongs pa dang / la la dmar gsod btang zhing / dmag dpon rung ha'o h+phang dang dmag mi bzhi bcu lhag tsam dngangs 'tshab ngang gro mo chu 'bi pho brang du bros phyin/ skabs de'i dmangs gzhas su 4ri bya ri la bros song / phi gling chu la mchongs song / dpa' bo'i bod dmag tsho yis/ phi gling tsag gshag btang song zhes btang bar grags/ rung ha'o h+phang sogs chu 'bi pho brang du 'byor nas dbyin ji'i dmag dpon chen po rmad khā thang sna la dmag rogs 'phral gtong dgos pa'i re ba bton pa bzhin rmad khā thang sna yis dmag dpung 'bor chen 'khrid de deng rabs can gyi me phyogs dang / me mda' sbag sbag sogs mtshon cha mang po 'khyer nas rgyal rtser 'byor 'phral bod dmag la tshur goX snrogs chen byas pa ma zad/ pha lha grong tsho dang / lcang lo gling kha btsan

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/bzung thog dmag don gyi rten gzhi btsugs te rdzong rtse'i mtha' bskor nas ha cang nyen kha che ba'i gnas su gyar ba'i skabs der gnas rnying dgon dang /rgyal rtse rtse chen dgon dgra lag tu shor ba ma zad/ rgyal rtse rdzong yang dgra lag tu shor nyen che ba'i zhib gsal snyan zhu bka' blon g.yu thog brgyud bka' shag tu phul bar de 'phral bka' shag gis bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad la rgyal rtse khul du snga phyir dmag 'thab rgyal pham ji ltar byung tshul skor dang / da lta zhi ba'i gros sol yong thabs med pas dgra bor 'gog rgol byed phyogs thad bka' bsdur zhus kyang / bod bzhugs am ban gyis 6 man ching gong mas bod dbyin dbar zhi gros kyi thag gcod byed pa las drag 'thab byas na mi 'grig pa'i bka' snga phyir yod/ nga rang da lta gzugs bab bde min la dra ga skyes byung mtshams rgyal rtser zhi gros byed par 'gro rgyu yin mizhes bshad de nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud kyis dbyin dmag la mgo 'dogs byed pa'i lam phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byas pa red/ dus der bod dmag gi go lag zhan pa dang dmag mi nyung ba sogs dka' ngal che bas tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gis zhi ba'i gros mol byas te dbyin dmag 'gog thabs kyi dgongs tshul 'don gnang mdzad de bka' tshab bla ma ngo las dang bka' tshab g.yu thog la zhi gros byed sgo'i thad bka' yig bstsal zhing / 'on kyang dmag don spyi khyab pa tshor bka' yig phebs 'byor ma byung gong zla lnga pa'i tshes bdun nyin gyi tho rengs su dbyin dmag gis rdzong rtser me phyogs dang me mda' sbag sbag gi mde'u ser drag ltar phab cing / skabs der rdzong rtser bod dmag lnga stong tsam yod pa de dag la lag char bod mda' dang / mda' gri mdung gsum/ 'ur rdo sogs las med kyang dpa' ngar zhum pa med par rang srung phar rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ de dus rgyal rtse'i dbyin 'gog dmag 'khrug nang zhugs myong ba'i rgan rabs tshos bshad don yodabyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag gis tho/ snar

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/rdzong la me smyogs dang me mda' sbag sbag yang yang brgyab/ de nas rkang dmag gis tshur rgol thengs mang byas kyang nga tshos bod mda' dang / mda' gri mdung gsum/ 'ur rdo sogs la brten nas 'gog rgol byas pa ma zad/ skabs 'gar mtshan mo ri rtse nas babs te dbyin dmag gi dmag sgar la phar rgol byed par phyin/ zla ba gcig tsam song rjes ri'i sgang gi chu tshang ma rdzogs/'tsho ba'i thog la dka' ngal ha cang che ba'i gnas su gyur/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i sems par g.yo 'gul spu tsam med par mtshan mo ri gsham gyi chu snyigs blangs te btung / skabs 'gar chu snyigs rdzogs te gcin pa'ang 'thung myong zer/de rjes stabs mi legs pa zhig la nyin zhig rdzas blug skabs gzab gzab ma byung bar rdzong rtse'i rdzas khang la me shor te bod dmag mang po grongs shing /dgra dmag gis go skabs de dang bstun nas tshur rgol drag po byas stabs ri rtse nas bod dmag rnams phyir 'then mi byed thabs med byung / de nas thag nye'i bod dmag khag gcig rang yul du phyir log pa dang / ser dmag dang yul dmag mang che ba'ang kha 'thor du song zhing / de rjes dmag don spyi khyab pa bka' tshab g.yu thog pas rin spungs dang / gling dkar/ mar rkyang / snye mo bcas kyi yul dmag chig stong bzhi brgya tsam bsdu 'gug gis 'go 'doms snye mo bkras gshongs pa dang / 'od yug rab dkar 'phrin las dgra 'dul/dar steng bsod nams dar rgyas sogs la mda' dpon dang ru dpon bsko gzhag thog sna dkar rtser mngags gtong gnang / dbyin dmag rnams kyis rgyal rtse btsan bzung byas rjes shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla lnga par lha sa'i phyogs su dpung 'jug byas pa'i lam bar sna dkar rtser 'byor skabs bod dmag dang yul dmag gis 'gog rgol gang thub byas kyang mthar pham nyes byung zhing / de nas bod dmag dang yul dmag rnams kyis dmag dpon spyi khyab6 1'i bkod sgrig ltar lam 'khel sa 'gag khag la 'dzing rags bzos te

le'udang po/ tā la'i blabaskuphrengabacu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'idusaskabs/dbyin dmag 'gog thabs byas rung phan pa gang yang ma byung bar dgra dmag rnams rim bzhin chu shur nye 'gram du 'byor/ de 'phral bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon rnams dang / gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi sogs sol bsdur gang legs mdzad mthar tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog lha sar ma bzhugs na dge mtshan che bar gzigs te rgyal tshab tu dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan bsko gzhag gnang thog sku 'khor hrag bsdus dang bcas/ lha sa'i byang ngos kyi sgo la brgyud byang lam nas nyen g.yol du phebs/ dus der bka' shag dang / drung rtsis/ gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mi sogs nas rgyal tshab kyi ram 'degs zhus te chab srid kyi byed sgo rnams mdzad/de rjes dbyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag lha sar 'byor 'phral bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad kyis dbyin dmag la gro zhib dang sha rigs 'bor chen spradade sne len byas/ 'on kyang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang dbyin dmag dbar thad kur 'brel ba byed dka' bar gyur cing / btsan 'dzul dmag lha sar 'byor rjes rta dmag dang / rkang dmag rnams ru sgrig sbyong brdar yin khul gyis bod kyi mi mang la 'jigs skul yang yang byas kyang / bod phyogs nas lha sa'i shar phyogs kyi 'brom stod dang / bde chen/ tshal gung thang sogs kyi 'don dmag 2000tsam bsdu rub kyis dbyin dmag la kha gtad gcog rgyu'i gra sgrig yang gsar byas te bsdad pa ma zad/ nyin zhig lha sar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa dang / dbyin ji'i dmag dpon ngo thug gros mol byed pa'i skabs su se ra dgon gyi grwa pa gcig gis rang srog blosabatang byas te gzan 'og gri dpa' dam zhig bcug nas glo bur du tshes gsum thang gi dbyin dmag gi gur nang mchongs 'ongs te dbyin ji'i dmag dpon gcig dang / dmag mi 'ga' zhig bsad rmas btang ste phyir mardozlos

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/'gro ba'i skabs der stabs mi legs pa zhig la gur thag la 'khon nas 'gyel skabs dbyin dmag gis mtha' bskor nas bzung thog dmar gsod btang ba'i don rkyen byung rjes ser skya mi mang tshang ma 'khon 'dzin je cher song ste yigasgyur sbyar 'grems byas pa'i nang tsu mi su yin rung dbyin ji'i dmag sgar chags yul nye 'gram du sha tshal dang gzan shing sogs nyo tshong gi 'brel ba gcod dgos pas mi tshad/ bod gzhung gi dpon gnas che chung sus kyang 'brel ba byas na mi 'grig ’ zer ba dang yang 6 gi gcig dang po tshes gsum thang chen nas brgyab ste/ khu bya babs pa bzhin du dgra sgar nang mchongs shing / ge sar lta bu'i dpa' bos phyi gling pa bsad nas/ ngo mtshar ltad mo bstan 'phral dbyin dmag rnams bros so zhes sogs bris par grags/dbyin dmag gi 'go pas lha sa'i ser skya mi mang tshang mas kho pa tshor 'khon 'dzin tshad med byed pa dang / gnam gshes grang ngar che la sa chu mi 'phrod pa sogs phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen rnam pa sna tshogs 'phrad pas bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad la 'phral du chings yig 'jog dgos pa'i re ba bton cing /am ban g.yu'u thad ni nyams chung thabs med cig yin pas/ bka' shag la btsan shed kyis chings yig 'jog dgos pa'i bka' phab rjes srid skyong la dgongs skor snyan sgron zhus pa'i bka' lan du bod ljongs tshogs 'dur gros bsdur byas te chings yig 'jog min lan gsal sprad 'thus kyang / gzhi nas da lta skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma rin po che bzhugs med stabs nga tshos thag gcod ga la thub ces gsungs par bod bzhugs am ban rab tu khros te skad chade tsho rung ha'o glang la shod par 'gro dgos zer/ de rjes lha sar bca' sdod ne pa la'i sku tshab pa ha zu'u dang / 'brug pa'i sku tshab o rgyan dbang phyug gnyis kyis 'jam thabs la brten nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la zhi ba'i grostu /la gnang na dge mtshan che lugs mang tsam zhus/ dbyin phyogs pas

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan babacu skabs/'jigs skul dang 'jam rtsub kyi thabs rnam pa sna tshogs spyad stabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa rnams gnam gyis sa brdung ba lta bur bya thabs med par gyar te shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla dgu pa'i tshes bzhi nyid lha sa'i chings yig ces pa rgyal 'tshong chings yig don tshan bcu yod pa zhig 'jog dgos byung / 'on kyang chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis lha sa'i chings yig khas ma blangs pa dang / mthar phan tshun gros sol gyis pe cing chings yig ces pa bzhag cing / de'i nang dbyin jis bod kyi nang srid la the gtogs rtsa ba nas byed mi chog me 'khor lcags lam dang / gzhung lam/lcags skud/ sa gter 'don byed bcas kyi dbang cha ni chin krung dbyang srid gzhung kho nar ma gtogs phyi rgyal rgyal khag su la'ang med ces bkod/ mdor na/ thengs 'di'i dbyin rgol dmag 'khrug la pham nyes byung na'ang bod kyi ser skya dmag dmangs yongs kyis bod mda' dang / mda' gri mdung gsum 'ur rdo sogs 'khyer te me phyogs dang / 'phrul mda'/ me mda' sbag sbag sogs deng rabs can gyi mtshon cha 'khyer ba'i dbyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag la dpa' ngar zhum pa med pa'i dmag 'thab yang yang byas te mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams dang / rang nyid kyi pha yul srung skyob byed pa'i ched du rang srogablos btang ba'i sku gshegs dpa' bo de dag gi mdzad rjes la mi rabs nas mi rabs bar bsngags par 'os so/drug pa/ krang dbyin bang gis bod don dag ther byas pa'i skor/shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin dardi/ ji

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta po'i dbyangs/btsan 'dzul dmag lha sar 'byor te yun ring ma song bar bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung la btsan shed 'jigs skul gyis chings yig 'jog dgos pa'i re ba bston/ g.yu'u thad kyis kyang dbyin dmag gi re 'dun ltar bod kyi dbang 'dzin par 'phral du chings yig 'jog dgos pa'i bka' phab/ dus der tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog nyen g.yol du phebs te bzhugs med stabs rgyal tshab dang bka' shag gis thag gcod mi thub pa'i skor gnas tshul rim pa zhus kyang nyan 'jog rtsa ba nas ma byas par mthar 4lha sa'i chings yig ces rgyal 'tshong chings yig don tshan bcu bzhag 'on kyang chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis khas len ma byas par krungadabyin dbar slar yang gros sol byed 'go tshugs te phyi don pu'u yi thang hra'o g.yi krung go'i dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mir bsko gzhag byas te ka li ka tar mngags gtong byas thog lha sa'i chings yig mi la bzo bcos byed phyogs skor gros sol yun ring byas kyang phan 'bras gang yang ma byung zhing /de nas bang hra'o g.yir nad gzhi phog ste dgongs zhu zhus pa'i tshab tu krang dbyin thang bsko gzhag byas te mu mthud de zhi ba'i gros mol byas na'ang sngar bzhin 'bras bu ma thob cing / mthar me rta (1906)lor pe cing du gros molabyed 'go tshugs te krung dbyang srid gzhung gi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi thang hra'o g.yi dang dbyin gzhung gi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi sā ta'o g.yi sogs zhi ba'i gros sol byas/ gros sol byed skabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dbyin phyogs la gun gsab kyi dngul slog sprod byed pa'i 'bor grangs dang dus tshod sogs kyi skor rtsod gleng ha cang chen po byung zhing mthar phan tshun zhi ba'i gros sol thog lha sa'i chings yig la bzo bcos gal chen byas te 6 pe cing chings yig 7ces pa bod don skor gyi chings yig dogā rdon drug bzhag skabs der krang dbyin thang gis krung dbyang phyi don

le'udang po/ tā la'i smrasaskuphrengabacugasum pa thubabastan rgyaba'idus bas/pu'u la tar yig cig btang nas bod skyong srid jus gsar pa zhig bton cing tar yig de'i nang du 6 dbyin jis bod don gnyer byas te yun ring phyin pa'i ring la gron dngul dbyin sgor khri chig stong tsam btang zhing mi rnams kyi bsam yul las 'das pa'i g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba spel ba dang dbyin jis ri pin dang u ru su gnyis dmag rgyag bzhin yod pas u ru su'i stobs shugs shar nub gang du'angakhyab mi thub pa zhes pa ma zad/ rang rgyal du don rkyen yang yang byung ba'i go skabs dang bstun te bod la btsan 'dzul byed 'go btsugs shing da lam slar yang paṇa chen bslu khrid kyis rgya gar du gdan drangs te rgyal po'i thob thang ltar bsu ba sne len gang gzab zhus shing rgya gar gyi tshags par thog dbyin jis paṇa chen dang tā la'i bla ma mi mthun pa gsal po shes stabs dbyin jis paṇa chen la srung skyob dang tā la'i bla ma rang tshugs byed 'jug rgyu med ces kha ta bslab bya byas pa red ces bkod yod/ paṇa chen ni sku na chung zhing phugs bsam dman pas mgo bskor du mi tshud pa'i nges pa med/ 'on kyang paṇa chen gyis rang tshugs dang gnas thabs byed ga la thub/ 'di ni ri pin gyis mtho lir rogs skyor byed pa'i g.yo thabs de bskyar du bed spyad pa zhig rang red/ phran gyi bsam par bod kyi shar nas nub bar le dbar bdun stong lhag tsam dang lho nas byang bar le dbar lnga stong lhag tsam yod thog zi khron dang /yun nan/ hran zhi/ kun su'u bcas zhing chen bzhi'i 'gag sgo yin stabs gal srid snang med du song na zhing chen bzhi'i 'gog srung nyin ltar byed dgos pa ma zad mthar thug gnas tshul ji yong tshod dpag dka' ba zhig red/ des ma tshad zhing chen khag gis mtha' mtshams srung skyob byed par dmag mi mang po bzhag dgos shing / 'on kyang bod ni rgya gar dang sa mtshams 'brel yod pas mtha' mtshams kyi rtsod gzhi thag gcod byed phyogs thad zhing chen khag dang mi 'dra la de'i nyen kha'i rang bzhin sngar dang mi 'dra ba zhig red/ gtso ༷/na

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/bzhes mkhan blon chen gyis gsungs pa ltar bod du bcos sgrig byed rgyu ni dngos gnas nar 'gyangs yud tsam byas na mi 'grig pa zhig red/ 'on kyang bod du bcos sgrig byed dgos na srid dbang tshur mi len thabs med dang srid dbang tshur len dgos na drag shugs la mi brten thabs med red/ sku drag gi mi rgyud drag 'dems kyis bod yongs la srid dbang 'dzin bcug thog dmag don shes mkhan dpon chen zhig gis dmag hrag nyis khri sne 'khrid de mgyogs myur ngang zi khron brgyud bod du bskyod de khag bgos thog 'gag rtsa'i sa cha khag la bca' sdod kyis mig snga'i nyen kha bsal te khyon yongs nas lhing 'jags byung rjes rim bzhin bod dmag kha snon dang sbyong brdar thog lo re bzhin rgya rigs dmag mi nyung du btang ste dmag grangs lnga stong tsam bod la bzhag na zing cha slong mkhan la drag gnon byed thub nges red/ phyogs mtshungs tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen rin po cher cho lo sngar las mtho ba bstsal thog bod kyi chos kyi bdag por bkur zhing nang srid dang phyi 'brel gyi bya ba mtha' dag dang srid jus gsar pa tshang ma rgyal khab kyis dpon rigs drag 'dems kyis do dam byed du bcug thog skyong gnon zung du 'brel nas bod mi'i bsam par rgyal khab kyi dbang shugs la rbad de brten chog pa 'dug snyam pa'i yid ches skye ba bzos na rgyab rten bcol ba'i blo rtsa de bas kyang brtan du 'gro nges yin pas bsam tshul tha dad pa ga la 'dzin phod/ des ma tshad dbyin jis kyang bod du yod pa'i rang re'i dmag shugs che chung la lta gi yod pas de ni bod bdag skyong byed thub min gyi rag las sa zhig tu gyur yod pa red/ rang res rang skyong byed thub na phyi gling pa go skabs ma rnyed par ham sems rang shugs su 'jags 'gro rgyu red/ gong gsal rnams gong ma chen 70

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/por snyan sgron gnang ba'i re ba yod mi①ces 'khod yod pa red/krang dbyin thang gis bton pa'i bod skyong ba'i srid jus gsar pa zhes pa des chin srid gzhung gi bsam 'dun dang mthun stabs rtsa ba'i cha nas bsam 'char de dang len thog chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis krang dbyin thang la tu'u thung gzhon pa'i go gnas bsko gzhag dang 'brel bod don zhib gcod byed par 'gro dgos pa'i bka' phab pa bzhin me rta (1906)lor rgya gar rdo rje gling du bskyod/ de lo'i spyi zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin lha sar 'byor zhing / skabs der rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / bka' blon gyis gtsos pa'i drung rigs ser skya/ mi rigs khag gi mi mang sogs lha sa'i nye 'dabs su phebs te dga' spro'i bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas zhus/ krang dbyin thang sogs chin srid gzhung gi dpon rigs 'ga' zhig lha sar 'byor rjes bod kyi dpon rigs dang / mi mang gis bod sdod am ban g.yu'u thad sogs lha sar bca' sdod man chin gyi dpon rigs gtso bo rnams kyis dbyin ji btsan 'dzul par ngo bstod dang bod rigs mi mang la brdab gsig dang mnar gcod gtong ba/ gzhung rgyu lkog za/ zhu rten lkog rngan len pa sogs tshul min gyi bya spyod la 'khon 'dzin ha cang chen po byed pa tsam ma zad/ chin krung dbyang srid gzhung la'ang blo log pa'i gnas tshul rtogs rjes rgya che'i ser skya dpon rigs dang bod rigs mi mang gi blo 'gug thabs dang / krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod du 'dzin pa'i dbang cha sra brtan thog bod skyong ba'i srid jus gsar pa lag bstar don 'khyol yong ched thog mar bod ljongs am ban g.yu'u thad sogs dpon ngan tsho'i snga phyi'i bya spyod la brtag zhib gting zab byas te gsal por rtogs don/ g.yu'u thad ① tshohan krang gisabatsam pa'i (tā la'i bla ma'i rnamathar 〉rgya yig deb shog grangs18'al gsal7/1

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/sogs lha sar bca' sdod chin krung dbyang gi dpon rigs gtso bo rnams kyis snga phyi bar gsum du bod mi mang gi rgyal gces dbyin rgol bya spyod la rgyab skyor byed rgyu lta zhog dbyin ji'i 'go dmag tshor ngo dga' gdong gsol byed pa dang / rang 'gan mi 'khur bar gzhung don 'thus shor gtong ba/ gzhung rgyu lkog zas dang rtsis khra rdzun bzo byed pa/ zhu rten lkog rngan len pa/ gsham 'og gi dpon rigs bsko skabs dga' nye phyogs lhung byed pa/ bod rigs mi mang la brdab gsig gtong ba/ kun spyod mi gtsang ba sogs kyi nyes skyon ha cang che ba dang / de bzhin bka' blon phun tshogs dbang ldan dang / snang rtse shagagi mi dpon gyi byed tshul ngan pa bcas chin gong mar gser snyan sgron te kho pa tshor nyes chad nan po gcod dgos pa'i re 'dun zhus shing / lo de'i zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin/ chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis g.yu'u thad sogs lha sdod dpon rigs ngan pa khag gcig gnas dbyung nyes chad gcod dgos pa'i bka' phab cing / bka' de'i nang 6 gong ma chen pos bka' phab par/ krang dbyin thang gis glog 'phrin thog nas phul ba'i zhu yig 'byor byung / de'i nang bod sdod dpon rigs kyi spyod tshul ngan pas bod rigs mi ser la mnar gcod dang / dmag phogs tam za sogs bya ba ngan pa ji snyed pa byas 'dug pas khong khro chen po langs shing / li'u wun thung dang /sung tha'o/ li meng si/ an zhi/ cang khro'o/ yus kra'o/ h+phan chi rung bcas gnas dbyung btang thog khrims la sbyar te mi so sor btson 'jug gam khrims gcod nan po byed dgos/ hran yi'u gnas dbyung btang nas nam yang gzhungagi las gnas 'khur mi chog la pha yul du bskyal thog do dam nan po byed dgos/ kra'o ba'o dang ma chon ci gnyis btsan shed kyis las 'khyur ngal gsokhyed 'jug dgos/ li h+phu lin gnas dbyung btang rjes las ka sprad de zhar+shaswā zhu byed du 'jug dgos/ gal srid khos sngar bzhin ham za byed rigs

le'udang po/ tā pa'i blabaskuphrengabacu gsum pa thubabastan spatsho'idus bas/byung tshe kho la nyes chad drag po gcod dgos/ g.yu'u thad ni nus pa med cing blo rmongs pa zhig yin stabs las 'gan sgrub thabs bral ba ma zad/ thog za byas pa'i rtsis tho phul yod pas sngon la kho pa gnas dbyung btang thog pe cin du phyir log byas te khrims gcod 'khur rgyu sgug bcug ste krang dbyin thang gis sngarabazhin nan tan gyi sgo nas zhib gcod mthar phyin byas te gnas tshul ji yod bskyar du zhu yig 'bul dgos/ bod kyi dpon rigs bka' blon phun tshogs dbang ldan sogs dpon ngan tshang ma gnas dbyung btang thog zhib brtsad kyis khrims gcod byed dgos mi ①zhes 'khod yod cing / krang dbyin thang gis gong ma chen po'i bka' ltar g.yu'u thad sogs dpon ngan rnams gnas dbyung dang khrims gcod byas stabs bod mi mang gis dga' bsu brtsi bkur zhus te krang dbyin thang bod sdod am ban rim 'byor gyi nang nas gzhung sems drang shos kyi dpon rigs gcig red zer/ krang dbyin thang rang nyid kyis kyang gong ma chen por phul ba'i zhu yig nang 6 blon chen nged da res gong ma chen po'i bka' ltar bod la bskyod pa des bod yongs la g.yo 'gul ha cang chen po zhig thebs yod cing / tshang mas nged kyi byed lugs la mig hrig ger bltas nas blon chen nged gong ma chen po'i bka' ched phebs ltaracad kyi las don la zhib gcod byed par yong mkhan zhig yin pas bod sdod dpon rigs spyir btang pa dang mi 'dra ba 'dug snyam zhing ②zhes bkod yod pa red/de nas krang dbyin thang gis chin krung dbyang srid gzhung la bod kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor sogs legs bcos byed thabs skor gyi bsam 'char don tshan bcu dgu bton pa der chin gong ma chen pos mos mthun gnang ste ཿ swāk+ta/ ཿshā sna paḥswātsā ྅/ nā sh+lau ཿgā'i rngapaḥ k+ta /rgyu ni ldi shāt+na/ ཿshāḥswādzāḥ/r+sha07/3

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/bod skyong thabs skor gyi srid jus gsar pa'i rtsa 'dzin lta bur gyur cing / de rjesasrid jus kyi rtsa 'dzin de gzhir bzung bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs khag bcos sgrig byas te 'brel gtug las khungs dang / dmag sbyong lta skul las khungs/ ja tshwa las khungs/ nor srid las khungs/ 'grim 'grul gter las las khungs/ bzo tshong las khungs/ slob don las khungs/ so nam las khungs/ bskor g.yeng nyen rtog las khungs bcas las khungs che gras khag dgu btsugs te phan tshun gyi 'brel ba dang 'gan nus gtan 'bebs gsal por gnang ba ma zad/ bka' blon gsar byung tshe brtan dbang phyug gis 'brel gtug las khungs dang bzo tshong las khungs kyi 'gan 'khur rgyu dang / bka' blon tsha rong dbang phyug rgyal pos dmag sbyong lta skul las khungs dang 'grim 'grul gter las las khungs/ ja tshwa las khungs bcasalas las khungs khag gsum gyi 'gan 'khur rgyu/ bka' blon bla ma blo bzang 'phrin las kyis nor srid las khungs dang / slob don las khungs/bskor g.yeng nyen rtog las khungs bcas las khungs khag gsum gyi 'gan 'khur rgyu/ gzhan yang da dung so nam las khungs kyi spyi khyab tu gung lha klu 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang / gung lcang can rnam rgyal tshe brtan/ las rogs su hor khang dza sag dbang chen phun tshogs dang / phun khang sras bkra shes rdo rje/ thon pa sras don grub rgyal po/ 'dod dpal do dam skal bzang yon tan/ rtse gnyer ye shes tshogs gnyis bcas bsko gzhag bstsal/ gong gsal las khungs che gras khag dgu'i nang nas las khungs khag gcig de nas 'go tshugs pa ma zad/ so nam las khungs dang / ja tshwa las khungs sogs btsugs pa des bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi nor srid las don la phan pa chen po byung ste 1959lor bar mu mthun gnas yod pa red/74pong dbyin thang gis da dung (lugs srol bslab bya go bde'i gtam 〉

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphrengabacu gsum pathubabastan rgyas༄dusaskabs/dang 〈bod srol legs bcos 〉zhes pa'i deb chung gnyis bod yig la bsgyur te saganas khag la 'grems spel byas pa der yongs khyab tu am ban bslab bya zhes 'bod kyi yod pa red/ deb de gnyis nang krang dbyin thang gis phapha bu bar la brtse dung yod pa dang / 6 rgyal blon bar la drang bden yod pa/74khyo shug bar la khyad par yod pa/’ tsa mi shi rjes ro sgam nang du blug dgos pakha6 byis pa lo bdun brgyad lon dus rgya yig slob dgos pa/74ga pa tshos nyin mo kha 'don byed mi dgos par zhor du zhing bzo tshong gsum gyi las rigs gnyer nas rgyu nor spel dgos pa las mi gzhan gyi sbyin par re ba bcol nas bsdad mi chog 4bod du tā ching gi lo 'go byed pa'i zla grangs bed spyod gtong dgos pa sogs 'dod tshul mang tsam bton nas bod kyi yul goms gshis lugs dang bsam pa'i 'du shes la btsan shed kyis bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bton pa red/ de bzhin krang dbyin thang gis 6 srid dbang tshur len dgos ’ zer ba de don du tā la'i bla ma dang sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang cha yongs su 'phrog ste bod sdod am ban gyis 'dzin rgyu dang / 2 bod rigs rgya rigs can du bsgyur rgyu/’ smyo chos lugs kyi byed sgor btsan shed kyis the gtogs byed pa ’ bcas kyi 'dod tshul de dag la bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs dang /mi dmangs gis mos mthun rtsa ba nas ma byas pa ma zad/ dge mtshan ldan pa'i bsam 'char 'ga' zhig kyang bod kyi mtho rim mi sna'i rtsa ba'i khe phan dang 'gal ba yod stabs bka' shag gis lag len mthar phyin bstar med cing /de bzhin gzhung bla'i bar gyi 'brel ba thag gcod byed phyogs la bya thabs bzang po gang yang 'don thub med/'on kyang krang dbyin thang ni lugs bsgyur gsar bcos kyi sngon thon bsam blo'i shugs rkyen gang 'tsham thebs pa'i dpon rigs sheg yin stabs bzo tshong las rigs 'phel rgyas dang / gter las gsar spel/ lhasam

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/'grul bde po yong thabs/ slob gso dar spel gtong ba sogs bod kyi spyi tshogasagong du spel ba'i 'dod tshul dang bya thabs mang tsam bton gnang ba desabod kyi bya gzhag la dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa thon stabs bod rigs mang pos krang tā ran zhes bsngags brjod yang yang byed kyi yod pa red/ khong gis sa bon bsnams phebs pa'i me tog de'i ming du'ang me tog lha krang tā ran ’ zhes ming btags te me tog de da lta gang sar khyab pas khong gi mdzad rjes la dran gso zhu ba'i mtshon rtags lta bur gyur yod/de nas chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bka' ltar krang dbyin thang shing sbrul (1907)lo'i spyi zla 6par bod nas rdog thon gnang ste dbyin ji dang rgyal rtser tshong ra 'dzugs thabs skor gros mol gnang bar sim lar phebs shing / bod don zhib gcod byed pa'i las 'gan rnams am ban lan yul la rtsis sprod gnang / skabs der bka' blon tsha rong dbang phyug rgyal po dang /sdos 'bring bdun bcas krang dbyin thang dang lhan du sim lar phebs pa bdun pa/ tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mcho mchog phyi sog tu nyen g.yol du phebs pa dang / de rjes pe cing du phebs te 7gong ma yum sras dang mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i skor/rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin dbyin dmag 'go pa rung ha'o h+phang gis sne 'khrid byas pa'i btsan 'ardoX dmag rnams chu shur lcags zam gyi nye 'gram du slebs stabs bka'

le'udang po/ tā la'i blabaskuphrengabacu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho dusaskabs/blon rnam pa dang / gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi/ ser skya dpon rigs khag bka' gros legs par mdzad de tā la'i bla ma mchog re zhig g.yol thabs mdzad na dge mtshan che lugs skor gser snyan sgron pa ltar/7gong sa mchog nor bu gling kha nas rtse pho brang du phebs thog tshes bcu gsum nyin dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan rtse pho brang gzim chung nyi 'od du ched mngags gdan zhu mdzad de 6 dbyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag la da phan bod gzhung nas snga phyi bar gsum du zhi ba'i gros mol lan dgu chad mthud byas kyang nyan shes ma byung stabs drag dpung gi 'gog srung g.yul 'gyed mi bya mthu med byung ba ltar dmag 'thab snga phyir gong ma chen po mchog la dbyin jis bod la 'bu ches chung zos btsan 'dzul byas dang byed bzhin 'dug pa dmag rogs skyabs 'jug rim par zhus kyang rgyab dpung rogs skyor ma gnang khar/bod sdod am ban nas kyang bod dmag gi 'gog srung bya gzhag la ma 'grig ma 'thus pa'i ka kor ji snyed gsungs pa dang da lam sna dkar rtse tshun gyi sa 'gag rdzong 'go khag la rang 'tshams kyis dbyin ji 'gog srung ched bzhag dpung dmag rnams phyir 'then dgos pa'i bka' btang ba bcas da cha dbyin ji'i 'go dmag rnams lha sar 'byor nyer da dung ngos nas gdeng tshod medapar de mur bsdad na rgyal bstan chab srid la 'phral phugs dge skyon ji yong 'gan blos bzod bral la brten snga 'phros rgya sog yul gru brgyud pe cing du bskyod de gong ma yum sras mjal 'phrad zhu thos sam mdo don bod bstan chab srid yun gnas kyi ched du ngal ba khyad bsad kyis thabs shes gang yong bya rtsis yin na/ de'i bar bstan srid kyi 'gan 'khur mdzad po da yod bla sprul khag gi nang nas khyed nyid las 'os bab che ba med gshes/ bod bstan chags 'jig 'gag rtsa'i skabs 'dir snying stobs kyi go cha bzhes te srid skyong gi thugs 'gan skyongs dgos zhes bka' phab pa dang cing lung bsgyur gā spyad

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/tham rtsis sprod gnang zhing / de bzhin bka' shag dang / drung rtsis/ drung rigs ser skya bcas la chos srid kyi gtso bo'i thugs 'gan dga' ldan khri pa nas bzhes rgyu dang / gsham 'og dpon rigs tshang mas rang rang so po'i 'gan bab kyi zhu bya gang spyi bstan srid la sman pa'i lhag bsam phyar ba gru 'degs byed dgos pa'i bka' slob yang yang mdzad/ de nas tshes 15nyin gyi nam phyed phyi cha'i dus su rtse pho brang nas tā la'i bla ma mchog dang sku bcar hrag bsdus bcas gsang stabs kyis chibs kha bsgyur zhing / da dung ser 'bras dga' gsum du yod pa'i sog po spom ra'i thu'i grwa pa mi grangs sum cu tsam lhan du 'khrid gnang mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin lha sa'i byang ngos sgo la'i nye 'gram gling bu rdzong gsar du phur lcog bla brang nas phebs bsu gra sgrig zhus par zhabs sor 'khod/ ba yag tu gsol tshigs phran bu bzhes te na bza' bla gos rnams brje gnang mdzad de sog rigs rje bo'i cha lugs su zhugs te glang thang brgyud rin chen brag gi dgon du bzhugs zhag mdzad/de nas stag lung dgon gyi nye 'gram du phebs skabs stag lung ma sprul sogasabla ma las sne yongs kyis spos sne dang phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus thog gzim chung du gdan drangs/ rim bzhin rwa sgreng du chibs bsgyur mdzad de dgon de'i bla ma las sne yongs nas ser sbrengs phebs bsu dang phebs lam thugs mkho sogs 'bul ba gang mang phul/ tshes bco brgyad nyin rwa sgreng dgon pa nas chibs kha bsgyur te 'dam gzhung dang gsang gzhung sogs brgyud rim bzhin ka chen la'i rgyab thang dkyil du nag chu zhabs brtan dgon gyi bsam gtan sprul sku dang las sne sogs nas phebs bsu dang bsnyen bkur zhabs tog gang legs zhus pa dang / de bzhin sgrub khang sprul sku sogs rten 'bul dang dkar spro'i sri zhu gzab rgyas zhus pa dgyes bzhes thog khul de'i ser+sha spya mang tshogs la mjal kha dang / tshe dbang sogs mdzad/ tshes nyer

le'u dang po/ tā la'i bla'i skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyas0 dusaskabs/brgyad nyin nag chu nas phebs rdog thon te zla bdun pa'i tshes gsum nyin gdang la brgyud de phebs skabs su 'go log pa'i jag pa thab khag sum cu skor 'dug ces skad grags ha cang che bas sku bcar rnams 'jigs snang rab tu skyes te re zhig phyir 'then mdzad na legs zhes gser snyan sgron yang 7gong sa mchog gis gsan bzhes rtsa ba nas ma gnang bar mu mthud 'gro dgos bka' phab pa ltar rim bzhin phebs/ jag pa 'go byings yongs kyis tā la'i bla gamajal ma thag tu dngangs skrag dang dad gus cig car du 'char te gnod 'cho spu tsam zhu rgyu phar bzhag 7gong sa mchog la dad gus chen pos phyag 'tshal dang dngos po mang po phul bas dgyes bzhes thog de rnams la byin rlabs bstsal te rim gyis byon nas gdang la'i 'gag sgor bzhugs bzhag mdzad/de nas zla bdun pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin mtsho sngon tshwa 'dam gzhung du phebs skabs gzhi nas grong tsho gzigs/ yul de'i sog rigs kyi gtso drag rnams kyis 'brog pa mi ser rnams 'khrid de phebs bsu'i mjal phyag tu bcar thog yul zog mang po phul/ de mtshungs phebs lam gyi yul sde tshang ma'i wang ye dang / mkhan po/ sog rigs mi sna tshang mas dad pa'i phyag dang bsnyen bkur zhabs tog gang legs zhus shing / zla brgyad pa'i zla mjug tu tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas pa kun su'u zhing chen khongs ṭā ku zhes pa'i sa gnas brgyud phyi sog tu phebs/ zla dgu pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin phyi sog gi bsam gtan skyob bde gling dgon gyi bla ma las sne no yon sogs kyis rten gsum dngos 'bul dang brtan bzhugs phul ba dgyes bzhes thog mi grangs nyis stong brgal bar grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang sogs gnang ba dang /g.yung dgon bsam gtan skyob bde gling gi chos rwar dam bca'i tshogs mgon du'ang zhabs sor bkod/ de nas dgon 'di'i grwa mang yongs la mang ja sku 'gyed gang legs dang / bla ma las sne rnams la sku brnyan sogs /spyang

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/cha gang gzab bstsal/ de nas zla dgu pa'i tshes sum cu nyin dga' ldan bde ldan gling du chibs bsgyur mdzad skabs chos rgyal khal kha rje btsun dam pas phebs bsur ched mngags mi sna mgron gnyer dang / dza'i sang / ha lag che bzhi sogs gtong gnang mdzad pa ma zad/ rgyangs ring nas ser sbrengs dang /spos sna sogs kyis sne drangs nas dbu gur du gdan drangs/ sog lugs kyi brten 'bul dang zang zing gi mchod pa gzab rgyas phul/ 7gong sa mchog nas dga' ldan bde ldan gling gi chos rar dam bca'i tshogs mgon du phebs pa dang / de rjes tshogs chen du mang ja sogs bsnyen bkur thog dge 'dun nyis stong sum brgya lnga bcu nga bdun la sku 'gyed bcas bstsal/phebs bsu gnyis par khal kha nas ched mngags gtong gnang mdzad pa'i mgron gnyer dang / dbu gdugs pa gnyis phebs byams pa brgyad 'bod lcag 'khyer mi gnyis ha lag che bzhi bcas 'byor te so so'i yul lugs kyi gus pa'i phyag phul/ tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog phebs byams la bzhugs te thub rten zhes par phebs/ de rjes khal kha rje btsun dam pa mchog gis jo lags mkhan che dang pa'i si mngags gtong mdzad de 7gong sa mchog la na bza' sogs 'bul lam zhus pa rnams dgyes bzhes mdzad/de nas tā la'i bla ma mchog phebs byams su bzhugs te sha ra a gsar du khalakha'i dbu gur gyi bzhugs sgar du byon te phebs bsu gsum par khal kha chogs chen dbu mdzad nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bkod de phul bas sna drangs te tā bla ma la/ jo lags ser skya dang / gsol thab pa/ grwa tshang khag gi las sne sogs mi grangs drug cu lhag tsam gyis gus phyag dang bcas mjal dar phul/ de nas zla bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu nyin phyi sog gi lte gnas grong khyer dā khu ral du phebs skabs chin gong ma chen po'i bkod mngags ltar sku srung du dā khu ral du yod paswā spyang ma'i dmag dpung go mtshon rang thogs 'ongs nas sku'i srung bya zhus/

le'u dang po/ tā pa'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/phebs lam g.yas g.yon du ser sbrengs bsgrigs te rnga dang sil nyan dkrol/dung dang rgya gling btang / dmag mi brgya phrag du mas ru bsgrigs zhus/ dri zhim spos kyi phreng ba char sprin sngon po ldang ba ltar nam mkha' khengs/ pho mo rganagazhon tshang mas rang rang gi rgyan dang cha lugs bzang pos bklubs te phebs bsu zhu ba'i dbus su tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas khal kha rgyal khag bzhis phebs sgrig zhus pa'i dga' ldan nyi 'od bzhugs khri chen mor zhabs sor 'khod ma thag am ban dang / rje btsun dam pa/ dā khu ral dgon chen gyi grwa tshang dgu dang khang tshan sum cu'i 'thus mi bcas kyis mjal dar dang rten gsum sogs rim bzhin phul bas dgyes bzhes gnang /de rjes chin gong ma chen po dang / rgyal yum hong tha'i hu nas tā la'i bla ma mchog la 'tshams zhu 'bul bar ched mngags chin phral am ban gtong gnang mdzad de mjal dar dang / na bza' sprin 'brug tshang 'khor dgu yod sogs gnang cha bstsal bas 7gong sa mchog yar bzhengs te pe cing phyogs su zhal gzigs thog sku phyag dgu phrugs mdzad pa dang / gong ma yum sras gnyis la thugs rje che zhu ba'i chab shog dang / kha btags nang mdzod ser po/ ston pa'i sku brnyan bcas 'bul gnang mdzad/de nas shing sbrul (1905)lor tā la'i bla ma mchog sog yul du bzhugs te chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor zhing / mdzad 'phrin mtshan snyan phyogs bzhi kun tu khyab pas dad ldan skye bo kun gyis dad gus tshad med dang zang zing gi 'bul ba grangs las 'das pa phul/tā la'i bla ma mchog phyi sog tu bzhugs skabs u ru su'i rgyal sar phebs rtsis gnang lugs skor tshad ldan yig rigs khag la zhib par brtag skabs gnas tshul de rigs rtsa ba nas med pa ma zad/ dus der u ru su'i srid gzhung gis kyang 7gong sa mchog gang myur bod du phyir log mdzad dgosdu di'i

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/re ba mang tsam bton zhing / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar phreng bar 'khod par gzhigs na/ tā la'i bla ma rim byon dang /khalakha rje btsun dam pa sku phreng rim byon rnams kyang phan tshun bla slob thugs snang dag pa'i gnas kho na yin gshes/ skabs der yang dang thog khal kha spyi sgos tshang mas 'tshams zhu dang phebs bsu snga phyi/ bzhugs sgar phebs sgrig sogs dang bas kun blangs lar rgya'i dge mtshan gcig gyur lta bu byung zhing /phar yang 'tshams rtags 'bul gnang gya nom pa bstsal ba sogs go bab la gzhigs pa'i bkur bzos spyan mthong mi dman pa mdzad rung / khul de'i skye bo mchog dman mtha' dag gis tā la'i bla ma mchog la sri zhu lhur len dang chos 'brel sogs zhus shing / gang gi mdzad 'phrin dang mtshan snyan phyogs bzhi kun tu khyab che bas khal kha rje btsun dam pa thugs ma rangs par dad pa 'gyur ba'i rnam pa byung ste tā ma'i bla ma mchog gi bzhugs khri bsheg gtor dang sku mdun du'ang tha mag 'then pa sogs 'jig rten ma rabs pa'i ngang tshul bstan stabs khal kha rgyal khag bzhi dang / rje btsun dam pa'i zhabs gras rnams nas gong sa mchog la dgongs sel rim zhus mthar/ khul de'i dpon rigs phal cher chos 'brel thob pa'i slob mar song stabs zhu bshags brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes kyi don smin bstsal thob bzhin tshes 7nyin tā la'i bla ma mchog dga' ldan theg chen gling gi 'du khang bzhugs khrir phebs 'phral rgyal khag lnga sbyi dang / mkhan po che chung phyag mdzod no yon/ tā bla ma gnyis sogs bla dpon gtso drag du ma dang / khal kha rje btsun dam pa'i zhabs 'bring bzhi bcu skor bcas kyis rten gsum dang / dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba gang gzab phul/ de rjes dad ldan skye bo du mar bka' dbang bstsal ba sogs bstan srid la phan pa'i mdzad pa rgya cher spel zhing / 'on kyang skabs der chin krung dardi(srid gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma mchog gang myur bod du phyir log phebs

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'idusaskabs/dgos pa'i bka' phab pa dang / bla slob dbar thugs mthun dam gtsang ma byung ba/ de bzhin bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kyang sku tsha gung don grub rdo rje dang / dza sag blo bzang don grub/ bla brang phyag mdzod pa/ gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi/ rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi gnyer pa/ bkra shis lhun po'i 'thus mi/ gar pa mi dgu bcas phyi sog gi grong khyer gtso bo dā khu ral du gdan zhur 'ongs pa bcas gong gsal gnas tshul de dag gis rkyen pas 7gong sa mchog nas bod du 'phral mar phyir log phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad cing / 'on kyang dbyin jis tā la'i bla ma bod du phyir phebs gnang b.rango rgol mtha' gcig tu byas par brten spyi lo 1906bod me rta lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu dgu nyin krang dbyin thang gis gong mar snyan zhu phul ba'i nang 'khod don tsa rgya gar gyi skam dmag tsung thung gis lkog tu phran la tā la'i bla mas u ru su dang 'brel thug gnang ba de'i bad la nga tsho dbyin jis ya lan slog thabs yod ces shod kyi 'dug dbya khral dpon rigs han gyis rtsad gcod byas par gzhigs na rgya gar srid gzhung gis sngar bod du 'gro myong mkhan ma tun ho nye lam slar yang bod du dmag skyod lam thig rtsad zhib byed par btang ba red ces shod kyi 'dug gnas tshul de rigs la bltas na dbyin jis bod du dpung skyod byed pa'i ham sems nyin re las nyin re bzhin je cher 'gro gi 'dug pas 'khrug rkyen slong rigs mi yong ba byed ched tā la'i bla ma bod du phyir phebs gnang bar 'gog thabs sam/ yang na pe cing du gnan drangs nas bzhugs su 'jug thabs gnang rogs mi zhes zhus/ skabs der 7gong sa mchog dā khu ral nas chibs kha bsgyur te lam bar gnas chen khag la gnas gzigs dang 'brel rim bzhin zi ling du phebs/ yul der phebs skabs ser skya mi mang yongs nas bsu ba gzab rgyas dang bsnyen bkur zhabs tog tshad med zhus shing / gong gsal gnas tshul gyis rkyen pa~X /na

bod kyi nye rabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/gong ma chen pos bskyar du bka' btang ba ltar 7gong sa mchog dang sku bcar rnams rje sku 'bum du lo gcig lhag tsam bzhugs/ de rjes 7gong ma kong zhu dang rgyal mo tshe zhi thad ha'o rnam gnyis kyi bkod mngags ltar tā la'i bla ma sku 'khoradang bcas zi ling nas chibs kha bsgyur te pe cing du phebs pa'i lam bar lan kru'u dang / shis an/ lin thung sogs brgyud rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar gnas gzigs su phebs pa'i gnas tshul de phyi'i rgyal khag gis shes 'phral 'jar man dang / ri pin/ u ru su sogs kyi dpon rigs dang dad ldan skye bo 'ga' zhig rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar gong sa mchog mjal bar 'ongs/7gong ma'i blon chen cun ji dang / san shi zhun hu'u brgyud gong ma yum sras rnam gnyis kyi gser yig phebs dgongs bzhin sa sprel (19༷ra)lo'i zlabadun pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin tā la'i bla ma mchog dang sku 'khor zhabs 'bring bcas ri bo rtse lnga nas pe cing du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i skabs su ri bo rtse lnga'idza sag dang / dpon rigs dgon pa'i las sne bcas kyis phebs skyel gzab rgyas zhus te ri rtse nas phebs thon bskyangs shing / khron hu nas me 'khor du zhugs te phebs skabs lam 'khel sa gnas babs tshugs khag gi zhi drag blon chen dang mi mang gis bsu ba gang legs zhus shing / zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum nyin pe cing lcags ri lho phyogs chan man me 'khor babs tshugs su phebs skabs chin krung dbyang gi 'brel yod zhi drag blon chen khag dang /dgon sde khag gi dza sag tā bla ma las sne/ dmag dpung sogs gral bstar bsgrigs pa'i dbus su tā la'i bla ma mchog phebs byams ser por bzhugs thog chibs zhabs chibs hrag dang bcas hong se ste dgon pa ser por gdan drangs shing / sngon rtsis ltar na zla /tshes 6nyin gong ma yum sras rnam gnyis nas mjal 'phrad gnang rgyu yin rung / gong ma dang yum tshe zhi tha'i hus tā la'itsho mar mjal 'phrad gnang skabs gus bkur zhu lugs skor rtsod pa chen

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/po byung ste mjal 'phrad kyi dus tshod nar 'gyangs kyis mthar tshes 20nyin mjal 'phrad gnang rgyu gtan 'khel mdzad de 7gong sa mchog phebs byams su bzhugs thog chibs zhabs chibs hrag dang bcas lam g.yas g.yon dmag mi'i ru sgrig dang / 'brel yod dpon rigs khag dad ldan skye bo mang po bcas kyi gral star dbus su byon te pho brang wang shu khran zhes pa'i shar phyogs kyi chab sgo'i 'gag tu phebs 'phral phebs byams las bshol/ rin khru'u tan gzim chung du yum tshe zhi tha'i hu phebs bzhugs thog yul chan nā khrin dang /cun ji sogs zhi drag dpon rigs lnga brgya tsam gyis sbrang ban dang / rlis khang sbug thang kun che ba nas phebs sne zhus shing / gsung sgyur zhabs zhu ba zhig dang / zhabs 'bring 'bras srungs 'dul ba slob dpon/ pe cin lo tsā bangag dbang dge 'dun/ sku bcar kun gling dza sag blo bzang bshad grub/gsol dpon che ba byams pa dge legs/ mchod dpon blo bzang 'od zer/mtshan zhabs mkhan che blo bzang ngag dbang bcas la yum tshe zhi tha'i hus mjal 'phrad gnang zhing / tā la'i bla ma mchog gis 7gong ma'i yum la phyag rten du ston pa'i sku brnyan dang mjal dar 'bul gnang mdzad/ gong ma'i yum nas tshur rin po che'i phreng ba zhig dang mjal dar dri med spus legs shig 'bul gnang mdzad de bzhugs gdan thog 'khod 'phral phan tshun 'tshams 'dri'i bka' mol gnang res gnang / de nas tā la'i bla ma dang / sku bcar mkhan po/ zhabs 'bring bzhi/ gsung sgyur ba bcas la 7gong mas mjal 'phrad gnang thog phan tshun bka' sol mdzad cing / tā ma'i bla ma mchog gis 7gong ma kong zhu dang yum tshe zhi tha'i hu mchog la bod kyi bya ba ha cang gal 'gangs che bas las don mtha' dag bod bzhugs am ban brgyud de zhu dgos tshe rtag tu 'gor gzhi ha cang che bas/ slad phyin las don gal che rnams bod bzhugs am ban brgyud mi dgos par ngos nas 7gong dī shān

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/por thad kur gser snyan sgron na chog gam mi chog de ltar byas na rgya bod gnyis kyi mthun lam dam po dang phyar ba zur 'degs kyis bod kyi sa cha srung skyong byed rgyur phan thogs yong nges red ces zhus kyang / de'i thad la skabs der 'grig min gyi lan gang yang ma gsung / de rjes li han yon zhes pa'i las khungs kyis tā la'i bla ma mchog la yig thog nas brda tho phul bar 6 gong ma'i bka' bzhin tā la'i bla mas rgyal yum hong tha'i hu'i 'khrungs skar thog gus 'dud chen po zhus pas bdag rkyen gnang 'os shing / bod du phyir phebs rjes bdag po'i rgyal khab kyi khrims srol la brtsi srung sngar las nan tan che ba byed pa'i re ba yod/ bya ba tshang ma gong mar thad kur gser snyan ma sgron par bod bzhugs am ban brgyud de zhus thog bka' lan sgug dgos/ de don yid 'jags gyis zhes zer bas rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog chin krungadabyang srid gzhung la thugs yid yongs su chad de thugs blo mi bde bar gyur/ de nas ring por ma lon par gong ma kong zhu dang yum tshe zhi ba'i hu snga rjes su dgongs pa rdzogs/ spyi lo 190/lo'i zla 10par/ gong ma shon thung gser khrir mnga' gsol bas chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa dbar gyi 'gal ba sngar las ches cher phyin/ dus der bka' shag gis mi sna ched mngags btang ste gong sa mchog 'phral du lha sar chibs bsgyur yong ba'i re ba zhus shing / chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis mos mthun gnang ba ltar/sa sprel (1908)lo'i zla bcu par tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas pa pe cing nas bod du chibs kha bsgyur zhing / chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis sngar srol ltar krung thang lā thung me 'khor babs tshugs su phebs skyel zhu bar btang /de nas rim bzhin tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas sku 'bum byams pa gling du phebs 'phral rta drel dang gsol thab kyi yo chas/ dbu gur sogs phebs ladī shugs mkho'i rigs nyo sgrub mdzad de bod la phyir log gnang rgyu'i gra sgrig
