le'u dang po/ tā pa'i blam skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstanasgyusatsho'i dusaskabs/legs par mdzad cing / sa bya (1919)lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes dgu nyin 7gong sa mchog gis bka' blon bla ma chang khyim pa dang / mkhan chen blo bzang grags pa/ gdan sa khag gi 'thus mi/ bod dmag khag gcig bcas lam khrid mi sna khag dang po de bod du mngags gtong mdzad/ de nas zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas rje sku 'bum nas chibs kha bsgyur zhing / khul de'i ser skya dpon rigs dang dad ldan skye rgu yongs kyis rgya che gzab rgyas ngang phebs skyel zhus shing / de nas zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin 7gong sa mchog shang sder phebs skabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gdan zhu bka' blon bla ma blo bzang 'phrin las sogs ser skya dpon rigs dang zhabs 'bring bcas phebs bsur 'byor/ yul de'i sog rigs mi mang gis 7gong sa mchog la bsu ba zhu ba'i dga' ston rten 'brel gyi tshogs chen thog rta rtsal 'gran bsdur dang / glu gar/ sbe ga sogs kyi gzigs mo phul/ zla 5tshes 18nyin shang sde nas phebs rdog thon te rim bzhin nag chu'i nye 'gram khra tshang la steng du phebs skabs paṇa chen rin po che'i sku tshab mgron gnyer spug pa dang / sa skya'i bdag mo/ mtshur phu kurma pa/ hor khang dza sagalha klu'i gung / lcang can gung sogs bod kyi dpon rigs che gras khag phebs bsur bcar zhing / lo de'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis nyin rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sku 'khor dang bcas pa nag chur phebs skabs paṇa chen blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang / bod bzhugs am ban gyi sku tshab grwa bzhi thung ling / dbus gtsang mda' dpon/ ser skya mi mang bcas kyis dga' bsu gzab rgyas zhus/ de nas ta la'i bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas pa phebs bsu'i gral bstar gyi khrod du nag chu sgrub khang dgon par phebs 'phral paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang sgrub khang sprul sku rnam gnyis kyi mjal dar dang maṇ+ḍal btegs pa dang / dkar spro sogs rgyas par bsgrigs te 7spyashā sa

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/mchog bde blag ngang phyir phebs gnang bar dga' ston rten 'brel zhus pas thugs shin tu dgyes shing / skabs der tā la'i bla ma mchog phyi sog dang pe cing sogs su phebs ring bod kyi gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog ha cang chen po byung ba ni/ krang dbyin thang bod du 'byor rjes bod nang khul du bcos sgrig thog bod skyong ba'i byed thabs gsar pa don tshan bcu dgu bton te srid dbang tshur len dgos zer ba dang / btsan shed kyis rgya'i skad yig dang goms gshis dang len byed 'jug pa sogs krung dbyang gong ma'i srid gzhung na rim gyi srid jus dang rgyab 'gal gyi bya ba mang tsam spel zhing / de rjes lan yus kyis am ban byas rjes rtsa ba'i cha nas krang dbyin thang gi srid jus gsar pa lag len bstar ba dang / de mtshungs kra'o 'ar phung gis sa 'go'i lam lugs med par bzos te dpon rigs mngags gtong lam lugs 'dzugs pa'i byed thabs de dar rtse mdo dang / li thang / 'ba'/ sde dge sogs bod rigs sa khul du drag shugs la brten nas lag bstar byas stabs rgya bod mi rigs dbar 'gal ba ches cher phyin/ da dung chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis kra'o 'ar phung bod sdod am ban dang / zi khron dang yun nan mtha' mtshams don gcod blon chen la bsko gzhag byas pa ma zad/ zi khron skam dmag gi khongs nas hrag sgrug brgyab ste dmag mi nyis stong tsam dmag sgar khag gsum la bgos thog sa bya (1909)lo'i zla drug par khren tu'u nas rdog thon gyis dar rtse mdo dang / chab mdo brgyud lha sar btang / kra'o 'ar phung gi dmag mi rnams lha sar 'ongs ba'i lam bar mi mang la mnar gcod tshad med btang /dkar nag dbye ba ma phye bar mi mang po bsad pa dang / dngos po 'phrog pa/lhag par du chos byed skyes bu rnams la rab tu sdang zug bcas byas/ de nas bzung chin krung dbyang srid gzhung dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'ardo/pa'i dbar gyi 'brel ba nyin bzhin je sdug tu song bar brten phyi rgyal

wa le'udangapo/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusasnabs/bas bod kyi nang srid la the byus byed pa'i go skabs gsar pa zhig rnyed cing /gong gsal gnas tshul de dag la brten nas tā la'i bla ma mchog gis chin krung dbyang la kra'o 'ar phung gi dmag mi rnams phyir 'then dgos pa'i re ba bton gnang mdzad cing / sa bya (1909)lo'i zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas nag chu nas chibs dog thon te 'dam gzhung dang / rwa sgreng / byang stag lung sogs brgyud lha sar phyir log phebs/ zla bcu pa'i tshes sum cu/ nyin lha sa'i nye 'dabs su phebs skabs bod bzhugs am ban lan yus dang de min las rogs rnams phebs bsur bcar yang tā la'i bla ma mchog gis spyan gyis ma gzigs pa'i tshul mdzad de kha ya tsam yang ma gnang bar phebs par grags/ bod bzhugs am ban lan yus khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar bzhin tā la'i bla mas u ru su'i mtshon cha dbor yod ces brjod de rtse pho brang du am ban ngo bskyod thog sku chas bsngogs bsher byas kyang gang yang ma thon zhing / slar yang nag chur mi sna ched mngags btang thog sku chas yongs rdzogs bsngogs bsher byas kyang mtshon cha sne gcig kyang ma thon par sku chas mang po bor brlag tu song / de nas tā la'i bla mas bod bzhugs am ban sogs la 'bru rigs dang gzan chag sogs mkho 'don byed mi chog pa'ibaka' phab ste phan tshun dbar me dang chu lta bur mthun thabs med par gyur/ dus der kra'o 'ar phung gi dmag dpung rnams chab mdo nas lha sa'i phyogs su 'ongs stabs bka' shag nas bod dmag dang / yul dmag sgrig 'dzugs kyis 'gog rgol ji ltar byas rung bod dmag rnams pham ste dmag dpung de dag rim bzhin lha sa'i phyogs su dpung bskyod byas te lcags khyi (1910)lo'i spyi zla 2par kong po rgya mdar 'byor skabs khul de'i bod dmag gis 'gog rgol drag po byas shing mthar bod dmag brgya lhag sro/ spyar/

bod kyi nye rabs losgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/dmag dpon bco brgyad tsam ske bcad de mgo bo khrom ston byas pas mi rnams snying rtsa 'dar bzhin dbang med du mgo sgur/de nas kra'o 'ar phung gi 'go dmag rnams lha sa'i phyogs su mu mthud yong skabs tā la'i bla ma mchog gis rang 'gul ngang bod bzhugs am ban gyi las rogs blon chen yun tsung ya'o rtse pho brang chen por gdan drangs te bod phyogs nas lam 'khel sa gnas khag gi bod dmag rnams phyir 'then byed rgyu dang / bod bzhugs am ban lan yus la brtse bkur zhu rgyu/ gang ci'i mkho sprod rnams sngar lam bzhin 'bul rgyu bcas zhal bzhes gnang zhing / las rogs blon chen tsung ya'o mchog gis kyang zi khron dmag dpung lha sar 'byor rjes spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags la srung skyong dang / zing cha mi slong ba/ tā la'i bla ma'i chos kyi dbang char gnod 'tshe mi byed pa/ chos byed skyes bu dam pa dmar gsod mi gtong ba/ bod kyi bya ba mtha' dag zhi ba'i thabs lam brgyud thag gcod byed rgyu sogs khas len mdzad/ 'on kyang bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la kra'o 'ar phung gi dmag mi rnams dmag khrims ha cang zhan stabs lha sa'i grong nang 'byor ma thag tu sa srung dmag mir me mda' brgyab ste mi re zung bsad/ de rjes lha ldan smon lam chen po'i do dam pa phun khang tha'i jir me mda' brgyab thog 'dzin bzung byas pa dang / las rogs rtse drung 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan dang phun khang tha'i ji'i zhabs 'bring rnams dmar gsod btang ba de bzhin rtse pho brang chen por kha gtad de me mda' 'phangs pa mi mang gi dngos zog mang po 'phrog bcom sogs byas pas lha sa yongs su zing cha shāspya / lhangs te tā la'i bla ma mchog mdzad thabs dka' ba'i gnas su gyur pa 90

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dus bas/brgyad pa/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mcho rgya gar du bros byol phebs pa'i skor/gong du smos pa ltar/ kra'o 'ar phung gi dmag mi rnams lha sar 'byor 'phral zing cha chen po bslangs stabs tā la'i bla ma mchog gi sku srog la'ang ha cang nyen kha che ba'i gnas su gyar bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi ser skya dpon rigs gtso bo rnams bka' gros mdzad de gnas skabs nyen g.yol gnang na dge mtshan che lugs skor gser snyan sgron pa dang / skabs der 7gong sa mchog la wang shu zhig phul 'byor byung ba'i nang du 6 chos kyi dbang lung rang 'jags ’ yin lugs 'khod pa tsam las srid dbang yongs su am ban gyis 'dzin rgyu yin pa gsal por mkhyen te chu thog brgyud pe cing du gong mar bod kyi chos srid bya ba'i skor snga phyi'i yong rkyen zhus/ rgyal ba rin po che phebs rtsis gnang ste lcags khyi (1911)zla dang po'i tshes gsum nyin sa srib tsam du dga' ldan khri pa tshe smon gling ho thog thu ched 'bod mdzad thog chos srid kyi byed sgo gang ci'i thad zhal ta bka' slob dang 'brel de'i phyag rogs su sne'u shag mkhyen rab phun tshogs bskos mngags mdzad cing de nas nam phyed tsam du rtse pho brang nas nor bu gling khar chibs bsgyur gnang ste srid blon bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje dang / zhol khang don grub phun tshogs/ chang khyim mkhyen rab dpal bzang / bka' blon gsar byung tshe brtan dbang phyugabaka' blon bsam pho ba/ bka' tshab gung thang bstan 'dzin dbang po bcas dang lhan du nam langs khar ra ma sgang gi gru kha thon te lha sa'i skyid snyisdo chu

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangs/brgyud ded nas gsol chas tsam yang bzhes long med par nyin gnyis kyi lam nyin gcig la phebs shing / bod bzhugs am ban lan yus kyis tā la'i bla ma bros byol phebs pa'i gnas tshul de shes 'phral rta dmag sum brgya lhag tsam rjes 'ded du btang zhing / zi khron gyi dmag mi rnams snga rjes su chu shur du 'byor 'phral gru 'tshol thabs byed skabs 7gong sa mchog gi bka' ltar skabs der chibs zhabs su yod pa sku bcar spyan bsal gnam gang gis gtsos sku srung rgya sbyong dmag mi bcu lhag tsam gyis gtsang po'i pha rol nas 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byas pa'i nang zi khron gyi dmag mi bcu lhag tsam srog shor ba ma zad/ de byings dmag mi rnams re zhig gtsang po brgal ma thub par lus stabs tā la'i bla ma mchog dang sku 'khor gtso bo rnams dpal di dang / sna dkar rtse brgyud bsam sdings dgon du phebs te bzhugs zhag gsum gnang / phyi nyin gong sa mchog na bza' dkyus chas bzhes te kha ba bu yug gang la'ang ma 'dzems par phag ri dngas la brgyud rim bzhin gro mor phebs/ de nas chin krung dbyang srid gzhung la gser snyan sgron te bod kyi las don mtha' dag zhi ba'i thabs lam brgyud thag gcod yong ba'i re ba chen po mdzadakyang chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gi brda lan gang yang ma gnang ba ma zad/ zi khron dmag mi rnams kyis rjes ded btang bas gro mor mu mthun bzhugs thabs bral ba dang / skabs der dbyin dmag gi dmag dpon rmad khā thang sna dang kho pa tsho'i rgyugs khyis g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba mang tsam spel te rgya gar du gdan drangs shing / ka lon spug tu phebs nas der bzhugs zhag bdun bzhugs/ dus der chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i dbu gnas gnas dbyung btang ba dang / tā la'i bla ma gsar pa gser bum dkrugs te bsko gzhag byed dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags byas pa ma za~X/2 bod sdod am ban lan yus kyis kyang gang sar rtsa tshig sbyar 'grems

le'u dang po/ tā la'i bla'i skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/byas pa dang 7gong sa mchog dang lhan du rgya gar du bros byol 'gro mkhan gzhung zhabs tsho gnas dbyung btang thog 'dzin bzung byed dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags byas pa sogs kyi gnas tshul rnams gsal por mkhyen par brten slar yang pe cing du phebs nas chin gong mar snyan seng zhus kyang don smin yong thabs bral bas 'bras ljongs su bca' sdod dbyin ji'i kron yon yel gyis gdan zhus byas pa ltar rgya gar rdo rje gling du phebs te dbyin gzhung nas sne len bsnyen bkur zhus pa dgyes bzhes thog bod kyi don gnad skor gsang ba'i gros mol mang tsam gnang zhing / dbyin gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma mchog la srung skyob byed par kha g.yar te bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i skog g.yo bshams/ dus der chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma'i mtshan gnas med pa bzos par brten rgyal nang gi sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad mos byed mkhan tshang mas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas 7gong sa mchog yun ring phyi rgyal du bzhugs tshe phyi rgyal ba dang chings yig bzhag nas bsam yul 'das pa'i mtha' 'bras ngan pa yong snyam ste chin srid gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma tshur 'gug thabs byed ched nor 'khrul gyi srid jus 'ga' zhig yo bsrang byas pa ste/ kra'o 'ar phung zi khron gyi spyi khyab par bsko gzhag thog bod du 'gro mi dgos pa'i bka' phab pa dang / rgya gar du pho nya ched mngags btang ste tā la'i bla ma bod du phyir log phebs dgos pa'i skul ma zhus pa sogs bya thabs gsar pa mang po spel yang dge mtshan ldan pa'i phan 'bras gang yang ma thon zhing / de nas lcags phag (1911)lo'i ston khar 'brug pa rgyal pos ka lon sbug tu yod pa'i khams yangs shing bkod pa legs pa'i spro khang zhig 7gong sa mchog la phul bas der bod du phyir log ma mdzad bar bzhugs shing / dus der rgyal nang gi gnas tshul la gnam sa mgo rting slog pa lta bu'i 'gyur ldog byung ba ste/ sku zhabs sun krung9 sbyan

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/mchog gis dbu khrid mdzad pa'i lcags phag gsar brje langs te lo ngo stong phrag 'ga' zhig krung gor dbang bsgyur pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dbang bsgyur lam lugs mgo rting bslogs shing / yangs shing rgya che'i mes rgyal gyi sa cha gang sar gsar brje'i me lce rab tu 'bar/ dus der rgya gar gyi tsung tu'u mu lu la rdo rje gling du ched mngags tā la'i bla ma mjal bar 'ongs te dbyin gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi phyi nang las don skor gsang ba'i gros sol yun ring gnang ba dang / de rjes tā la'i bla ma mchog gis spyan bsal gnam gang ngam zla bzang dgra 'dul bod du mngags gtong mdzadade bod kyi sa gnas gtso gnad khag tu zi khron dmag mir 'gog rgol byed pa'i 'thab byus brtsams/ dus der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs dang u ru su'i ngan bskul 'og tā la'i bla ma'i chab srid kyi dgongs bzhed la rtsa ba'i 'gyur ldog byung ba ste/ rgyal nang du lcags phag gsar brje langs pa'i go skabs dang bstun te bod 'di mes rgyal dang kha bral gtong ba'i grabs mdzad pa dang de snga dbyin jir ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu gnang ba de dbyin ji'i drag shugs la brten nas krung dbyang srid gzhung la ngo rgol byed pa'i langs phyogs su bsgyur zhing / u ru su'i drag shugs la brten nas dbyin ji mthar skyod pa'i langs phyogs nas u ru sur rgyab rtsa bcol te bod rang btsan byed pa'i langs phyogs su bsgyur te mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la gnod pa'i bya ba 'ga' zhig mdzad cing / lcags phag (1911)lor tā la'i bla ma mchog gis u ru su'i 7gong ma ni kho lar btang ba'i springs yig 'di ltar/5yangs pa'i sa chen bde bar skyong ba gong ma rgyal po chen po mchog gi zhabs sbyisdo t+t+waṃ /zhu gsol/ rang re bod rgyal khab mdzi'i rgyal khab dang nye 'brel mardokā yon tshod las mnga' 'og pa min kyang / rim par za sems kyis bod

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasardzo dusaskabs/pa mgo skor dbang jus thams cad 'phrog rtsis kyis bstan par rma 'byin chos byed bsad de chos rdzas rgyu dngos ham 'phrog mnar gcod brjod kyis mi langs pa bya mus stabs/ de dag dang nye 'brel khongs gtogs sngar mus bzhin skad cig tsam yang gnas thabs med pa dang / bod don skor de snga rgyal khab chen po ru dbyin rnam gnyis nas chings yig bzhag gnang la brten rang 'tsho zin tsam byung don/ deng sang bod rgyal khab dpon dmangs thams cad nasargyal khab chen po gnyis la rogs bcol rgyab brten thog sger btsan pabyed rgyur mgrin dbyangs gcig gis ngos tā la'i bla mas gong ma bdag po chenapor gsol 'debs yin zhes zhu ba/ 'di thad rgyal khab chen po gnyis nas 'phral du bka' sol thugs rje che thog phyi rgyal chen po rnams su dril bsgrags rogs phan dang / lhag par du mdzi phyogs nas gnod sems khog bcug gi bod rdzongs rgya khongs yin tshul gyi dmag btang ste kha mchu mi byed pa'i nges pa mi 'dug pa/ de thad rgyal khab chen po rnam gnyis nas bka' sol gyis slad sger btsan phugs brtan bde bar 'khod pa'i rogs mgon cis kyang thugs rje che ba dang / sngon rgyal po chen por zhus pa ltar don smin gyi rgyal khab chen por nang pa'i mchod gnas lha khang bzhengs gnang la rgyal po rgyal sras bcas dang / btsun mo sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas shing / chab srid bskal brgyar brtan pa'i ched du zhabs brtan zhu mi mkhan po gcig dang / dge 'dunabacu drug bcas bod sogs thor god pa'i mi sbo rad thu sogs nang pa gang nas kyang bsdad chog pa'i bka' 'doms dang / lha rabs sa gnas gu dog pas sa cha gsol ras yod pa zhu/ mtshan zhabs can gdong sa smad byang phyogs kyi dgon sde khag la dad rten bskur thog nang pa thams cad chos lugs yaraldan gyi do dam byed rgyu'i lag khyer sprad don ltar gang cir rogs mgon thugs rje che ba dang / rgyal khab tu slob gnyer ba kha shas btang yodami snas/

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta po'i dbyangs/slob grwa che mor 'jug gnang gis rogs mgon thugs 'dor med pa zhu rgyu bcas dgongs dbyings su 'jags pa mkhyen/ zhu 'degs lha gos dang sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan rnying ma bcas zla tshes bzang por phul zhes 'khod/u ru su'i gong ma ni kho la springs yig de 'byor 'phral tā la'i bla ma mchog la yig lan phul te bod la mdza' zhing phan pa'i bsam pa nam yang 'gyur ba med pa yod lugs dang / da dung 'di'i skor dbyin ji'i rgyal khab dang bka' mol zhu dang zhu bzhin du yod pas nyid kyi thugs 'dod ltar zing gzhi snying 'jags myur du yong nges red ces zer ba sogs ngan pa skul slong mang tsam byas shing /skabs der bod kyi sa gnas mang por zi khron dmag mi dang rgya rigs la ngo rgol byed pa'i zing cha shugs chen langs pa dang / zi khron dmag dpung nang khul du'ang 'gal ba ches cher phyin zhing / bod sdod am ban lan yus dmag spyichen por bsko gzhag byas rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung la zi khron dmag mi'i dmag phogs rgya dngul sung khri bcu dang / rta nor lnga stong tsam dgos pa'i re ba bton cing / skabs der zi khron dmag mi drag shugs che bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rgya dngul sung khri drug dang / rta nor lnga stong tsam mi sprod ka med byung / zi khron dmag dpung gis kha dan tshig la mi gnas par phyir 'then rtsa ba nas ma byas pa ma zad/ dmag mi tshor dmag phogs 'bor chen sprad stabs rang snang gang shar gyis sho sbag rgyag pa dang / bud med la logagayem/ tshong zog 'phrog bcom/ khang pa mer bsregs pa sogs byas stabs bod rigs mi mang tshos ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas pa dang / zi khron dmag gi hrang sha'o dmag dpon she go leng sogs dmag mi khag gcig kyang blo log ste bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi phyogs su langs thog krung ying gis bkod 'doms byed pa'i zi khron dmag mi dang zla ba gcig lhag tsam ring dmag 'thabasdu byas shing de bzhin gro mor bca' sdod byed mkhan zi khron dmag mi nang

le'udang po/ tā la'i blasaskuphrengabacu gsum pa thubabastan rgyarab dusaskabs/khul du'ang zing cha chen po langs/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon tsha rong dbang phyug rgyal po dang / bka' drung tsha zhag pa/bstan rgyal gling sogs nas zi khron dmag mir rgyab skyor shugs chen byas pa bcas bod kyi gnas tshul ha cang rtog 'dzing che ba'i gnas su byar zhing / lha sa'i thal spungs sgang nas thad drangs rnam sras gling dang / gdung rtse zur/bla brang rnying pa/ gsung chos ra ba/ klu sbug rgyal sgo bcas kyi byang ngos rnams bod dmag gis bzung / de'i lho ngos rnams zi khron dmag gis bzung nas phan tshun sa me dang me skyogs rgyag res byas te dmag 'thab yun ring byas/mthar zi khron dmag mi rnams nang khul 'gal ba che ba dang / sgrig khrims zhan pa/ mkho sprod dus thog tu mi 'byor ba sogs phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen shin tu mang bas pham nyes tshabs chen phog ste ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su lhungs/chu byi (1912)lo'i zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu nyin tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas ka sbug mngon dga'i pho brang nas bod ljongs su chibs kha brgyur/skabs der rgya gar du yod pa'i bod mi ser skya mang tshogs kyis phebs skyel gzab rgyas zhus pa dang / dbyin ji'i dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis ru sgrig zhwa phud kyi gus 'dud zhus par mjal kha gnang / de nas rim bzhin rdza leb la brgyud shar gsing mar phebs nyin gnya' gdong nas tā la'i bla ma phebs byams su bzhugs thog chibs zhabs dang bcas byon par gro mo spyi khyab mda' dpon spel zhi ba 'go dmag yongs dang / shar gsing mar bca' sdod dbyin ji'i ngo tshab dpon rigs meg sgrol dang las byed rnams kyi phebs bsu dang bcas shar gsing ma'i mgron khang du phebs te nyin zhag bdun tsam bzhugs/shod drung shel dkar gling par bka' tshab bsko gzhag stsal ba sogs chos srid kyikhyed sgo mang tsam spel gnang mdzad/ de nas ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi ser dmag nyis brgya lhag tsam dang 'go 'doms mda' dpon rag kha /k+ta pa/

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta po'i dbyangs/spom mda' tshang dang 'brog pa tshang gi khams dmag bcas kyi phebs bsu dang srung skyob 'og phag ri brgyud rwa lung dgon du phebs/ dus der kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po ches phebs bsu'i mjal dar dang / dngos 'bul rgya che btegs pa bzhes thog phan tshun gsung mol zhib lhug mdzad/ 'on kyang paṇa chen rin po che'i mdzad tshul 'ga' zhig la 7gong sa mchog thugs blo ma mthun par phan tshun 'gal ba ches cher phyin/ ra lung dgon nas chibs kha bsgyur te rgyal rtser ma phebs par rdza ra dkar mo brgyud thad kur bsam sdings dgon par phebs/ skabs der lha sar dmag 'thab mjug sgril med stabs dgon der zla ba gnyis lhag tsam bzhugs/ de'i ring mdo smad don gcod las tshan blo bzang la tā bla ma'i go gnas dang / bka' shag shod pa bshad sgra sras la bka' mgron/ phebs byams 'go pa zur khang sras la bka' drung bcas bsko gzhag bstsal ba dang gzhan yang dgon khag mang po'i bla sprul las sne dang /rdzong gzhis kyi sne 'thus yul sde'i gtso drag sogs la mjal kha gnang zhing /dus der bod bzhugs am ban lan yus dang / dmag dpon man krung zung nas tā la'i bla ma bsam sdings su phebs pa shes phral wang shu zhig phul te/ rgya bod chings 'dum gros sol gnang bar 7gong sa mchog gi sku tshab cig 'phral du mngags gtong gnang ba'i re ba bton pa ltar blon chen chang khyim mkhyen rab dpal bzang dang / ser smad tsha ba khri pa sprul sku/ rtse mgron bstan 'dzin phun tshogs bcas la nang don bka' slob zhib rgyas dang 'brel lha sar bkod gtong mdzad de phan tshun zhi ba'i gros sol byas pa brgyud bod bzhugs am ban dang / phogs dpon sogs 'brel yod dpon rigs dang sku srung ba nyung shas phud/ de min zi khron dmag yongs rdzogs rgya gar brgyud phyir log dgos pa dang / rgya'i dpon rigs dang sku srung bar dgos nges kyi me mda' bsnyi zlog kha shas phud de byings mtshon cha yongs rdzogs bod sa gnas srid

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan spab dusaskabs/gzhung gi go mdzod du dam 'byar gyis nyar tshags byed dgos pa'i chod yig bzhag bka' tshab shel gling par bka' blon bsko gzhag bstsal ba'i gsar mjal zhus/ de nas lha sa'i gnas tshul rim bzhin nying 'jags song bas zla /tshes 29nyin 7gong sa mchog dang sku 'khor dang bcas bsam sdings nas chibasakha bsgyur te nya sog gru kha brgyud zad chos 'khor yang rtser phebs te zla shas ring dgon der bzhugs shing / de nas chu byi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug nyin lha sar phebs pa'i skabs su rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri pa tshe smon gling dang / bka' blon sogs ser skya dpon rigs/ mi mang yongs nas bsu ba gzab rgyas zhus/ phyi char pa'i char thag chod kyang / nang thigs pa'i thigs thag mi chod ces pa'i dpe ltar/ 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho lha sar phyir log phebs rjes bod kyi dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul gyi 'gal ba ches rno ngar dang / dza drag can du gyur te tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis dbar gyi 'brel ba je sdug tu song zhing / de bzhin bstan rgyas gling dgon pas zi khron dmag la rgyab skyor shugs chen byas stabs dgon pa'i rgyu dngos yongs rdzogs gzhung bzhes btang / dge 'dun pa rnams rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir slog zla bzang dgra 'dul gyis 7gong sa mchog la srung skyob dang zi khron dmag la 'gog rgol bcas kyi byas rjes yod ces bod dmag gi dmag spyir bsko gzhag bstsal/ tsha rong dbang phyug rgyal po dang / sras bka' mgron gnyis ka me mda' brgyab ste bsad stabs tsha rong la gzhung zhabs med pas zla bzang dgra 'dul 'tsho 'dzin go mag tu bkod sgrig gnang ste shul 'dzin bstsal bas phyis tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul zhes zer/ rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri pa tshe smon gling la gzengs bstod mdzad ched sgos gzhis mang po gsol ras gnang zhing / ser ra bla spyir 'dam brgya shog brgyad kyi spyi khyab dang / dga' ldan bla spyir mtsho sna rdzong gi rdzong dpon ya gcig //na

bodakyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/'jags bstsal/de nas bod kyi rdzong gzhis yan chad gyi ser skya dpon rigs yongs rdzogs bskongs 'tshogs thog slad phyin bod kyi phyi 'brel dang dmag don/khrims lugs sogs ji ltar byed dgos pa'i skor gros sol yang yang byas gshes/ bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs mang che bas chin gong ma chen pos bod la 'dzin pa'i nor 'khrul gyi srid jus la mos mthun mi byed pa tsam las/bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i 'dod tshul rtsa ba nas med cing 'on kyang dbyin ji dang u ru su'i rjes 'brangs pa nyung shas kyis thabs brgya byus stong gis bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs nas kha bral btang spra ཿdzāshā shāl ring lugs pa'i mi ser spel yul du bsgyur rgyu'i re ngan bcangs dgu pa/ dbyin ji'i dbyen sbyor bas sim la'i gros chogs zer ba 'chogs pa'i skor/sim la'i gros tshogs ni chu glang (1912)lo'i zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin/ nyin rdu'i byang ngos sim la zhes pa'i sa gnas der 'tshogs shing /gros tshogs de ni dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas mngon sum 'joms med kyis krung go'i nang srid la the byus byas te bod 'di mes rgyal gyi khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i lkog g.yo'i ngan byas shig yin/ gros tshogs der zhugs mkhan ni krung dbyang gi sku tshab bod sdod shongan spru hre dren dbyi h+phan dang / sho'an h+phu hre gzhon pa wang had phyin/ dbyin ji'i sku tshab phyi 'brel blo/ min rmad kha ma hung dang / krung go'i las don gyi cha rgyus pa la'o li/ bod

le'udangawo/ tā la'i blasaskuphreng bcugasumab thubabastan spabadus ba /kyi las don gyi cha rgyus pa spel/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab blon chen bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje dang / las rogs tha'i ji khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal/ sne mgron mkhan chung bstan pa dar rgyas/ rim bzhi rta mdo ba/ rim lnga khyung ram gzhon pa/ shod mgron thub bstan ngag dbang / ser 'bras dga' sum gyi 'thus mi sogs yod/gros tshogs de ma tshogs gong du 'bras ljongs su bca' sdod dbyin ji'i dpon rigs spel ched mngags rgyal rtser yong nas blon chen bshad sgra dpal 'byorardo rje sogs dang gsang ba'i gros sol thengs mang byas te/ bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs min tshul skor yig rigs gang mang gra sgrig byed dgos pa'i ngan skul byas pa'i skor spel rang nyid kyis btsams pa'i 〈bod kyi sngon chad dang deng rabs 〉zhes pa'i nang lha krung go'i dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i gzhung tshab krung gor sdod pa'i skabs su ngas rgyal rtser blon chen bshad sgra dang thug 'phrad byas pa yin/ khong bod kyi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i sku tshab byas ste lha sa nas rgya gar gyi gros tshogs su gzhug par 'gro mkhan zhig red/ ngas khong la sngon chad krung go dang bod dbar 'brel gtug byed lugs dang / krung gos rim bzhin btsan bzung byas kyang da lta bod kyis tshur len snyam pa'i kra'u dang / rdzong khag gi 'brel yod yig rigs rnams 'tshol bsdu byas te tshogs 'du'i thog 'khyer dgos pa'i bslab bya byas pa yin ’ zhes mngon sum 'dzems medakyis bkod yod cing kho pas ngan skul byas pa bzhin bod sa gnas srid gzhungagi yig tshags mang po bsdu rub dang phyogs sgrig byas te tshogs 'dur 'khyer zhing / skabs der bshad sgra blon chen dpal 'byor rdo rje dang las rogs ba'i ji khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rnams hin rdu'i byang ngos sim lar 'byor skabs phyir 'brel blon chen rmad kha ma gung gi sku tshab dang 'bras spyi blon chen sogs dbyin ji'i1 /sbyan

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/rigs 'ga' zhig gis bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas byas pa dang / 'thus mi tshor bzhugs gnas kyang gra sgrig gang legs byas pa ma zad/ dbyin ji srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che gras 'ga' zhig thug 'phrad byed par 'ongs nas phan tshun gros sol yang byas yod/thengs de'i gros tshogs ni rmad kha ma hung gis yongs su kha lo bsgyur zhing /dbyin ji'i dpon rigs 'ga' zhig dang blon chen bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje sogs sngon tshun nas gsang gros rim pa byas pa ltar/ gros sol 'go tshugs ma thag tu blon chen bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mis blang bya drag po don tshan drug bton pa 'di ltar/5don tshan dang po/ phyin chad rgya bod phar tshur dbang byus la the byus mi byed pa ma zad/ bod 'di rgyal khab rang btsan yin par thag bcad/ skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma rin po che bod kyi chos srid yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po yin par thag bcad/ kwang zhu'i khri bzhugs so gnyis pa phyi lugs 'das lo 1906zla bzhi pa'i tshes bdun la pe cing du rgya phyi gnyis chings yig rtags 'jog skabs bod kyi sku tshab dang / tham ka phab rigs med gshes brtsi 'jog byed mi thub par brten rgyal khab gsum ka nas cha 'jog med pa byed rgyu/don tshan gnyis pa/ rgya bod kyi sa mtshams thad byang shar zi ling rme ru sgang rdo btsugs dang / shar rma chen spom ra'i gangs ri'i chu brgyud phugs pa dang po/ shar lho'i mtshams byan drangs zer ba'i yul du mchod rten dkar po zhes pa bcas yin nges yongs grags bzhin da lam dbye 'byed bgyis par bod kyi sa khongs zhib cha byang phyogs kun lung ri rtse/ mal rten ta'i ri rtse/mtshal 'dam ri brgyud nas ro ni li ri rtse/ sba khang spo tho'i ri rtse nas mtsho sngon po'ibyang brgyud sba nag khag gsum tshur tshud pa'i rgya'i zhing chen kun zhu'i sa mardo/sna brgyud/ de nas lho phyogs phyin te shar lho'i sar 'go log hor khog

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/nyag rong / rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad/ lcags la/ dar mdo tshur tshud de nas lhor phyin gyi zi khron dang yun nan sa mtshams bar/ de nas bod kyi sa mtshams brgyud nub ri dmar tshun bcas zhib pa bar skabs bod kyi sa cha rgya phyogs nas rim zos la zhis khang zhes ming gsar btags yod 'dug pa de'i khongs 'khod kyi sa dang / mi rigs rnams kyang bod mi yin gshes phyin chad bod gzhung du bdag pa dang / lo ji long gi khral dngul rnams phyir slog byed rgyu byasado/ na tshan gsum par/ dbyin bod tshong gi 'gro lugs skor 'das lo 1892zla dang po'i tshes nyer lnga dang 'das lo 190〈zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer bdun la bzhag pa'i chings gsal rnams dbyin gzhung dang / bod gzhung bkā' sol gyis phan tshun gnyis dge'i bskyar bcos byed rgyur rgya phyogs la the cha dado/ na tshan bzhi pa/ bod du rgya dpon dmag sdod rgyu sngar phan 'khon 'gras chen po zhugs pa'i mi rigs yul gcig tu mnyam tshogs byed rgyu slar yang rtsod 'khrugs kyi rgyu ma zad/ rgya gzhung la'ang phogs 'gro las/ bod nas yong 'bab med cing / bod gzhung mi ser dang bcas par 'gro don brdab gsigs la rten 'phral phugs phan tshun bde 'jags yun gnas ched bod kyi sa khongs la rgya mi am ban dang / dpon rigs/ dmag mi/ mi ser bcas 'gro sdod mi chog rgya mi tshong pa bod gzhung gi bka' 'brel dpon rigs kyi lag 'khyer med par bod bskyod mi chogadon tshan lnga pa/ sog yul du'ang skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gsumapa bsod nams rgya mtsho phebs te nang bstan khyab spel bla slob lar rgya gcig khal kha rje btsun dam pa'i sku skye ngos 'dzin dang zhabs zhu bla ma dpon rigs gtong rgyu/ cho lo/ bka' shog sogs stsal mus ma zad/ rgya so/ snal

bodakyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/spunas gdan sa khag la grwa rgyun dang dge rgyun 'bul dngos khyon che yong mus gong gsal khul gyi nang pa'i chos byed bla ma grwa rigs nas tā la'i blo ma rin po che'i chos khrims 'khur shes sogs lam lugs sngar bzhin gnas rgyu/don tshan drug pa/ rgya dngo na dmag dang / mi ser bcas nas dbang shed kyis bod gzhung sku chas dngul dngos 'phrog 'khyer/ g.yar blangs/nyag rong sogs rdzong gzhis 'phrog nyar dngos po khral 'bab/ sde dge gzhung zhabs mi ser dang / la dwags kha bal bcas kyi mi bsad rgyu dngos 'phrog 'khyer stor brlag khang pa mer bsregs bzhig stor bcas rang bzhin gyong 'khur thub min la skyin tshab 'phral sprod byed rgyu bcas kyi tshig don yod pa zhu rgyur/ bod gzhung sku tshab srid blon bshad sgras/ chu glang zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gcig la 7zhes 'khod/ bod kyi 'thus mis bton pa'i gros gzhi don tshan drug po de'i thog nas bltas na dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan bskul 'og kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brangs pa nyung shas kyis smyo ham chen pos bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs nas kha bral btang ste rang btsan zhes pa don du dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul du bsgyur rtsis byed pa'i lkog g.yo zhig yin pa ha cang gsal/dus der krung dbyang gi sku tshab bod bzhugs sha'on rmu hre dran dbyi h+phan gyis krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bkod mngags ltar bod sa gnas kyi 'thus mis bton pa'i gros gzhir dgag lan brgyab pa 'di ltar 6 rgya bod gnyis 'brel ba byung ba nas bzung bod la phan pa rgya che dang srung skyob lan mang byas gshes/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun par rgya dmag lha sar thog mar slebs/yang spyi lo 1240lor jing gir rgyal pos bod la dmag drangs nas kho rang gi rgyalakhab chen po'i mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ spyi lo 1652lor tā la'i bla ma de bsdi/ lhogong ma shun tshe mjal bar 'ongs te tā la lnga par mtshan gsol/ 'ja'

le'udang po/ tā la'i blasaskuphrengabacugasums bubabastanasgyurabacusaskabs/sadam kha stsal/ yang spyi lo 1717lor jun gar dmag gis bod yul khyab pasagong mas dpung rogs btang ste pha rol po rnams bod nas phyir bskrad/de rjes gor dmag lan gnyis lhags/ thengs gcig la gor dmag tshig khri brgyad stong tsam thongs nas bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa stor bshig btang ba dang / dngos po lag par gang thebs 'khyer/ bod 'di ha cang 'u thug thabs zad kyis slar yang rgya nag gong mar dmag rogs bcol bas lam seng dmag mi khri tsho lnga bod du bsdangs/ gor dmag rnams phyir bskud/ bod mi dang / bod kyi sa cha srung ched rgya nag nas mi srog mang po dang / gser dngul grangs med btang ba'i lo rgyus ni rgya nag gi deb ther dang yig tshags nang 'khod pa smos ci/ dbyin gzhung gi yig tshags deb khongs dang / sger gyis bris pa'i dpe deb sogs la'ang gsal po 'khod yod/ nye lam rgya bod dbar 'khon rtsod yong rkyen rgya nag la khag dkri med/ skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma'i mdzad lugs dang / dpon rigs rdo rje g.yib sogs kyi dbyen sbyor dkrugs shing la brten nas byung 'dug gong zhus ltar/ bod phyogs kyi rdo tshig rnams khas len byed mi thub pa'i rgyu rkyen gong du bkod pa phud bod don 'di'i skor gsham gsal don tshan khag rtsa bzung byed dgos pa ste/gcig la/ ngos gsham gsal ming rtags 'khod pa rnams nas thugs blo mthun pa'i sgo nas bod ljongs 'di bzhin rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab kyi sa cha'i nang du gnas nges yin pa cha 'jog bya rgyu dang / bod gzhung dbyin gzhung gnyis ga'i thad nas 'di la dkrog rkyen sogs mi byed pa'i sngar rgya nag gis bod khams la dbang bsgyur gang yod la bod phyogs nas kyang sngar lam bzhin brtsi gnas dgos rgyu dang / de dag la dbyin gzhung nas kyang cha 'jog mdzad rgyu/ rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab gzhung nas kyang bod yul de bzhin rgya'i zhing chen du bsgyur bkod mi byed pa khas len byas/ dbyin gzhung nastu snang

bodakyisterabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/bod ljongs sam bod kyi sa sde cha shas dbyin khongs su bzhes rgyu med pa byas/gnyis la/ rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab gzhung gis bod lha ldan du am ban gcig bsko gzhag byas te bzhag chog pa dang / de la sngar lam gyi tshad dbang thob thang gang yod sngar rgyun ltar byed dgos pa la sku srung rgya dmag nyis stong drug brgya bzhag pa de thog nas chig stong lha ldan du 'jog rgyu/ de 'phros chig stong drug brgya sa gnas am ban de'i 'dod pos ltar 'jog rgyu/gsum la/ bod phyogs nas phyi rgya'i las don dang / dmag don byed sgo'i skor rgya nag gi bka' slob ltar byed rgyu/ yang phyi rgyal khag su 'dra zhig dang gros mol bya dgos rung rgya gzhung ma brgyud par mi byed/ 'on kyang phyi lo 1906zla dgu pa'i tshes bdun nyin dbyin bod chings yig don tshan lnga pa nang gsal/ dbyin ji'i tshong ra'i do dam pa dang / bod kyi dpon rigs phan tshun thug 'phrad tshong don skor gros mol dgos rigs la dgag bya med/bzhi la/ bod phyogs gnas bod dpon khag dang mi ser rgya phyogs la dkar ba yod rigs mkhyen gsal btson bcug byas rigs dang rgyu dngos gzhung bzhes byas rigs rnams dgongs dngas kyi btson 'don dang rgyu dngos phyir slog byed rgyu byas/dza ཿ la/ bod phyogs kyi 'char gzhi don tshan lnga pa de skor bka' sol ma da dru/glu de snga tshong gi 'gro lugs skor gyi chings yig phyi lo 1892zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lnga dang yang phyi lo 190〈bzhi pa'i tshes bzhi tshong gi 'gro lugs kyi chings yig rnams la bskyar bcos bya dgos byung tshe tshang ma zhib sol gyis phyi lo 19༷6zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer bdun la rgya phyi nas bod don skor bzhag pa'i chings yig de'i don tshan gsum pa ltar bka' mol gnang rgyu/103dun la/ rgya nag dngos gnas dang / bod kyi sa mtshams de bzhin da

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/lta 'di nang rtags lam rab bkod de zur phul zhus yod/ phyi lo 1912ok+ṣa bar tā rig sum cu la mizhes 'khod/ krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab dran dbyi h+phan nas tshig 'jam la don zab mo'i sgo nas rgya bod gnyis kyi lo rgyus thog gi 'brel ba dang lhag par du yon rgyal rabs kyi dus nas bzung bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs bston med gcig tu gyur stabs sngar lam bzhin bod bzhugs am ban gtong dgos pa dang / srung dmag bod du bca' sdod byed dgos pa/ phyi 'brel dang dmag don sogs bod kyi las don gal che'i rigs krungadabyang la snyan sgron ma zhus par rang dgar phyi'i rgyal khab gang 'dra zhig la'ang 'brel gtugs mi chog pa sogs skor nan bshad yang yang gnang /de bzhin bod kyi dpon rigs dang / mi ser krung dbyang la blo dkar ba yod rigs la don med bsnyad 'dogs kyis btson 'jug byas pa tshang ma 'phral du glod bkrol dang dngos po gzhung bzhes byas rigs phyir sprod dgos pa'i re ba nan po bton cing / 'on kyang bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje sogs bod sa gnas kyi 'thus mi tshos bod sger btsan yin lugs skor mtha' 'khyongs byas stabs krung dbyang srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi'i dbar 'khon rtsod mang tsam byung ba dang / lhag par du rgya bod sa mtshams zer ba'i skor phan tshun rtsa ba nas mthun thabs med pa'i gnas su gyur pa red/dus der dbyin gzhung gi 'thus mi rmad kha ma hung gis sngon tshud nas kho pa tshos nang sol zhib gros byas pa ltar/ rgya bod dbar bar 'dum byed mkhan yin khul gyis chings yig 'char zin don tshan bcu gcig bton pa der krung dbyangasrid gzhung gi sku tshab kyis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs 'char zin don tshan bcu gcig zer ba bzo bcos phran bu byas te rma kha ma hung dang bshad sgra tsho gnyis nas nang sol chings yig bzhag pa 'di ltar/ 107

bodakyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/yodon tshan dang por/ zur tho gsal ba'i chings yig nang gang yod de da lta'i chings yig 'di la bsgyur bkod du 'gro gzhi'am ma mthun pa go ldog tu gyur pa'i rigs ma yin pa'i gzhi gang yod la phan tshun do bdag gzhung sa rnams nas rtsi 'jog gnang dgos/don tshan gnyis par/ dbyin gzhung dang / rgya nag gzhung nas bod ljongs 'di bzhin phyi rgyal rgya nag gi mnga' khongs yin dbang rtsis kyang / bod phyi ma'i nang don rgyal khab rang btsan yin pa mkhyen chod ltar cha 'jog gnang nas mnga' khongs sa mtshams la dbye 'khri dang / bod phyi ma'i nang don dbang byus/ tā la'i bla ma'i sku skye ngos 'dzin dang / khri gsol sogs la the tshogs gtananas mi byed par tshad dbang gang yod tshang ma lha ldan bod gzhung rgyal khab rang la gnas rgyu khas len byas/ rgya nag gzhung nas bod yul 'di nyid rgya'i zhing chen du mi bsgyur ba'i khas len byas/ dbyin ji'i gzhung nas kyang bod dang bod sa'i cha shas tsam yang bdag mi byed pa khas len byas/don tshan gsum par/ rgya gar rgyal khab dang de 'brel rgyal phran rnams dang / bod gzhung sa 'brel la brten sa mtshams nye 'dabs bde 'jags dang / bod du chab srid gtan gnas dgos pa dbyin gzhung la khyad par chen poyod par cha gnas byung don rgya nag gzhung sa nas chings yig 'di'i don tshan bzhi pa'i tshig don ltar ma gtogs bod phyi mar dmag mi mi gtong ba ma zad/ zhi drag dpon rigs mi 'jog pa dang / rgya nag gi mi ser sa zhing 'debs 'khos kyi bod du gzhis chags gtan sdod byed mi 'jug par khas len byas/ rgya nag gi dpon dmag de 'dra chings 'di bzhin rtags 'jog skabs bod phyi ma'i nang yod rung / zla gsum mi 'gyangs par phyir 'then byed rgyu/ dbyin gzhung nas kyang 'das lo 1904zla dgu pa'i tshes bdun la dani/ zlod dbar bzhag pa'i chings yig gi 'bru don ltar ma gtogs bod la

le'udang po/ tā la'i blabaskuphrengabacu gsum pa thubabastanargyasatsho'idusaskabs/zhi drag dpon rigs mi 'jog pa dang / sku tshab rnams kyi sku srung las lhag pa'i dmag mi mi 'jog pa ma zad/ mi ser sa zhing 'debs 'khos kyi gzhis chags gtan sdod byed mi 'jug par khas len/don tshan bzhi par/ gong gsal dpyad mtshams byung rung lha sar rgya nag dpon po che ba gcig bzhag srol 'dug par sku srung bab mtshungs dang bcas pa sum brgya las lhag pa gtan nas bzhag mi chog pa byas yod/don tshan lnga par/ bod skor rgya nag dang bod rgyal khag gnyis nang tshag bar chings yig dang / gan rgya bzhag mi chog pa ma zad/ rgyal khab gzhan dag dang yang mi 'jog pa rgya bod gnyis kyis khas len byas yod/ yin kyang dbyin bod gnyis bar phyi lo 1904zla dgu pa'i tshes bdun bzhag pa'i chings yig dang / spyi lo 1904zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer bdun la dbyin ji dang / rgya nag bar bzhag pa'i chings kyi 'bru don ltar dbyin gzhung dang chings gan bzhag chog pa byas yod/don tshan drug par/ dbyin ji dang / rgya nag bar phyi lo 1906zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer bdun la bzhag pa'i chings gsal don tshan gsum pa de bzhin brtsi 'jog ma dgos pa byas yod/ rgya nag gam rgyal khag dga' nye gzhan dag la gnang ba'i tshong byus bde thabs de nang bzhin dbyin ji'i tshong zog la yang gnang dgos/don tshan bdun pa'i/ ka par/ phyi lo 1892dang phyi lo 190〈la bzhag pa'i tshong gi 'gro lugs chings yig rnams la brtsi 'jog med pa byed rgyu byas/ kha par/ phyi lo 1904la bzhag pa'i chings yig gi don tshan gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa/ lnga pa'i 'bru don la brtsi 'jog yong ba'i ched du bod gzhung nas dbyin ji gzhung dang / bod phyi mar tshong gi 'gro lugs gsar bzo lam seng bya rgyu'i khas len byas yod/ yin kyang rgya gzhung dang ma bstun par1 /chos

bod kyi nye rabs losgyus ta ra'i sgrodabyangs/yig 'dir bsgyur bcos su 'gro gzhi'i tshong gi 'gro lugs chings yig mi 'jog rgyu byas/don tshan brgyad par/ dbyin bod gnyis bar phyi lo 1904zla dgu pa'i tshes bdun la bzhag pa'i chings yig 'di don bzhin bod gzhung la bka'agrol zhu dgos byung na rgyal rtse nas yig 'grul la sogs pas thag chod min yong 'dug pa/ rgyal rtser bzhugs pa'i dbyin gzhung sku tshab sku srung khrid nas lha sar 'gro chog pa byas yod/don tshan dgu par/ chings yig 'dir rtsa 'dzin bde ched du bod kyi sa mtshams sa khra zur yod la rtags dmar po/ bod nang ma dang / phyi ma'i sa mtshams la rtags sngon po brgyab yod pa ltar yin/ da lta'i chings yig 'di'i tshig don gang yod rung /bod nang mar bod gzhung gi dbang cha thob thang yod mus tshang ma rang 'jagasa'i lhag don dgon khag so so'i bla ma bsko gzhag dang chos sde'i skor sogs bsgyur bkod kyi dbang cha tshang mar gnod 'gal nyam chag tu mi 'gro ba byas yod/don tshan bcu par/ da lam chings yig 'di bzhin dbyin yig dang /rgya yig bod yig rnams yi ger bsgyur skabs go bsdur tan tig byas yod pa go phyogs log gleng byung na dbyin yig tu gsal ba de rang la sor gnas bya rgyu/don tshan bcu gcig par/ chings yig 'di bzhin lag rtags brgyab pa nas bzung brtsi 'jog bya rgyu/ chings yig 'di bzhin dbyin rgya bod bcas kyi yi ge 'dra gsum re'i thog sku tshab so so'i tham ga dang / ming rtags 'khod yod/ sim lar phyi lo 1914zla bzhi pa ju la ta ris gsum rgya lugs mi ser rgyal khab kyi lo gsum pa'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum/ bod shing stag zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu la zhes 'khod/110

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/gongagasal chings dan don tshan khag bcu gcig de'i thog nas gsal por mthong thub par/ dbyin ji'i sku tshab rmad kha ma hung sogs kyis sngon tshud nas kho pa tsho nang sol byas pa ltar bar 'dum byed pa'i ngang tshul ston pa tsam las don du g.yo sgyu'i sbyor bar brten nas mtsho sngon dang / shi'i khams kun su'u/ zi khron/ yun nan bcas kyi bod rigs sa khul yongs rdzogs bod khongs su brtsi dgos pa dang / de la'ang phyi nang gnyis su dbye ba ste/ 'bri chu'i nub ngos sa khul la bod phyi dang / 'bri chu'i shar ngos sa khul la bod nang ma zhes ming btags/ bod nang ma'i sa gnas khag gi bya ba mtha' dag rgya bod thun mong nas do dam gnang dgos zer ba dang / bod phyi ma'i bya ba che 'bring chung gsum tshang ma bod gzhung rang nas thag gcod byed chog pa zer ba 'di ni mngon sum 'dzems med kyis bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong rtsis byed pa zhig rang yin/dus der yon hre khad srid gzhung nyams chung thabs med kyi gnas su lhungs te/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs par mdung rtse kha gtad kyis 'thab rtsod byed mi phod stabs dbyin gzhung gis mgo thar dpung 'dzul gyis chings yig 'char zin don tshan bcu gcig 'di gtso bor 'dzin te gros mol byedadagos zer ba ma zad/ slar yang 'char zin don tshan brgyad bton te krung dbyang srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dran dbyi h+phan la btsan shed kyis ming rtags 'god dgos brjod par ltar/ dran dbyi h+phan yang byed thabs dben pa'i gnas su gyur nas 'char zin don tshan la ming rtags bkod cing /gnas tshul de rgyal nang gi tshags par thog bkod 'phral rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs gis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas pa ma zad/ yon hre khad sridagazhung la kha rdung drag po btang bas yon hre khad kyis chings yig 'char zinader chog mchan sprod ma nus par dren dbyi h+phan la chings yig da~X su

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/'jog skabs ming rtags 'god mi chog ces bka' phab pa ltar chings yig dngos su 'jog skabs dren dbyi h+phan gyis ming rtags rtsa ba nas ma bkod stabs dbyin gzhung sku tshab rmad kha ma hung dang bod sa gnas kyi sku tshab blon chen bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rjes gsang ba'i thog ming rtags bkod pa ma zad/ zhar byung sa phra'i thog dbyin bod sa mtshams rmad kha ma hung zhes pa'i sa thig bkod/ 'on kyang sim la'i chings yig ngo ma der krung dbyang srid gzhung gi 'thus mis bkod mngags ltar dngos su ming rtags bkod med stabs chings yig de'ang dbyin bod dbar gsang ba'i thog bzhag pa'i khrims 'gal gyi chings yig cig yin la/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i dpang rtags khungs btsan zhig kyang chags yod/bcu pa/ bod sa gnas su srid 'dzin gyi byed thabs gsar pa 'ga' zhig byung ba'i skor/rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dang ser skya dpon rigs che gras 'ga' zhig mes rgyal nang khul dang / phyi sog rgya gar sogs kyi sa gnas mang por dus yun gang 'tshams bzhugs te sngon thon gyi 'dzugs skrun dang / 'phrul chas/ tshan rig lag rtsal do dam lam lugs/ dmag don sogs dngos su gzigs stabs dbyin ji dang / rgya gar/ phyi sog mes rgyal nang khul gyi do dam lam lugs dang tshan rig lag rtsal sogs skor brtag zhib yun ring gnang ste bod kyi spyi tshogs dngos 'brel gong spel gtong dgos na deng rabs kyi rdo/2 rig lag rtsal dang / do dam lam lugs/ dmag dpung nges can

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/zhig sogs dgos nges las lha bla ma kho nar gsol ba 'debs bzhin bsdadar mi 'grig pa de gsal por mkhyen/ der brten bod kyi chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ dmag don sogs yar rgyas gong 'phel yong ched byed thabs gsar pa 'ga' zhig lag len bstar ba 'di ltar/ shing stag (1914)lor sim la'i gros chogs grol nas yun ring ma song bar bod dmag bcos sgrig dang rgya bskyed btang ste bod dmag dmag sgar gcig la nyi tong gi dmag dpon rnying pa ya su ma ji ya nas nyi hong gi drag po'i lugs srol gyi dmag rtsed dang / dmag sgar gcig la u ru su'i drag po'i slob sbyong thon pa sog po bstan pa rgyal mtshan nas u ru su'i lugs kyi dmag rtsed/ dmag sgar gcig la dbyin ji'i lugs kyi dmag rtsed/ sngar yod rgya sbyong dmag rtsed bcas khag so sor slob sbyong byed du bcug ste dmag rtsal 'gran bsdur gyis dmag rtsed gang zhig dge mtshan che ba yod med gzigs zhib dang 'brel bod dmag chig khri tsam 'dzugs rgyu'i 'char 'god gnang / de'i spyi khyab dmag dpon che ba bka' blon tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul dang / dmag spyi gzhon pa tha'i ji khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal la bsko gzhag bstsal/ de rjes dmag sgar gsar rnying rnams ka sde'i go rim sde tshan bsgrigs shing / dmag dar dang / dmag spyi las khungs kyi rtsa 'dzugs sgrig gzhi/ dmag khrims sogs gtan 'bebs gsal bsgrags gnang / gong gsal dmag sgar khag de rnams la de snga'i rgya sbyong / sgrig gzhi gzhir bzung dmag mi lnga brgya rer mda' dpon re dang / de 'og ru dpon gnyis dang / brgya dpon bzhi/lding dpon nyi shu/ bcu dpon lnga bcu re bcas rim bzhin bsko gzhag bstsal zhing / de nas dmag don mi sna gso skyong byed ched rgyal rtser dbyin jis dmag dpon gyi slob grwa btsugs te dmag don mi sna khag gcig gso skyong gis rim bzhin dmag sgar so sor khag bgos thog dmag dpon gyi las1 di/na

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/'khur sdo // /bod dmag gi mtshon cha'i 'byung khungs thag gcod yag po yong ched grwa bzhi glog 'phrul khang gsar btsugs thog me mda' dang mde'u bzos/'on kyang skabs der lag rtsal dang rgyu chas sogs phyi nang gang ci'i cha rkyen shin tu dman pas me mda' dang mde'u'i 'bor tshad dang spus tshad gnyis ka 'gan srung byed ma thub stabs rjes su grwa bzhi dngul dpar khang du bsgyur nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dngul lor par 'debs kyi las 'gan 'khur te rim bzhin dngul sgor dang / zangs ṭam/ shog dngul/ sbrag 'dzin bcas par 'debs bya yul du bsgyur/ lo der dngul lor 'ga' zhig par 'debs 'grems spel gnang /de nas bod du glog las dang / gter las/ sbrag tar las rigs sogs gsar 'dzugs byed ched byang ngos pa rig 'dzin rdo rje dang / smon grong mkhyen rab kun bzang / skyid sbug dbang 'dus nor bu/ sgog mkhar bsod nams rgyal po (yig cha 'ga' zhig tu bsod nams mgon skyabs zhes 'khod )bcas dpon rigs kyi gzhon nu bzhi dbyin ji'i rgyal sa lun tun du glog las dang / sbrag tar/ gter las/ dmag don bcas slob sbyong byed par gtong gnang ba dang 'brel kho tsho'i lta skyong 'go 'dzin byed po rtsis pa lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gtong gnang mdzad/ spel gyis brtsams pa'i 〈bod kyi sngon chad dang da lta 〉zhes pa'i nang bkod don tsa mtho rim gyi phru gu bzhi'i nang nas lo na rgan shos sgog mkhar bas dmag las sbyangs pa dang / dmag sgar du'ang zla ba bcu gcig tsam sbyong brdar byas shing / slob grwa ma thon gong bod la phyir log pa dang / lo chung shos byang ngos pa nisnrung grung 'dzoms la rig pa rno ba zhig yod/des glog las sbyang ste sbyang 'bras gang legs thon zhing / de min gzhan gnyis slo/ spyang la brtson 'grus zhan pas grub 'bras de tsam byung med zer/ kho tsho

le'udang po/ tā la'i blam skuphreng bcu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/snga rjes su bod la log rjes skyid sbug dbang 'dus nor bus lha sa'i tar khang btsugs te 'go 'dzin byed po'i 'gan 'khur gnang ba dang / smon grong mkhyen rab kun bzang gis lha sa'i byang ngos nas gser gyi gter kha 'don pa'i las 'go brtsams nas gter kha 'don skabs sa 'og nas sbal pa chen po zhig thon pas mi mang pos bkra mi shis pa'i rtags mtshan red ces gter 'don pa'i las kur ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs las mtshams mi 'jog ka med byung / 'on kyang skabs der rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i bka' dgongs bzhin bod kyi sa gnas rdzong gzhis khag la bka' rgya btang ste gter rdo 'tshol zhib byed dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar sa gnas khag nas gter rdo'i dpe tshad 'dra min sna tshogs sa gnas srid gzhung la phul te mi mang yongs nas gter rdo 'tshol ba'i bya ba bzang po zhig 'go tshugs pa red/ byang ngos pa rig 'dzin rdo rjes bod du 'phrul 'khor bzo grwa 'dzugs rgyu'i 'gan 'khur gnang ba ma zad/ dog sde'i chu shugs glog 'don khang btsugs te glog bzhu yang spar thub pa byung ba red/ sgog mkhar ba bsod nams rgyal po bod la phyir log nas yun ring ma song bar tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs/ de rjes dpon rigs dang tshong pa che gras khag gi bu phug mang po rgya gar la slob sbyong du 'gro mkhan sbyong yod kyang bod kyi 'dzugs sgrun la phan pa'i bya ba gang yang ma byung bar mame /bya/ ga (1916)lo'i zla dgu pa'i nang lha sa bstan rgyas gling gi nye 'dabs su khang pa gsar skrun thog bod lugs sman rtsis khang dngos su btsugs/ dbu 'dzin sman rtsis mkhas dbang 'bras spungs sman sbyin pa mkhyen rab nor bur rtse drung las tshan che ba'i go gnas bsko gzhag mdzad/dbus gtsang dang / khams/ mnga' ris sogs mnga' khul sa gnas khag nas slob ma mang po bsdu bskong thog bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang / khyas snar

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/sman rtsis kyi gzhung lugs la sbyang pa gang legs byas te bod kyi rig gnas gong du spel ba dang / bod mi drag zhan tshang ma'i nad gsor phan pa'i bya ba mang po mdzad pas da lta'ang sman rtsis khang zhes yul gru kun tu grags che bar gyur/gzhan yang bod ljongs kyi zhing nags thon skyed gong 'phel yong thabs dang / thon zog gtso bo bal gyi tshong las skor sogs dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'byung thabs la'ang thugs 'khur che bzhes mdzad yod pa ni/ rnam thar nang 1912bod chu glang lor 6 bod ljongs ser skya yongs la slad kyi blang dor byed sgo'i skor gyi rtsa tshig sbug dam sbyar ma zhig bstsal pa'i don tshan 4lnga par/ da nas bzung spyi sa ri klung bed med stong lus ji yod la khyim pa nyams can rtsol ldan nas sa zhing 'dul ba dang / sbyar lcang skye tsher yan gyi phan bde spel ba'i 'debs 'khol gang thub byed pa'i gzhung sger chos bcas sus kyang bkag 'gog nam yang mi chog cing / de dag dge bed lo gsum khral med du spyad rjes rgya khyon dang dge bed la gzhigs pa'i khral bogs gnyis lo 'gel 'os thog 'dzin bdag gtan 'jags su sprad pas gzhung 'bangs gnyis slebs yong ba bya rgyu 70zhes gsal ba ltar de sngon sa stong bed med rnams kyang srid gzhung dang / dgon sde/ sger pa khag bcas kyis bkag 'doms byed pa de dgaslad zhing pa nyams myong dang 'bad rtsol yod pa tshos sa zhing gsar sbol lam/ sbyar lcang skye tsher sogs 'debs gang thub rang mos ltar byas chog pa gnang zhing / thon skyed byas pa'i dge bed ji byung lo gsum ring khral 'bab med par so sos longs spyad chog pa dang / de rjes khral lam yang na bogs ma sogs gzhung 'bangs gnyis lo gtan 'bebs kyis 'dzin bdag ngal rtsol byed po rang la gtan 'jags byas 'thus gnang ba de ni skabs de'i spyi tshogs ① 〈da kyiglo sarig gnasadapyad gzhi'i cha bdamasabasgrig 〉dega'adonathengs11pa'i par ngos21rdordo/mi

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/la dpags na gsar bcos shig yin pas gzhung 'bangs gnyis kur dge slebs nges can zhig byung yod/de bzhin bod kyi tshong las thon zog drag shos lug bal yin pa de dag sa gnas so so'i dpon dang tshong pa mnyam 'brel gyis 'brog par rin 'bab sne sel tsam las ma sprad par nyo 'dren gyis rgya gar phyogs btsongs te khe bzang za bar brten gzhung tshong spom mda' tshang la bsko gzhag gnang ste/ 'brog par yul thang gi bal rin gcig gyur sprad de nyo sgrub kyis rgya gar la sdebs tshong byas nas gzhung la khe 'bab che tsam 'bul gyi yod rung / rgya gar gyi ma rtsa can chekhag tshos kha mthun byas te bal gong gcog gang thub byas mthar gyong gun gtong gi yod par brten tā la'i bla ma mchog nas tshong las bya gzhag de rigs la'ang thugs 'khur chen po bzhes kyi yod pa ni/ rnam thar nang 1921bod lcags lug lor/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum nyin/ a me ri ku'i si'i su ye dam/ kha kring la phyag bris bstsal don/ smyo 'di ga bod yul nas thon khungs bal rnams bod gzhung gi chab srid dang / mi ser gyi bde thabs 'phel rgyas ched lo gsum ring gzhung tshong spom mda' tshang nas tshong bsgyur chog pa de ltar yang / snga lo'i bal 'bab rnams rgya gar ka yan khag gsum la btsongs zin thog 'di lo'i bal 'bab rnams kyang tshong bsgyur bya rgyu yin rung gong gsal ka yan rnams nas ngan mthun thog bal gong dma' gcog dang / de ga a me ri ka nas bal nyo'i ngo tshab yong skabs gong gsal ka yan rnams nas chang rin sprad de bal nyo rgyu kha bkag gis phyir slog thog bal nyo tshong la gnod rkyen gang thub ngan pa kha 'gril sha stag byas te bal 'dod nyo 'dod tshong byed ma bcug pas gzhung gun che gshes/ da cha gzhung tshong spom mda' tshang gi bal do rnams rgya gar ka yan gyi lag thog 'grim tshong ma dgos par rang re do bdag rnams phan tshun ngo sprad thog nas bal tshong byas 'thus shig byustu /na

bod kyi nye rabs lo sa ta ra'i sgradabyangs/gnyis sman yong rgyu zhes 'khod pa'i phyag bris shig bstsal ①zhes 'khod 'dug pa bcas dpal 'byor gong spel thad kyi zhib phra'i lag bstar bya rim gzhung yig nang 'khod rgyu yang / 'dir rnam thar nang nas dpe mtshon gnyis drangs te bkod pa lags so/ja ni bod mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i nang med thabs med pa zhig yin pa dang / skabs der 'grim 'grul stabs mi bde bas 'thung ja yul phyogs gzhan nas 'dren par dka' ngal ha cang che ba'i gnas su gyur cing / ja'i gnad don de thag gcod thub res chu phag (1922)lor ja chu rong du ja shing 'debs las kyi tshod lta gnang / de'i 'go 'dzin byed por ru dpon las tshanasams pa skal bzang bsko gzhag bstsal/ 'on kyang lo mang ring ja shing 'debs las tshod lta'i las kur phan 'bras mngon gsal dod po de tsam ma byung stabs rjes su tshod lta'i las ka de mtshams 'jog gnang dgos byung /chu phag (1922)lo der bod kyi lte ba'i grong khyer lha sa'i spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi las kur shugs snon yong ched slopu li si'i ’ dmag sgar gsar du btsugs te lha sa'i phyogs bzhir pu li si'i tsho khang re dang / srang lam gtso bo khag la slopu li si bzhag ste nyin mtshan kun tu bde srung gi las ku'i 'gan 'khur 'dzugs gnang mdzad cing / de'i 'go khrid du legs ldan sa lhab (ming gzhan bsod nams legs ldan )dang / rtse drung mkhyen rab kun bzang bsko gzhag gnang ba ma zad/ mdo mkhar sras dang / lcang grong pa sogs la zu pu li si'i mi dmag khrims dang / sgrig gzhi/ sbyong brdar bya thabs sogs zhib 'jug byed rgyu'i bka' bkod kyang gnang ba red/de nas shing glang (1925)lor sbrag tar khang gsar du btsugs pa 292① bod kyi lo rgyusarig gnasadapyad gzhi'i cha bdam bsgrigs〉deb 'don thengs11pa'i par ngos118

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/dang / de'i 'go 'dzin byed por rtse drung grags pa chos rgyal dang / las bya shod drung spel bzhi ba/ tar gtong rtse drung chos ldan bstan dar/ shod drung skyid sbug pa/ sbrag drung gnyis bcas bsko gzhag bstsal thog tar yig dang sbrag yig gla cha dngul 'bab ji byung zla ba drug re'i mtshams su rtsis phra khams dwangs bka' shag la 'bul dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang /de rjes dngul khang gsar du btsugs te thog mar phun khang gung la dngul khang gi 'go 'dzin bsko bstsal dang / de rjes bka' blon tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul sogs la 'go 'dzin bsko gzhag gnang nas bod kyi dngul lor lam lugs la bsgyur bcos gnang ba ste/ de snga bod du ṭam dkar sna tshogs 'gro rgyugs byed srol yod/ ṭam dkar de rigs nang nas chan lung tsang pa'o zhes pa'i chin gong ma chan lung skabs su gtan 'bebs dang par 'debs gnang ba'i ṭam dkar de 'gro rgyugs gang 'tshams che ba zhig yin pa dang / ṭam dkar de la bod mi rgan rabs rnams kyis ma dag rgyun 'jags kyis tsang chan pa'o lung zhes 'bod/ bod dngul lam lugs la bsgyur bcos gnang rjes bod rang nas zangs kyi pad shag kha gang dang / skar lnga/ skar phye brgyad/ zho gang bcas rigs bzhi dang / de rjes dngul gyi zho lnga'i sgor mo/srang gang sgor mo/ sung gsum sgor mo sogs dngul par dang / da dung gser ṭam yang par 'debs byas yod/ de rjes 1912lo bzhin bzung bod kyi shog lor thog ma dngul ṭam lnga dang / ṭam bcu/ ṭam bco lnga/ ṭam nyi shu rtsa lnga/ ṭam lnga bcu bcas rigs lnga dpar 'debs byas pa de dag shing par yin la ljang / li/ smug ser/ sngo bcas tshos gcig ma yin pa dang /lo rabs sum cu'i yas mas tsam la ṭam lnga bcu'i shog lor lcags par tshon khra can thog mar brgyab pa dang / de min dngul srang lnga dang / srang bcu/ srang nyi shu rtsa lnga/ srang brgya tham pa bcas kyi shog lor rnams ni tā la'i bla ༵ ༵cu

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/gsum pa sku gshegs pa'i rjes su rim bzhin bton pa ma zad/ dngul srang gang zho lnga'i sgor mo dang / srang gsum sgor mo/ srang bcu'i sgor mo/ srang nyer lnga dang / srang lnga bcu'i sgor mo sogs kyang dpar 'debs byas yod/gong du smos pa'i bod dmag rgya bskyed dang / bzo grwa/ sbrag tar/slob grwa/ dngul khang sogs 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i nor srid yong 'bab thag gcod yong ched dpya khral bsdu lugs la bsgyur bcos byas te bal sho dang /tshwa sho/ pags sho sogs dpya khral lam lugs gsar du btsugs shing / des bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / dgon sde khag dbar 'gal ba shugs chen langs pa dang / lhag par du paṇa chen gyi mnga' zhabs bkra shes lhun po dang 'brel ba je sdug tu song zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni chin rgyal rabs kyi dus nas bzung paṇa chen gyi mnga' khongs dgon sde khag dang / sger pa sogs kyis sa zhing dang 'brog sde mang po bdag bzung byas kyang bkra shis lhun por dpya khral dang zhing bogs gang 'tshams 'jal dgos pa tsam las/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung la dpya khral che rigs 'jal mi dgos stabs dbya khral lam srol gsar du gtan 'khel gnang ba des kho pa tsho'i khe phan la gnod 'tshe shugs chen phog pas yid mi rangs par gyur/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bkras lhun bla brang khongs gtogs rnams kyang tā la'i bla ma'i mnga' zhabs spyi mtshungs su bsgyur chen shing stag (1914)lor gzhis ka rtse'i spyi rdzong du mkhan chung blo bzang don grub dang / shod drung mu bya bsko gzhag gnang thog gtsang phyogs rdzong khag bcu drug la do dam byas/ paṇa chen mnga' 'og gi rdzong gzhis tshang ma de'i nang du 'dus pa ma zad/ rdzong gzhis de dag nas bal sho dang / pags sho/ tshwa sho sogs khral rigs sna tshogs bsdu len byas shing / de bzhin lcags bya (1921)lor zhib 'phar las khungs gsar du btsugs te bzhi snro/ lhun por lo re dmag phogs 'bru khal chig khri bsgrub dgos pa'i

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/bka' phab stabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bkra shes lhun po dbar 'gal ba nyin bzhin je sdug tu song ba dang / mthar chu phag (1922)lo'i zla 11tshes 15nyin gyi mtshan mo paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma sku 'khor dang bcas mes rgyal nang khul du bros byol du phebs/dus der bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / de'i mnga' khongs dgon sde khag dang sger pa sogs dbar la'ang 'gal ba je mang du phyin pa dang / lhag par du srid blon bskyar du btsugs gnang ba des bka' shag gi dbang cha chung du phyin stabs tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / bka' blon tsho'i dbar gyi 'brel ba'ang nyin bzhin je sdug tu song zhing / skabs der mdo smad khul du bod dmag dang zi khron gyi dmag mi'i dbar zing cha yang yang langs pa sogs mdor na bod nang khul gyi gnas tshul de rnyog 'dzing ha cang che ba'i gnas su gyar bas dbyin jis bod 'di mes rgyal dang kha bral gtong ched spel slar yang bod du btang ste tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul sogs kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brangs par shog sbubs rlung 'tshang gis gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs btsugs te tā la'i bla ma'i srid bsgyur bya rgyu'i lkog g.yo'i ngan byus bshams shing / sgrig 'dzugs de'inang zhugs mkhan mang che ba rgyal rtse dbyin dmag slob grwa nas thon pa'i bod dmag gi dmag dpon gzhon nu rnams yin/ tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul gyi khyim du gsang ba'i sgo nas tshogs 'du bskongs te sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang 'phrog thabs skor zhib gsal gros sol dang mna' skyel dam bca' 'jog pa sogs byas/ tshogs zhugs khongs mi bod dmag gi dmag dpon dwags po sbrum pas lkog tu rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku drung du bskyod de tsha rong sogs nas ngan gros byed pa'i gnas tshul rnams zhib gsal snyan seng zhus stabs tā la'i bla mas gnas tshul 'di ni ha cang che ba'i lkog g.yo zhig yin pa gsal por mkhyen cing / ring min tsha rong zla bza~X /gra

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/'dul bod dmag gi dmag spyi'i go gnas las phab/ dmag don dbang cha yongs su 'dzin thub pa'i ched du tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku tsha dgas po sbrum par bod dmag gi dmag spyi bsko gzhag bstsal/ 'on kyang dwags po sbrum pa ni dmag don gyi 'jim bang zhan pa dang / sgyid lugs che ba zhig yin stabs don dngos thog dmag don gyi dbang cha tshags su tshud pa zhig ma byung bar brten rtsis dpon lung shar la dmag spyi'i 'tsho 'dzin bsko gzhag bstsal/ spel gyis bcoms pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i rnam thar nang smyo spyi lo 1925lor slebs skabs tā la'i bla mas blo brtan 'gyur med gyisadabyin ji rgyal khab dang 'brel ba nyin bzhin rgyang ring du btang ste krung gor phyogs pa red/ lo 'dir khong gis lung shar la bod dmag gi dmag spyir bsko gzhag byas shing / lung shar ni dbyin ngo rgol byed mkhan yin pa mngon gsal dod po red/ nga tsho'i grogs po rnying pa de snga'i bod dmag gi dmag spyi tsha rong ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dbyin jir dga' zhen yod pa zhig red/skabasader khong gi dbang cha mang che ba shor ba ma zad/ mu mthud go gnas dma' ru btang zhing / 1926lor rgyal rtser btsugs pa'i dbyin ji'i slob grwa mtshams 'jog byas pa red ’ ces bkod pa bzhin/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho ni don dngos thog rang gi mes rgyal la dga' zhen che ba dang /bod mi rigs kyi dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas/ dmag don sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad myur du gong spel gtong ba'i dgongs pa rgya che yod stabs dbyin jis zhi drag gnyis kyi thabs la brten nas g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba ji ltar bshams kyang kho tsho'i dmigs yul ngan pa de gsal por mkhyen pa ma zad/ rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi spun zla'i 'brel ba gting zab tu gtong rgyu dang / krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi mthun lam legs bcos byed1 spya 'di ni thabs lam bzang shos yin pa lo mang ring gi bya ba dngos kyi

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/nang nas gsal por rtogs te sa 'brug (1928)lo'i dgun dus ma skul dang blangs kyis rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar bca' sdod bod kyi mkhan po blo bzang pa sangs dang / de rjes pe cing g.yung ho kung ste dga' ldan byin chags gling gi mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas rnam gnyis nan cing du gtong gnang mdzad de go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan pa ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma rang nyid la dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs dang mnyam 'brel gyis mes rgyal la 'khon 'dzin byed pa'i dgongs tshul rtsa ba nas med lugs bab gsed yang yang gnang ba dang / paṇa chen rin po che bod la phyir log gnang rgyur dga' bsu dang brtsi bkur zhu gi yin zhes gsungs/ de rjes lcags rta (1920)lor li'u man chin gyis gnas bskor du yong ba'i tshul byas te mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas dang mnyam du bod du yong ste krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba 'dzugs rgyu'i skor 'khod pa'i go min tang gi tsung thung cang ce hre'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma zhig gong sa mchog la phul zhing / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis khong rnam gnyis la bod kyi sngar srol bzhin bsu ba sne len gzab rgyas gnang / li'u man chin skabs der lo nyi shu rtsa gsum la slebs pa dang khong gi ma ni bod rigs shig yin pas thengs 'dir bod du yong don ni krung dbyang dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba bskyar gso yong ched yin zhes gsal bshad yang yang zhus pa ma zad/ go min tang bod sog u yon lhan khang gi bsam 'char ltar bod kyi gnad don ji ltar byas te thag gcod byed dgos pa'i skor dri ba don tshan brgyad bton pa 'di ltar/6 dang po/ bod dang krung dbyang gi 'brel ba ga 'dra byas te bskyar gso byed dgos sam/gnyis pa/ krung dbyang gis bod la dbang bsgyur gyi dbang cha ༵ /dra

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/byas te 'dzin dgos sam/gsum pa/ bod sa gnas rang skyong gi dbang cha ga 'dra byas te gtan 'khel byed dgos sam/bzhi pa/ tā la'i dang paṇa chen rnam gnyis krung go go min tang nang zhugs py-i ༵/ tā la'i dang paṇa chen gyi bod kyi chab srid kyi go gnas dang dbang cha sngar bzhin byed dam/ yang na gsar du gtan 'bebs bzo dgos sam/ drug pa/ paṇa chen bod du phyir log na/ tā la'i mchog nas bsu ba gang 'dra byed dam/bdun pa/ phan tshun 'brel ba byed bde ba'i ched du tā la'i bla ma nas nan cing du don gcod khang 'dzugs sam/brgyad pa/ bod phyogs nas krung dbyang la da dung re ba gang zhig yod dam 7zhes 'khod yod/gong gsal gyi don tshan khag la dris lan zhib gsal phul ba dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bka' la brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan pa smos ci/ lo de gar mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi spyi khyab 'thus mir bsko gzhag bstsal/de rjes lcags rta (1920)lo'i zla 12par go min tang bod sog u yon lhan khang gis dpon rigs shes go leng dang / drung yig than yun hran rgyagar brgyud bod du gtong gnang mdzad kyang shes go leng chu shur du 'byor rjes glo bur du grongs pa dang de'i sku phung lha sar gdan drangs nas 'das mchodagazab rgyas gnang ba dang / drung yig than yun hran la tā la'i bla ma mardo//sa mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma zad/ bsu ba dang sne len gang legs

le'udang po/ tā la'i bla'i skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/gnang zhing / khong bod du yun ring bzhugs kyang gnad don che ba gang yang thag gcod byed thabs bral bas mthar phyir log phebs/lcags lug (1921)lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis tshul khrims bstan 'dzin sogs ser skya dpon rigs 'ga' zhig nan cing du mngags gtong mdzad de nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi don gcod khang dngos su btsus/sa/ krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba slar gso dang sngar bas gong 'phel phyin pa bcas so/bcu gcig pa/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang bod kyi dbang 'dzin pa nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res byas pa'i skor/chu bya lo'i (1922)zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dang thog mgul 'cham bzhes te sku khams cung zad mi bde bar gyur cing / tshes 24nyin rgyud smad grwa tshang la 'char can gyi dgun mjal gnang bas sku gzugs 'khrugs te snyung gzhi je sdug tu song bas bka' shag dang dga' ldan khri zur byams pa chos grags mchog nas tā la'i bla ma'i sku gam du bcar chog pa'i snyan sgron zhus kyang bka' blon tshor mjal 'phrad ma gnang ba ma zad/ snyan sgron mjal dar yang yang phyir slog gnang ba dang / dga' ldan khri zur gyi mjal dar dang rten dod bzhes te mjal 'phrad gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ de nas gong sa mchog snyung gzhi nyin bzhin lci ru song ba'i gtam ngan de phyir khyab rjes rgya che'i ser skya mang tshogs yongs nas sems khral tshad med byas pa ma zad/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / rgya stag ༵ 2/ che/

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum sogs dgon sde khag gi dge 'dun pa yongs kyis brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs dang zhabs rim gang mang bsgrubs kyang phan pa gang yang ma byung bar zla 10tshes 20nyin gyi zhogs pa thugs dran nyams nas gsung mol gang yang gnang mi thub par gyur te dgong dro'i chu tshod drug pa tsam la nor gling skal bzang pho brang gi 'dab 'brel gzim chung 'chi med mchog 'khyil du gzim khri mtha' can du gyur cing / skabs der dgung grangs 58la phebs yod/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gtam ngan de khyab 'phral bod ljongs lha sde mi sde yongs sdug bsngal gyi khung bu'i nang du lhungs shing / bka' shag gis bdun gsum ring dpon rigs rnams rna rgyan 'dogs mi chog pa dang / khang pa tshang ma'i dar lcog 'bebs dgos pa/ shel yol khra khra brgyab mi chog pa/ skye rgu mtha' dag gyon chas khra khra sil sil gyon mi chog pa sogs kyi bka' phab/de nas gong sa mchog gi sku gdung rin po cher chos gos rnam gsum dang /zhal khebs dar gos mtshal kha/ dbu zhwa paṇa ring sogs sgron te bzhugs khri'i steng du gdan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol/ sku mdun du mchod sprin rgya che gzab rgyas bshams/ de bzhin gdan sa chen po ser 'bras dga' gsum dang / gling bzhi ste kun bde gling dang / bstan rgyas gling / tshe smon gling /tshe mchog gling sogs dgon sde khag gis sngar srol ltar dgongs rdzogs gang legs bsgrubs thog de rjes gdung mjal btang ste gdan sa chen po ser 'bras dga' gsum dang / gling bzhi'i 'thus mi/ yab gzhis/ bka' blon/rgyal sprul/ gsol gzim mchod gsum drung rtsis sogs ser skya dpon rigs yongs dang / sa gnas rdzong gzhis khag gi 'thus mi sogs nas mjal dar dang gser gdung gi zhal 'debs rgya che phul/12bye nas lo de'i zla 12tshes 22nyin bka' shag gis dmigs bsal

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusaskabs/tshogs 'du bskongs te rgyal dbang mchog gi sku gdung lha khang dang gdung rten bzhengs phyogs skor gros bsdur mdzad skabs 'thus mi rnams nas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho ni bod 'bangs ser skya yongs la bka' drin lhag par che ba zhig yin pas gser gdung khyad du 'phags pa zhig bzhengs dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ltar/ 'phral du gser gdung gsar bzhengs do dam par bka' blon khri smon pa dang / mkhan drung ram pa ba/ rtsis dpon khri dga' ba/ las bya 'ga' zhig bcas bsko gzhag bstsal ba dang 'brel gser gdung lha khang dang gser gdung bzhengs yul gang dga' brtag dbyad gang legs mdzad thog rtse pho brang dmar po'i nub rgyud du ar las dang gser gdung las grwa dus gcig tu 'go tshugs te rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig las sku tshad rgyug mtho lngas mtho ba dang / bzo bkod shin tu legs pa rin bral phra rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i gser gdung dge legs 'dod 'jo bzheng 'go tshugs pa dang / de bzhin dad ldan skye bo kun gyis mchod 'bul dang bsnyen bkur zhu bde ba'i ched du rgyal dbang mchog gi 'dra sku lnga bzhengs te gdung khang dge legs 'dod 'jo dang / rtse po ta la/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang / zhol par khang / nor bu gling kha bcas la bzhugs su gsol ba'i gtan 'bebs mdzad cing / phyogs mtshungs sngar lam ltar go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la shāl dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i skor zhib gsal snyan na zhu/sa/ der bod kyi dbang 'dzin pa nang khul srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de sngar bas rno ngar dang / dza drag mngon gsal dod po bcas su gyur/ de snga rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho zhal bzhugs skabs su spyan bsal tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul dang / rtsis dpon lung shar rdo 25 tshe

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/rgyal/ de rjes sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel bcas rim pa bzhin dbang shugs ha cang che bas bka' blon sogs ser skya dpon rigs mang po yid mi rangs par gyur pa dang / de bzhin tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul dang / lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal/ spyan bsal kun 'phel bcas kyi dbar gcig dbang gcig gis 'phrog pa'i 'thab rtsod mthun thabs med pa rim brgyud du byung yod/ rtsis dpon lung shar gyis dmag spyi'i go gnas bzung rjes tsha rong gis bod sog dmag spyi byed skabs go mtshon mang po mi tshang bar kha g.yar ba thabs lam 'dra min brgyud nas tsha rong bka' blon gyi dbang cha gnas dbyungs btang ba dang / 6 de rjes spyan bsal kun 'phel lags dang lung shar gnyis shugs che mnyam yin stabs spyan bsal nang khul mthun po ma byung bas bsnyad 'tshol ched tā la'i bla mar gleng phyogs mang po zhu gi yod 'dug dper na lung shar rol cha gtong rgyur dga' po yod stabs zla re bzhin nyin gnyis tsam ring rol cha gtong rogs tsho dang mnyam du 'dzoms te nyin gung tsam nas gzhas dang zhabs bro brgyab ste sdod kyi yod lugs sogs snyan phra zhus stabs/ gzhung don las kur do 'khur ma byas pa lta bu'i dgongs phyogs byung ste dmag spyi'i las 'khur phyir 'then dang rtsis dpon rang 'jags su 'jog pa gnang duzhes gsal ba ltar lung shar dang kun 'phel lags gnyis dbar 'gal ba rno ngar can chags yod/ 'gag rtsa de 'dra zhig gi skabs tā la'i bla ma glo bur dgongs pa rdzogs stabs lung shar gyis 'khon lan slog pa'i go skabs rnyed nas drung rtsis dang / gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mir ngan bskul gyis spyan bsal kun 'phel lags dang / khong gi pha gon sogs 'dzin bzung gis mthar khong kong por rgyangs 'bud btang / de rjes spyan bsal kun 'phel gsal①/ (bod kyi rigaganasal sadapyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam bsgrigs〉deb gnyisapa'i par ngos19par 128

le'udang po/ tā pa'i blasaskuphrengabacu gsum pa thub bstan rgyarabacu skabs/lags rgya gar du bros kyang / rgya gar bas khong la dogs pa chad med byas te gang 'gro'i sar gsang nyul rtag tu btang ba sogs nyen kha ha cang che ba'i /nas su rgyar stabs mes rgyal nang sar tshur phyir log mi byed ka med byung ba rid/ de nas shing khyi (1924)lor/ drung rtsis sogs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms thog srid skyong gsar bsko byed phyogs skor gros sol dang 'brel go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la snyan sgron zhus pa ltar/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes srid skyong dang glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug srid blon las rogs su bsko gzhag byas/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes khri la 'khod ma thag tu dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas slar yang shog sbubs rlung 'tshang gis de'i srid dbang mgo rting slog pa'i ngan byus mang tsam spel zhing / dus der lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal sogs nas skyid phyogs kun mthun zhes pa'i gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs sheg btsugs/sgrig 'dzugs der phyi rgyar bstan pa rgyas pa'am 'gro ba bde ba sogs 'bod/ kho pa tshos lkog tu tshogs 'du bskongs te bod du sgrid mo khe rin si'i (dmangs gtso zhes pa'i don yin )lam lugs lag len bstar dgos brjod skabs tshogs zhugs dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis tha snyad de'i go don gang yin zhes 'dri skabs lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyis dbyin ji'i lam lugs la zer ba red ces 'grel bshad khungs ma dag cig brgyab stabs tshogs zhugs dpon rigs la las bod la dbyin ji'i lam lugs 'dzugs rgyur ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs sgrig 'dzugs de'i khongs mi nang khul du 'gal ba langs te gsang ba'i gros sol byas pa'i gnas tshul rnams bka' blon khri smon la snyan seng zhus shing / khri smon gyis gnas tshul de thos 'phral srid skyong rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jal dpal ye shes la snyan sgron zhus stabs bka' shasdu /sa

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal 'dzin bzung thog mig 'bras gnyis ka bton pa ma zad/mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes dang / tshe gang btson du 'jug rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas shing / gros mi gtso gras 'ga' zhig kyang rgyang 'bud du btang /de rjes spyan bsal kun 'phel lags kyi rgyab rtsa spom mda' stobs rgyal sogs nas smar khams khul yul dmag bsdu rub kyis bod dmag la tshur rgol byasate smar khams kyi sa cha bdag bzung byas pa'i gnas tshul bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis shes 'phral chab mdo nas bod dmag 'bor chen btang ste smar khams su dpung 'jug byas/ spom mda'i dpung rogs rnams dmag pham ste spom mda' stobs rgyal sogs mi khag gcig zi khron zhing chen khongs 'ba' yul du bros pa dang / de min yul dmag khag gcig bod dmag gis bzung ste rkang pa'i nya khug gi rtsa bcad de phyir slog btang zhing / spom mda' rabadaga' yang gong gsal don gnad dang 'brel ba shin tu che ba bcas la brten bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bod dmag btang ste lha sar yod pa'i spom mda' tshang gi khang pa'i mtha' bskor byas na yang / spom mda' yar 'phel ni spyang grung 'dzoms shing skabs bstun bya ba gang cir byang chub pa zhig yin stabs lam seng bod sa gnas srid gzhung la dgongs sel dang rgyu dngos gun gsab byed pa'i khas len dam bca' bzhag ste gnad don rnams zhi ba'i ngang thag gcod thub pa byung ba red/de nas shing khyi (1924)lo'i zla 4par go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis sku tshab hong rma'o sung bod du gtong gnang mdzad de lha sar 'byor bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas dpon rigs btang ste bsu ba dang sne len gang legs zhus/ hong rma'o sung sku 'khor dang bcas pa lha sar 'byor 'phral sngar srol ltar lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / rgya stag ra mo che/ se 'bras da/rmi gsum bcas par gnas gzigs dang mchod 'bul rgya che gnang / de

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'ikhu mkha /rjes pho brang chen po rtse po ta lar mdzad sgo tshogs te tā la'i bla ma mchog dzi6 rgyal skyong bstan rgyas kun byams byang chub slob dpon chen po zhes pa'i rje snon cho lo dang / g.yang kri'i 'ja' sa dam kha phul/ gser gdugazhal 'debs gser dang nor bu'i rigs 'bor chen gnang zhing / krung dbyang sku tshab hong rma'o sung dang las rogs li tan sogs bod du zla ba gsum bzhugs te/ krung dbyang srid dazhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar 'brel ba 'thus sgo tshang du gtong ba sogs kyi skor phan tshun zhib gros thengs mang gnang ste nan bshad gnang don/ krung dbyang gis bod du 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i mdzad phyogs ni tsung li sun krung hran gyi zhal chems ltar mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi rtsa don gzhir bzung ste phyi 'brel dang / rgyal srung / rang rgyal dang phyi'i rgyal khag gzhan dag dbar gyi tshong 'grul sogs bya ba gal chen rnams krung dbyang gis 'gan 'khur dgos pa phud/ de min gnad don rnams sngar bzhin bod sa gnas srid gzhung rang gis thag gcod byas chog pa dang / krung dbyang dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'gal rkyen mtha' dag med pa bzo ba/bod kyi 'dzugs skrun gong 'phel gtong ba sogs yin/ skabs der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas rgya bod 'brel ba sngar bas dam zab 'gro bar zhed snang tshad med skyes te ha'o the sogs ched mngags bod la btang ste rgya bod mi rigs dbar dben sbyor dkrug shing dang gtor brlag gtong ba'i spyod ngan mang tsam spel ba red/de nas hong rma'o sung gis slar yang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che khag rnams dang bka' gros zhib gsal gnang ste go min tang krung dbyangasrid gzhung gi bka' bkod ltar gros sol byed pa'i rtsa don don tshan dgu bton par/ bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs bston med yin pa dang /bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bka' la brtsi1 ༵/ra
