bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i sgradabyangs/mtha' gcig tu zhu rgyu 'di ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin zhes gsungs/ de bzhin bod kyi chab srid lam lugs dang / bod dang phyi'i rgyal khag dbar gyi 'brel ba/ bod kyi dpon rigs che khag rnams bsko gzhag byed phyogs skor sogs kyi rtsa don rnams gsal por bton gnang ba red/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis gros mol byed pa'i rtsa don de dag la dmigs te bod 'di phyi phyogs su mtshon na krung go'i mnga' khongs yin rung / don du krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod 'di zhing chen zhig tu mi bsgyur ba'i khas len dgos pa dang / bod kyi da yod chos srid lam lugs thams cad sngar bzhin rang dbang rang bdag byed dgos pa/ bod du rgya gzhung gi sku tshab dpon rigs shig bca' sdod chog kyang ngo 'khor mi grangs nyer lnga las 'gal mi chog pa/ bod du gtan sdod rgya rigs mtha' dag bod kyi so nam las khungs kyi khongs su bcug ste do dam byed dgos pa sogs tshul min gyi don tshan bcu bton zhing / gong gsal don tshan de dag gi thog nas gsal po mthong thub pa zhig la dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og bod kyi dbang 'dzin pa nyung shas kyis sim la'i gros tshogs skabs kyi nor 'khrul lam phyogs de mtha' 'khyongs byed pa de yin/de nas hong rma'o sung dang phyag rogs li tan sogs sku 'khor rnams rgya gar brgyud nan cing du phyir phebs gnang rjes go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la bod kyi gnas tshul zhib gsal snyan sgron zhus pa dang 'brel phan tshun gnyisacas thog lha sar bod sog u yon lhan khang gi don gcod khang gsar btsugs kyis bod sog u yon lhan khang gi u yon li'u phu'u phren la bod sdod don gcod khru'u yi khru'u krang bsko gzhag gnang ba dang / don gcod khang de'i khongs su 'grim 'grul pu'u yi tshong las glog 'phrin khang zhig btsugs/ de bzhin skyid stod par slob grwa dang / sman khang dang / gnam gshis babs tshu/sdu )cas btsugs kyang de dag la las don mi sna mi grangs bzhi bcu zhe lnga

le'udangawo/ tā la'i brasaskuphrengabacugasumasathubabastan spabacu ba /las med/bcu gnyis pa/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin dang gser khrir mnga' gsol ba'i skor/thog mar yang srid sa phyogs gang du sku 'khrungs yod min skor sngar lam bzhin chos skyong srung ma khag la 'phrin bcol gzab rgyas kyi thog nas lung zhu dang / skyes chen dam pa khag la thugs dam brtag zhu/ lhag par du chos 'khor rgyal lha mo'i bla mtshor bskang 'phrin gang zab thog srid skyong sku ngo ma sa gnas rang du phebs te mtsho gzigs gnang srol ltar shing phag (1925)lo zla 5par rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes dang / bka' blon khri smon pa nor bu dbang chen/ mkhan drung bkra shes gling pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen sogs sku 'khor dang bcas pa rgyal me tog thang dgon par phebs te dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mos gtsos pa'i bstan srung khag la bskang 'phrin gnad smin gnang zhing / de nas dgon de'i shar byang mtshams su gnas pa'i lha mo'i bla mtshor rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog mtsho mjal du thengs gsum tsam phebs te mtsho mjal ji byung gsang rgya gnang bas sku bcar sus kyang shes tshor ma byung zhing / de nas lha sar phyir log phebs rjes shing phag (1925)lo'i zla 6tshes gnyin mtsho mjal ji gzigs shog lhe zhig bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus la gnang ba'i nang / dbu can gyi yig 'bru a dang / ka/ ma/ zhes dang / de rjes dgon pa thog sa gsum rtseg bar thog g.yu rtsi can gyi yang steng du gser zangs kyi rgya phebs /shā pa/

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/dgon pa de'i shar phyogs 'gro lam skya tha ler ri chung zhig gi rtsar thug pa/de'i thad khang pa thog gcig ma thog sngon po byas pa gcig gzigs tshul rnams 'khod yod/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus thog 'os 'dems mi sna lam khagagasum la bgos te tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid 'tshol bar gtong rgyu'i thag gcod byas pa ltar/ mtshan zhabs ke'u tshang sprul sku dang / phyag rogs zhol mkhe smad sras bsod nams dbang bdus/ nag chu mkhan po rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin/ rtse drung blo bzang tshe dbang bcas mtsho sngon zhing chen zi ling khul du mngags gtong mdzad pa dang / yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che dang / phyag rogs su rtse mgron bstan pa 'byung gnas/ rtse drung chang khyim pa thub bstan tshe dpal/ shod drung phun rab pa bcas dwags kong khul du gtong gnang mdzad/ ser byes khang ser sprul sku dang / phyag rogs su rtse drung las tshan tshul khrims chos 'phel/ shod drung las tshan 'bri yul ba bcas so sor yang srid rtsad gcod zhu phyogs kyi byed sgo'i gron dngul dang / sku'i nyer chas sogs bstsal te gtong gnang mdzad pa ltar phyogs gang sar rgyal ba'i yang srid rin po che brtsad gcod skor dogs 'char 'os sprul tshang mar bsregs bcad brdar gsum byas mthar ke'u tshang sprul sku ngo las nas a mdo'i khul gang sar brtsad zhib gnang bas a mdo sku 'bum gyi shar smad stag 'tsher zhes pa'i zhing grong chung ngu zhig tu byi'i char zer ba'i khyim tshang gi yab chos skyong tshe ring dang / yum bsod nams mtsho gnyis la shing phag (1925)lo'i zla 5tshes 5nyin sku 'khrungs pa'i chung srid mtshan lha mo don grub zhu ba khye'u gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i ngo mtshar che ba'i rtags mtshan mang dag cig byung ba khul de'i ser skya kun gyi khrod du yongs su grags pa dang / lhag par du rwa sgreng rin po ches mtsho 'jal du gzigs pa'i lung pa'i dbyibs dang mthun pa bcas la brdo/ spya nas mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gzhung la tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid kyi

le'u dang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dusamakha /'os sprul de bzhin bod du gdan 'dren chog pa'i re ba zhus kyang kru'u ba pu h+phang dang / sku 'bum bla spyis yang srid ngo ma yin min sa gnas da ga rang du gtan 'khel byed dgos pa sogs ka kor mang po bshad stabs sngar srol ltar na yang srid thos sprul tshang ma lha sar gdan drangs nas chos phyogs kyi 'gro lugs bzhin brtag dpyad ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa'i skor thabs mkhas gang che'i bab gsed re zhu gnang mod/ 'on kyang rma pu h+phang nas yang srid blu yon lta bur tā yang 'bum phrag bzhi tsam dgos zer ba sogs 'gog rkyen mang po bzos stabs go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la snyan seng mi zhu ka med byung zhing / go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis zi ling kru'u zhi rma pu h+phang la tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid 'os sprul bod la phebs skyel zhu dgos pa'i bka' phab pa dang / gron dngul sgor khri bcu tsam gnang / de nas yang srid 'os sprul rin po che dang / yab chos skyong tshe ring / yum bsod nams mtsho sogs sku 'khor dang bcas pa rma pu h+phang gi ngo tshab hre krang rma yon had dang / phu'u thon krang sogs rta dmag brgya phrag 'ga' zhig gi phebs rogs 'og mtsho sngon nas chibs kha bsgyur/sa yos (1929)lo'i zla 6tshes 28nyin rtse gzim chung bde ldan 'khyil du bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms thog srid bka' lhan rgyas nas drung rtsis brgyud bka' gsal gnang don/ tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid 'os sprul khag la snga rjes su brtag zhib nan tan byas pa brgyud mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs stag 'tsher du 'khrungs pa'i chung srid lha mo don grub de nyid yang srid 'khrul bral gcig thog gtan 'khel mdzad 'os su 'dug na bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms nas kyang mdzes zon spangs pa'i tshig tho 'bul dgos gsungs pa ltar/ ser 'bras dga' gsum dang / gling khag gzhung zhabs ser skya dpon rigs sogs spyi mgrin nas sku 'bum stag 'tsher du 'khrungs pastu /sa

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/sprul de rang rgyal ba'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhu rgyu'i bsam gros gcig mthun yin zhes tshig tho phul nas dngos su tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid du gtan 'khel khyab bsgrags gnang ba red/ yang srid rin po che bod kyi sa sner phebs 'byor zin par brten phebs bsu snga phyi gsum khongs bka' blon bon shod pa tshe brtan rdo rje sogs nag chur phebs bsur phebs rgyu'i khyab bsgrags gnang zhing / skabs der glo bur du rgyal ba'i yang srid rin po che ston 'khor dang bcas gdang lar chibs bsgyur gnang zin pa'i gnas tshul 'byor 'phral bka' blon bon shod tshe brtan rdo rjes gtsos chibs zhabs ser skya dang /phebasakhyams pa/ rnam grwa/ rtse gsol thab pa/ chibs dar sogs zla 8tshes 5nyin lha sa nas thon te 'brom stod zhag sar 'byor skabs nag chu 'go pa zung nasadza drag gi rta shad 'byor gsal zla /tshes 1༷nyin yang srid rin po che sku 'khor dang bcas nag chur phebs rgyu gtan 'khel zin lugs gsal ba ltar/bka'ablon bon shod ngo las hrag bsdus 'phral du chibs rdog thon pa ma zad/de min las bya rnams zla 〈tshes 9nyin nag chur 'byor dgos pa'i bka' brda gnang / de nas phebs bsu ba ngo las tshang ma snga rjes su dus bkag ltar nag chur 'byor zhing / rim bzhi yan nas khal kha gzugs dang las tshan drung dkyusarnams rgya lu chas/ rtse skor nas phyar gru chab stod sogs gzab mchor gang legs kyis yang srid rin po cher phebs bsu dang mjal dar phul/ tshes 10nyin gyi nyi shar mtshams su mdzad sgo gnang bar yang srid mchog sprul rin po che na bza' bla chas bzhes te bzhugs khrir bzhugs su gsol/ tā la'i bla ma'i yab yum gnyis kyang bzhugs khri'i 'gram du sku bzhengs gnang ste bzhugs/ dus der bka' blon bon shod pa tshe brtan rdo rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi spyi 'thus zhus te maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten phul thog rgyal ba'i yardordo/ rin po che gcig thog thugs gtan 'khel ba'i rgyal ba rwa sgreng dang /

le'udang po/ tā pa'i blas skuphrengabacu gsum pa thubabastan rgyasatsho dusaskabs/bka' shag bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms kyi tshig tho bcas 'bul gnang mdzad rjes phebs bsur bcar ba'i ser skya dpon rigs ngo las yongs nas mjal dar phul zhing / phyag dbang zhus/ gsol ja bzhes 'bras phebs/ de rjes bla rtsis las tshan dngos grub sding pa blo bzang rdo rjes sde brgyad gser skyems dang / srid pa ho'i rgyab yig sgrogs sbyang dang 'brel chibs dar sogs kyis sngon bsus sngar lam gzhung zhabs ser skya chibs hrag dang bcas nag chu zhabs brtan dgon du zhabs sor 'khod/de nas rim bzhin 'dam stod dbu ma bkra shis thang du bzhugs zhag sar phebs bsu gnyis par rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes sogs phebs/ de nas bka' gdams bstan pa'i chu 'go rwa sgreng dgon du chibs bsgyur gyis bzhugs zhag gsum gnang ste rim bzhin ri rgya bsam gtan gling du zla /tshes 22nyin chibs bsgyur gyis bde chen 'dod rgu bang du nam mkha'i skar tshogs sa la 'phos pa ltar bzhugs sgar sgar sgrig che mo'i sgar thog tu chibs bsgyur gyis phebs bsu gsum par gzhung zhabs ser skya yongs rdzogs dang / gdan sa gsum/ rgyud grwa rnam gnyis sogs kyi bla sprul mkhan la sa/ bal po dang / 'brug pa lo phyag pa/ ka shi mir kha che'i 'go pa sogs mjal khar bcar zhing / der bzhugs zhag gcig gnang ste zla /tshes 24nyin tā la'i bla ma mchog gi yang srid sku 'khor dang bcas pa lha sar phebs skabs sngar lam chibs bsu'i bkod pa mu tig star la brgyus pa ltar bsgrigs pa'i dbus/ phebs byams nang bzhugs su gsol zhing / g.yas ngos su se 'bras dga' gsum chos sde gtso bo rnams kyi dge 'dun tshos mchod mas dang /rin chen sna tshogs lag tu thogs pa'i ser sbrengs dang / g.yon ngos su bod dmag sge/sa go mtshon lag tu thogs nas bstod pa'i glu dbyangs dang gus 'dud zhus/ bro pa gzhas ma sogs sgyu rtsal gyi rigs rnam pa sna tshogasdu 3)nga /

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'isgra dbyangs/'budadakrol kyi byed brag mtha' yas pa sogs bsu ba gzab rgyas zhus/ de bzhin dri bzang sna lnga sbyar ba'i spos dang bsang gi dud sprin mtha' yas dgung sngon yongs su khengs par spros/de nas rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang / srid zur glang mdun gung / bka' blon/ sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po sogs kyis chibs zhabs dang bcas thog mar yang srid rin po che lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du byon nas jo bo shākya mu ner thugs smon mtshams sbyor mdzad rjes nor gling skal bzang pho brang du gdan drangs so/ de nas zla 10tshes 12la rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes dang / mtshan zhabs dar han stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab mthu stobs rnam gnyis kyis yongs 'dzin bgres gzhon gyi thugs 'gan yongs su bzhes/ tshes 12nyin yang srid rin po lha ldan gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs thog jo bo shākya mu ne dang / thugs dam gyi rten gtso thub dbang sta zur ma/ rje bkra shes rdo kha ma/ sgrol ma gling dga' ma bcas gdan drangs pa'i drung du rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po ches dbu skyes gtsug phud zhes te mtshan du 'jam dpal ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang bsgyur mtshungs pa med pa'i sde zhes gsol gnang mdzad/de nas lcags 'brug (1940)lo'i zla 1tshes 14(yig tshags 'ga' zhig tu tshes 20zhes 'khod )nyin tshoms chen srid zhi phun tshogs kyi mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i dbang pos btegs pa'i gser khrir rgyal dbang mchog sprul rin po che mnga' gsol zhu skabs/ sngar lam bzhin bka' blon bla ma dang / spyi khyab mkhan po gnyis nas phyag 'dren gdan zhu dgos par skabs de'i bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang spyi khyab mkhan po ngag dardidī /stan 'dzin gnyis nas phyag 'dren zhus te bzhugs khri chen mo'i steng

le'udang po/ tā la'i blas skuphreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgyasatsho'i dus bas/du bzhugs su gsol thog bkra shes rtags brgyad dang / rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyis sne drangs pa'i khyad du 'phags pa'i 'bul nor rnam pa sna tshogasaspyan lam du bstar ba dang / mdzad sgo rgya che gzab rgyas 'tshogs shing /lha zhol khul du rnga brdung dar 'phyar dang / bde yangs shar du bro pa gzhas ma/zlos gar/ lha mo ba sogs bstar sgrig gis 'khrab ston dang / rdo ring nang mar shing rtsed/ rdo ring phyi mar mi rta'i bang rtsal bcas par gnang sbyin dang /sbe kha rdo mgyogs sogs pho rtsal sna tshogs 'gran pa bcas bkra shes dga' ston bla na med par rol/ phyogs mtshungs bod ljongs yul gru kun tu'ang gtam snyan dar 'phyar gyi dga' ston gzab rgyas ci dgar spel ba lags so/dus der go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho khri phebs mdzad sgor bod sog u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang 'u krung shin ngo las nyin rdu brgyud lha sar mngags gtong mdzad cing / 'u u yon krang lha sar 'byor skabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sngar lam bzhin bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas zhus shing 'on kyang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brangs pa tsho yid mi rangs par 'bras ljongs pa'i chabasrid dpon rigs nā sogs mi bcu lhag tsam bod du btang / kho pa tsho phyi tshul du tā la'i bla ma'i khri phebs mdzad sgor rten 'brel zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan rung / don du 'u krung shin la lta rtog dang / rgya bod spun zla mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril la gtor bshig gtong bar 'ongs/ de bzhin dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas ngan bslab byas paṃ ltar tā la'i bla ma phyi phebs mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byed phyogs dang / gdan thob sogs kyi skor la rtsod gleng mang tsam chags shing / 'u krung shin gyis krung dbyang gi bka' bkod ltar bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bston med yin pa'i rtsa don rgyun 'khyongs mtha' gcig tu gnang ba ma zad/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyi mdzanā byes

bodakyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/lagazhigs te 6 spru go zhung ho han he :zhes pa'i cho lo gnang / de nas 'u u yon krang zhabs 'bring dang bcas lha sa nas slar yang nyin rdu brgyud khrung chin du phyir log mdzad/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sngar lam ltar dza sag ngag dbang rgyal mtshan sogs 'thus mi mngags gtong thog go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la thugs rje legs 'bul yang zhus yod/tā'i'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho khrir phebs rjes sngar srol ltar/ tā la'i bla ma'i yab tshang la snga rjes su sgos gzhis dang mnga' 'bangs mi ser mang tsam phul zhing / lha sa lcang gseb shar du gzim shag gsar bskrun bcas bod gyu /zlo dī bdag che gras su gyur nas yab gzhis stag 'tsher zhes grags pa 140
rmyalatshab rwasadang stabang rab kyi sdo

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/dang po/ tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs pa rdzogs rjes sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi gnas babs skor/rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing lug (1895)lor dgung grangs bco brgyad la phebs skabs lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan dngos su bzhes te chu bya (1922)lo bar lo ngo sum cu so bdun tsam chab srid bskyangs pa'i ring tā la'i bla ma sku phreng na rim dang mi 'dra bar phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen sna tshogs 'phrad cing / 'on kyang gong sa mchog gis 'gal rkyen de dag las rnam par rgyal te bod kyi chab srid dang /rigaganas/ dpal 'byor bcas gong du spel ba dang / lha par du mes rgyal mtha' mtshams sra brtan yong ched sku ngal 'dzems med kyis mes rgyal dang mi dmangs la phan pa'i phyag las du ma mdzad/ stabs mi legs pa zhig la chu bya (1922)lo'i zla 10tshes 15tsam la mgul cham bzhes/ tshes 27nyin snyung gzhi je lod du gyur kyang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags nas srid blon dang bka' shag la snyan seng ma zhus par gsang ba gnang / de rjes bka' shag gis gong sa mchog gi snyung gzhi je 'od du song ba'i gnas tshul shes 'phral bka' blon bla ma dge 'dun chos dar dang / bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal/ bka' blon gnang byung pa bcas nas dga' ldan khri zur byams pa chos grags gdan drangs te nor gling spyan bsal pho brang du gsol 'de111 zhu bar phebs kyang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalatshabar nga thubabastan 'jamadab spe shesadangastagabragangagadabangagasungarabacin bgabakag 'gog gnang stabs sku mdun du bcar thabs med par phyir log mi byed thabs med byung / 'on kyang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis gsungs par gzhigs na tā la'i bla mar snyung gzhi phog rjes 'gan blos rtsa ba nas ma bzod par bka' shag tu snyan seng zhu rtsis thengs mang byas kyang gong sa mchog gis bka' shag la snyan seng rigs gtan nas byed mi dgos/ sku drag de tsho yong nas brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul ba sogs byas na nga'i rlung nad la gnod pa ma gtogs phan pa gang yang yong gi ma red ces gsungs byung / de zla'i tshes 29nyin sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis gnas chung chos rje gzim chung du gdan drangs nas gzim chung spyan 'dren zhus pas gnas chung chos rjes cham 'joms dpa' bo bcu bzhi 'bul dgos zhes brjod pa ma zad/ chos rje'i gam g.yog gis sman blangs te phul 'phral gong sa mchog bka' sol gnang rgyu med par gyur/ don du sman log phul ba red/ de nas chu bya (1922)lo'i zla 10tshes 2༷nyin gyi dgong mo'i chu tshod 10pa'i thog rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho gzim khri mtha' can du gyur bas sku bcar kun 'phel lags nas srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug dang / bka' shag la snyan seng mi zhu thabs med byung ba red/skabs der bod kyi ser skya mang tshogs mang po zhig gis gong sa mchog 'tsho bzhugs skabs mes rgyal dang bod mi dmangs la phan pa'i bya ba bzang po ji snyed pa mdzad kyang da lam snyung gzhi bzhes pa'i skabs zhabs brtan sna gcig kyang sgrub mi ma byung bar glo bur dgongs pa rdzogs pa ni ha cang thabs sdug cig red zer srid blon glang mdun dang / bka' shag sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel sogs la 'khon 'dzin shugs chen byas/ de mtshungs srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug dang / sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel/ rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal bcas dbang 'dzin shog kha stu /sa

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/go skabs 'di dang bstun nas spyi tshogs thog dang bod ljongs tshogs 'du sogs gang sar rang phyogs la bstod cing gzhan phyogs la dma' 'bebs byed pa'i gleng phyogs mang po bzos pa dang / g.yo thabs sna tshogs la brten nas so so'i shog khas bod yongs kyi srid dbang kha lo sgyur thub thabs byas/tā la'i bla ma zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul dang /lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal/ thub bstan kun 'phel bcas sku bcar spyan bsal phan tshun dbar gcig dbang gcig gis 'phrog pa'i 'thab rtsod rab dang rim pa byung yod/ rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyis bod dmag gi dmag spyi'i go gnas bzung rjes tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul gyis bod dmag gidamag spyi byed skabs go mtshon mang po tshang min skor skyon 'dzugs mang po byas/ 66de rjes sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags dang lung shar gnyis shugs che mnyam yin stabs spyan bsal nang khul mthun po ma byung bas bsnyad 'tshol ched tā la'i bla ma'i sku mdun du gling phyogs mang tsam bzos/ dper na lung shar rol cha gtong rgyur dga' po yod stabs zla re bzhin nyin gnyis tsam ring rol cha gtong rogs tsho dang mnyam du 'dzoms te nyin dgung tsam nas gzhas dang zhabs bro brgyab ste sdod kyi yod lugs sogs snyan phra zhus stabs/gzhung don las kur do 'khur ma byas pa lta bu'i rtsis dpon rang gnas su 'jog pa gnang 7zhes gsal ba ltar lung shar dang thub bstan kun 'phel lags dbar 'gal ba shugs cher song ba'i 'gag rtsa'i skabs der gong sa mchogaglo bur dgongs pa rdzogs stabs lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal la 'khon lan slog pa'i go skabs shig rnyed nas drung rtsis dang gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mir skul slong mang tsam byas pa dang / lhag par du sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags su gong sa mchog gis dmigs bsal gyi brtsi mthong chen po gan7 4stabs dbang shugs ha cang che bas sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag khag

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalatshabarwazhed thubabastan 'jamadapalas shesadang gzagangagadabangagag ngarab/du skabs/gcig mi dga' bar gyur te khong la 'khon 'dzin chen po byas/ skabs der dpon rigs khag gcig gi ru spyan bsal/ spyan bsal zer rgyal ba spyan ras gzigs kyi spyan la su mi bsal bar bsdad yod pa red ces zer/ yang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi yab bkra shis kyis 6 sde pa gzhung / sde pa gzhung zer yang nga gnyis pha bu gnyis red ces brjod pa red zer spyi tshogs thog skad cha de rigs ha cang khyab che bar gyur/ da dung gong sa mchog dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das rjes sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis gzim chung gi phyag lde khag bka' shag la 'bul lam zhus pa tsam las srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug dang bka' blon lhan rgyas kyi mdun du sngar bzhin dbang shed che ba dang lta ba mtho bas bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i khongs mi dang de min sku drag mi nyung ba zhig gis mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan stabs sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags la zhu len khrims gcod de bas byed bde ba byung /yang sgos lcags lug (1921)lor sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis grong drag dmag mi zer ba sku drag gi sras gzhung zhabs ma zhus pa dang / tshong pa che 'bring khag gi bu phrug de bzhin dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen gang legs yod pa bcas kyi bu phrug chig stong tsam bsdu bskong thog grong drag dmag sgar btsugs te rang nyid kyi drag dpung zhig tu brtsis kyang blos 'gol mthong chen bya yul de dag gis gzhan gyis ngan skul byas pa'i 'og go skabs de dang bstun nas nga tshor btsan shed byas te dmag khongs su bcug pa las dmag mi byed 'dod rtsa ba nas med lugs skor 'u thug snyan zhu phul stabs srid blon dang bka' shag gis grong drag dmag mi yongs rdzogs phyir slog byas te sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi rgyab rten dmag dpung rnams yongs su rtsa gtor btang / 145

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/de nas sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags dang / bla sman pa byams pa lags/ gnas chung sku rten blo bzang bsod nams bcas bod ljongs tshogs 'du chen mo'i sar bskongs te gong sa mchog la sman log phul ba sogs nag nyes de dag tshogs 'du'i sar ngos len zhu dgos zhes tshogs 'du'i gtso skyong pa drung rtsis kyis bshad kyang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis zhwa phud gus bkur tsam yang ma byas par gong sa mchog gi snyung gzhi'i skor srid blon dang bka' shag la snyan seng mi zhu ba de dag tā la'i bla ma sku ngo ma'i dgongs don yin lugs skor mang tsam zhus stabs tshogs zhugs ser skya dpon rigs mang po khong khro langs te 'phral du btson 'jug dang / lus steng khrims gcod bka' dpyad gtong dgos pa'i gros 'go bton/ de nas drung rtsis dang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus kyis 66de ring khyed kyis bod ljongs tshogs 'du chen mor gus bkur zhwa phud tsam mi byed pa'i thog ngos len sne gcig mi zhu ba'i gdeng tshod ji yod do nub bsam blo btang ste sang nyin tshogs 'dur ngos len kha gsal zhu dgos ①zhes brjod nas phyir slog btang sku/ bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags phyir log rjes da res tshogs 'dus nag med nyes 'gel gyis bzo lta sprod bzo che ba 'dug snyam ste me mda' zhig gra sgrig gis rang med mi med cig bzo dgos snyam yang khong gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yongs 'dzin phur lcog sprul sku byams pa thub bstan tshul khrims mchog gis 'jam bshad blo 'gugs gnang bas de don dang len zhus/ de nas slar yang bod ljongs tshogs 'du chen mo 'tshogs 'phral sku srung ru dpon cha pa sras dbang chen g.yu lhar ka dang dmag mi lding khag gcig khrid de thub bstan kun gsal①/ (bod kyi lorgyu rig gnasadapyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam bsgrigs〉deg12pa'i shog grangs1 par 146

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalatsabarazhed thubabastan 'jamadapalase shesadang gabragangagadabangagasungarabakyidus bas/'phel bros byol du mi song bar 'phral du tshogs 'du'i thog khrid yong dgos pa'i bka' phab pa bzhin ka dang ru dpon cha pa sras nas thub bstan kun 'phel tshogs 'du'i sar khrid yong stabs sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags che nyams yongs su shor te pus mo'i lha nga gnyis sa la btsugs te bsdad/skabs der tshogs 'du'i sar lus bsher btang ba ma zad/ drung rtsis nas 6 khyod kyis nag nyes rnams ngos len zhu dgos mizhes brjod 'phral sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyis phyag 'tshal bzhin rang skyon ngos len thog nor 'khrul nag nyes che yang / da phan gong sa skyabs mgon rin po cher zhabs zhu yun ring byas par dgongs te srog thog tu 'gro mi dgos pa'i re ba phyag yang yang 'tshal te zhus mthar 6 srog thog la 'gro dgos min khyed rang la rag lus yod mi ces zer bzhin dngos su 'dzin bzung thog btson srung ka dang dmag mi dang sbrags rtse pho brang gi shar chen lcog tu btson 'jug byas pa ma zad/ thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi yab bkra shis dang spun nye 'ga' zhig gis rnam kun ltag shed ngoms te dbang shugs ha cang che bas pha bkra shes nor gling nas 'dzin bzung gis snang rtse shag tu bcug thog nang gzhis snye mo khul la sgo the'u rgyag par rtse drung ngag dbang bsam gtan sogs btang / de bzhin spun nye ser byes phyag mdzod grwa chung dang / zhol las khungs gnyer chung ngag dbang sogs 'dzin bzung gis zhol las khungs su btson 'jug byas thog nang gzhis tshang mar sgo the'u brgyab/ de bzhin bla sman pa byams pa lags dang gnas chung sku rten blo bzang bsod nams gnyis kyang tshogs 'du'i sar zhu ba len thog btson 'jug byas/de nas bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa nas gong gsal mi sna rnams la nyes chad khrims gcod byed phyogs skor gros sol gzab nan byas pa dang 'brel bka' shag brgyud srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang stu/ la

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i sgradabyangs/'char phul phyag rtags yong ba zhus par/ sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags kong po rtse la sgang rdzong du rgyang 'bud gtong rgyu dang / khong gi pha bkra shes snye mo rdzong la rtsis sprod thog nang mi khyim rgyud dang bcas pa'i kha dbang gzhung bzhes gtong rgyu/ de bzhin bla sman pa byams pa lags kyi kha dbang gzhung bzhes thog dwags po rgya tsha rdzong du rgyang 'bud gtong rgyu/ gnas chung sku rten blo bzang bsod nams 'bras spungs blo gsal gling la rtsis spod bya rgyu bcas kyi bka' dpyad btang ba ltar lo de ga'i zla 12tshes 29nyin dgu gtor te dgon sde khag nas gtor rgyag dang / khyim tshang tshang mas dgu gtor glud rdzong byed pa'i nyin der thub bstan kun 'phel lags rtse shar chen lcog btson khang nas bton te dpon rigs ser skya gnyis dang dmag mi bcu'i lta srung 'og lha sa'i khrom gzhung brgyud khrid yong ba dang / khong gi pha bkra shes snang rtse shag gi btson khang nas bton te lha sa'i khrom gzhung brgyud khrid yong ste dusagacig tu rgyang 'bud gtong ba sogs gang sdug gang ngan byas/ de rjes thubabastan kun 'phel lags kong po rtse la sgang rdzong nas tshug yul brgyud rgya gar du bros pa dang / de nas rgya gar bas khong la dogs pa chen po byas te/'dzin bzung btson 'jug byed rtsis byas kyang skabs de'i rgya gar du bca' sdodago min tang srid gzhung gi gzhung tshab che mo ba'i rogs ram 'og rgyal sa nan cing du bros byol phebs pa dang / 'tsho bar dka' ngal ha cang chen po 'phrad/de bzhin skabs der srid blon las rogs su 'os skor dbang 'dzin dpon rigs shog kha so so'i dbar rtsod gleng ha cang chen po byung zhing / bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i thog se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po las sne tshos mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur ngang 6 bod chos ldan gyi zhing khams khyad du 'phags pa rdokā lugs gnyis kyi chab srid chos bzhin bskyang dgos na dad gus zhu yul

le'uganyisapa/rgyalatshabarwazheng thubabastan 'aposadabagayoshethadang gabragangagadabangaganarab/dugabagazhig dgos gal che bas bla sprul zhig srid blon las rogs su bsko dgos 7zhes brjod kyang / 4lcang can sras bsod nams rgyal pos srid blon phyag rogs bla sprul bsko rgyu en chung snabs tshir gcig khri steng du bzhag de'i gsham phyag mdzod dza sag sna thag 'bo gang tsam 'then mkhan chab srid kyi nyams myong rtsa ba nas med pa zhig la bskos na mi 'grig ཿzer/ rtse skor rtse drung tshang mas se 'bras dga' gsum gyi gros 'gor yongs su mos mthun byas te bla sprul zhig srid blon las rogs su bsko dgos pa'i lta ba mtha' 'khyongs byas/ yang dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang byug la ma 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis 6rgyal ba'i sku tsha song tsang byin rlabs che ba tsam las de min gyi dge mtshan che ba gang yang mi 'dug ces brjod/ dus der tshogs 'du'i thog rtsod gleng shugs che byung ste/ mgron gnyer che mo ba bstan 'dzin chos 'phel gyi skul slong 'og rtse drung rnams tshogs 'du nas phyir 'then gyis tshogs 'du zur du 'tshogs te srid blon las rogs bla sprul zhig dgos pa'i dge mtshan gnas lugs mang tsam brjod/ dus mtshungs shod drung bon shod tshe brtan dbang rgyal sogs drung 'khor khag gcig gis kyang rtse drung dang se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po dang 'thus mi'i phyogs su langs stabs rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes srid blon las rogs su bsko gzhag gnang bzo che bar brten rwa sgreng phyogs gtogs kyi rgan rgan gras shes ldan dad gus can gyi dpon rigs dang zhabs 'bring mang pos 6 srid blon las rogs bsko gzhag gnang rigs byung tshe khyed kyis rtsa ba nas zhal bzhes gnang rgyu med/ de snga bstan gling de mo ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas mchog dang / rwa sgrong sku thog gong ma ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal ① bodakyi lha sarigaganasadapyadagazhi'i cha bdamasabasgrig 〉deg1 pa'i shogagrang 711)sag

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/mtshan sogs srid skyong gnang skabs nag med nyes 'dogs kyis do phog gyong gun chen po phog pa'i lo rgyus bslab bya de tshor dgongs bzhes gzab nan gnang dgos ’ zhes zhus/ de bzhin dpon rigs la las 6 sde pa gzhung gi sku drag de tshor ngo tsha khrel gzhung rtsa ba nas med ces zer/ lhag par du rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyi yab phun tshogs dgra 'dul gyis kyang /srid skyong gi thugs 'gan rtsa ba nas ma bzhes rogs gnang mi zhes re ba skyabs 'jug yang yang zhus pa bcas la brten rwa sgreng rin po ches srid blon las rogs lam seng mi gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / 'on kyang srid tshab bla sprul zhig bsko rgyu ni ldog thabs med pa'i dmangs kyi re 'dun zhig tu gyur/de rjes srid blon las rogs su 'os gtso bo rnams zan brtag 'bul rgyu'i thag gcod gtan 'khel byas/gnyis pa/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rgyal tshab kyi gser khrir 'khod pa/bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas bsdus kyis tshig tho phul nas rgyal tshab su 'os zan brtag bsgril rgyu'i 'os su rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes dang / dga' ldan khri pa mi nyag a mi ye shes dbang ldan/ phur lcog sprul sku byams pa thub bstan tshul khrims gsum su bzang ba yod min mtshan shog bris te rtse po ta la'i rten gtso 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra'i spyan sngar mchod sprin gzab rgyas bshams pa dang 'brel srid blon glang mdun dang / bka' blon rnam pa/spyi khyab mkhan po/ drung yig che mo ba/ rtsis dpon/ gdan sa se 'bras da/dī /sum gyi mkhan 'thus bcas lhan 'dzoms thog dga' ldan khri zur

le'uganyisapa/ rgyal tshabar nga thubabastan 'jamadapalazhe shesadangastagazagangagadabangagag ngarab naphabagabyams pa chos grags mchog nas thugs smon gnang bzhin zan brtag ba)tshosabs rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes bzang zhes thon/ skabs der rtswasgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rwa sgreng dge 'phel gling du bzhugs mus yin stabs bod rdzongs tshogs 'dus rwa sgreng rin po ches rgyal tshab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes gnang yong ba zhu ba'i pho nya mngags pa ma zad/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la snyan sgron chog mchan zhu yig kyang phul/ dus der rwa sgreng mchog gis kyang lha bla ma'i lung bstan dang bod ljongs ser skya dpon rigs mang tshogs kyi 'dun par gzhigs nas lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu'i zhal bzhes mi gnang mthu med byung ba bzhin rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing khyi (1924)lo'i zla 1tshes 10nyin gza' skar 'byung 'phrod mchog tu dge ba'i nyin rgyal tshab kyi gser khrir mnga' gsol ba dang / dus mtshungs srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug gis sngar mus bzhin srid blon gyi 'gan bzhes gnang rgyu'i re ba zhus pa bzhin rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis srid blon glang mdun dang lhan sbrel thog lo lnga tsam ring lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan yongs su bzhes/dus der rgyal tshab rwa sgreng sogs kyis dmigs bsal tshogs 'du'i thog gong sa bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku gdung lha khang dang rten rnams bzheng phyogs skor tshogs zhugs 'thus mi yongs kyis mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur thog rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho ni bod dmangs skye 'gro kun la bka' drin lhag par che bas gser gdung khyad du 'phags pa zhig bzheng dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ltar/ gser gdung gsar bzheng legs sgrub yong ched do dam par bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang chen dang / mkhan drung ram pa ba/ rtsis dpon khro dga' ba/ de bzhin las bya 'ga' zhig bcas bsko gzhag bstsal ba dang 'brel gser gdung lha khang dang gser gdung bzheng yul gang dga'1 //ga

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/dpyad gra sgrig legs par mdzad de rtse pho brang dmar po'i nub rgyud du gser gdung lha khang gi ar las dang gser gdung las grwa dus gcig tu 'go tshugs te rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i gser sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig las sku tshad rgyug mtho lnga yis mtho ba dang / bzo bkod khyad du 'phags pa/ rin bral phra rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i gser gdung dge legs 'dod 'jo bzheng 'go tshugs pa dang / phyogs mtshungs dad ldan skye bo pho mo kun gyis mchod 'bul dang bsnyen bkur zhu bde ba'i ched du gong sa mchog gi sku 'dra byin can lnga bzhengs te gdung khang dge legs 'dod 'jo dang / rtse po ta la/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang / zhol par khang / nor bu gling kha bcas la bzhugs su gsol rgyu'i gtan 'khel mdzad/ de bzhin rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mthun lam la shugs snon dang / go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnasasrid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba 'thus sgo tshang du gtong ba'i thad phyag las mang po gnang ba ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid gdan zhu gnang rgyu'i thad la'ang phyag las rgya che mdzad pa bcas la brten btsan dga' sho /bas 'khon 'dzin bcangs nas rwa sgreng gi srid dbang mgo rting bslag rgyu'i lkog g.yo bshams/gsum pa/ lung shar rdo rje che rgyal sogs la nyes chad phog pa/dus der rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal ni dbang shugs ha cang che ba zhig yin pas slad phyin bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo sgyur thub pa'i ched du sdonā 'gyur byed pa'i gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs shig btsugs te phyi rgyar

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalatsabarwa nga thubabastan 'jamadapalayeshesadang gabragangagadabangagatsorabakyis rnabagabarjod mkhas tshig 'jam gyis 6 skyid phyogs kun mthun nam bstan pa rgyas pa 7zhes 'bod/ don du sgrig 'dzugs de'i lte ba'i khongs mi mang che ba ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi pha shul bu 'dzin byed mkhan dang ham sems can gyi shod drung khag gcig yin zhing / kho pa tsho'i lkog gshom der ser skya dpon rigs mang che ba'i rgyab skyor thob pa'i chen du kho pa tsho'i khongs mi gtso gras phyag dpe do dam pa rtse drung thub bstan dge ldan (ming gzhan dkar me khang gi kong phrug zer )gyis rtse skor gyi rtse drung nang gling phyogs mang po bzos pa ste 6 de snga'i lung bstan zhig nang mchod rten mgo med 'ong zer ba yod pas da lta rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i gser gdung gsar bzheng gnang mus mjug 'khyongs rgyur gegs bar chen po yong nyen yod pa red/ der brten rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid 'khrul bral gdan zhu thub pa dang /bstanasrid la nyams chag med par yar rgyas gnas thabs sogs kyi ched nga rang tsho gzhung gi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba yin stabs zhen skul zhu 'os pa yin 0tshul sogs kyi ngan skul byas par brten rtse skor gyi rtse drung mang che bas lkog g.yo ngan byus kyi gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs yod pa rtsa ba nas ma shes par rtse drung thub bstan dge ldan gyi skul slong 'og rtse drung brgyad cu lhag tsam gyis nang mol gan rgya der ming rtags bkod pa red/ 'on kyang de rjes 6 rtse drung 'tshog sar shod drung bsher dpang rgyal mkhar nang pa dang / shod drung sman ri ba/ shod drung brag mthon pa/ de min gcig bcas yong ste sman ri bas nga tsho shod skor ni skyes tsam nas sa bzang gdan btings/ khang bzang mgo la gyon te 'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal med pas bstan srid 'di tsam nyag thug dus nga tshos rkang len byed dgos kyang rtse skor nas gnang ba thugs rje che/ nga tsho shod ① bod kyi rigaganasal spodapyad gzhi'i cha bdam bsgrigs〉deg pa'i shog grangs6 sdu/)sal/

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/skor mi nyi shu rtsa gsum yod/ de ring ming zhu gi min/ nga tsho bzhi spyi 'thus su bcar ba yin/ srid gzhung gis go gnas bsko 'then drang po rtsa ba nas med pas rtswa gnyer dang / rtsam bzhes/ shing gnyer bcas gsum gyong gun yod pa shod skor pha gzhis yod pa'i kha gtad rtse drung grwa rkyang nas gnang mus dang /chab srid kyi dbang cha 'dzin mkhan bka' blon bzhi'i khongs su rtse skor gcig las med pa sogs drang po min pa dngos ra gsal 'phrod yod pas rtse skor la bka' blon bla ma gcig 'phar du phul te rtse shod bka' blon gnyis re gnang rgyu/da lta bka' shag nang bka' blon khri smon gyi dbang shugs su phyin te gang ci'i thad drang po drang bzhag rtsa ba nas med milugs skad cha mang po bshad mi①pa red/ skad cha 'di dag la rtse skor gyi rtse drung mang po yid ma rangs par gyur te smyo bka' blon khri smon gyis drang po ma byas pa'i skor nga tshor rtsa ba nas shod rgyu med/ gal srid bka' blon khri smon gyis drang po ma gnang ba'i dbang du btang na'ang / thag gcod chog mchan rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyis gnang bas dgongs 'gal yong nges red ces brjod/ dus der rtse skor gyi rtse drung khag gcig gis kho pa tsho'i lkog g.yo rim bzhin gsal rtogs thub ste sgrig 'dzugs de nas phyir 'then byas/ nyin zhig 6 skyid phyogs kun mthun ’ zhes pa'i gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs de'i lte ba'i khongs mi rnams lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi gtso skyong thog lkog tu tshogs 'du 'tshogs te 6 bod du da yod lam lugs bsgyur bcos thog sgrid mo khe rin si'i (dbyin skad de dmangs gtso zhes pa'i don yin )lam lugs lag len bstar dgos ’ zhes brjod skabs tshogs zhugs dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis tha snyad de'i go don gang yin skad cha dris par lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyis dbyin ji'i lam lugs /shā4 bod kyi rigaganasal sadapyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdamasabasgrigs〉deg pa'i shog grangs62par gsal/

le'uganyisapa/ rgyal tshabarwa nga thubabastan 'jamadapalas shesadabastagakhragangagadabangagasungarab/dus bas/la zer ba red ces 'grel bshad khungs ma dag cig brgyab stabs tshogs zhugs dpon rigs khag gcig gis zhe gangs can chos ldan zhing khams la dbyin ji'i lam lugs lag len bstar mi rung zhes brjod nas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ lhag par du rim bzhi ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas 6 tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs la mdun dpral ba bstan nas 'dzing dgos pa las/ rgyab lcang lo bstan nas bros rgyu med ces gsungs nas der mos mthun rtsa ba nas med ces gsungs pa ma zad/ gsang gros byas pa'i gnas tshul rnams bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang chen la gsang brda yang zhus/ khri smon gyis gnas tshul de thos 'phral rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes la gser snyan sgron te khong gnyis ka 'bras spungs su g.yol thabs gnang nas bzhugs/ de nas nyin shas song mtshams rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal shod 'gag tu bskongs te las zhabs cig gnas dbyung gis dpon chas zhwa gos lham gsum bshu skabs lung shar bas lham nang nas yi ge zhig bton te kha la zas pas shod mgron gzim gyis 'gram pa btsir nas 'don thabs ji ltar byas kyang bton mi thub par khyur min btang ba dang / lham ya gcig sngog bsher byed skabs mthu sngags 'khor lo'i steng 6 khri smon nor bu dbang chen nan mi zhes 'khod yod pa red ces yongs grags byas/ de nas lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal dang / ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma rtse shar chen lcog gi btson khang du btson bcug byas pa ma zad/ lcang can bsod nams rgyal po dang / rgyal mkhar nang pa/sman ri ba/ brag mthon pa/ cha pa sras dbang chen g.yu lha/ rtse drung mkhyen rab mthar phyin/ kong phrug thub bstan dge ldan sogs kyang 'dzin bzung thog btson 'jug byas/ skabs der drung yig che mo ba mkhyen rab mthar phyin dang / rtsis dpon klu khang ba tshe dbang rab brtan/ dmag spyi mkhanā snang

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/bstan pa 'jam dbyangs/ sku srung mda' dpon snang dkar dbang phyug mthar phyin bcas gyod don zhib bsher par bsko gzhag thog lung shar la 'dri rtsad zhu ba thengs mang len kyang ngos len rtsa ba nas ma zhus stabs ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas lung shar sogs kyis 66skyid phyogs kun mthun mi zhes pa'i gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi phyi rgyar chab srid legs bcos bya rgyu zhes brjod mkhas tsam las don du bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang chen sogs mgo ting bslogs te bod kyi srid dbang lung shar sogs kyis len rgyu'i nang gan yod lugs skor ther 'don byas pas lung shar ba phrag pa glod bzhin mig gnyis sa la lta ba dang / smra ba'i lce chad pa lta bur gyur te nag nyes rnams ngos len ma zhu rang zhu thug de nas lung shar don gnad kyi zhib gcod pa bzhi sbrel gyis 'charagazhi phul bar byed gte gtso bo lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi mig 'bras gnyis ka 'don rgyu zhes 'khod yod na'ang rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes yod stabs ra mi'i dbang po yan lag gcod breg byed pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dang yongs su 'gal bas srid blon gleng mdun mchog gis thag gcod bka' mchan yong ba zhu mi zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid blon glang mdun gyis 'char gzhi der yongs su mos mthun chog mchan gnang ste lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi mig 'bras gnyis ka bton nas zhol btson khang du tshe btson du bcug lcang can bsod nams rgyal po dang / cha pa sras dbang chen g.yu lha/rgyal mkhar nang pa/ sman ri ba/ brag mthon pa/ mkhyen rab mthar phyin/kong phug thub bstan dge ldan bcas byed gte rnams mtha' khul rdzong gzhis khag so sor rgyang 'bud btang / skabs der lcang can bsod nams rgyal po kong po rtse la sgang du rgyang 'bud btang / de rjes khong dang 'dra ba rgyang 'bud btang ba'i sku drag 'ga' zhig bka' dpyad dgongs 'khrol gyis lha sar phyir log1 zlog gzhung zhabs bskyar zhu chog pa byung bas khong gis kyang bka' shag la

le'uganyisaspa/ rgyalatshabarwazheng thubabastan 'jamadabalayeshesposastagazagangagadabangagatsorab/dusposagabade sdug snyan zhu phul nas phyir log chog pa zhus kyang bka' shag gis mos mthun rtsa ba nas byas med/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni khong ni don rkyen de'i nang gi byed gte gtso bo'i gras shig yin pa tsam ma zad/ rnam kun ser skya dpon rigs gzhan la mthun lam zhan pa dang / mang tshogs kyi khrod du'ang bag chags ngan tsam yod pas red/ skabs der 6 lcang can rgyal po'i pho brang /dkrog dkrog gze ma ra mgo mgo la tog yod ma gtogs/ tog med thar sa ma red ces pa'i dmangs gzhas gang sar khyab pa de'i thog nas mang tshogs khag gcig gis khong la 'khon 'dzin chen po byed pa gsal po mthong thub/desan lcang can gung bya thabs dben pa'i gnas su lhungs te gnas skor du 'grobar kha g.yar nas 'brug yul brgyud rgya gar du bros byol phebs te yun ring bzhugs/ de bzhin lha klu sras tshe dbang rdo rje dang dga' byang bstan pa gnyis las zhabs gnas dbyung btang ba dang / ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs khongs kyi gtso gras shig yin rung lung shar sogs byed gte rnams ther 'don byas stabs gu yangs su bzhag pa red/yig tshang las khungs kyis rtse drung kong phrug thub bstan dge ldan gyi g.yo sgyu'i mgo skor 'og tshud nas gan rgyar ming rtags 'gon mkhan rtse drung brgyad cu lhag tsam yod pa de dag la zhu ba blangs pa tsam las dbye 'byed rtsa zhib ma gnang bar yang bzos kyis mkhan chung so sor nyes chad gser srang bzhi re (gser srang rer dngul srang dgu dang zho lnga )dang / rtse mgron dang / shod mgron/ las tshan pa bcas so sor nyes chad gser srang do re/ rtse drung dkyus mar nyes chad gser srang gang re bcas gtong rgyu'i thag gcod gnang /dus der thub bstan kun 'phel lags su nyes chad chen po phog ste kong po rtse la sgang du rgyang 'bud btang ba dang kha dbang gzhung bzhes btang ba sogs ya nga ba'i gnas tshul de spom mda' stobs rgyal gyis go thos byung 5snyingan

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangs/khong ni rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos smar khams khul gyi yul dmag gi 'go 'dzin ru dpon la bsko gzhag gnang ba zhig red/ ru dpon spom mda' stobs rgyal ni gong sa mchog dang sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags su lhag bsam zol med gnang mkhan zhig yin stabs gong sa mchog sku gshegs 'phral sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags su nyes chad 'di lta bu phog par yid ma rangs par shing khyi (1924)lo'i zla 10par khong gis yul dmag rnams khrid de smar khams sa srung mda' dpon nor rgyas nang pa'i dmag sgar la mtshan gtib btang / skabs der mda' dpon ngo ma bzhugs med pa dang /brgya dpon dang dmag mi 'ga' zhig la rmas skyon phog me phyogs dang / me mda' rdzas mdel/ sger gyi rgyu dngos bcas pa mang po 'phrog bcom byas pa ma zad/ khams phyogs tshang ma bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi chab 'bangs su sdod mi dgos par sgor langs byed dgos pa'i skul slong yang byas/ 'on kyang kho pa tshor yid mthun rgyab skyor byed mkhan ma byung khar/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang /srid blon glang mdun/ bka' shag bcas kyi bka' bkod ltar mdo spyi bka' tshab bkas mthong pa 'gyur med rgya ma tshos drag gnon dmag dpung 'phral rdzongs gnang / spom mda' stobs rgyari gyi yul dmag rnams la dpa' rtsal gang tsam yod zer yang go lag sogs gang ci'i thad bod dmag dang 'gran thabs med pas spom mda' stobs rgyal dang yul dmag khag gcig zi khron zhing chen khongs 'ba' phyogs su bros byol du phyin/ yul dmag khag gcig bod dmag gis gson por bzung ste rkang pa'i nywa khug gi rtsa chen bcad/ la la bsad rmas btang / bu rgan pa spom mda' rab dga' don rkyen de dang 'brel ba che bas/ bod dmag btang ste lha sar yod pa'i spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel gyi sdod shag gi mtha' bskor nas 'dzin bzung byed nye'i skabs de/ /sna mda' blo bzang yar 'phel ni spyang sgrung 'dzoms shing rnam kun thob

le'uganyisapa/ rgyal tshabarwa)kho thubabastan 'jamadapalazhe shesadang gabragangagadabangagasungarabakyidu skabs/khungs gdan sa'i grwa rigs las bya rnams dang mthun lam che bas grwa rigs dang spun nye tshos bka' shag tu spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel ni thengs 'di'i don rkyen dang 'brel ba rtsa ba nas med lugs dag 'bud zhus pa dang /spun nye'i byas nyes la gzhigs te sa gnas srid gzhung gi go mtshon dang /sger gyi rgyu dngos 'phrog bcom byas rigs rnams skyin tshab chad lus med pa 'bul rgyu'i khas len zhus pa ma zad/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang / srid blon glang mdun/ bka' shag sogs la'ang dgongs sel zhus/ des na bka' shag gis pha spom mda' nyi ma rgyal po dang / bu nyi ma rgyal mtshan gnyis ka sa gnas srid gzhung la lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang / spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phelayang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi tshong don thad snga phyir zhabs zhu lan mang zhus pa sogs la brten rtsad zhib med par nyes pa yang bzos kyis gzhung sger rgyu dngos skyin tshab sprad 'thus chog pa'i thag gcod gnang /bzhi pa/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis hong rma'o sung dmigs bsal bod du gtong gnang mdzad pa/shing khyi (1924)lo'i zla 4par/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis hong rma'o sung bod du gtong gnang mdzad/ de'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs mchod sprin 'bul ba'i go skabs de dang bstun nas go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnasasrid zhung dbar gyi 'brel ba 'thus sgo tshang du btang ste phyi rgyal btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod kyi nang srid kha lo sgyur ba'i spyod ngan bkag 'ahā/ bya

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/rgyu de /ḍing/ rma'o sung sku 'khor dang bcas pa lha sar 'byor rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sne len dang bsu ba gzab rgyas zhus/ de nas sngar srol ltar goyin tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab rnams lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / rgya stag ra mo che/ se 'bras dga' gsum sogs la mchod 'bul gnang bar phebs/ de rjes rtse pho brang chen po po ta lar mdzad sgo rgya che tshugs te rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshor lha rgyal skyong bstan rgyas kun byams byang chub slob dpon chen po ’ zhes pa'i rjes snon cho lo dang / g.yang ṭi'i 'ja' sa dam kha bcas gnang ba ma zad/ rgyal ba'i gser gdung gi zhal 'debs kyang gang legs 'bul gnang mdzad/ hong rma'o sung dang las rogs dpon rigs rnams lha sar zla gsum tsam bzhugs te rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang / srid blon/ bka' shag sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa dang rgya bod 'brel ba dam gtsang yong ba dang / go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod kyi las don la shugs snon rgyag phyogs thad phan tshun bka' mol thengs mang gnang / gzhan yang go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bka' mngags ltar/ lha sar bca' sdod bod sog u yon lhan khang gi don gcod khang dngos su btsugs te go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi dpon rigs khagagacig lha sar bca' bzhugs gnang rgyu dang / skyid 'dod slob grwa dang /'grim 'grul pu'u khongs kyi sbrag tar khang / sman khang / gnam gshes babs tshugs sogs dngos su 'dzugs thub pa byung bas rgya bod mthun lam la shugs snon thebs thub pa byung ba red/ skabs der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brang pa tshos thabs brgya byus stong gi sgo nas go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rnams bod du yong bar bkag 'gog byas/'o/ // kho pa tsho'i dmigs yul de sgrub mi thub stabs srid sgyur gyi bya thabs

le'uganyis/ rgyalarmenano thubabs 'asarabalakhoshegasastabakharabangagasarab:dugasagal brten nas btsan rgol rgyal gces shog kha'i stobs shugs rtsa gtor gtong ba'i lkog gshom rab dang rim pa spel/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes kyis rgyal gces yar thon gyi dar cha mthon por bsgrengs te krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel bar shugs snon dang / rgya bod mi rigs gyi mthun lam la phan pa'i phyag las mang po gnang ba ste/ ri 'gog dmag 'khrug 'go tshugs ma thag tu paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dang lhan du go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur dang rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan pa dang /lhag par du bod rigs ser skya mang tshogs kyi khrod du ri 'gog rgyal skyob kyi dril bsgrags slob gso rgya che spel/ dus mtshungs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis pho nya mngags te paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa bod du 'phral mar phyir log mdzad rgyu'i re ba bton/ des na btsan dga' shog khas khong la 'khon 'dzin de bas che ba byas te g.yo thabs la brten nas srid dbang 'phrog rgyu'i lkog g.yo chen po zhig bshams pa red/dus der rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes dang srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug dbar la'ang gzhung sger phyag las mang po'i bad phan tshun dgongs pa ma mthun pa'i 'gal rkyen byung ste rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis sngar srol ltar rgyal tshab na rim la las 'brel med cing /bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis dgos gal med stabs rgyal tshab las gnas dgongs zhu yong ba'i re ba 'don gnang mdzad/ 'on kyang bka' shag dang /drung rtsis/ se 'bras dga' gsum kyi 'thus mi bcas kyis rwa sgreng mchog nas mu mthun lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu'i re ba yang yang zhu skabs sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu phyogs skor sogs phyag las mang po'i thad srid blon glang mdun gyis 'grig min gnas tshul mang po byung1 sdu/sa

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/gsungs pas tshogs 'thus gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mis srid blon glang mdun gyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog la brtsi med byas tshul nyes pa mang po bgrangs nas srid blon glang mdun la nyes chad gtong rgyu'i bsam 'char dang gros 'go mang tsam bton/ tshogs 'thus byings nas srid blon glang mdun la dmigs bsal nyes pa de yin med pa dang / rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku tshar brten srid blon zur pa'i go gnas dang /gsol phogs rang 'jags 'bul rgyu'i skor bka' shag tu tshig tho spyi tham bzhi sbyar phul bas bka' blon rnams srid blon glang mdun sar bcar te thabs mkhas kyis tshogs 'du'i tshig tho rnams snyan sgron gyis srid 'gan 'jog gnang dgos pa'i blang bya bton pas de don kur kor rtsa ba nas med par yongs su zhal bzhes gnang ba red/lnga pa/ stag brag shog khas g.yo thabs la brten nas srid dbang blangs pa/gong du smos pa ltar/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes ni rgyal gces chos gces kyi bla ma skyes chen dam pa zhig yin stabs a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brang pa tshos g.yo thabs la brten nas srid dbang 'phrog rgyu'i lkog g.yo zhig bshams pa ste/ lcags 'brug (1940)lor/ nyon zhig 6 lha sar sus sbyar med pa'i yig skyur zhig thon pa'i nang don gtso bor rwa sgreng la sdom pa med pas rgyal ba rin po cher chos lugs kyi bslab sdom 'bul bzhes sogs byas na mi 'grig mi①ces bkod de /shā2 bod kyi rigaganas rgyu dpyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdam bsgrigs〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs paragasal

le'uganyisaspa/ rgyal tshan nga thubabastan 'jamadapalaye shesadangastagabragangagadabangagatsorab nagasag gang sar gleng phyogs mang tsam bzos/ der brten rgyal tshab rwasgreng kyi dgongs par chu rta (1942)lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi par rab byung gi sdom pa 'bul bzhes gnang rgyu'i dus tshod zin par lo gcig lhag tsam las med stabs sngon tshud nas dgongs zhu g.yol thabs ma byas na chos srid gnyisakar phan thogs med pa'i klan ka yong nges red dgongs pa las de ni stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog kha'i 'char gzhi yod pa'i lkog gshom zhig yin pa rtsa ba nas ma mkhyen pa red/ der brten rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis 'phan po seng ge sgang du sdod pa'i khams rigs seng ge bla ma zer ba der rnam kun cha 'jog dang yid ches chen po gnang gi yod pas kho pa lha sar rwa sgreng bla brang gi sdod khang du ched 'bod kyis 6 rgyal tshab rang 'jags gnang dang /dgongs zhu gnang ba gang bzang pra phab gnang ba'i pra lung du rgyal ba rin po che'i sku sbyar yang 'tshub lhong che bas rgyal tshab dgongs zhu gnang ste rkyen sel bsnyen sgrub gnang na bzang ba 'dug mi ①ces bshad/ gong gsal gnas tshul de'i thog nas seng ge bla ma zer ba de ni mi bden rdzun sgrig byed mkhan zhig yin pa dang / stag brag shog khas kho pa bsru brid dang g.yo sgyu'i sbyor bar brten nas srid dbang 'phrog rtsis byed pa ni gsal por mthong thub/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng ni mes rgyal la sha zhen che ba dang chos phyogs mkhyen rgya ha cang che ba zhig yin rung chab srid 'thab rtsod kyi myong bya dman pa dang / lhag don seng ge bla ma'i g.yo gtam la thugs blos rjen 'gel gnang bar brten nor 'khrul gyi sgo nas rgyal tshab dgongs pa zhu 'dod 'gog thabs med pa zhig byung ba red/skabs der rgyal tshab gsar pa bsko phyogs skor rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang / dza zur 'jam dbyang bde legs/ snang gnas bla ma thub ① bod gyi rig gnasalo rgyasadapyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdamasabasgrigs〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs7pa/tā/la/

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/bstan byams pa skal bzang / mkhar rdo sprul sku skal bzang thub bstan/gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan sogs dang nang sol bka' bsdur gnang bas smyung gnas bla ma dang mkhar rdo sprul sku gnyis kyis kun bde gling ho thog thu sogs rgyal sprul khag dang / phur lcog yongs 'dzin su la bskos kyang skabs mtshams su rgyal tshab kyi dbang cha tshur 'bul dka' bas stag brag rin po che rgyal tshab tu bsko gzhag mdzad na 'os shing 'tshams pa zhig red/ khong ni rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / thugs snang dkar ba/dgungayo drug cu re dgur phebs pa bcas yin stabs khong srid skyong la bsko gzhag gnang na thugs blos rjen 'gol chog pa dang / sku'i 'gal rkyen sel rjes srid dbang tshur bzhes bde ba yong tshul sogs nor 'khrul gyi bsam 'char mang tsam bshad pa dang / bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang bka' blon bon shod tshe brtan rdo rjes kyang gong gsal bzhin nor 'khrul gyi bsam 'char mang tsam zhus/ 'on kyang skabs der gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan dang / bka' gung phun khang bkra shes rdo rje/ rtsis dpon ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma bcas kyis 6 rgyal tshab dgongs zhu ma gnang bar da mur rang 'jags gnang na legs lam yong tshul dang / dbang dang bral na thams cad pham nyes yong tshul/ sku gyur 'tshub lhong yod tshe rkyen sel zlog rim gnang na legs 7zhes gnas lugs ji ltar zhus kyang gsan 'jog rtsa ba nas mi gnang zhing / lhag par du gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan gyis 6 stag brag rin po che zer ba'i bla ma de yang ngas bltas na thugs sems gnag mdog kha po zhig 'dug pas phyin chad srid dbang rang 'jags 'bul bzhes zerab khag po red ces zhus pa de la rwa sgreng rin po ches khyod nga'i rtsa ba'i bla 164

le'uganyisab/ rgyal brwazhed thubabastan 'jamadasprulazhe she dngasnagabragangagadabangagasungarabakyisabaskabagamar kha btang ba de ni dam nyams red ces bka' bkyon yang gnang ba red/ ①skabs der rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes mchog gis btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brang pas g.yo thabs spel bar tshor snang rtsa ba nas ma byung ba ma zad/ da dung stag brag ngag dbang gsung rabasred skyong la bsko gzhag gnang rgyu'i skor nang sol gnang bas stag brag shog kha'i chab srid kyi dmigs yul yongs su grub/ stag brag gis 66lo gnyis gsum tsam song mtshams srid skyong mdzad 'khur rwa sgreng rin po ches slar bzhes gnang na de'i ring rang ngos nas hur thag zhus chog pa dang / ngos nas rwa sgreng rin po che'i bka' drin rjes dran gyis mdzad pa'i 'phro skyong zhu rgyu/rwasgreng bla brang gi ltos bcas la phan 'gyur rogs ram gang zab zhus chog ’zer ba sogs kyi g.yo sgyu'i gtam snyan mang tsam zhus/ dus der rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gis 6 ngas bsgrub rgyu'i las ka 'phro can gcig ni rtsis dpon ka shod par bka' blon bsko rgyu khas len zin pas bka' blon 'pho 'gyur snga ba su byung yang de'i las tshab tu rtsis dpon ka shod pa chos rgyal nyi ma bsko gnang yod pa zhu 7zhes gsungs pa dang / khyung ram gyi gyod gzhi khra slog mi chog pa'i re ba 'don gnang mdzad pa bcas la stag brag gis khas yongs su blangs/ dus mtshungs bka' blon rnams dang / drung rtsis/ gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/tshogs 'thus gnad yod khag la rwa stag bla brang gnyis nang sol gnang ba dang bstun nas srid skyong nang bshug gtong ba'i las don de bgegs rkyen bar chad med par legs sgrub yong ba'i nang gsed gnang ba dang / lhag par du stag brag gi phyag mdzod bstan pa mthar phyin gyis rtsis dpon ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma'i sar bcar nas yokhyed la bka' blon bsko gzhag gnang rgyu de stag brag ① bod kyi lorgya rigaganasadapyadagazhi'i cha bdam bsgrigs〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs pa/tā/la/

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/rin po che yis yongs su zhal bzhes gnang bas srid skyong dang yongs 'dzin gsar bsko gnang rgyu'i thad sku ngo rtsis dpon mchog gis tshogs 'du'i sar 'khrog langs 'gal rkyen mi yong ba'i rogs ram skyabs 'jug ci nas yod pa zhu mi zhes zhus pas rtsis dpon ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas de don bzhin zhabs zhu gang thub nges par zhus chog ces khas len gnang ba ma zad/ stag brag rin po cher bstod pa'i bka' mol yang mang tsam gsungs/de nas lcags 'brug (1940)lo'i lo smad tsam la rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes mchog gis bka' shag la 66de sngon ngos nas rgyal tshab srid skyong gi las gnas dgongs zhu rim pa zhus kyang bka' blon rnam pas mtshon ser skya dpon rigs dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus kyi rgyal tshab rang 'jags byed dgos pa'i re ba 'don gnang mdzad pa ltar da bar 'bad brtson cher skyed kyis rgyal tshab kyi las 'gan khur te gong sa mchog gi yang srid rin po gdan zhu dang / dbu skyes gtsug phud/ dge bsnyen sdom bzhes/ gser khrir mnga' gsol/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba 'thus sgo tshang du btang ba sogs mdor na bod kyi bstan srid las don gang ci'i thad 'thus shor med par legs sgrub zhus yod/ 'on kyang da lam lha bla ma'i lung bstan dang phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen mang bas gnas skabs rgyal tshab las gnas dgongs zhu thog bsnyenasnrub zlog rim mi zhu thabs med la bka' shag gis de don bzhin bod ljongs tshogs 'dur bka' bsdur dgongs 'khrol ci nas yod pa zhu mizhes gsungs/de nas bka' shag gis tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa skong 'tshog thog drung rtsis rnams bka' shag tu ched 'bod kyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'a/sdu /pal ye shes kyis rgyal tshab dgongs pa zhus te tshab tu stag brag rin po

/le'uganyisapa/ rgyalarmar nga thubabastan 'jamadapalaye shesadabastagakhragangagadabangagatsorabasnyenagasagache bsko gzhag mdzad rgyu'i dgongs tshul ldog thabs med pa de tshogs 'du'i thog brgyud bsgrags mdzad/ tshogs 'dus gros sol nan tan byas mthar ra rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan mu mthud bzhes rgyur bka' shag gis gsol 'debs gnang bar zhal bzhes ma thob kyang /bod ljongs tshogs 'dus slar yang mu mthud bstan srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes dgos pa'i re 'dun mi zhu thabs med yin zhes gros thag bcad pa'i skor drung rtsis brgyad sbrel dang / gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/ de bzhin tshogs 'thus 'ga' zhig bcas lha sa rwa sgreng bla brang gi spro khang du ngo bcar zhus te rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes la maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang mjal dar phul te drung rtsis mkhan 'thus tshang mas gus phyag 'bul bzhin rgyal ba sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen pos rgyal srid chos srid dngos su ma bzhes bar rgyal tshab rin po ches lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes gnang yong ba'i re 'bod zhu ba yang yang phul yang rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gis gsan 'jog rtsa ba nas mi gnang bar de ni lha bla ma'i lung bstan yin tshul skor mang tsam gsungs/ de'i sang nyin bka' shag nas rtse pho brang chen po po ta lar tshogs 'du mu mthud 'tshogs te gros bsdur byed dgos zhes gsungs pa dang /de nyin rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog kyang rtse pho brang du phebs stabs bka' blon rnam pa dang / drung rtsis brgyad sbrel/ gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/ dza tha'i/tshogs 'thus mi nyung ba zhig bcas kyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gis mu mthud lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes dgos pa'i re 'bod ji ltar zhus kyang gsan 'jogs rtsa ba nyid nas ma gnang stabs tshogs 'thus tshang mas de ni rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gi dgongs pa 'gog thabs med pa zhig rang yin pas de don mos mthun mi zhu thabs med thog bka' shag dang / drung rtsis brgyad sbrel/spyikhyab mkhan po/ gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/ de min tshogs1 ༷ltos

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/bcas kyis rtse pho brang du stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab bzhugs yul du bcar te bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis stag brag la srid tshab 'gan bzhes gnang dgos pa'i snyan seng zhus par stag brag rin po ches 6 da cha nga lo na gas shing srid skyong gi 'gan dbang rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gi bka' bzhin lo ngo gnyis gsum ring gang 'khyol zhus chog pa dang / dus mtshams su srid skyong gi 'gan dbang yongs rdzogs rwa sgreng rang la phyir 'bul zhus chog cesagayo thabs kyis mi sgrub khas len byas/ dus der bod ljongs spyi tshogs kyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gi mdzad rjes gzengs su thon pa rnams tho bkod zhib phra mdzad thog da lam rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog gi sku'i gegs rkyen bar chad sel ba'i ched du gnas skabs srid 'gan dgongs zhu gnang ste rwa sgreng dgon du bsnyen sgrub tu phebs bzhugs gnang rgyu dang / srid skyong las tshab stag brag gis byas te lo gnyis gsum tsam song mtshams rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes mchog gis rgyal tshab rang 'jags gnang rgyu'i skor gsal zhing gsal ba sogs 'khod pa'i bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i tshig tho dam drug sbyar 'dra bzhi bzos nas rwa sgreng dang / stag brag so sor 'dra re dang / bka' shag la 'dra gcig tshogs 'dur 'dra gcig bcas 'bul nyar byas/de nas lcags sbrul (1941)lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin gnam lo gsar du bzhad pa'i skabs der stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab kyis srid skyong dang yongs 'dzin bgres pa'i gsar mjal zhus te lugs gnyis kyi 'gan dngos su bzhes thog stag brag lha sar bzhugs yul kun bzang pho brang du rgyal zur rwa sgreng sku 'khor dang bcas pa gdan drangs te gsol ston gzab rgyas bshams pa ma zad/ thugs rje legs 'bul gyi dngos po yang gang legs phul ba red/de nas yun ring ma song bar rgyal zur rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rwa rdo|8 dgon du phyir log mdzad skabs bka' blon rnam pa dang / gdan sa

le'uganyithab/rgyamatshabarwazhed thubabastana'ajamadabalayoshegadangastagabragangagadabangagatsorab/dus bgase 'bras dga' gsum gyi bla sprul/ gzhung zhabs ser skya/ bod dmag dmag sgar khag gi ru sgrig dang bcas mdor na srid skyong las thog ltar rgya che gzab rgyas kyi phebs skyel zhus pa red/ yin na yang bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la srid skyong stag brag la dbang cha thob ma thag rgyal zur rwa sgreng la phebs skyel tsam yang ma zhus stabs rwa sgreng bla brang gi dpon rigs gtso gras rnams 'gyod swāmasadang khong khro cig car du 'char bas rwa stag dbar gyi 'gal ba'i 'go sngags/rwa sgreng rgyal zur dgongs zhu gnang ste rwa sgreng dgon du lo shas bzhugs ring thog mar rwa stag gnyis nang mol gnang ba ltar/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'gangs che'i las don dang las tshan bsko phyogs sogs skor rgyal zur rwa sgreng la bka' 'dri dgongs skor zhu mi ched mngags btang / 'on kyang stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab lo na mtho ba dang chab srid kyi myong bya zhan par brten gser khrir 'khod nas yun ring ma song bar dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa tshos g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba mang tsam spel nas bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur stabs srid skyong stag brag kyang don dngos thog kho pa tsho'i lag cha lta bur gyur pa red/slor sgreng rin po ches rgyal tshab gnang ring bod rgya'i dbar gyi 'brel ba sngar las je dam du gtong gi yod pa red/ 'on kyang stag brag srid skyong byas rjes dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang dbyin ji dga' nyer sten mkhan mtho rim pa nyung shas nas btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og bod 'di rlabs chen mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral du btang thog btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i mi ser spel yul du bsgyur rgyu'i re ngan bcangs 77te mes gagal①/ (bod kyi lorgyu rig gnasadapyad gzhi'i cha bdam bsgrig 〉deg12pa'i shogagrangardo//par

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/bod kha bral gtong ba'i bya ba mang po spel ba ste/lcags sbrul (1941)lor ri 'gog dmag 'khrug langs nas ri pin gyis mtsho 'gram gru kha khag bkag 'doms byas stabs dbyin ji sogs mthun phyogs rgyal khab khag gis mes rgyal nang khul du dmag mkho'i yo chas rogs ram byas pa rnams rgya gar nas 'bar ma'i sa cha brgyud mes rgyal nang khul du dbor 'dren byed lam shor bas rgya gar dang / rang rgyal gnyis nas bod kyi rtsa yul brgyud dmag mkho'i yo chas dbor 'dren bya rgyu'i 'gro lam gsar bzo byas chog pa zhes lha sar bca' sdod rgya gar don gcod khang gi dza sag ra ye bha dur nor bu don grub dang lha sar bca' sdod go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi don gcod khang gi khung tsung gis bod sa gnas srid gzhung la gnas lugs ji ltar bshad kyang de don mos mthun ma byas par dbu tshugs mtha' bkag byas/ 'on kyang lo der a ri'i dmag don 'thab jus gsang 'phrin cus kyi trī sna bod du dmag don brtag zhib byed par yong chog pa'i mos mthun byas pa chu k+ta /(1942)lo'i zla 5tshes 22nyin khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas phyi rgyal las khungs btsugs te de'i 'go gtsor zur khang zur pa dza sag dbang chen tshe brtanasogs bsko gzhag byas pa ma zad/ phyi'i rgyal khag gi bod sdod don gcod khang dang / lha sar bca' sdod go min tang bod sog u yon lhan khang gi don gcod khang la slad phyin las don mtha' dag phyi rgyal las khungs brgyud de bka' shag la snyan sgron zhu dgos pa las thad gar bka' shag la 'brel gtugs byed mi chog pa'i brda khyab btang bas dbyin ji dang a ri'i las don mi snas 'phral mar phyi rgyal las khungs kyi brda khyab dang len thog phan tshun 'brel ba yang yang phyogs yor srid jus bzung zhing / 'on kyang skabs der go min t+ta~X krung dbyang srid gzhung gis gnas tshul de shes 'phral ngo rgol mtha'

le'uganyisapa/ rgyal tshaban nga thubabastan 'jamadapalazhe she dang gzagangagadabangagasungarab:du skabs/gcig tu byas pas dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa rnams ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su gyarashi/ nga sprel (1944)lor lha sa bde skyid gli khar bca' sdod dbyin ji'i tshong don spyi khyab pa ri car san (rgya yig gi yig cha khag la li'i khra sun zhes 'khod )dang / 'bras spyi'i las rogs me car she rab (dbyin ji'i mi yin )gnyis kyis bka' shag la 6 deng skabs 'dzam gling yongs la 'gro khyab che shos ni dbyin ji'i skad yig yin pas bod kyi chab srid dang / dmag don/ bzo las sogs gang ci'i thad rang rkya 'pher ba zhig byed thub pa'i ched du bod rigs phru gu mang tsam zhig la dbyin ji'i skad yig bslabs na yag po yod pa red ’ ces bshad/ don du de ni dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i tshab byed mi sna de gnyis kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang de'i rjes 'brang pa tsho'i 'dod blo ltar bod 'di mes rgyal nas kha bral btang ste dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul du sgyur ched rkang 'dzin mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i 'thab byus rang bzhin ldan pa'i lkog g.yo zhig red/ de rjes bsam 'char de bka' shag brgyud srid skyong stag brag dang / bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyang sogs la zhus pas kho pa tshos der yongs su mos mthun byas shing / bka' shag gis kyang dbyin ji'i slob grwa 'dzugs rgyu'i zhib gsal bya thabs skor dpon rigs mngags gtong gis me car she rab dang nang mol yang yang byas pa ma zad/dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa phyi rgyal las khungs zer ba'i 'go gtso zur khang zur pa dza sag dbang chen tshe brtan dang / las tshab rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gnyis kyis kyang bka' shag la 66lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa 'dzugs rgyu 'di bzhin bod phan che bas 'phral du phyag bzhes thub pa zhig nges par gnang dgos zhes skul lcag thengs mang zhus pas srid skyong stag brag gis bka' phab pa'i don bzhin dbyin ji'i slob grwa 'dzugs gnyer bye〉 zlo'i

bodakyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/do dam las 'gan drung rtsis thun mong la sprad/ de nas dbyin ji'i slob grwa gsar rgyag bya yul klu sgug rgyud kyi gzhung gling dang sa stong du ar las 'phral tshugs bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas/ de'i las grwa'i do dam par rtsis pa sdum ra gabasko gzhag thog gron dngul srang nyis khri lnga stong dang / 'bru khal bdun brgya tham pa sprad pa ma zad/ shod skor gzhung zhabs kyi bu phrug dang / rtse skor gyi shag tshang ngam tsha bo sogs zhabs sdod kyi dmigs sgo rnams slob grwar zhugs dgos pa'i bka' yang phab/ slob khang gsar rgyag gi las ka 'phral du legs sgrub ma thub stabs bka' shag brgyud gser snyan sgron pa ltar/ snga 'phros drung spyi gling kha'i spro khang du slob grwa tshugs rgyu gtan 'khel byas te/ shing sprel (1944)lo'i zla 6tshes 11zhin slob grwa dngos su tshugs pa red/ skabs der slob grwar zhugs mkhan gras su sku drag che 'bring chung gsum gyi bu phrug dang tsha shā sum cu lhag tsam dang / tshong pa che khag gi bu phrug bcu phrag kha shas yod pa dad/byin ji'i rjes 'brang pa gso skyong byed pa'i slob ga de dngos su btsugs rjes 6 bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs tshos bod shing 'brug (1904)lo'i dmag dus kyi khrag gi bslab bya de brjed med la/ kho tsho ni rang gi mes rgyal la dga' zhen chen po yod par brten rgyal zur rwa sgreng sogs rgyal gces mtho rim gyi ser skya mi sna khag gcig gis phan tshun nang gnas spel nas 'gog rgol skul slong byas shing / lhag par se 'bras dga' gsum gyis mtshon dgon sde khag gi nang chos lugs la gnod skyon 'byung gzhi'i dogs 'drog byed pa bcas mdor na lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa btsugs pa de la ngo rgol gyi sbir grags byung ①ba sogs la brten gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus tshang ma /shā2 bodakyi rigaganasal sadapyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdam bsgrigs〉deb 2pa'i shog grang 65byer gsal/

le'uganyisapa/ rgyaro0rwazheng thubabazha 'tharabaphagoshegasastagabragangagasangagatsorab dugasagardog rtsa gcig sgril gyis 4lha sar btsugs pa'i dbyin ji'i slob grwa de bzhin bod kyi bstan srid gang la'ang rtsa ba nas mi phan pa dang / ser skya mi dmangs rnams kyi 'dod blor gtan nas mi babs pas 'phral du phyir 'then yong ba zhu mizhes srid skyong stag brag dang / bka' shag la re 'dun zhu skabs bka' shag gis tsa dbyin ji'i slob grwa de ni srid skyong stag brag gi bka' 'khrol byung thog bod gzhung dang dbyin gzhung bka' sol mdzad de btsugs pa zhig yin zhes brjod/ skabs der rgyal gces ser skya dpon rigs mang po khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar nas 6 slob grwa 'dzugs phyogs skor bod ljongs tshogs 'dur bka' bsdur tsam yang mi gnang ba dang / ma 'ongs par bu phug de tshos srid kyi dbang cha 'dzin skabs bstan srid la gnod skyon de bas che ba yong nges la chu la zam pa med na brgal ba las thos med pas lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa btsugs na bod kyi bstan srid dang 'phral phugs gang la'ang gnod skyon che bas slob grwa 'dzugs mi 'jug thag gcod yin mi zhes brjod pa ma zad/ lha sa'i mang tshogs kyis kyang zu dag pa lha ldan gzhung la/ ma dag dbyin ji'i slob grwa/ dge rgan sna chen yog tog dge phrug grwa pa'i a lce zhes pa'i dmangs gzhas shig btsams pa de gang sar btang bas srid skyong stag brag dang bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs sogs btsan dga' shog khas dbyin ji'i slong grwa btsugs nas zla ba dgu tsam song rjes phyir 'then mi byed ka med byung ba dade/ bzhin stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab sogs btsan dga' shog khas kho pa tsho'i stobs shugs je cher gtong ched bka' blon gnang byung pa nyes med phyir 'then gyis de'i las tshab tu zur khang dbang chen dge legs dmigs bsal gyis bsko gzhag byas pa dang / tā la'i bla ma'i sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po ser byes ngag dbang bstan 'dzin btsan shed kyis dgongs zhu nākā du

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/bcug ste las tshab tu 'jam dbyangs dkyil mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bsko gzhag byas pa/ rtsis dpon 'bri yul don med las gnas phyir 'then gyis las tshab tu zhwa sgrub pa dbang phyug bde ldan bsko gzhag byas/ mdor na gzhung zhabs ser skya dpon rigs dang gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus nang gi rgyal zur rwa sgreng dang krung dbyang srid gzhung la lhag bsam dkar ba'i rgyal gces stobs shugs la 'khon 'dzin dang rdung deg chen po btang bar brten kha bral dang kha bral la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de sngar bas mngon gsal dod pa dang dza drag che bar gyur/ skabs der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang de don dngos thog stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab dang / stag brag dza sag bstan pa mthar phyin/ bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs kha bral ring lugs pa nyung shas kyi lag tu bzung ste mu mthud /sdu shā trī /nga bu gcig gyur la gtor bshig gtong ba'i spyod ngan mang tsam drug pa/ rwa sgreng shog kha'i stong bsam dang /stag brag shog kha'i bsam don/rwa sgreng dang stag brag dbar de sngon nang mol gnang ba ltar lo gnyis gsum tsam song mtshams srid skyong gi 'gan dbang phyir 'bul gnang rgyu'i kha dan gyi dus tshon snga sa nas zin rung / srid skyong stag brag shog khas 'gan dbang phyir 'bul zhu bzo gang yang med stabs rgyal zur rwa sgreng thub bstan 'di/ /pal ye shes mchog gis go skabs shig dang bstun nas lha sar ngo

le'uganyisab/ rgyal tshabar nga thubabastan 'jamadabalawe shesadangastagabragangagadabangagasungarab/dusaskabs/phebs thog stag brag dang nang sol zhib gsal gnang dgos dgongs shing /shingakhrel (1944)lo'i zla 1tshes 2nyin rtse pho brang du zan ril phul bar gzhigs na/ tā la'i bla ma'i sku sgyur gegs bar che ba yod lugs phebs stabs gong sa mchog la brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu gtan 'khel zin pa'i gsang gnas de rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog gis mkhyen rjes da res lha sar ngo phebs gnang thub pa'i go skabs bzang po zhig byung song dgongs te/ rwa sgreng mchog la lhag bsam dkar ba'i 'brel yod dpon rigs la phyag bris gnang ste/ 6 da lam 'di nas bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang /bka' blon phun khang / mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan/ 'bras sngags mkhan zur ngag dbang mkhas mchog sgo mang mkhan po chos 'phel rgyal po/se ra stod pa mkhan po rgyal mtshan seng go ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho bcas so sor phyag bris ched gnang gis bka' mngags gnang yod cing /gtso bo bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang / mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan gnyis nas dam don gnang rgyur khyed nas ser byes mkhan por gros bsdur dang 'brel gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po dang / las sne gnad yodakag la gsang ba'i sgo nas thabs shes brgyud bskul gyis rgyal ba rin po cher brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul bar rwa sgreng lha sar gdan 'dren zhu dgos zhes gdan sa gsum nas bka' shag tu snyan seng gis gdan zhu thub pa zhigakhyed dgos zhes gsungs ①pa ltar dpon rigs tshos gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus khag so sor 'brel gtugs byas nas phan tshun gzhogs 'degs gnang dgos pa'i nang mol gnang ba dang / lhag par ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtshos gtso bo'i 'gan khur te gdan sa gsum gyi ① bod kyi rig gan lo rgyusadapyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdamasabasgrigs〉deg6pa'i shog grang621rdokā/la/

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/mkhan po dang 'brel yod las sne rnams dang gsang ba'i gros mol byed skabs mkhan po dang 'brel yod las sne mang che bas rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi bka' dang len zhus te/ shing sprel (1944)lo'i zla 2pa'i nang lha sar tshogs mchod 'tshog skabarme gdan sa'i mkhan po khag gis gsang ba'i gros mol thog gong sa mchog la brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul bar rwa sgreng rin po che lha sar gdan zhu dgos pa'i re 'dun thun mong nas bka' shag tu snyan seng zhu rgyu byas/de rjes zla 2pa'i nang gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po rnams bka' shag tu ngo bskyod kyis las don gal 'gangs che ba zhig snyan seng zhu rgyu yod pas 'phral du tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms 'tshog rgyu'i re ba zhus pa'i lan du bka' shag gis snga 'phros tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms 'tshog dgos don med kyang / bka' shag nas drung rtsis lhan rgyas 'phral du tshogs 'du 'tshog rgyu'i mos mthun byas te gnad don che rigs gang yod sngon du drung rtsis lhan rgyas sar zhu 'thus chog pa zhes brjod/ nyin shas song mtshams lha sa bla brang steng gi gzim chung zur 'phyong du drung rtsis lhan rgyas tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa dang / ser 'bras kyi mkhan po las zur tshang ma dang dga' ldan gyi 'thus mi bcas kyang ngo bcar mnyam 'dzoms zhus/ tshogs 'du'i thog gdan sa'i mkhan 'thus tshos gnad donagal che zhig snyan seng zhu dgos stabs kha sngon bka' shag la gser snyan sgron pa ltar/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms 'phral du skong 'tshog yong ba'i re 'dun zhus kyang mkhan drung tā bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen gyis dzigand don gal che gsung 'os gang yod gsal por gsungs na nga tshos bka' shag tu snyan seng zhus chog pa 7zhes gsungs par/ 'bras spungs sngags pa'i mkhan zur ngag dbang mkhas mchog dang / ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtshos gtso bor byas pa'i gdan sa se 'bras gnyis kyi mkhan po la shā/ dang / dga' ldan 'thus mi bcas kyis gcig rjes gnyis mthud

le'uganyisapa/ rgyal tshabar nga thubabastan 'jamadapalaye shesadangastagabragangagadabangagasungarab dus bas/kyis 6 rwa sgreng rin po che ni bla ma skyes chen dam pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yin pas gong sa mchog sku sgyur ngan dogs yod pas brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan zhu bar rwa sgreng rin po che gdan zhu gnang dgos ’ zhes bsam 'char mang tsam zhus/ skabs der ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus tsho'i re 'dun rnams drung rtsis brgyud bka' shag tu snyan seng zhu skabs bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la de snga rgyal zur rwa sgreng dang bla brang gi drin gyis bskyangs te 'tsho ba'i bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis glo bur du khong khro chen po'i rnam 'gyur bstan te 6 gong sa skyabs mgon chen por brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu'i thad 'di gar srid skyong stag brag rin po che sku zil pa khrom mer bzhugs yod pa ma red dam/ de 'dra yin bzhin du rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po che lha sar gdan zhu bya rgyu ni la cha'i sgang la spags thel rgyag dgos don yod pa ma red/ lar nas ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po tsho chos 'chad nyan dang / bslab pa slob gnyer gnang nas bzhugs tshugs na dga' yi ma red pas mi①zhes brjod bzhin og tshom byil byil btang / dus der sa dbang bon shod tshe brtan rdo rje dang / zur khang dbang chen dge legs gnyis kyis bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyi skad char rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu byas/ dus der bka' blon phun khang bkra shes rdo rjes 6 srid skyong stag brag rin po che sku zil pa khrom mer bzhugs yod rung / la cha'i sgang la spags thel zer ba de 'dra gang nas yin/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che nas gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i yang srid gdan zhu dang / dbu skyes gtsug phud 'bul bzhes sogs gnang ba ma red dam/ 'di skor gang dga' bka' mol gnang rogs zhes rwa sgreng la phyogs pa'i skad cha bshad kyang mthar bya thabs ① bod kyi rigaganasal sadapyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdamasabasgrigs〉deb 6pa'i shog grangs25//dhil/
