le'uganyisapa/ rgyal tshar nga thubabastan 'jamadabal〉zhi dngastagabragangagadabangagasungarabakyidus bas/pas bzhon rta rang sgrig thog me mda' sbag sbag che ba gnyis sogs deng rabs can gyi go lag cha tshang thogs nas 'bri gung rtsa chu brgyud shar ngos nas rwa sgreng dgon du dpung 'jug byas/ nga dang rgyal rtse dmag sgar gyi ru dpon phun tshogs g.yu rgyal dang / rkang dmag nyis brgya tham pas me mda' sbag sbag che ba gcig dang me smyogs gcig sogs dmag mi rnams go lag rang sgrig thog 'phan po sgo la nas gzhung lam brgyud rwa sgreng phyogs su dpung 'jug byas/ de bzhin dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul dang rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa blo gsal don grub gnyis kyis 'go gtso byas te rtse shod bka' gsum gyi sku tshab rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs dang / shod mgron thub bstan bsam mchog bka' mgron khri smon sras/ de min mtsho sgo sras don grub tshe ring / bka' mgron dpal lhun sras/ dmag spyi khang gi las bya las tshan pa lhun grub tshul khrims/shod drung nya smon pa sogs dang bod dmag lnga bcu skor bcas rwa sgreng du bskyod/kho pa tsho snga rjes su rwa sgreng gi nye 'gram du 'byor skabs bcom mdo nas rwa sgreng phyogs su 'gro sa'i lam 'phrang la 'dzing rags brgyab yod pa dang / rwa sgreng dgon gyi g.yas g.yon du 'dzing rags mang po brgyab yod pa ma zad/ pho rong thang du'ang dmag sgar btsugs te rwa bla'i zhabs 'bring dang / khams rigs/'brog pa bcas kyis mtshon cha khyer nas bsdad yod tshul dang / lhag par du drag tsal che ba'i ga rgya 'gram nag gi ab phrug mang po yod tshul gyi gtam gleng thos rjes dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul dang / rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa sogs dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te rim bzhi zhwa sgrub pas gra sgrig yag po ma byas na zhabs 'dren zhu yi red ces smras/ de nas dmag spyi ngo las sogs kyis nang gros byas te 'bri gung gtsang po brgyud skyod mkhan kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi rta dmag rnams sngon du 'byor yod med lta zhib byed par rtse drung blo gros chos 'dzin dang / rtse drung blo gros chos 'phel sogs 'go dmag khag gcig sdu/ du

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/btang / don du kha dang dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub sogs rta dmag nyis brgya skor snga sa nas rwa sgreng dgon du 'byor zin pa red/ kha dang dmag sgar gyi rta dmag rnams rwa sgreng du 'byor skabs grwa dmangs dang / bla brang gi zhabs 'bring mang pos lag tu mtshon cha khyer nas 'gog rgol dmag 'thab yun ring byas stabs grwa pa dang bod dmag phyogs gnyis ku'i khongs nas shi rmas 'ga' zhig byung zhing / mthar rwa sgreng gi grwa dmangs dang zhabs 'bring rnams mtshon cha zhan la dmag 'thab kyi nyams myong rtsa ba nas med pa dang / bod dmag mi 'bor mang la deng rabs can gyi mtshon cha mang po yod stabs grwa dmangs rnams la pham nyes chen po byung ste bros byol du mi 'gro thabs med byung ba red/ bod dmag gis rwa sgreng blangs rjes snying rje spu tsam med par nyes med mi ser mang po'i khang pa dang ra lug sems can bcas pa mer bsregs/ de nas bod dmag rnams dgon pa'i nang 'dzul te gcan gzan ltogs pa sha la rngam pa bzhin khang pa'i sgo dang sge'u khung dang / cha sgam yod tshad bcag tsa rten gtso jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i drung gi gser kong dang / lha khang gzhan gyi gser kong bzhi/ dngul kong grangs med bcas rdo brdung btang nas dmag mis khyer ba red/ dpe cha sa steng du g.yugs nas dpe ras khyer ba dang / dpe cha'i steng du sdum nag gsho ba/gtsug lag khang du rta bong 'jug pa/ lha khang gi khug kyog gang sar skyag gcin gtong ba/ lhung bzed nang skra 'khru ba/ dgon nang du bud med nyar ba sogs mdor na nang pa sangs rgyas pa lta ci/ phyi rol mu stegs pas kyang byed mi srid pa'i ngan rgu tshang ba'i bya spyod yod tshad bod dmag de tsho'i gras kyis byas/ kho tshos da dung grwa shag nang gi sku sa la brdabs nas bcag rjes grwa pa 'bar khog gcig bsad yod ces gtor brlags btang / gnas 222

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalatshabar nga thubabastan 'jamadapalazhe shesadangastagabragangagadabangagasungarabasnyen mkhas/tshul de tshor bsam gzhigs byas na grwa pas 'gog rgol ma byas thabs med red/ ①da dung rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / zhal thang me thub ma sogs rin thang bral ba'i gna' rdzas gal che mang po'ang dmag mis rku 'khyer byas shing / kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag kho nas rwa sgreng dgon dang bla brang gi dngos rigs bcom 'phrog byas pa khal g.yag nyis brgya tsam gyi rgyab chas lha sa khul du dbor nas tshong sgyur byas pa red/ de bzhin dmag spyi dza sag skal tshul dang / rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa blo gsal don grub ngo las kyis rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi 'brog khag gi 'bri g.yag dang / chibs chen sogs rta drel sum cu tsam/ gsang spyod nang sbas pa'i gser leb lcag shing sgam bcu gnyis/ rgya dngul rta mig ma dang / rgya dngul sa phag sam dkar bcas ko btum brgyab pa'i do po nyi shu rtsa gsum/ dar gos chen dang gru'u tsi ltebs sgril/ me mda' dang mde'u sogs rtsa che'i dngos rigs yongs rdzogs gzhung bzhes thog lha sar dbor ba red/dus mtshungs rgyal gces grwa pa gtso gras 'ga' zhig bros byol du song stabs kha dang ru dpon gsum dang / brgya dpon dam chos/ lding dmag sum cu skor/ de bzhin rgyal rtse dmag sgar gyi dmag mi nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas 'dzin bzung byed par btang bas grwa rigs khag gcig bros shor ba dang / 'ga' zhig 'dzin bzung byas/ zla ba chos rab sogs grwa rigs mi bdun lha sar khrid nas khrims gcod nan po byas pas la la khrims 'og tu shi ba dang / la la rgyang 'bud btang / drel pa mkhas grub dmar gsod btang nas mgo lag rnams sangs rgyas gsung rab kyi mjing par bskur te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa mtshon byed kyi dar chen thog bkal/ gzhan yang ye shes zla ba ① bod kyi rigaganasal sadapyadagazhi'i rgyu chabadamasabasgrigs〉deg pa'i shogagrangs 'byebye/sal/

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/dang / bsam gtan/ mthar phyin sogs rgyal gces grwa rigs rnams la khrims gcod tsha nan btang ba sogs mdor na 'dzam gling yul gru kun tu grags che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i gnas chen rwa sgreng de nyid gshin rje'i khrims ra dang mtshungs par gyur pa'o/bcu pa/ rwa sgreng bgrongs rjes stag brag shog khas bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur pa/stag brag shog khas dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i bsam 'dun ltar/ thabs brgya byus stong gi sgo nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkrongs pa dang /rgyal gces stobs shugs la rdung deg tshabs chen btang ste bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur/ 6 1947lo'i lo mjug tu 'bras spyis ri car san brgyud bka' shag la brjod gsal/ rgya nag nas rwa sgreng zing 'khrug thad la dbyin phyogs dang rgya phyogs bar gyi 'khrug rtsod yin tshul tshags par bkram 'dug pas bod nas kyang rwa bla'i yong rkyen dang / rang btsan yin skor gyi tshags par bkram dgos kyi 'dug zer ba sogs kyi ngan skul byas pa red/’ ①gong gsal skad cha dum bu 'di'i thog nas kho pa tsho'i dmigs yul gtso bo gang yin gsal po mthong thub/ btsan dga' shog khas mngon sum 'dzems med /sa snga rjes su mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i spyod ngan rab dang rim pa spel ba ༵༵4 bodakyi rigaganasal gdapyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdamasabasgrigs〉thog lagasal/

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalatshabarwachad thubabastan 'jamadapa la〉shesadang gabragangagadabangagasungarab/du skab /1 ye shala'i chogs 'du zer ba'i skor/rab byung bcu drug pa'i me khyi (1946)lo'i zla 12par rgya gar ldi lir e sha ya mi rigs ser po'i don gnad skor gyi tshogs 'du zhig skong 'tshog bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byed pa'i skabs der dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du bed spyad de bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i lkog g.yo zhig bshams/ de yang lha sar bca' sdod dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab ri car san brgyud bka' shag la e sha ya'i tshogs 'dur rgyal khab gzhan dang 'dra bar bod kyi sku tshab gtong dgos pa'i mgron brda zhig 'byor bas stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog khas kho pa tsho'i 6 bod rang btsan mi zer ba'i stong bsam de mngon du 'gyur ba'i go skabs shig byung song snyam nas dga' tshor chen pos sku tshab gtong rgyu'i khas len byas/me khyi (1946)lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes shar du tshogs zhugs 'thus mi ngo las rnams shod 'gag tu bskongs te srid skyong stag brag sogs kyi bkod mngags ltar sne mgron thub bstan legs smon gyis 6 srid skyong stag brag gi bka' phebs dgongs don bzhin rgya gar ldi lir e sha ya mi rigs ser po'i don gnad skor gyi tshogs 'dur bod gzhung nas sku tshab satong rgyu gtan 'khel zin pas sku tshab tu tha'i ji bsam pho tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang / mkhan chung blo bzang dbang rgyal/ las byar bsam pho sras bstan 'dzin don grub dang /rtse drung kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ skad bsgyur ka shod sras don grub dang /las tshan skyid sbug dbang 'dus nor bu bcas bsko gzhag byas pa yin/ zhib phra'i byed sgo bka' shag gi bkod mngags ltar byed dgos ① zhes bka' ① bod kyi rigagan lha sadapyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdam bsgrigs〉dege pa'i shogagrangs 'byek+ta/la/

bod kyi nye rabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/sgrogs sbyang byas/ de bzhin chos lugs skor mkhyen rgya che ba'i 'bras spungs dge bshes rig 'dzin bstan pa dang / dga' ldan dge bshes ngag dbang dpal ldan gnyis chos lugs shes bya'i skor blo 'dri yul du ched mngags btang / bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las rnams lha sa nas ma thon gong srid skyong stag brag dang / bka' shag gi bka' 'brel ltar bod 'di chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su rgyal khab dngos su btsugs tshul dang / hor se chen rgyal po'i dus du sog bod dbar mchod yon gyi 'brel ba chags tshul/ phag gru dang / gtsang pa sde srid/ lhag par du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa mchog gis dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang dngos su btsugs tshul/ bod kyi btsan po rim byon dang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon gyis chos srid bskyangs tshul/bod dang rgya nag gi sa mtshams dang / bod dang rgya gar gyi sa mtshams skor sogs nang don don tshan brgyad dgu tsam bkod pa'i yig cha zhig bzos te thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i thog khyer nas 2 bod rang btsan mi zer ba'i kho pa tsho'i dmigs yul de sgrub thub pa'i re stong bcangs/ de rjes me phag (1947)lo'i zla dang por bod gzhung gi 'thus mi ngo ma gnyis bka' shag tu bos nas gong gsal yig cha rnams sprad thog zhib gsal nang mol bslab bya mang po byas pa ma zad/ srid skyong stag brag gis thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i spyi khyab paṇ+ḍi ta 'ja' wa la ne ho ru dang / tshogs 'du'i gra sgrig 'go 'dzin sa ro ca ne+e na ye kru lha lcam/ tshogs 'du'i las bya a pa kro re dang a sdur ka lam bcas 'brel yod 'go 'dzin las bya so sor yi ge re dang skyabs zhu'i rten gser dang / rum gyi sa gdan/ snam rigs sogs bskur/ de bzhin rgya gar du bca' sdod dbyin gzhung sku tshab dang / 'bras spyi blon chen sogs la'ang yi ge dang gong gsal bzhin rten chas dngos rigs bskur/ me phag (1shā/7)lo'i zla 1tshes 6nyin bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las rnams lha sa nas thon

le'uganyi ba/ rgyalatshabarwazheng thubabastan 'jamadapalas shesadang gzagangagadabangagasungarab:du skab /te 'bras ljongs brgyud rgya gar du bskyod dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar/ bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las drug lha sa nas gro mo'i phyogs su bskyod/ skabs der lha sar bca' sdod dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i las tshab ri car san gyis bka' shag la 6 ye sha ya tshogs 'du'i dpon rigs nas yi ge 'byor gsal/ tshogs 'du 'tshog yul du 'grems rgyu'i bod gzhung gi dar cha zhig 'phral du gnang skyong dang / gal te dar cha gnang chog med tshe gzhung dar che chung gi tshad dang tshos ris sogs kyi gnas tshul byung bstun ldi lir bzos chog ①ces brjod pa ma zad/ kho pas da dung tshogs 'du 'tshog yul du rgyal khab khag gi dar cha 'grems rgyu gtan 'khel zin pas bod kyi dar cha yod tshe bod 'di rgyal khab dngos zhugs kyi gras yin pas chab srid thog khe phan che ba yod lugs skor ngan skul mang tsam byas/ srid skyong stag brag dang bka' shag gis ri car san gyi bsam 'char ltar gangs ri dang seng ge'i ri mo yod pa'i sngarayod bod dmag gi dmag dar de rgyal dar du brtsis nas dar cha gsar btsemakhyas pa ma zad/ dar cha'i ri mo'i 'grel bshad kyang bod dbyin yig rigs gnyis su bkod nas a drung rta shad ched gtong byas stabs 'thus mi ngo mganyis gro mo nas ma thon gong lag son byung ba red/ skabs der bod sa gnasasrid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pas khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas 'thus mi ngo las btang ba'i gnas tshul de go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis shes 'phral skyon brjod dang bkag 'gog mtha' gcig tu byas/ 'on kyang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pas der nyan 'jog bya rgyu lta zhog de las ldog ste bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las la tar btang ste go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab ma 'byor gong bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las ldi li gsar par ① bodakyi /gaganas rgyu dpyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdamasabasgrig thag pa'i shogagrangs221)/la/

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/'byor ba byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las kyis srid skyong dang bka' shag gi bka' bkod ltar ka sbug nas 'phral du ldi lir bskyod/ kho pa tsho ldi lir 'byor skabs thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i gra sgrig las khungs kyi 'brel yod mi snas gnam gru'i babs thang du ched mngags bsu ba zhu bar 'ongs pa ma zad/ de'i sang nyin zhogs pa de rang la 'ja' wa la ne he ru dang /sa ro ca ne na ye kru lha lcam gnyis ched mngags bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las sdod gnas mgron khang du 'ongs nas 'tshams 'dri yang byas/ de bzhin ldi li gsar pa'i tshags par khag nang bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las rgya gar ldi li gsar par bslebs zin pa'i skor dril bsgrags shugs chen byas te bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las rnams thengs 'di'i tshogs zhugs rgyal khab khag gi sku tshab ngo ma'i gras yin lugs skor gyi gleng phyogs mang po bzos/ de rjes bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las tshos paṇ+ḍi ta ne he ru'i sar bcar nas srid skyong stag brag sogs kyi yi ge dang skyabs zhu'i dngos po rnams phul ba ma zad/ thengs 'di'i tshogs 'dur ched du gra sgrig byas pa'i 6 bod rang btsan yin tshul gyi yig cha dang / rgya bod sa mtshams/ bod nyin sa mtshams sogs kyi nang don 'khod pa'i yig cha gzhir bzung ne he ru dang nang mol byas/ 'on kyang bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la ne he rus 6 bod rang btsan zhes pa'i skor tshogs 'du'i thog gtam bshad bya rgyur mos mthun ma byas pa red/ ne+e he rus 6 thengs 'di'i e sha ya'i tshogs 'du thengs dang po rgya gar gyi sa thog tu 'tshogs pa red/ tshogs 'du 'di brgyud phan tshun ngo shes 'brel gtugs dang / gnas tshul spel res bya rgyu tsam las sa mtshams sogs srid don kyi skor sus kyang gleng na mi 'grigs la/thag gcod kyang rtsa ba nas yong srid kyi ma red ’ ces brjod/e sha ya mi rigs ser po'i don gnad skor gyi tshogs 'du dngos su 'ardo/ /bas tshogs zhugs sku tshab mi grangs sum brgya tsam yod cing / de'i

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalatshabarwazhed thubabastana'ajamadabaphagoshesadangastagasprugangagadabangagasungarab/du snakha /nang e sha ya rgyal khab che gras khag la sku tshab bzhugs yul stegs bu bcu re dang / bod kyi sku tshab la stegs bu bzhi sprad/ rgyal khab so so'i sku tshab gtso bo sdodaganas mdun lcog gi gdong ngos su pang leb thog rgyal khab kyi ming dang rgyal dar gyi ri mo bris yod la/ bod kyi sku tshab gtso bo'i mdun lcog gi gdong ngos su'ang pang leb thog gangs ri dang seng ge 'khod pa'i dar cha dang bod ces bris yod pa red/ de bzhin tshogs chen gyi kru'u zhi sdings cha'i rgyab ngos su sa bkra chen po zhig bkal yod pa 'di'i nang bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs ma yin par rang btsan rgyal khab cig yin pa gsal por bkod yod stabs go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab yan h+phan gyis thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i 'go 'dzin pa tshos bod 'di rgyal khab cig tu brtsis nas tshogs 'dur gdan drangs pa ma zad/ bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs nas kha phral ba'i sa bkra 'di lta bu zhig bkal ba der skyon brjod dang ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ skabs der tshogs 'du'i 'go 'dzin tshos g.yo gtam mang po bshad de thengs 'di'i tshogs 'dur bod kyi sku tshab ni yin dran dang /war dri/ i wan kri/ ka mi shan sogs dmangs khyod skyid sdug mthun tshogs kyis gdan drangs pa zhig yin pa las/ rgya gar srid gzhung gis gdan drangs pa rtsa ba nas ma yin la/ sa bkra'i nang gi gnad don la'ang do snang rtsa ba nas ma byung zhes khungs lung med pa'i 'grel bshad mang tsam brgyab/ de rjes tshogs 'dus sa bkra der bzo bcos brgyab ste bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs cha shas shig yin pa'i lo rgyus gyi don dngos dang mthun pa'i sa bkra zhig mi bzo ka med byung ba ma zad/ bod kyi 'thus mis kyang ched mngags bzos te khyer yong ba'i gangs ri dang seng ge'i ri mo bkod pa'i dar cha de dngos su bkal ma nus pa red/ 'on kyang (bod rigs lo rgyus gnad bsdus 〉zhes pa sogs rgya yi/ gi rtsom yig mang po'i nang skabs der bod kyi gangs ri da~X sbyang

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/ge'i ri mo bkod pa'i dar cha de e sha ya rgyal khab gzhan gyi dar cha dang mnyam du bkal ba red ces 'khod yod pas de ni lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang rtsa ba nas mi mthun pa zhig red snyam/ gong smos ltar go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhungagi sku tshab kyis gnad don de'i thad ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas par brten bod kyi 'thus mis tshogs 'du'i thog tu gtam bshad byed skabs bod dang rgya gar dbar chos phyogs kyi 'brel ba yod lugs dang / bod hin mi rigs dbar la phan tshun 'brel ba che ba'i lo rgyus yun ring yod tshul/ thengs ji'adi'i tshogs 'dur gdan zhu gnang bar dga' po byung tshul sogs las 6 bod rang btsan miyin lugs skor skad cha tshig gcig kyang shod ma nus pa dang / de bzhin tshogs chung khag bgos kyis gros bsdur byed skabs bod k+to thon khungs dang / so nam byed stangs/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba/ shesaX rig sogs skor gyi gnas tshul bshad pa las btsan dga' shog khas bskur ba'i tshig tho'i nang gi skad cha tshig gcig kyang shod ma nus pa red/thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du grol skabs tshogs zhugs sku tshab tsho'i 'dra par 'og tu ming dang / las 'gan/ lo rgyus mdor bsdus bcas 'khod pa'i deb gcigabazos nas sku tshab so sor sprad cing / tshogs 'du'i 'go 'dzin sa ro ca ne na ye kru lha lcam gyis bod kyi 'thus mi ngo las kho mo'i gzim shag tu ched mngags bos nas mi rer deb re sprad thog 6 khyed rang tsho bod la mtshon na/bod zer ba gang du yod med tsam ma shes mkhan mang po yod pa red/ da lam e sha ya tshogs 'du 'dir zhugs pa dang / par deb 'di bton pa nas bzung rgyal khab tshang mas bod ha go gi red/ de ni khyed tshor thob pa'i 'bras bu red ༷ces brjod/ sa ro ca ni na ye kru lha lcam gyi skad cha dum bu de ni byerdo0 bod kyi rig gnasalorgyusadapyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdam bsgrigs〉deg2pa'i shogagrangs26lagasal/

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalathobarwa nga thubabastan 'jamadapagaye shesadangastagabragangagadabangagasungarab/du skabs/bod kyi 'thus mi rnams la sems gso btang ba zhig rang red/ mdor na/dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og srid skyong stag brag sogs btsanadaga' shog khas e sha ya mi rigs ser po'i don gnad skor gyi tshogs 'du'i thog chen mngags 'thus mi ngo las drug tsam btang nas tshogs 'du'i thog 6 bod rang btsan yin lugs skor dril bsgrags byas te 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag dang / lhag par du e sha ya rgyal khab khag gi rgyab skyor thob pa byas nas kho pa tsho'i bsam 'dun ji bzhin 'grub pa'i re ba byas kyang / don dngos su tshogs 'du'i thog e sha ya rgyal khab sus kyang 6 bod rang btsan ’ yin pa khas len ma byas stabs kho pa tshor sna rgyug tsha thag chod cig phog pa red/2 bod0 chong don chogs pa sogs0 skor/skabs der btsan dga' shog khas da dung mu mthud mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i ched du 6 hur brtson gyis bod dmag rgya skyed gtong bzhin yod pas tshod dpag ltar na spyi'i dmag grangs mi khri lnga tsam dang / lha sar bca' sdod pu li si mi grangs chig stong / de bzhin dbyin ji'i lag nas go mtshon nyo bzhin yod cing / mtshon cha khag dang po de ka spug nas tshur dbor bzhin yod pa red/ de'i khongs su me mda' sbag sbag che ba brgya tsam dang / me skyogs bcu/ me mda' ring mda' khri lhag tsam/ rang 'gugal me mda' ring mda' brgya/ rdzas mdel do po brgya tsam yod pa de rnams tshod dpag byas na zla rjes mar lha sar 'byor gyi yod pa red/ de min go thos su rgya gar du yod pa'i dbyin ji'i go mtshon yongs rdzogs bod la btsong rtsis yod pa dang / de'i rin 'bab tu sa cha khag gcig bogs mar gtong ba'am yang na gser sa phag 6 231

bodakyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/sprod sa yod pa red/ 0srid skyong stag brag sogs kyis kho pa tsho'i dmigs yul mngon du 'gyur ba'i ched du dbyin ji'i mtshon cha mang po nyos te bod dmag rgya skyed btang ba dang phyogs mtshungs rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan dang / chang khyim thub bstan tshe dpal/ rim bzhi spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel/ skad bsgyur dbus mda' zur khang sras lha stobs rgyal bcas las grub pa'i bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa zer ba sgrig 'dzugs dang ngo las bsko gzhag thog khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas a ri sogs rgyal khab khag la 'gro chog pa'i lag khyer dang / a ri'i spyi khyab ru man dang /dbyin gzhungagong ma 'jo je/ rgya gar gyi spyi khyab srid blon paṇ+ḍi ta no he ru sogs la thang ka 'tshem drub ma re dang / mjal dar/ tā la'i bla ma'i sku par bris ma re sogs bskur nas me phag (1947)lo'i zla khams 11nyin lha sa nas rdog thon gyis rgya gar dang / a ri/ dbyin ji sogs su btang / don du skabs der bod nas phyi 'gro thon khungs gtso bo bal dang / rnga ma/ khul rtsid/pags rigs/ gla rtsi/ khrag rwa sogs yul zog tshong bsgyur byas pa'i spyi'i rin thang a ri'i sgor khri sum cu tsam yang ma zin stabs chen mngags tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang med/ kho pa tsho'i dmigasayul gtso bo ni skabs de'i go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi phyi 'brel pu'u yi dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs nang 'khod pa ltar/ zu rgyal spyi'i thog tu bod 'di rang btsan yin pa'i rnam pa bstan rgyu dang gcig krung dbyang gi tshod 'dzin 'khur mi dgos par rang mos kyi sgo nas 'dzam gling rgyal khab gzhan dang 'brel gtugs bya rgyu dang gnyis/ a ri stobs shugs che bas rgyab skyor 'thob re byed pa dang gsum/ bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs dang tshong pa byedi2 bod lagan kyi tho spoyig cha phyog bas 〉rgyachu'iltoshogagrangs257lagasal/

le'uganyibab/ rgyalatsa'irazhed thubabastana'ajamadabaphayeshesadangastagazagangagadabangagasungarab dus dgarnams 'brel ba dam zab yod pas tshong khe yong re byed pa dang bzhi/ mu mthudadamag mkho'i yo chas nyo sgrub bya rgyu dang lnga bcas yin stabs tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa'i ming khyer ba tsam las don du chab srid kyi dmigs grub ched red/ rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pas gtsos pa'i bod kyi bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa rgya gar du 'byor rjes rgya gar gyi spyi khyab srid blon paṇ+ḍi ta ne+e he ru dang thugs 'phrad byas te rgya gar dang bod gnyis lo ngo stong phrag mang po'i sngon nas chos dang / shes rig thad 'brel ba chen po yod lugs dang / da cha rgya gar rang btsan thob pas rgya gar dang bod dbar chings yig 'jog dgos tshul/ phan tshun mtha' mtshams sa 'dres shin tu che bas zhi don mnyam gnas bya rgyu ha cang gsal 'gangs che tshul/ de bzhin tshong don skor sogs nang sol bsam gros mang tsam byas/ dus der rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa zer ba rgya gar du 'byor ba'i gnas tshul de go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis shes 'phral bod sa gnasasrid gzhung la bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa zer bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi lag khyer thogs nas phyi'i rgyal khab gang zhig la'ang skyod mi chog pa'i bka' phab pa ma zad/ rgya gar du bca' sdod go min tang krung dbyangasrid gzhung gi gzhung tshab che mo bas 1947lo'i zla 12tshes 21nyin rgya gar gyi spyi khyab srid blon ne he ru dang phan tshun thugs 'phrad byes te 66dbyin ji'i go mtshon bod du dbor 'dren byas pa'i lhag ma lcags ro rgya gar du yod pa rnams la brtag zhib thog dbor 'jug mi chog pa dang / bod sa gnas sridagazhung gis rang 'tsham byas nas sprad pa'i phyi rgyal du 'gro chog pa'i lag khyer khas len byed mi chog ces brjod/ de'i lan du srid blon ne+e he rus/6 dbyin ji dang rgya gar dbar srid dbang sprod len byed pa'i skabs su rgya gar du go mtshon nyo snang bya rgyu ni ha cang las sla po zhig red/ gnas tshul de lhaswāk+tas

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/yod med brtag dpyad zhus chog bod rigs rgya gar du yong dus phyi rgyal du 'gro chog pa'i lag khyer 'khur mi dgos/ dbyin jir 'gro chog pa'i lag khyer ni rgya gar du bca' sdod dbyin ji'i mtho rim kron yon gyis chog mchan 'god dgos pa las/ rgya gar srid gzhung gis chog mchan 'god dgos med ces brjod/ de rjes rgya gar gyi spyi khyab srid blon ne ho rus 6 bod 'di krung go'i rang skyong gi sa cha zhig red mi ces brjod par go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi gzhung tshab che mo bas yorang skyong zhes pa de rang btsan rgyal khab cig ma yin pas bod kyi rang skyong dbang cha de krung go'i rtsa khrims nang 'khod pa'i dbang cha de rang la tshod 'dzin byed dgos ’ zhes brjod/ de nas zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa'i ngo las rnams rgyalakhab gzhan du 'gro bar 'dzam gling rgyal khab mang che bas bod 'di rang btsan gyi rgyal khab cig yin pa'i khas len ma byas stabs rgyal khab gzhan du 'gro ba'i lag khyer dang lag dngul thad dka' ngal mang po 'phrad pa dang /lhag don go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bka' tsha nan phab pa sogs la brten rgya gar nas thon te shang kyang dang / hrang han brgyud go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi rgyal sa nan cing du me phag (1947)lo'i zla 11tshes 21nyin 'byor/ kho pa tsho nan cing du 'byor rjes sne len dang 'brel gtugs gros sol gyi las 'gan tshang ma bod sog u yon lhan khang nas khur ba dang / tsung thung cang ce hre sogs kyis mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma zad/ 6 a me ri ka dang / dbyin ji sogs rgyal khab khag la bskyod na 'gro song che ba tsam las/ phan pa gang yang med/ lha rab byung na bod la phyir log gnang na legs shos dang / gal srid nges par du gong gsal rgyal khab khag la bskyod dgos tshe go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi lag khyer 'khur dgos pa dang /rgyaX ༵༵ gang du 'byor yang krung go'i gzhung tshab khang yod pas khyed tshor gang

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalathob2shed thubabastan 'jamadapalan she dang gabragangagadabangagasungarabakyidu snab /ci'i thad rogs ram thob nges red ces gsungs/ zhwa sgab pa sogs tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa'i ngo las tshos a ri dang dbyin ji sogs la 'gro ba'i gron dngul a ri'i sgor mo khri nyis brgya tsam dgos pa'i re ba bton yang go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis grangs 'bor ha cang mang bas dka' ngal che ba yod tshul bshad de lag dngul a ri'i sgor khri lnga tsam sprod rgyu'i khas len byas/ dus der zhwa sgrub pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs kyis bod sog u yon lhan khang brgyud 'thus mi ngo las bod du phyir log bya rgyu yin tshul snyan seng zhus/ don du kho pa tsho nan cing du sdod skabs lkog tu a me ri ka dang /dbyin ji/ rgya gar sogs kyi gzhung tshab dang ngan 'brel gyis phyi rgyal du 'gro chog pa'i lag khyer len rgyu dang dngul lor brje res bya rgyu sogs kyi byed sgo mtha' dag yongs su grub/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis zhwa sgab pa sogs kyi rdzun gtam rnams bden par mngon nas kho pa tshor phyi rgyal gyi dngul lor dang / gnang skyes gang legs gnang ba ma zad/ ched mngags gnam gru btang nas shang dang du bskyal/ 'on kyang kho pa tshos sngon tshud nas 'char 'god gra sgrig byas pa ltar/ sa byi (1948)lo'i zla 5tshes 17nyin shang gang brgyudas rir bskyod/ dus der a rir bca' sdod go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi gzhung tshab che mo bas ngag thog nas gsal bsgrags spel te/6 1 bod sa gnas la rang sger gyis phyi phyogs su 'brel ba byed pa'i dbang cha med/ 2 zha sgab pa sogs la a ri'i srid gzhung dang tshong don gros sol byed pa'i dbang cha med/ 2 shang kung du bca' sdod a ri'i spyi khyab las don khang nas zhwa sgab pa sogs kyi lag khyer thog mchan 'god ma byas gong du shang dang du bca' sdod rang rgyal gyi dmigs bsal mngags gtong pa ko'o la brda lan ma byas pa gang yin nam/ 4 a ri'i srid gzhung gis krung gor bod kyi bdag thob dbang cha shad pa khas len bzhin du bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis 2//na

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/'god byas pa'i lag khyer khas blangs pa ni rtogs dka' ba'i gnad don zhig red/ 'di ni shang gang du bca' sdod a ri'i spyi khyab don gcod pa mi sger gyi nor 'khrul yin mi srid pas a ri'i srid gzhung gis bod kyi gnad don thad 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur la 'gyur ldog byung ba ma yin nam/ de don gsal bshadaganang dgos zhes brjod/ de'i lan du a ri'i srid blon rma she 'ar gyis zu a ris bod kyi gnad don thad la krung go'i srid gzhung gi bsam 'char la brtsi bkur dang lag bstar bya rgyu yin/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi las don de'i skor gtso gnyer byed mkhan gyis brjod gsal du shang gang du bca' sdod a ri'i spyi khyab don gcod khang gis zhwa sgab pa sogs la spyir btang gi 'bri shog thog a rir bskyod chog pa'i mchan 'god byas pa las yul skor du bskyod chog pa'i lag khyer thog mchan 'god byas med pas gnad don des krung gos bod la 'dzin pa'i bdag dbang la gnod 'tshe yong mi srid pa zhig red ces brjod/ de bzhin go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis dbyin ji sogs la'ang gong gsal ltar 'brel gtugs dang ngag thog nas gsal bsgrags spel bas dbyin ji'i phyi 'brel pu'u yis de don dgongs sel zhus pa red/gong gsal ltar go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pas khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas a ri dang / dbyin ji sogs la bskyod par ngo rgol dang 'brel yod rgyal khab khag la'ang gsal bsgrags spel stabs zhwa sgab pa sogs ngo las tshang ma ci bya gtol med du gyur te tshong las kyi byed sgo 'ga' zhig spel thub pa tsam las rgyal khab khag gis bod kyi srid don thad rgyab skyor byed mi nus pas kho pa tsho'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul de sgrub ma thub pa red/ de rjes kho pa tsho a ri dang dbyin ji sogs la zla shas ring bsdad de mthar sa byi (1948)lo'i zla 12par h+pha ran si daji /dardi /6 li/ sun si/ rgya gar sogs bsgyud bod du phyir log ma byed ka med

le'uganyigab/ rgyalatshabarwached thubabamiga'ajamadabal〉shesadangastagabragangagadabangagasungarab/dus da /byung ba bye/ de/ra rgyal nang gi gnas tshul la'ang rtsa ba'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba ste/ krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og gi krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis le'u hren g.yul 'gyed dang / phen cin g.yul 'gyed/ ho'e had g.yul 'gyed bcas la rgyal kha rlabs chen thob rjes 'bri chu brgal te lho khul du dpung skyod byas pa ma zad/ nub byang dang /lho nub sa khul du'ang dpung skyod byas stabs go min tang srid gzhung 'di bzhin rlung gi dbus na gnas pa'i sgron me lta bur gyur/ mes rgyal skam sa chen po yongs su bcings 'grol gtong ba'i skabs der a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas mngon sum 'dzems med kyi sgo nas dmag don mi sna btang ste mtsho sngon dang mdo khams sogs sa khul du yod pa'i go min tang gi dmag mi lhag ma rnams la byus bkod byas te gung khran tang la ngo rgol byas/skabs der bod du yod pa'i a ri dang / dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa tsho dngangs skrag rab tu skyes nas bya thabs dben pa'i gnas su gyur/ dus der ri car san gyis srid skyong stag brag dang bka' shag la gsang gtam yin khul gyis lha sar gung khran tang gi so pa dang sgrig 'dzugs mang po yod tshul skor brjod pa ma zad/ de dag tshang ma lha sa nas 'phral du phyir 'bud ma byas na phyi nang lag 'brel gyis bod btsan bzung byed nyen shin tu che bas 'phral du phyir 'bud byed dgos zhes ngan skul byas/ kho pa'i gtam de btsan dga' shog kha'i bsam 'dun dang yongs su mthun stabs kho pa tshos lkog tu nang mol byas te sa glang (1949)lo'i zla 7tshes /nyin ka lon sbug rgyang bsgrags babs tshugs thog nas lha sar bca' sdod go min tang gi don gcod khang 'phral du phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / phyogs mtshungs nyin de rang du lha sa'i spang lam gang sar bod dmag bkram ste lha sar bca〉 /da

bodakyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta po'i dbyangs/go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi don gcod khang gi las don mi sna yongs rdzogs gza' 'khor gnyis nang phyir 'then byed dgos zer ba ma zad/dpon rigs sdod gnas khag tu bod dmag gis mtha' bskor ba dang / phyi phyogs dang sbrag tar gyi 'brel ba yongs su bcad/ de bzhin go min tang srid gzhung gi 'grim 'grul pu'u khongs kyi sbrag tar khang gtor ba dang / shi'i krang la gri brgyab ste rmas skyon phog skabs der lha sar yod pa'i rgya rigs tshong pa dang / tha na dgon par yod pa'i rgya bla ma mang por yang gnod skyon chen phog pa red/ de nas nyin gnyis tsam song rjes rgya gar ldi li'i tshags par khag thog lha sa'i zhib gsal gnas tshul bkod de gang sar dril bsgrags byas/mthar go min tang gi dpon rigs dang nang mi sogs rgya gar brgyud phyir log byed dgos byung ba red/ thengs 'dir lha sar yod pa'i rgya rigs yongs rdzogs phyir 'bud byed pa'i don rkyen 'di'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul ni a ri dang dbyinaji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod du yod pa'i kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brang par shog sbubs rlung 'tshang gis go min tang srid gzhung la kha'i nyi ma lta bur gyur pa'i go skabs de dang bstun nas bod 'di mes rgyal nas kha bral btang ste btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i mi ser spel yul du bsgyur rgyu de red/ skabs der shin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gis 'go brjod du 〈phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul pas krung go'i mnga' khongs bod 'di khyur mid rtsa ba nas gtong mi chog 〉ces pa'i ched brjod spel te/ 6 bod sdod rgya rigs yongs rdzogs phyir 'bud byed pa'i don rkyen 'di ni a ri dang dbyin ji'i byus bkod 'og kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brang pa ne+e he ru dang bod du yod pa'i btsan dga' shog kha ngan 'brel byas te gung khran tang la ngo rgol byed pa'i bya ba zhig red/ a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas snga sa nas krung go'i mnga' khongs bod 'di kho pa tsho'i mi ser spel yuX —8 'gyur ched snga rjes su bod la drag po'i btsan 'dzul dang / so pa mngari

le'uganyisab/ rgyal tshabarwathekho thubabastan 'jamadabalas shesadang gabragangagadabangagasungarab/dus ba /po btang ste rgyal gces stobs shugs la rdung deg btang ba ma zad/ kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brang pa gso skyong yang byas te g.yo thabs la brten nas bod kyi dbang cha bzung / bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral btang ste btsan rgyal ring lugs pas khyur mid gtong ba'i bsam tshul 'di ni nyin mo'i rmi lam lta bu yin pas rtsa ba nas 'grub thabs med pa zhig red/ krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid byas pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis bod dang mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs sa cha yongs rdzogs bcings 'grol gtong nges yin mizhes khyab bsgrags byas pa red/bcu gcig pa/ srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab srid khri nas phab pa'i skor/gong du smras pa ltar/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das rjes bod kyi gnas tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas su gyur pa dang / kha bral dang kha bral la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de nyin bzhin rno ngar can du gyur/ lhag par du stag brag shog khas g.yo thabs la brten nas bod kyi srid dbang ham bzung byas rjes mes bod kha bral gtong ba'i bya ngan rab dang rim pa spel ba der bod kyi ser skya mang tshogs yongs nas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ 'on kyang stag brag shog khas mes rgyal dang bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs kyi khe phan la ma bltos par 6 bod rang btsan ’ zhes pa'i sdig nyes kyi dmigs yul de sgrub ched mu mthud a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs dang / dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs/ rgya gar gyi log spyod stobs shugs bcas dang ngan 'breswā byas te mi dmangs bcings 2)/la

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/dmag bod du skyod par 'gog rgol byas shing / dper na/ a ri'i so pa la'i ci'ar thang mu sis bka' shag tu btang ba'i yi ge'i nang slongs gzi brjid ngang rang rgyal gyi tsung thung tu'u lu men mjal thub pa byung ba ma zad/ khyed tsho'i srid gzhung gi yi ge de yang khong la phul zin pa yin/ lhag par du bod kyi rang btsan la 'jigs skul rdzog stabs deng rabs kyi mtshon cha dang / dmag don byus 'dri ba sogs rgyab skyor rogs ram yong ba zhu skabs sku zhabs tu'u lu men gyis khyed tshor gdung sems mnyam skye gnang gi 'dug de bzhin a ri'i rgyal don blon chen ji sun gyis bod la rgyab skyor byed dgos na bod kyi gnas tshul la zhib phra'i brtag zhib byed dgos pas khyed lha sar skyod skabs 'thus mi tshogs pa zhig yul skor spro 'cham gyi ming thog nas gtong gi yin zer ba sogs ’ gtam 'chal mang tsam bshad yod pa red/ de bzhin la'i 'ar thang mu si bod du sdod skabs bka' shag gis kho par 6 gal srid gung khran tang gis bod la tshur rgol byas na a ris bod la rogs ram gnang ngam/ rogs ram gnang na tshad gang 'dra zhig gnang gi red dam mi①zhes dris par de'i lan du la'o 'ar thang mu sis tsa gal srid gung khran tang gis bod la tshur rgol byas na byang rgyud dang khams kyi shar ngos nas dpung 'jug byed nges yin pas/ sa cha de gnyis kur lam thag ring tshad dbyin le drug brgya re yod pa red/ thog ma'i lam thag dbyin le nyis brgya tsam 'gro bde tsam yod rung / de rjes kyi lam rnams 'gro dka' bas bod nas nges med rgol rdung ru khag rtsal ldan zhig sgrig 'dzugs byas tshe btsan 'dzul pa bkag 'gog byed thub pa zhig dang / kho tsho'i mkho sprod byed lam gcod thub pa zhig yong bas btsan 'dzul byed par mi dngos ha cang mang po gtong dgos pa zhig yong gi red/ de yang rtsal ldan bye/0 bod sagan kyi lo sayig cha phyogasabasus〉rgyasagashogagrangs278lagasal/

le'u gnyisapa/ rgyal tshabar nga thubabastan 'jamadapalan shesadangastagakhragangagadabangagasungarab kyidus bas/dmag dpung de lta bu zhig sgrig 'dzugs byed par cha rkyen gnyis 'dzoms dgos pa ste/ gcig ni mtshon cha (yang ba'i mtshon cha )gang 'tsham zhig mkho sbyor byed dgos pa dang / gnyis ni lag rtsal thad sbyong brdar byed dgos pa de red/ bod mir mtshon cha dang sbyong brdar yag po zhig byung na gong gsal gi 'gog srung gi las 'gan de khur thub kyi red ’ ①ces bshad/ dus der a ris me mda' ring mda' dang / me shin me/na dang kreng gan zer ba'i me mda' sbag sbag lag 'jom sogs mtshon cha 'bor chen rgya gar brgyud bod du dbor nas gzhung zhabs ser skya lo na chung ba khag gcig dang / bod dmag rkang 'dzin pa khag gcig la mtshon cha gsar pa de dag bed spyod gtong lugs sogs skor dmag don sbyong brdar mang po byas pa ma zad/ dbyin ji'i so pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang las ka 'dra min sna tshogs la kha g.yar te bod du 'ongs thog mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis bod bcings 'grol gtong bar 'gog rgol byed pa'i ngan byus mang po btings pa red/ srid skyong stag brag sogs btsan dga' shog khas zhi drag gi thabs rnam pa sna tshogs la brten nas 'gog rkyen mang po bzos kyang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis da dung ngang rgyud ring pos kha ta bslab bya gnang ba dang / zhi ba'i thabs lam la brten nas bod bcings 'grol sa/tong ba'i ched du dge ba'i bshes gnyen chenapo shes rab rgya mtsho mtsho sngon brgyud bod du bslab bya gnang bar gtong gnang mdzad/ 'on te dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab rgya mtsho nag chu khar 'byor skabs srid skyong stag brag dang bka' shag sogs kyi bka' bkod ltar drag shugs la brten nas phyir bskrad/ de rjes shis khams zhing chen mi dmangasasrid gzhung gi kru'u 'i gzhon pa dge stag rin po che bod kyi mtho rim ① bod saganasakyi lo sayig cha phyog bsdus〉rgya yigashog grangs278lagasal/ 241

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/mi sna rnams la dge bshad sdig bkrol byed par chab mdor bar phebs pas de 'phral mdo smad spyi khyab kyis srid skyong stag brag dang bka' shag la snyan seng zhus par 6 dge stag sprul sku lha sar gtong mi chog la/ mar phyir log byas na'ang mi 'grigs :zhes pa'i brda lan 'byor/ kho pa tshos de ltar byed pa'i dmigs yul ni skabs der gal srid btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rgyab skyor 'og bod dmago mang po bsdu rub kyis bcings 'grol dmag la 'gog rgol byed pa'i bya ba de sgrub ma thub tshe dge stag rin po che brgyud zhi ba'i gros mol byed snyam pa de red/ dge stag rin po che chab mdor bkag nyar byed ring stabs mi legs par glo bur du dgongs pa rdzogs/ btsan dga' shog khas zhi drag gi thabs lam la brten nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod byed par bkag 'gog ji ltar byas kyang gcig gyur ni ldog thabs med pa'i lo rgyusakyi 'phel phyogs shig yin stabs/ mdun du skyod bzhin pa'i lo rgyus kyi rtsibs stong 'khor lo de log spyod stobs shugs gang 'dra zhig gis kyang 'gog thabs med cing / dpa' mdzangs brtul phod kyi mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis lcags stag (1950)lo'i zla 1༷tshes 7nyin chab mdor dpung 'jug byed 'go tshugs nas bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag dang yul dmag lnga stong bdun brgya so brgyad tsam gtor/ zla 10tshes 11nyin bod dmag ta dang mda' dpon sde dge sras skal bzang dbang 'dus 'go dmag dang bcas pa 'os langs byas nas chab mdo dngos su bcings 'grol btang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs kyis dga' bsu zhus pa'i gnas tshul de gang sar khyab rjes btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang /de'i rjes 'brang pa stag brag shog khar rdung rdog tsha nan zhig phog ste kha bral ri~X sdugs pa rnams snam zad sgron me lta bur gyur/

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalatsangarwa nga thubabastan 'jamadapalaye shesadang gabragangagadabangagasungarabakyidu skabs/dus der bod kyi dbang sgyur shog kha nang khul du'ang 'gal ba je cher phyin pa dang / phyi nang gang cir dka' ngal che ba'i dus la babs/ lcags sbrul (1941)lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab bod sa gnasakyi dbang 'dzin pa gtso bor gyur rjes a ri dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis rgyal gces stobs shugs la rdung deg tshad med btang ba dang / mes bod kha bral gtong ba'i bya spyod rab dang rim pa spel ba/ bod kyi rgya che'i ngal rtsol mang tshogs la brdab gsig dang / mnar gcod tshad med btang ba bcas la brten bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba bcas dgun gyi me tog bzhin nyams rgud du phyin/ kho pa tshos gzhung rgyu lkog bza' dang mi dmangs la bshu gzhog tshad med btang stabs rgya che'i mi dmangs kyis kho pa tshor 'khon 'dzin chen po byas nas zur za byed pa'i dmangs gzhas mang po btsams pa dper nas/ 6 khri 'bum bzas nas mi rgyags/ rdzong gzhis bco brgyad bzas song / ja sag yi dwags che mo/ gang song shod rogs gnang dang mi zer ba dang / 6 tag tag rgyal pos bzos song /stag lung brag gis bzos song / phul song lags dang phul song / rtsab ral phyag la phul song zer ’ ba lta bu'o/ dus der rgyal gces ser skya dpon rigs dang / ser skya mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis kha bral shog khar 'khon 'dzin chen po byas te srid skyong stag brag las gnas dgongs pa zhu dgos pa'i re ba bton stabs stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab srid skyong gi las gnas dgongs pa mi zhu thabs med kyi gnas su gyar nas rgyal gces stobs shugs la rgyal kha rlabs chen thob pa red/243

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgrodabyangs/bcu gnyis pa/ bod kyi lo rgyas kyi bde skyid nyi ma shar ba/'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs su a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod ham bzung byed rgyu'i lkog grabs byas shing / chu rta (1942)lor dbyi li ya thu'o yer si tha'i la sogs a ri'i sku tshab tshogs pa bod du 'ongs nas bod kyi 'brel yod dpon rigs dang gsang ba'i gros mol yang yangabyas te bod kyi kha bral ring lugs pa dang a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs dbar gyi 'brel ba nyin bzhin dam zab tu phyin zhing de rjes me phag (1947)lo'i zla ba 1༷par rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan dang mkhan chung chang khyim thub bstan tshe dpal/ rim bzhi spom mda' yar 'phel/ zur khang mda' dpon lha dbang stobs rgyal bcas tshong don rtog zhib tshogs pa zer ba sgrig 'dzugs byas te a me ri ka dang dbyin ji sogs la rtog zhib tu 'gro rgyu zhes bshad kyang don du skabs der bod kyi bal dang / pags rigs/ sman rigs rtsa che sogs phyir gtong tshong zog gi spyi'i rin gong a ri'i sgor khri sum cu tsam las med stabs ched mngags tshong don tshogs pa gtong ba'i dgos pa ci yang med gshes/ kho pa cho'i dmigs yul gco bo ni a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs pas sngon tshud nas lkog ngan bshams pa ltar a me ri ka dang dbyin ji/rgya gar sogs dang ngan 'brel gyis bod sger btsan zer bar rgyab skyor thob pa'i re stong byed pa de yin/ 'on kyang btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i 'dod blo dang yongs su 'gal te 'dzam gling rgyal khab mang pos kho tshor rgyab skyor ma byas staXsdu sa rgyal du 'gro ba'i lag 'khyer dang 'gro dngul sogs la'ang dka'

le'uganyisab/ rgyalatsangarwa:kho thubabastan 'jamadabal〉she dngastagabragangagadabangagasungarab dusaskabagangal mang po 'phrad cing / gnas tshul de dag la brten nas bod kyi tshong don tshogs pa de sa byi (1948)lo'i lo stod du nan cing la mi 'gro ka med byung ba dang / skabs der nan cing go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod kyi tshong don tshogs pa phyi rgyal du 'gro dgos don med lugs skor nan bshad byas kyang tshong don tshogs pas nyan 'jog rtsa ba nas ma byas par lkog tu nan cing la bca' sdod a ri'i gzhung tshab che mo si thu lud ting dang / dbyin ji'i gzhung tshab che mo ba sogs la ngan sbrel gyis phyi rgyal du 'gro chog pa'i lag 'khyer dang 'brel yod byed sgo rnams bsgrubs rjes bod kyi tshong don tshogs pas bod du phyir log byed rgyu yin lugs skor go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la snyan sgron zhus stabs kho pa tshor phyi rgyal gyi dngul lor dang / gnang skyes gang legs gnang ba ma zad/ ched mngags gnam gru btang ste hong kong bar du bskyal zhing / kho pa tshos sngon tshud nas lkog g.yo bshams pa ltar/hong kong du bca' sdod a ri'i gzhung don khang gi rogs ram 'og zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs mi bzhi a ri'i rgyal sa ho hrin kun du bskyod de tshong don kha la 'khyer ba tsam las don du a me ri ka dang bod dbar 'brel ba dngos su btsugs pa dang / a rir zla ba bzhi lhag tsam bsdad/ de rjes dbyin jir skyod de zla shas ring bsdad nas sa byi (1948)lo'i lo mjug tu rgya gar brgyud bod du phyir log byas pa red/skabs der mes rgyal skam sa chen po'i thog rtsa ba'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'gyur ldog byung ba ste/ le'o hran g.yul 'gyed dang phen cin g.yul 'gyed/ho'o had g.yul 'gyed bcas dmag 'thab chen po gsum la rgyal kha rlabs po che thob ste go min tang gi dmag shugs gtso bo rnams tshar bcad stabs cang ce hre'i srid dbang rlung gi dbus na gnas pa'i sgron me lta bur gyur pa dang /mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i mes rgyal skam sa chen po rim bzhin bcings ri~Xsal

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/gtong bzhin pa'i skabs der a me ri ka dang / dbyin ji/ nyin rdu/ bod du yod pa'i kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brangs pa stag brag sogs dngangs skrag rab tu skyes thog bod sdod nyin rdu srid gzhung gi las tshab ri ca san gyi g.yo sgyu'i sbyor bar brten nas kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brangs pa sne'u shag thub bstan thar pa dang /zur khang sogs la lha sar gung khran tang gi gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs dang gung khran tang mi yod stabs kho pa tsho mu mthud lha sar bzhag na phyi nang lag sbrel gyis bod 'di rgya yi 'og tu tshud nyen shin tu che bas kho pa tsho 'phral du phyir 'bud byed dgos brjod pa ltar/ mtho rim log spyod pa de dag gis nan cing du bca' sdod bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi don gcod khang gi ngo las yongs rdzogs phyir 'then byas pa ma zad/ sa glang (1949)lor lha sar bca' sdod go min tang gi dpon rigs yongs rdzogs dang / gung khran tang mi red ces lha sdod rgya bod las don mi sna yongs rdzogs phyir 'bud byas shing / da dung bod ljongs glog 'phrin las khungs zer ba dngos su btsugs te rgya bod dbar mchod yon gyi 'brel ba tsam las/ bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs min lugs skor gtam 'chal mang tsam spel ba dang / lo de'i zla 8par a me ri ku'i so pa'i 'go pa la'o 'ar thang mu si bod du btang ste mngon sum 'dzems med kyis krung go'i nang srid la the byus dang / bod kyi mtho rim log spyod shog khag la shog sbubs rlung 'tshang gis bod dmag rgya skyed btang ste mi dmangs bcings 'akrol dmag la 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byed dgos pa'i ngan byus du ma bshams kyang / lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo mdun du bskyod par log spyod kyi stobs shugs gang 'dra zhig gis kyang 'gog thabs rtsa ba nas med pa ni spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid las 'da' ga la nus/sa glang (1949)lor/ krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag giswā ni/ ljongs phud pa'i mes rgyal skam sa chen po bcings 'grol btang ste spyi

le'uganyisapa/ rgyal tshaban nga thubabastan 'jamadapalawe shesadangastagabragangagadabangagasungarab/dusaskabs/zla 10tshes 1nyin rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhis gnam bde sgo mo yang steng nas 'dzam gling yongs la krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes pa'i gzi brjid kyi khyab bsgrags mdzad cing / mtha' yas dgung sngon dbyings su skar lnga'i dar dmar lhab lhub g.yo ba dang / mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis dga' spro'i skad gsang 'byag sgra ldir ba ltar bsgrags pa dang / de nas bzung dmangs gtso ring lugs gsar pa'i gsar brje mjug sgril zhing / mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i spyi /gasdu ring sdigs kyi bgrod lam thog gom stabs chen pos mdun skyod byed ba na 'o/ sdu nga ṭā/sa rgyal gyi lho nub mtha' mtshams su gnas pa'i bod sa mtho'i thog gi mi rigs khag gi zhing bran rnams da dung sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las ma thar bar nyin mtshan kun tu bde skyid kyi nyi ma de gang myur bod du shar rgyu'i re sgug byed bzhin gnas yod/ dus der 〈mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par 〉thog tu krung go mi dmangs kyis nges par du bod bcings 'grol gtong rgyu yin zhes pa'i ched brjod cig spel bas a me ri ka dang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa/ kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brangs pa rnams dngangs skrag tshad med skyes te zhi drag thabs lam gang sar brten nas 'gog rkyen mang po bzos kyang /krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis da dung ngang rgyud ring pos kha ta bslab byaganang ba ma zad/ bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob ched dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab rgya mtsho mtsho sngon brgyud bod du bslab bya byed par gtong gnang mdzad kyang / nag chu khar 'byor skabs bod kyi btsan rgyal dga' nyer bsten mkhan kha bral shog khas drag shugs la brten nas phyir bskrad pa red/ 'on kyang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis kun khyab glog 'phrin brgyud krung dbyang gis bod du 'dzin pa'i mi rigs 'dra 2/shām

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/dang chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus dril bsgrags dang / bod du yod pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i stobs shugs mtha' dag mthar bskud de bod 'di gang myur dro skyid ldan pa'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang tshur log dgos pa'i bslab bya yang yang gnang ba dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar zhi ba'i gros mol byed ched lcags stag (1950)lo'i zla 7tshes 10nyin shis khams zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dge stag rin po che bod kyi mtho rim mi snar dge bshad sdig bkrol byed par gtong gnang mdzad de gong zla'i tshes 24nyin chab mdo sa gnas su phebs 'byor byung ba dang / khong gis 'brel yod ser skya dpon rigs khag la gang ci'i dril bsgrags dang slob gso gnang ba ma zad/tā la'i bla ma mchog zhal mjal te gang ci'i gnas lugs zhus chog pa'i re ba 'don gnang mdzad par mdo smad spyi khyab pas 'phral du bod sa gnas srid gzhung la dbe stag rin po che chab mdor phebs lugs skor snyan sgron zhus lan du 6 dge stag sprul sku lha sar gtong mi chog la/ mar phyir log byas kyang mi 'grigs mizhes 'khod yod/ de'i dmigs yul ni skabs der gal srid btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rgyab skyor 'og bod dmag dang yul dmag 'bor chen bsdu rub byas te bcings 'grol dmag la 'gog rgol byed pa'i bya ba de bsgrub ma thub tshe dge stag rin po che brgyud de zhi ba'i gros mol byed snyam pa de red/de nas mdo smad spyi khyab kyis bka' shag gi bka' ltar dge stag rin po che chab mdor bkag bzhag skabs stabs mi legs par lcags stag (1950)lo'i zla 〈tshes 22nyin glo bur chab mdor sku gshegs so/ dge stag grongs rkyen skor la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' shas byung rung / rjes su brtsad zhib skabs rgyun nad snyung gzhi 'phar ldab khar khong rang gis gsol sman mchod nyepa snro8 rkyen byas par mngon/

le'uganyisapa/ rgyalatsabarwazhed thubabastan 'jamadapalayeshesadang gabragangagadabangagasungarab/dus bas/dge stag rin po che ni mtshan snyan shin tu che ba'i rgyal gces sprul sku zhig yin te/ shing phag (1925)lor dmar dmag rgyang bskyod skabs dkar mdzes khul du 'byor bar khong gis bod rigs mang tshogs skul slong gnang ste dmar dmag la gang ci'i rgyab skyor lhad med mdzad cing / khong gis bod pa srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhin pa'i las 'dzin gnang ba dang / de rjes bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob chen rang srog blos gtong gis chab mdor phebs khar/ chab mdo dang lha sar yod pa'i gnyen grogs rnams la zhal ta bslab bya yang yang mdzad mthar bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong ched sku srog kyang legs skyes su phul ba'i rgyal gces ring lugs pa'i snying stobs der rang cag rnams kyis nam yang slob sbyong zhu 'os pa zhig yin/de nas bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong rgyur phyi nang gi 'gog rkyen mtha' dag sel ba dang / bod 'di mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang gang myur log thub pa'i ched du lcags stag (1950)lo'i ston dus su mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag chab mdo phyogs su dpung bskyod byas/ gnas tshul de thon rjes stag brag sogs bod kyi mtho rim log spyod pa dngangs skrag chen po skyes te btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang ngan pa lag sbrel gyis mtshon cha mang po bod du dbor ba dang / dmag skul brgyab ste dmag sgar gsar pa dang ser dmag sogs khams phyogs su rgyab skyor byed par btang / mdun du skyod bzhin pa'i lo rgyus kyi rtsibs stong 'khor lo de log spyod stobs shugs kyis 'gog thabs ga la yod/ lcags stag (1950)lo'i zla 10tshes 7nyin mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis chab mdor dpung 'jug byed 'go btsugs te bod dmag gi gtso shugs dmag dang yul dmag lnga stong bdun brgya so brgyad tsam dmag 'thab kyi nus pa shor ba bzos shing gong zla'i tshes 11nyin smar khams phyogs kyi sa srung bod dmag ta dang mda' dpon ༵ /ge

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/skal bzang dbang 'dus 'go dmag yongs kyis 'os langs byas pa bcas brgyud zla 10tshes 15nyin chab mdo grong rdal yongs su bcings 'grol btang bas btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brangs par rdung deg tsha nan phog cing / kho pa tshos ngo tsha kha skyengs kyis khungs med skad yang yang brgyab pa ste/ gong lo'i zla 10tshes 21nyin dbyin ji'i tshags par thog tsa krung gos bod la 'dzin pa'i bdag po'i dbang cha der lo rgyus thog nas gzhi 'dzin sa zhig rnyed mi thub ’ ces ngo tsha khrel med kyis bshad pa dang / dus mtshungs a me ri ku'i mnyam 'brel gsar 'gyur khang gis lun tun nas spel ba'i glog 'phrin gsar 'gyur nang du 6 krung gos bod du dmag bskyod btsan 'dzul byas pa de khrims dang mthun min brtag zhib byed kyi yod ’ zer ba sogs gtam 'chal sna tshogs spel zhing / bod kyi mtho rim log spyod shog kha ni dngangs 'tshab dang skyo snang cig car du 'char te ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su lhungs pa dang / bod kyi dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul gyi 'gal ba de sngar bas rno ngar dang mngon gsal dod por gyur te srid skyong stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab 'phral du srid skyong gi las gnas dgongs zhu byed dgos pa dang / tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog gis lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes dgos pa'i re ba bton pas srid skyong stag brag las gnas dgongs zhu mi bya thabs med du gyur cing / lcags stag (1950)lo'i zla 10tshes /nyin tā la'i bla ma mchog gis lugs gnyis kyi gtso 'gan yongs su bzhes gnang mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gas chab mdo sa khul yongs su blangs pa dang / bcings 'grol dmag la rgya che'i mi dmangs kyis dga' bsu zhu ba sogs dngos yod gnas tshul rnams gang sar khyab rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che gras bka' blo/ )cho / spyi khyab mkhan po drung rtsis sogs dang / gdan sa ser 'bras

le'uganyisapa/ rgyal tshabarwa nga thubabastan 'jamadapalaye shesadabastagabragangagadabang gsungarabakyidusaskabs/dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi bcas gsang ba'i gros mol thengs mang byas te tā la'i bla ma mchog lha sa nas nyen g.yol mdzad na dge mtshan che ba'i gnas lugs zhib gsal gsol bar brten lcags stag (1950)lo'i zla 11tshes 11nyin/ mkhan che blo bzang bkra shis dang rtsis dpon bde mkhar ba tshe dbang rab brtan gnyis la srid tshab bsko gzhag gnang ba dang / de 'phral tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas gro mor nyen g.yol du phebs/ dus der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa nang khul du'ang 'gal ba je cher gyur cing / btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rjes 'brangs pa nyung shas kyis tā la'i bla ma mchog phyi rgyal du gdan drangs nas a me ri ka dang dbyin ji sogs la skyabs gnas bcol te bod sger btsan yong bar brtson len byed dgos zhes brjod kyang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che gas mang che ba dang gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi/ lhag par du bod kyi ser skya mang tshogs yongs kyis de la ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas par brten phyi rgyal du gdan 'dren zhu ma thub/ rgyal gces dpon rigs mang pos phyi rgyal la rgyab rten bcol nas bod sger btsan yong thabs byed pa ni sgrub thabs med pa zhig yin/ de bas krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang gros mol gyis zhi ba'i thabs lam la brten nas bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol yong thabs byed pa ni yang dag pa'i byed thabs kho na yin zhes brjod don mthar rgyal gces dpon rigs dang / gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mi'i dgongs tshul la ser skya dpon rigs mang ches yi rangs byas te krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la gong bkur zhu rgyu dang / 'phral du 'thus mi btang ste zhi ba'i gros sol gnang rgyur gros thag bcad/ de nas krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bod sa gnasasrid gzhung nas 'thus mi mngags te mi rigs 'dra mnyam thog zhi ba'i gros mol byed dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar/ lcags yos (1951)shāsnyi spyi

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/zla 2par nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus/ thub bstan bstan dar/ thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi mi lnga bsko gzhag dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog gis tshogs gtso'i 'gan bzhes gnang rgyu gtan 'bebs gnang thog 'thus mi rnams gong lo'i spyi zla bzhi par snga rjes kyis pe cing du bde 'byor byung ba dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi li we han dang /krang cing u/ krang go hwa/ sun kre yon bcas la bsko gzhag gnang ba dang /li we han gyis tshogs gtso'i 'gan bzhes gnang rgyu'i gtan 'bebs gnang ste lcags yos (1951)lo'i spyi zla 4tshes 29nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rnams lhan 'dzoms thog zhi ba'i gros mol gnang 'go tshugs pa dang / phyogs gnyis tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul gzhir bzung mdza' brtse'i mthun lam gyi gros mol thengs mang gnang thog gong lo'i zla 5tshes 22nyin pe cing chin pho brang du/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung phyogs gnyis ku'i dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi rnams nasabod zhi bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags dngos su bkod pa'i mdzad sgo gzab rgyas tshogs pa dang / gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi gang ci'i 'brel ba'i skor la gtan 'bebs gsal zhing gsal ba gnang ba ma zad/ bod nang khul gyi lo rgyus thog lhag pa'i gnad don khag kyang thag gcod yang gnang ba sogs la brten tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs mang che ba/ rgya che/ snazlo tshogs bcas kyis brtsi bkur mtha' gcig tu thob yod/

le'uganyisab/ rgyal tshabarwarje'o thubabastan 'jamadapal〉shesadang gzagangagadabangagasungarab/du skabs/(tā la'i bla ma mchog gis/ ma'o kru'u zhir phul ba'i 〈bod zhi bas bye〉ngas pagrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la brtsi bkur zhu ba'i skor ga zlokhri /bya/nga mi dmangs srid gzhung gi ma'o kru'u zhi mchog la/'di lo bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bka' blon nga phod sogs dbang cha cha tshang yod pa'i sku tshab mi lnga ched gtong byas pa 1951lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i zla mjug la pe cin du slebs 'byor gyis krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis dmigs 'dzugs gnang ba'i dbang cha cha tshang yod pa'i sku tshab dang zhi ba'i gros mol byas te phyogs gnyis po'i sku tshab kyis mdza' brtse mthun lam gyi rmang gci'i thog 1951lo'i zla 5tshes 22nyin 〈bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉la ming rtags bkod par bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang bod rigs ser skya mi dam ngas rnams kyis gcig gyur thog srung brtsi zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma'o kru'u zhi dang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'og mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod dpung sder rogs ram bya rgyur 'bad pa lhod med kyis rgyal srung sra brtan dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs bod nas phyir 'bud byas te mes rgyal gyi sa khongs dbang cha gcig gyur la srung skyob bya rgyu bcas/bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas tā la'i bla mas spyi lo 1951lo'i zla 10tshes 24bod lcags yos zla /tshes 24nyin phul ’ zhes gsal yod/de nas tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sku 'khor dang bcas pa lcags yos (1951)lo'i zla 5tshes 18nyin gro mo nas chibs kha brgyur te zla 6tshes 15nyin lha sar phebs 'byor zin pa de ni btsan rgyal ring lugs ༵ 5)nga /

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/de'i rjes 'brangs pa'i lkog g.yo ngan byus thal ba'i rdul du brlags te bod 'di dro skyid ldan pa'i mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang tshur log thub pa byung ba red/ rlabs chen krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og spun zla mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi khe phan longs su spyod thub pa dang / bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs yar ngo'i zla ltar nyin bzhin gong du 'phel zhing / bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i nyi ma shar ri'i phrag pa'i rtse nas shar te bsil ldan sā la'i ljongs su 'phros shing / dus de nas bzung bod kyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs yongs rdzogs bde skyid dpal yon 'bar ba'i 'od zer stong ldan gyi mdun lam du bskyod pa lags so//254

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/sbyi lo 1876me byi/ 1 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho ni/ yab kun dga' rin chen dang yum blo bzang sgrol ma'i sras su bod zla 5tshes 5zhin dwags po glang mdun du sku 'khrungs/ 2 srid skyong rta tshag rje drung ho thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan se 'bras su chibs bsgyur gnang / 2 dbyin jis slar yang 'brug yul du btsan 'dzul byas pa ma zad/ bod du btsan 'dzul byed pa'i grabs byas/ 4 mu ru su'i ngo dpon nyi'i zer ba bod du bskor nyul du yongs stabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang ser skya mi dmangs yongs nas ngo rgol dang bkag 'gog mtha' gcig tu byas/spyi lo 1877me glang / 1 7gong ma kong zhu mchog gis srid skyong rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan la rgyal tshab thong shan gyi cho la gnang / 2 bod zla 10tshes 20nyin 7rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho ni gsol gzim mchod gsum dang / bka' blon g.yu thog lha dbang rdo rje/ tha'i ji mda' dpon sogs dpon rigs ser skya lnga bcu tsam gyis lha sar gdan drangs/ bod zla 11tshes 14nyin/ yang srid thub bstan rgya mtsho tshal gung thang du phebs/ dus der sngar srol ltar bka' mngags bod bzhugs am ban sung ku'e dang / las rogs se le ang rnam gnyis kyang tshal gung thang du phebs bsur phebs/ nyi 'od du yang srid rin po che zhal shar du gzigs su bzhugs/ sku rgyab tu rgyal tshab rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos ༵ snal

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/mtshan dang yongs 'dzin phur lcog rin po che/ ser skya dpon rigs rnams zhabs pus btsugs te bzhugs/ gnam bskos 7gong ma chen po kong zhus bstsal ba'i gser bum dkrugs mi dgos par tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid ngo 'dzin chog pa'i bka' yig de am ban mchog gis sgrog sbyang mdzad/ yang srid rin po che zhal shar gzigs te phyag dgu phrugs phul/ de rjes tshal gung thang nas chibs kha bsgyur/spyi lo 187ras stag 1 bod zla 1tshes 4nyin par+ṇa chen sku phreng brgyad pa blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug lha sar phebs/ tshes 11nyin/ srid skyong rta tshag rje drung ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / yongs 'dzin gzhon pa phur lcog rin po che rnam gnyis kyi phebs rogs 'og paṇa chen blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug tshal gung thang du phebs/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis zhal 'dzoms thog phan tshun mjal dar phul/ 2 paṇa chen sku phreng brgyad pa blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi drung du 7rgyal ba'i yang srid rin po ches dbu skra'i gtsug phud phul te rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan du rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ 2 yang srid thub bstan rgya mtsho rtse po tā la'i gser khrir mnga' gsol chog pa zhes/bka' mngags bod bzhugs am ban sung ku'e brgyud chin krung dbyang srid gzhung la gser snyan sgron/khyu lo 1879sa yos/ 1 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen po kong zhu'i bka' phyir phebs ltar/ bod zla 6tshes 14nyin 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol/ 2 gong ma chen pos rgyal yab kun dga' rin chen la gung gi cho lo dang / nor bu'i tog rma bya sgro gdong bcas bstsal/sngar srol ltar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sgos gzhis rgya che gnang bas ma~X zlodag che gras su gyur/ phyis yab gzhis glang mdun zhes 'bod/ 2

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/srid skyong rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin bgres par bsko gzhag bstsal/ 4 bod zla 10par sung ku'e am ban gyi las tshab tu sa'i ling ang am ban lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo bdun bzhugs/sbyi lo 1〈〈2chu rta/ 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo bdun la phebs skabs kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che skung gzhi drag po bzhes stabs srid skyong rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/byu lo 1882chu lug 1 bod zla 6tshes 16nyin kun gzigs paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ sku dmar gdung bkra shis lhun po'i mchod sdong chen por bzhugs su gsol/ 2 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho gsol gzim mched gsum dang / ser skya dpon rigs kyi phebs rogs 'og lho gnas su phebs/ 2 paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma ni/ yab rta mgrin dang yum dam chos mtsho gnyis kyi sras su bod zla 1tshes 12nyin dgas po ka shar yul du sku 'khrungs/ 4 tshogs mchod ser sbreng gi nub mo bal po ra ta ma na zer ba dang / phyogs 'grul khams rigs bud med gnyis byu ru nyo tshong ma 'grigs khar/ bal po'i tshong pas bud med gnyis la rkun khag btsugs pas bod rigs ser skya mang pos bud med gnyis la rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu byas te bal po'i tshong pa dang bod rigs mang tshogs dbar 'khrug zing langs/ 5 bod zla 10par gor kha ba'i dpon po ka dan su pi da lā lha sa nas rang yul du phyir log skabs/7rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshos ched mngags mjal 'phrad gnang ste/ gor bod dbar zhi ba'i mthun lam gtan gnas yong ba'i re ba mdzad/ 6 mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu ni/ yab rtsis rig mkhas can krang ma~X /ba

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/bam rtsis pa rnga bo cher grags pa dang / yum dbyangs can gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu'i dus su rtsed thang lnga mchod grwa tshang du chos zhugs gnang / dgung lo bcu bzhi tsam du lha sa lcags po ri 'gro phan gling du gso rig slob gnyer du phebs/ dka' ba gang la'ang ma 'dzems par mkhas dbang mang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas rig gnas spyi dang khyad par du sman rtsis la sbyang pa dpyis phyin pa mdzad de mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur/ 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i bka' bkod ltar/ lha sa sman rtsis khang gsar du btsugs nas mkhas mchog 'di nyid la rtse drung las tshan pa'i mtshan gnas dang sbrags sman rtsis khang gi dbu 'dzin du bsko gzhag bstsal/ de nas slob ma mang po 'dus te rig gnas spyi dang lhag par sman rtsis kyi gzhung lugs slob 'khrid legs par mdzad de sman rtsis la mkhas pa'i slob ma mang du thon/bod kyi rig gnas gong du spel bar mdzad 'phrin gzengs su thon pa byung stabs 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos dmigs bsal gyi gzigs bskyangs gnang ste mkhan chung gi mtshan gnas dang / de rjes sku bcar mkhan chen dar han gyi go ming gnang / krung dbyang srid gzhung gis kyang thugs khur che bzhes kyis rgyal yongs srid gros kyi u yon dang / sman rtsis khang gi dbu 'dzin du bsko gzhag bstsal/sbyi lo 1885shing bya/ 1 7rgyaladabang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog dang /srid skyong rta tshag ngas dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas bsam yas gtsug lag khang du zhabs sor 'khod/2 bal po'i rgyal pos ching dngul gun gsab dngul srang khri bcu gsum dang sum stong bzhi brgya tsam slog sprod dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ltar/ bod nas dngulasrang khri bcu dang / 7gong ma chen por gser snyan sgron pa ltar/ si khroX /spya mdzod nas dngul sung drug khri bdun stong tsam snga bsnur zhus te phyir

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/slog zhus pas gor bod dbar 'khrug zing ma byung / 2 bod zla 11par bka' mngags bod bzhugs am ban 'un hra'o lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo gsum tsam bzhugs/byu lo 1886me khri/ 1 bod zla 4tshes /nyin nyi nub khar rtse shar brgyud du kun gling rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis chab srid lo bcu gnyis bskyangs te dgongs pa rdzogs/ 2 bod zla 5tshes 12nyin bod ljongs tshogs 'du spyi gros kyis mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur thog de mo hu thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las srid 'dzin las tshab tu bsko gzhag bstsal te mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir mnga' gsol/ rtse gzim chung nas srid skyong na rim gyi dngul tham chen po dang / rnam sras gan mdzod nas de mo sku thog gong ma gnyis kyi dam phrug rtsis 'bul zhus/ 2 srid skyong de mo hu thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du rab gnas su phebs/khyu lo 1887me phag 1 dbyin jis lung thur la'i so lta khang phyir 'then byed dgos brjod par bod bzhugs am ban gyis mos mthun byas/'on kyang bod zla 2par se 'bras dga' gsum dang / gdan sa bkra shis lhun po/ bod kyi ser skya mi mang yongs nas bod bzhugs am ban brgyud 7gong ma chen por gser snyan sgron/ lung thur la ni bod kyi sa khongs bston med yin pas so lta khang phyir 'then ma byed thag gcod yin zhes brjod/ da dung dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa 'bras ljongs nas phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i re ba bton/2 bod zla 7tshes 15nyin/ dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa'i kha gnon du 'bras ljongs sa mtshams su mda' dpon lha lding sras dang / las rogs rtse mgron bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kong dmag dang bcas pa btang / de rjes bod zla 7tshes 28nyin / dmag sgar spyi khyab bka' blon lha klu ye shes nor ༵ 5)nga /

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/ram pa bkra shes dar rgyas/ dbus mda' nga phod/ gzhis rtser sdod res mda' dpon mkhar sna dang skyid sdod bcas sa mtshams su bskyod/ 2 bod zla 'tshes 5nyin/ srid skyong de mo hu thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las yongs 'dzin bgres par bsko gzhag bstsal te gsar mjal zhus/byu lo 1〈〈〈sa byi/ 1 bod zla 1por bkas mngags bod bzhugs khrang keng am ban dang las rogs hreng thad lha 'byor thog bod du lo ngo gsum bzhugs/ 2 bod zla 2tshes 7nyin/ dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa'i dpon dmag lnga brgya tsam gyis glo bur du lung thur la bshams nas tshur rgol byas/dus der bod dmag rnams so lta khang gi nye 'gram du ru bsgrigs te bsdad yod stabs dbyin dmag la rgol lan slog ste dmag dpon gcig bsad/ dmag mi rnams phyir bros/ 2 bod zla 2tshes 15nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang du gser bum dkrugs te 'os sprul chos kyi nyi ma paṇa chen sku phreng dgu par ngos 'dzin gnang / 'di zla'i tshes 22nyin gzhis rtse bde chen pho brang du gser khrir mnga' gsol/ 4 bod zla 2tshes 5nyin 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'bras spungs su zhabs sor 'khod de dbu ma gsan bzhes gnang /khyu lo 1〈〈khas glang / 1 bod bzhugs am ban 'un hra'o sanas dbyungabatang ste hreng thad bod du 'byor/ am ban des chin gong ma'i mgo 'dogs ring lugs kyi srid jus yongs su lag len bstar/ srid skyong de mo ho thog thu dang / bka' blon ram pa bkra shis dar rgyas/ gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mi sogs nas lung thur la bod kyi sa cha bston med yin lugs skor ji ltar zhus kyang nyan 'jog spu tsam yang ma byas par/ bod zla 2par am ban hreng thad ka li ka tar chings yig 'jog par bskyod/ 2 chin krung dbyang srid gzhung nas rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gcen po don grub rdo rje la gung gi swā sdunas brgyud 'dzin gnang /

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/sbyi lo 1890lcags stag tā chin 7gong ma chen pos bkas mngags bod bzhugs blon chen hreng thad dang / tā dbyin rgyal khab nas ched du mngags pa'i hin rdu khag lnga'i spyi khyab las don 'dzin mi blon chen ang dang po mnyam 'dzoms thog rgyal btsong chings yig don tshan brgyad bzhagakhyu lo 1891lcags yos/ 1 bod bzhugs blan chen hring thad slar yang gro mo rin chen sgang du bskyod/ dbyin ji'i 'thus mi sba'o ye ('bras spyi blon chen yang zer )dang phan tshun gros mol yun ring gnang / dbyin phyogs nas tshul min gyi re 'dun mang tsam bton pas bod phyogs nas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ 2 bod zla 9par bod bzhugs blon chen hring thad gro mo rin chen sgang du tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs/ 2 bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban khu'i hon dang las rogs yan mu'u bod du gtong gnang mdzad/sbyi lo 1892chu sprul/ chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab zi khron yo shi dmag sgar gyi tshan sbyangs ho'o khrang yun dang / dpya khral pi ho nā (dbyin ji'i mi rgyud yin zer )dbyin ji'i 'thus mi 'bras ljongs su bca' sdod srid 'dzin blon chen sla'o yer bcas thun mong gros mol yun ring byas te rgya gar rdo rje gling du sna gdong 'gag sgo'i skor chings yig don tshan dgu ba'agasbyi lo 1895shing lug 1 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo nyi shur phebs te/ bod zla 1tshes 15nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang du yongs 'dzin sku gzhon phur lcog blo bzang tshul khrims 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ 2 bod kyi dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul 'gal ba shugs cher phyin te bka' shag dang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi'i re 'bod ltar/ de mo ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas srid skyong dgongs zhu mdzad/ 2 bod zla /tshes /nyin/ pho brang chen po rtse po tā la'i srid zhi'i phun tshogs pho brang du 7rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshos 2༷/sa

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/gnyis kyi thugs 'gan yongs su bzhes/spyi lo 1896me sprel/ 1 bod zla 1lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs su 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho tshogs phebs thogs ston chen bshams/dge 'dun pa rnams la bka' chos gnang / 2 bod zla 2pa'i nang bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban 'un had lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo lnga bzhugardzu/ lo 1899sa phag 1 srid skyong zur pa de mo ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas dang nyag sprul sogs 'dzin bzung byas thog chos rar bcug grwa tshang gi rgyu dngos rang 'jags thog de mo bla brang gi rgyu dngos yongs rdzogs gzhung bzhes btang / mthar srid skyong zur pa de mo stod sa dga' rdzong du rgyang 'bud thog sa gnas de ga'i ri shur zhig nang bkrongs/ der dran rten gyi rdo phung zhig dngos su mjal rgyu yod zer/ de lo sku gshegs tshul skor yig tshags khag nang bshad tshul mi 'dra ba shin tu mang / 2 nyag sprul rtse shar chen lcog la btson 'jug byas rjes mgul bcad de rang srog lcebs/ 2 su ru su'igasang nyul rdo rje g.yib rang yul du phyir log u ru su'i gong mas kho par dmigs bsal gyi thug 'phrad byas te g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba mang du bshams/bod la phyir log byed skabs u ru su'i gong mas tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtshor 'bul rgyu'i yi ge zhig 'khyer yong nas bod kyi gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing che bas u ru su kho nas bod la rgyab skyor byed thub lugs skor mang du bshad/sbi lo 19༷༷lcags byi/ 1 bod zla 2par tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho gsol gzim mchod gsum sogs ri bo dga' ldan dang / chos 'khor rgyal/ 'khrungs gzhis/ rtsa ri/ lho gnas sogs la chibs bsgyur mdzad/ 2 bod zla 2par 'un had am ban dgongs pa rdzogs/deswā ༵༵ tshab chin hran am ban phyir 'then thog las tshab tu g.yus kung am

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/ciban lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo gsum bzhugs/spyi lo 1902chu stag 1 bod zla 4tshes 15nyin/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang du paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi mas 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ de nas gtsang du phyir phebs/2 bod zla 11par bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad lha 'byor thog bod la lo lnga bzhugs/byu lo 1902chu yos/ 1 dbyin jis bod 'bras sa mtshams zhi ba'i gros sol thog thag gcod dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ltar/ bod zla 2tshes 17nyin 7gong ma chen po'i bka' ltar/ bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad kyis gnas gsum pa'i kre h+phu ha 'un shi'i dang gro mo'i dpya khral si spa 'ar/drung yig che mo ba blo bzang 'phrin las/ dbus mda' tsha rong dbang phyug rgyal po bcas 'thus mi bzhi dang / las byar rtse drung dge 'dun chos dar dang /brgya dpon 'gyur med tshe brtan/ lding dpon lnga/ rgya sbyong dmag bcu gnyis bcas mngags gtong mdzad/ dbyin dmag gi dmag dpon tung ha'o h+phang dang / 'bras ljongs su bca' sdod dbyin ji'i kron yon tha gnyis nas dbyin ji'i 'thus mi'i ming 'khyer te dmag mi nyis brgya tsam 'khrid thog bod la 'brel gtugs rtsa ba nas ma byas par sa mtshams brgal te gam pa rdzong du 'ongs/ da dung 'thus mir bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad dang / bka' blon zhig yong dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ltar/ chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad 'phral du 'gro dgos pa'i bka' phab/'on kyang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis gam pa rdzong du gros mol byed par ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ 2 bod zla 11par hrang zha'o dmag dpon rung ha'o rlung gis sne 'khrid byas pa'i dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i dpung dmag sing pa'i rkang dmag chig stong bzhi brgya tsam dang / gor ṣa'i da~X mi

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/bdun brgya/ rta dmag mi grangs brgya/ me phyogs dang me mda' sbag sbag gi dmag sde gcig sbang kha la'i bzo dmag sde khag gcig g.yul 'gyed dmag gi sman khang sogs mi grangs chig khri lhag tsam nag thang du 'dzoms/2 bod zla 12tshes 12nyin dbyin ji'i hrang sha'o dmag dpon rung ha'o sprung gis btsan 'dzul dmag stong phrag 'ga' zhig 'khrid de rang rgyal gyi sa mtshams gro mor btsan 'dzul byas/ de nas rim bzhin phag ri dang / stod la/ gu ru phyogs su bskyod/ 4 bka' blon bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rjes dbyin ji'i dpon dmag dang ngan 'brel byas stabs gnas dbyung btang stabs sku gzugs je sdug tu song nas dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i skag tu dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/khyu lo 1904shing 'drug 1 dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas rgyal rtser btsan 'dzul byas/ bod kyi ser skya mi mang yongs nas mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams srung skyob byed ched dpa' ngar zhum med kyis 'thab rtsod byas/de nas dbyin dmag gis rim bzhin lha sa'i phyogs su dpung 'jug byas/2 bod zla 6tshes 15nyin gyi nam phyed tsam du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum thub bstan rgya mtsho sku 'khor zhabs 'bring hrag bsdus bcas sog yul du bros byol phebs/ de'i ring dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan rgyal tshab tu bsko gzhag bstsal/ 2 bod zla 6tshes 16tsam du dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa'i dmag dpung lha sar 'byor/ bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u bad dang / rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis snga rjes su dbyin ji'i hrang zha'o dmag dpon rung ha'o drung la lta bar phebs/btsan 'dzul pas dbyin bod dbar chings yig 'jog dgos pa'i re ba bton/ am ban g.yu'u thad ni nyams chung thabs med cig yin pas/ bod sa /nās srid gzhung la btsan shed kyis chings dan 'jog dgos pa'i bka'

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyusakyi lo tshigasagal chen/phab/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rgyal gces dpon rigs rnams kyang gnam gyis sa brdungs pa lta bu bya thabs dben pa'i gnas su gyur te/ bod zla 7par lha sa'i chings yig ces pa rgyal 'tshong chings yig don tshan bcu bzhag 4 bod zla rapar dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa'i dpung dmag lha sa nas phyir log ga skyid rgu mdor bca' bzhugs she thar dran tā ran dang / cun lang ru gnyis kyis 7gong ma kong zhur gser snyan sgron pa'i bka' bzhin/nyag rong sa gnas kyi bdag gnyer dbang cha phyir len gnang / byu lo 19༷5shing sprul/ 1 paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma dbyinaji btsan 'dzul pas rgya gar du btsan 'khrid byas/ 2 7rgyal dbang thub rgya mtsho nang sog tu phebs/ gdul bya 'gro ba'i don du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs kyis dad gus tshad med zhus stabs khal kha rje btsun dam pa phrag dog langs te mi 'dod pa'i ngang tshul bstan/ tā la'i bla ma dang rje btsun dam pa dbar mi mthun pa'i rkyen byung bas bod la phyir log phebs 'dod gnang / dus der chin gong mas kyang bod la phebs dgos pa'i bka' phab/byu lo 1906merta/ 1 dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas chings yig gi snying don la gzhigs te chu 'bi ham bzung byas/ rgyal rtse dang / phag ri/ gro mo sogs la dbyin ji'i tshong ra btsugs/ 2 bod zla 4par/ tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas dā khu ral nas chibs kha bsgyur/ lam bar dgon gnas gal che khag la gnas gzigs dang 'brel mcho sngon zhing chen khongs zi ling du zhabs sor 'khod/ 2 chin 7gong ma kong zhu'i bka' bzhin/ bod kyi don zhib pa krang dbyin thang rgya gar rdo rje brgyud lha sar phebs/ bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad sogs dang / bod kyi dpon rigs bka' blon phun tshogs dbang ldan sogs kyi byas snrostu la
