bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i dbyangs/gzhigs te gnas dbyung btang / 4 dbyin jir chings dngul sgor 'bum lnga sprod dgos stabs bka' blon gsar byung tshe brtan dbang phyug dang / las bya bla phyag bsam mkhar/ rtse dpon khe smad pa bcas chings dngul sprod par ka li ka tar bskyod/ dngul 'bab tshang ma gong ma tshang nas gnang / 5 paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa rgya gar nas gtsang du phyir log mdzad/ 6 bod zla 10par bod bzhugs am ban g.yu'u thad gnas dbyung btang ba'i las tshab lan yus am ban lha 'byor thog bod du lo lnga bzhugs/ 7 dbra ston snang gsal nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis bon gyi gdan sa a grags snang gsal dgon pa phyag btab/spyi lo 1907me lug 1 bod zla 10par dga' ldan khri zur blo bzang rgyal mtshan la srid skyong bsko gzhag bstsal/ bod zla 11tshes 12nyin srid khrir mnga' gsol/ las rogs su bshad zhol chang gsum te bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje dang / bka' blon bla ma chang khyim/ zhol khang pa bcas bsko gzhag bstsal/ 2 so nams las khungs dang ja tshwa las khungs gsar du bzlogs/ / bka' blon tsha rong dbang phyug rgyal po gro mo sa mtshams zhing da da spyo zlo 1ste/0〈sa sprel/ 1 bod zla 1por rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas tha'e yon du phebs 'byor zin pas sa gnas de ga'i dpon dmangs rnams kyis bsu ba zhabs tog gang legs mdzad/ de nas rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar gnas mjal du phebs pa'i gnas tshul phyir gyar/ snga rjes su 'jar man dang / u ru su/ ri pin sogs rgyal khab khag gi dpon rigs dang chos pa 'ga' zhig gis mjal bar 'ongs/ bod zla 7par gong ma kong zhu mchog gis pho nya mngags te/ tā la'i bla ma rgyal sa pe cigā 76 phebs dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas rgyal sa

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/pe cin du phebs/ 7gong mas mjal 'phrad gnang / 2 bod zla 9par 7gong ma kong zhu dang / yum tshe shi'i thad ha'o snga rjes su dgongs pa bde bar gshegs/ 2 bod zla 10par 7gong ma sha'on thung gser khrir mnga' gsol/dus der chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa dbar 'gal ba ches cher phyin/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mi sna ched du mngags te 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho gang myur lha sar phyir phebs dgos pa'i re ba zhus pa ltar/ chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gis kyang de ltar mos mthun gnang / 4 bod zla 10par rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bzlos pa pe cin nas chibs kha bsgyur te sku 'bum byams pa gling du zhabs sor 'a da/khyu lo 1909sa bya/ 1 bod zla /par tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa nag chu'i nye 'gram du phebs/ paṇa chen rinapo che'i sku tshab mgron gnyer che mo dang / sa skya'i bdag mo/ mtshur phu kurma pa/ hor khang dza sag lha klu'i gung / lcang can gung sogs dpon rigs che gras 'ga' zhig phebs bsur phebs/ nag chur phebs rjes paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma dang / rgya bod dpon rigs/ nag chu'i ser skya mi mang yongs nas bsu ba dang bsnyen bkur gang legs zhus/ nag chur zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bzhugs/ bod zla 10tshes 2༷nyin lha sar phebs 'byor byung 'phral bod bzhugs am ban lan yus dang 'gal ba shugs chen byung /2 kra'o 'ar phung bod sdod am ban dang / zi khron dang yun nan sa mtshams don gcod blon chen du bsko gzhag bstsal/ 2 bod zla 11tshes 17nyin dga' ldan khri zur blo bzang rgyal mtshan srid skyong dgongs zhus thog bshad zhol chang gsum la sde srid bsko gzhag thog srid khrir mnga' gsol/khyu lo 191༷lcags khri/ 1 bod zla 1tshes 2nyin/ zi khron ༵ /ma

bodakyi nyerabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/dmag 'ba' dang / li thang / tsha ba rong sogs gzhung lam brgyud bod phyogs su 'ongs/ bod zla 2par kong por rgya 'byor/ lam bar sde 'bangs mi ser la mnar gcod tshad med btang / bod dmag gis phar rgol mtha' gcig tu byas kyang / mthar dmag pham te bod dmag brgya lhag tsam srog shor/'go dpon gtso bo bco brgyad tsam ske bcad de mgo bo khrom ston byas pas mi rnams snying rtsa 'dar bzhin dbang med du mgo sgur/ 2 bod zla 1tshes 2nyinanam phyed yol tsam du 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho rtse pho brang nas nor bu gling khar phebs/ grabs rags bsdus mdzad de sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa ra ma sgang gru kha don te bros phebs/ bod sdod am ban lan yus kyis gnas tshul de thos 'phral rta dmag sum brgya tsam btang ste rjes 'ded btang / 2 dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan slar yang rgyal tshab bsko gzhag gnang / de'i phyag rogs sne'u shar mkhan chen mkhyen rab phun tshogs bsko gzhag bstsal thog tā la'i bla ma'i tog gnas gnang / bka' tshab tu bsam pho dang / gung zang pa bsko gzhag bstsal/sbyi lo 1911lcags phag 1 spyi zla 10tshes 10nyin sun krung hran gyis 'u khrang gyen langs bslangs te man ju srid gzhung la ngo rgol byas te gong ma'isrid gzhung mgo rting bslogs/ 2 ston khar tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho ka sbug tu phebs nas 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i spro khang du bzhugs/ 2 paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma gtsang phyogs su phyir phebs/ 4 khung po a bla grags pas bon gyi gdan sa a grags snang gsal dgon pa zhig gso mdzad/sbyi lo 1912chu byi/ 1 bod zla 5tshes 10nyin 7rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho sku 'khor zhabs 'bring dang bcas ka sbug nas bod du chibs kha bsgyur/rgya ༵༵ du yod pa'i bod mi dang / dbyin ji/ 'bras ljongs pa sogs kyi

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo zigs gal chen/dpon rigs dang dad ldan mang tshogs kyis phebs skyel gzab rgyas bshams/de nas rim bzhin gro mo rin sgang dang / phag ri rdzong / bsam ldings dgon par phebs/ dus der lha sar dmag thag yongs su chod med stabs bod zla 12paragazhi nas lha sar phebs/ 2 bod zla 2tshes 15nyin kra'o 'ar phung gi dmag dpung gis se ra dgon par dmag drangs/ 2 bod zla 10tshes 20nyin/ dmag 'thab yongs su thag chod/ lcags phag gsar brje langs te kra'o 'ar phung srog thog btang / bod du yod pa'i kho pa'i dmag mi lhag ma rnams rgya gar brgyud phyir log 4 spyi zla 6tshes 14nyin zi khron dang / yun nan du yod pa'i dmag dpung khag gcig khams khul du 'byor/ dus der dbyinajis bod du dmag mi gtong mi chog ces ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs yon hre khad srid gzhung gis bod bskyod dmag dpung 'gro mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i bka' phab/ 5 tsha rong dbang phyug rgyal po dbyin dmag dang ngan 'brel yod lugs gleng brjod mang po byung bas srog thog btang ba dang / kha dbang gzhung bzhes gnang /spyi lo 1912chu glang / 1 bod zla 10tshes 12nyin/ hin rdu'i byang ngos sim la zhes pa'i yul der sim la'i gros tshogs 'go tshugs/ 2 gros tshogs 'dir zhugs mkhan gras su krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab bod kyi sha'on rmu hre dran dbyi h+phan dang / sha'on spru hreng gzhon pa wang had phen/dbyin ji'i sku tshab phyi 'brel blon chen rmad kha ma hung dang / krung go'i las don gyi cha rgyus pa la'o si/ bod kyi las don gyi cha rgyus pa spa'o yer/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab srid blon bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje dang /las rogs dmag spyi chung ba tha'i ji khri smon pa/ shod mgron che chung / gdan sa gsum dang drung rigs ser skya'i 'thus mi bcas yod/byu lo 1914ging stag 1 bod zla 5tshes 10nyin/ dbyi)6 /'i

bod kyi nye rabs lo sa ta ra'i dbyangs/'thus mi rmad kha ma hung dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi bshad sgradapal 'byor rdo rjes lkog tu khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas sim la'i chings yig zer bar ming rtags bkod/ 2 lo mjug tu zla bzang dgra 'dul gyi byas rjes la gzhigs te bod dmag gi dmag spyir bskos/ ji khri smon dmag spyi mkhan chung du bsko gzhag bstsal/ de nas bod dmag bcos sgrig dang rgya bskyed thog dmag mi khri gcig btsugs/ de dag dmag sgar khag tu bgos te mda' dpon dang / ru dpon/ brgya dpon/ zhal ngo (lding dpon yang 'bod )bcas gsar du bskos/ 2 dbyin jis rgyal rtser slob grwa btsugs te kho pa'i rjes 'brangs pa gso skyong byas/sbyi lo 1915shing yos/ byang ngos pa rigs 'dzin rdo rje dang / smin grong mkhyen rab kun bzang / skyid spug dbang 'dus nor bu/ sgog mkhar bsod nams rgyal po bcas sku drag gi phru gu bzhi dbyin ji'i rgyal sa lun tun du glog las dang / sbrag tar/ gter las/ dmag don bcas slob sbyong byed par btang / de dag gi 'go khrid du rtsis pa lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gtong gnang mdzad/khyu lo 1916me 'drug 1 lha ldan sman rtsis khang gsar du btsugs/de'i dbu khrid du mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu bsko gzhag bstsal/ slob phrug rnams ni phyi nang khag gnyis su dbye zhing / nang khag gi dgon sde khag dang / dmag sgar khag nas phal pa'i phru gu rig pa rno ba khag gcig khral du bsdu ba dang / phyi khag ni dang blangs kyis slob grwar yong mkhan phru gu khag gcig bskong bsdu byas thog rig gnas spyi dang / khyad par sman rtsis kyi gzhung lugs kyi bka' khrid legs par mdzad de mkhas dbang rab dang rim pa thon/des bod kyi rig gnas gong du spel ba dang / rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi gzugs kha~Xde thang yong phyir gal che'i nus pa thon pas skye bo kun gyis bsngags

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/pa'i yul du gyur/ 2 bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis hor spyi khyab pa btsugs te tsho pa khag mnga' 'og tu 'dus/byu lo 192༷lcags sprel/ srid blon bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje dang /srid blon chang khyim pa snga rjes su dgongs pa rdzogs/sbyi lo 1921lcags bya/ 1 bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis phyi nang gi dgos mkhor gzhigs te phogs khang las khungs gsar du btsugs/ 2 srid blon zhol khang pa kher rkyang gis chab srid bskyangs/sbyi lo 1922chu phag 1 bod kyi 'thung ja yul phyogs gzhan nas 'dren mi dgos pa'i ched du ja chu rong du ja shing 'debs las byas/ de'i 'go khrid du ru dpon las tshan pa byams pa skal bzang bsko gzhag bstsal/2 phogs khang gsar du btsugs te bkra shis lhun po nas dmag phogs 'bru khal chig khri bsgrub dgos pa'i bka' phab stabs bkra shes lhun po dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar 'gal ba mthun thabs med pa'i gnas su gyur te/bod zla 11tshes 15nyin gyi mtshan mo paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa byang lam brgyud mes rgyal nang sar bros byol du phebs/2 lha sar pu li si'i dmag sgar gsar du btsugs te/ lha sa'i phyogs bzhir pu li si tsho khang bzhi btsugs thog dmag mi lding khag re re bzhag sung lam gtso bo khag la nyin mtshan gtod med pu li si dmag mi nyal bya bzhag pa'i srol gtod/ de'i 'go khrid du bsod nams legs ldan nam legs ldan sa hob dang / rtse drung mkhyen rab kun bzang bsko gzhag bstsal/skyo ba lo 1924shing byi/ lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gtsang du khral zhib tu ba da/sbyi lo 1925shing glang / 1 sgrag khang dang de rjes tar khang gsar du btsugs/ de'i 'go khrid du rtse drung grags pa chos rgyal dang / shod drushā spyal

bod kyi nye rabs lo sa ta po'i sgradabyangs/bzhi bskos/ 2 bod dang zi khron gyi sa 'brel khul de dag shes khams dmigs bsal sa khul zhes ming bsgyur byas/ 2 paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa rgyal sa pe cin du 'byor/de nas byang shar dang / nang sog nan cing / ha'ang kro'u/ mtsho sngon sogs su gzigs bskor dang gnas mjal du phebs/sbyi lo 1926me stag 1 dbyin jis kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brangs pa tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul la shog sbubs rlung 'tshang gis gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs btsugs te tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i srid dbang mgo rting slog rgyu'i lkog g.yo'i ngan byus bshams/ sgrig 'dzugs nang zhugs mkhan mang che ba ni bod dmag gi dmag dpon gzhon nu rnams yin/ gsang gnas de rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshos mkhyen 'phral tsha rong rta bzang dgra 'dul bod dmag gi dmag spyi'i go gnas spabs/ rgyal rtse'i dmag dpon slob grwa mtshams 'jog byas pa ma zad/ gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs nang zhugs mkhan dpon rigs tshang ma gnas dbyung btang / 2 bod dmag gi dmag dpon sbrum pa bas (sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku mched yin zer )gsang gtam skyel ba'i byas rjes la gzhigs te bod dmag gi dmag spyi bsko gzhag bstsal/ 'on kyang kho pa ni 'jon thang zhan pa dang / sgyid lugs che ba'i nyal thag a pa zhig yin stabs don du dmag spyi'i dbang cha dmag drung lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi lag tu lhung /2 srid blon zhol khang dgongs pa rdzogs te de'i las rogs glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug srid blon du bsko gzhag bstsal/spyi lo 1927me yos/ 1 rab byung bcu drug pa'i rtsis 'go tshugs/2 rig gnas spyi dang khyad par sman rtsis mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gis rig ldan snying thig bcoms/273 lo 192/sa 'drug 1 spo bo'i khral rigs 'phar snon dang / khral

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/gzhung gsar du bkod rtsis byas stabs spo bo ka gnam sde pa bdud 'dul gyis rang nyid kyi dbang bsgyur sra brtan yong ched bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang dmag 'thab lan mang byas/ 2 dgun dus su 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos ma skul dang blangs thog rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar bca' sdod bod kyi mkhan po pa sangs dang / de rjes pe cin g.yung ho kung ste dga' ldan byin chags gling gi mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas rnam gnyis nan cing du gtong gnang mdzad de krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa ma zad/ snga phyi'i gnas lugs babs sel zhus/byu lo 1929sa sprul/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis spo bo ka gnam sde par dpung 'jug byas/ ka gnam sde pa bdud 'dul gyis g.yog 'ga' zhig 'khrid de rgya gar du bros/ dbyin ji'i dpon hor sam la mgo btags zhus/khyu lo 1920lcags rta/ 1 g.yung ho kung ste dga' ldan byin chags gling gi mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi 'thus ra bsko gzhag bstsal/ 2 bod zla 12par go min tang krung dbyang sridagazhung bod sog u yon lhan khang gi 'thus mi she go le'ang dang / drung yig yun hran rgya gar brgyud bod du btang yang / 'thus mi she go le'ang chu shur du 'byor rjes dgongs pa rdzogs/ drung yig yun dran lha sar zla shas bsdad kyang don gnad gang yang thag gcod ma thub par phyir logabyu lo 1921lcags lug 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gis tshul khrims bstan 'dzin sogs nan cing du gtong gnang mdzad de nan cing du bca' sdod don gcod khang dngos su btsugs/ krung dbyang dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung bar gyi 'brel ba 'thus sgo tshang du phyin/bca 1922chu sprel/ spyi zla 1tshes 28nyin/ 1 ri pin btsan rgyal ring lugs pas rang rgyal du btsan 'dzul byas stabs tā la'i bla ma mcho17 byeng /

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis nas krung dbyang srid gzhung la rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu zhus te ri pin btsan 'dzul par ngo rgol byed pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/2 bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dmag skul brgyab ste grong drag dmag sgar gsar d+dhā zlo ཿkā//2chu bya/ bod zla 10tshes 20nyin/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo lnga bcu nga brgyad du phebs te gzim khri mtha' can du gyur/ gtam ngan de khyab 'phral lha sde mi sde yongs sdug bsngal gyi khung bur lhungs/sbyi lo 1924shing khri/ 1 drung rtsis tshogs 'du che mo'i thog srid blon gsar bskos byed phyogs skor mol bsdur dang 'brel go min tang krung dbyang sridagazhung la gser snyan sgron pa ltar/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes srid blon dang / glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug srid blon las rogs su bsko gzhag bstsal/ 2 bod zla 4par/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis hong rma'o sung bod du mngags/ khong lha sar 'byor skabs bod sa gnasasrid gzhung gis bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas mdzad/ de rjes rtse pho brang chen po po tā lar mdzad sgo rgya che 'tshogs/ 7rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshor 6 hu go hwa phu tshe yon jo tā hre zhes pa'i rjes snon cho lo dang / g.yang ṭi'i 'ja' sa dang dam kha bcas bstsal/ gser gdung gi zhal 'debs rin bral dngos po gang legs gnang / 2 rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgongs pa gzhan don du rdzogs rjes bod kyi gnas tshul de bas rnyog 'dzing ches cher phyin/ dus der lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal sogs nas skyid phyogs dgongs mthun zhes pa'i gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs btsugs/ bod du dbyin ji'i lam lugs 'dzugs dgos pa'i skul slong byas stabs tshogs mi nang khul kha swā /thun par kho pa tsho'i skog g.yo rnams bka' blon khri smon brgyud srid skyong

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jal dpal ye shes la snyan seng zhus/ de ma thag tu bka' shag gis lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal 'dzin bzung byas te/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms thog 'dri ba nan tan blangs/ mthar mig 'bras gnyis ka bton pa ma zad/ kha dbang gzhung bzhes dang / tshe gang btson du 'jug rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas/ tshogs mi gtso bo 'ga' zhig rgyang 'bud btang spyi/ lo 1925shing phag bod zla 6tshes 5nyin tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid yul gru gang sar btsal 'tshol byas mthar/ a mdo sku 'bum byams pa gling gi shar smad stag mtsher byi'i char yab chos skyong tshe ring dang / yum bsod nams mtsho'i sras su 'khrungs pa'i khye'u de yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus/ de nas mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gzhung la'ang yang srid bod du gdan drangs chog pa'i re 'dun ji ltar zhus kyang kru'u zhi rma pu h+phang gis mos mthun ma byas stabs/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la gser snyan sgron/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis yang srid bod du gdan drangs chog pa'i bka' phab pa dang /bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kyang gron dngul gang mang sprod dgos pa byung /byu lo 1927me glang / bod zla 10tshes 28nyin/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma dgung grangs lnga bcu nga bzhir phebs te dgongs pa rdzogs/sbyi lo 192ras stag paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mtsho sngon du sku 'khrungs/khyu lo 1929sa yos/ 1 bod zla 10par tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sku 'khor dang bcas pa lha sar phebs/ ser skya dpon rigs dang dad ldan mang tshogs yongs nas bsu ba gzab rgyas mdzad/de nas rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang / srid zur/ gung / bka' blon/ spyi khyab mkhan po sogs kyi phebs rogs 'og lha ldan gtsug lag khang du byon na17 rdo bo

bod kyi nyerabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgradabyangs/shākya mu ner thugs smon mtshams sbyor mdzad rjes nor gling bskal bzang pho brang du gdan drangs/ 2 bod zla 1༷tshes 12nyin rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes dang / mtshan zhabs dar han stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab rnam gnyis nas yongs 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan yongs su bzhes/ yang srid rin po che sprul pa'i gtsug phud bzhes/ mtshan du 'jam dpal ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang 'dus mtshungs pa med pa'i sde zhes gsol/sbyi lo 1940lcags 'drug 1 bod zla 1tshes 14nyin rtse pho brang chen por tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir mnga' gsol/ 2 go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis rwa sgreng 'jam dpal ye shes la 6 spru go hung hran hre zhes pa'i cho lo gnang / 2 skyed rgu mdo nas paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma'i sku gdung bod du gdan drangs/ gzhis rtse bkra shis lhun po'i dgon gyi dngul sdong chen mor bzhugs su gsol/sbyi lo 1941lcags sprul/ phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen mang pos rkyen pas rwa sgreng lo gsum ring srid blon dgongs zhu mdzad de stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab rgyal mtshan srid blon gyi khrir bskos/khyu lo 1942chu / 1 bod zla 5tshes 22nyin khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas phyi 'brel las khungs btsugs/ bod du bca' sdod dbyin ji dang bal po'i sku tshab la slad phyin las don mtha' dag phyi 'brel las khungs ma brgyud par bka' shag la 'brel ba byed mi chog zer/ de bzhin go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi don gcod khang gi dpon rigs rnams kyis krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bka' ltar phyi 'brel las khungs la 'brel ba rtsa ba nas ma byas stabs dbyinaji'i rjes 'brangs pa rnams ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su lhungs/ 2 hoḥ/ 6khyab pa med pa bzos te tsho pa so dgu de dag snye rong rdzong sogs rdzong

bod kyi nyerabs lo sa kyi lo tshigs gal chen/khag drug gi mnga' 'og tu gtogs/sbyi lo 1942chu lug mon zhib mda' dpon bying pa ba dang rtse mgron phun rab pa gnyis nas zhib gzhung gsar du bkod/spyi lo 1944shing sprel/ 1 dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas dpung dmag btang ste rang re'i rdza yul smad gyi wa lung la btsan 'dzul byas/ 2 dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa'i dpon dmag rdi rang sa khongs sprang nang tsho drug dang / rong nang stod smad du 'ongs te bod kyi dpon rigs kyis khral bsdu bar bkag 'gog byas/ 2 bod zla 6tshes 11nyin dbyin ji'i rjes 'brangs pa gso skyong byed ched lha sar dbyin ji'i slob grwa btsugs/ bod kyi ser skya mi mang gis ngo /la mtha' gcig tu byas stabs yun ring ma song bar slob grwa kha 'thor du nga / spyi' 1947me phag 1 rgya gar rdi li gsar par bskong tshogs byas pa'i e sha ya'i gros tshogs thog bod sger btsan rgyal khab tu brtsis te gdan zhu byas te tshogs 'dur zhugs pa ma zad/ gangs ri dang seng ge rtags can gyi dar cha de bod kyi rgyal dar la rtsis te skyel grabs byed pa sogs kha bral gyi bya ba mang tsam spel bar go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs kho pa tsho'i dmigs yul bsgrub mi thub par ngo tsha kha skyengs kyi gnas su gyur/ 2 zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / lha klu che dbang rdo rjes bod dmag nyis brgya lhag tsam 'khrid de rwa sgreng dgon par rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes 'dzin bzung byed par bskyod/ 2 ser byesagrwa tshang gis rwa sgreng gi rgyab langs byas pa sogs la brten se ra dang / bod sa gnasasred gzhung bar dmag 'khrug langs/ 4 bod zla 2tshes /nyin bod dmag gis se ra blangs/ thengs 'dir se ra'i grwa pa dgu bcu lhag tsam bsad/grwa pa mang po rmas/ byed gte bcu phrag 'ga' zhig 'dzin bzung thog lha/shās

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus tasbu ra'i sgradabyangs/gcod drag po btang / skabs der bod dmag gi spyi khyab pa bka' blon ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas dgon pa'i gna' rdzas dang rgyu dngos la srung skyob gang legs gnang bas dgon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten dang rgyu dngos la skyon chag de tsam ma byung / 5 bod zla 2par rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rtse shar chen lcog tu bkrongs/ 6 bod zla 10par zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan dang / rim bzhi spom mda' yar 'phel/ zur khang mda' dpon sogs bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa zer ba sgrig 'dzugs bzos/sbyi lo 194/sa byi/ zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs bod kyi tshong don tshogs pa'i 'thus mi rnams nan cing du 'byor/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod du phyir log dgos pa'i bka' brda bslab bya ji ltar gnang yang kho pa tshos lkog tu a ri dang dbyin ji'i gzhung tshab la 'brel ba byas te shang kāng brgyud a ri dang / dbyin ji sogs rgyal khab khag la bskyod de kha bral gyi bya spyod mang tsam spel/bca 1949sa glangan 1 bod zla 1tshes /nyin dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i ngan skul 'og bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi lha sar bca' sdod don gcod khang phyir 'then dgos pa'i bka' phab pa dang / skyid 'dod slob grwar sgo dam brgyab/ bod sdod rgya rigs yongs rdzogs dang nang mi khag gcig phyir 'bud byas pa sogs bya spyod ngan pa mang tsam spel/ 2 bod zla rapar a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i so pa'i 'go gtso la'o 'ar thang mu si bod du btang / bod kyi mtho rim log spyod par ngan skul dang / deng rabs can gyi go mtshon mang du sprad de lkog g.yo'i bya ba mang tsam spel/ 2 spyi zla 10tshes 1nyin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis takā shāḥtang thog rgyal khab dbu brnyes par rten 'brel zhus pa dang / krung

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus kyi lo tshigs gal chen/dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan pa ma zad/bod gang myur bcing bkrol yong ba'i re 'dun zhu gnang mdzad/spyi lo 1950lcags stag 1 bod zla 7tshes 24nyin dge stag rin po che chab mdo sa khul du phebs te 'brel yod mtho rim mi snar dge bshad sdig bkrol yang yang gnang ba ma zad/ myur du tā la'i bla ma mjal te bod zhi ba'i bcing bkrol gtong lugs skor gros mol zhu dgos pa'i re ba bton/ 'on kyang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' bkod ltar/ mdo smad spyi khyab pa lha klu tshe dbang rdo rjes dge stag rin po cher khyed lha sar phebs mi chog la/ phyir log phebs na'ang mi 'grigs zhes zhus stabs bya thabs bral te mu mthud chab mdor bzhugs/ bod zla /tshes 22nyin dge stag sprul sku glo bur du dgongs pa rdzogs/ 2 zla 10tshes 7nyin mi dmangs bcing bkrol dmag bod bskyod dmag dpung gis chab mdor dpung 'jug byed 'go tshugs/ tshes 15nyin chab mdo yongs su blangs/ bod dmag dang yul dmag lnga stong bdun brgya so brgyad tsam rtsa gtor btang / 2 zla 10tshes 11nyin/ ta dang mda' dpon sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus 'go dmag dang bcas pas rmar khams su 'os langs byas/ 4 bod zla 4tshes 〈nyin/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos lugs gnyis kyi 'gan yongs su bzhes/stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab rgya mtsho srid blon dgongs pa zhus/ 5 bod zla 11tshes 11nyin/ mkhan chen blo bzang bkra shis dang / rtsis dpon klu khang ba tshe dbang rab brtan la srid tshab bsko gzhag dang / de 'phral tā la'i bla ma sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas gro mor bros byol du phebs/byu lo 1951lcags yos/ 1 spyi zla 2par nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus/ thub bstan bstan dar/thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas ༵༵ sa

bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus ta ra'i sgra dbyangs/gnasasrid gzhung gi 'thus mi mi lnga pe cin du gtong gnang mdzad/ spyi zla 4par 'thus mi rnams snga rjes su pe cin du bde 'byor byung / spyi zla 4tshes 29nyin/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rnams zhi ba'i gros mol gnang 'go tshugs te/ spyi zla 5tshes 22nyin bod zhi ba'i bcing bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod/ 2 spyi zla 5tshes 24nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung mchog gis gsol ston gzab rgyas bshams te bod zhi ba'i bcing bkrol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod par rten 'brel zhu gnang mdzad/gsol ston thog kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis gsung bshad gnang ba ma zad/ paṇa chen er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med rnam gnyis nas snga rjes su gsung bshad gnang / 2 spyi zla 6tshes 12nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bod bzhugs sku tshab dmag dpon chen po krang cin u rgyal sa pe cin nas bod du thon/ 4 spyi zla 7tshes 14nyin dmag dpon chen po krang cin u gro mor 'byor/ tshes 17nyin gro mo dung dkar dgon du tā la'i bla ma dang mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma zad/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma zhig phul ba dang / mdza' mthun gyi gsung sol yun ring gnang / 5 spyi zla 〈tshes /nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sku tshab krang cin u zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa lha sar phebs/ bod sa gnasasrid gzhung gi ser skya dpon rigs khag dang / bod dmag rgya che'i ser skya mang tshogs bcas kyis bsu ba gzab rgyas zhus/ 6 spyi zla /tshes 17nyin/ tā la'i bla ma sku bcar zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa lha sar phebs 'byor mdzad/ 〉 spyi zla 10tshes 24nyin/ tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mardo ༵༵ga gis ma'o kru'u zhir tar yig phul te/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi

ser skya dpon rigs dang / mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis sems thag gtsang bcad kyis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la brtsi bkur zhu rgyu yin gsungs/ / spyi zla 10tshes 16nyin dmag dpon chen po krang go hwa dang /tha'an kon san rnam gnyis kyis sne 'khrid gnang ba'i bod bskyod mi dmangs bcing r+shakrol dmag lha sar 'byor/ 9 spyi zla 12tshes 19nyin/ paṇa chen er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan zi ling nas chibs kha bsgyur te bod du phebs/

hā/gi/'gashā'agyu pa/ da/sdu'ahās/bsamak+ṣiṃ/bod kyi nye rabs lo rgyus taspru ra'i sgra dbyangs/〉〉 =/tsha kha/na/ spyoXstun+tirji/rte/mis kha/pe/ 1/dzo 54// ༷kyi hrīḥshār+sā hwas kha/|/ shrī/rna mkham :triḥ'atsho/stu/732sdu/ stu sgrig mangs/ snyu/ghā ༵༵༵༵bstuXchi/4brgyab////nga//8/—7—055 ༷/738—875 495 bodaslo
